papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：卤化物有序化对混合卤化物钙钛矿的结构相稳定性有强烈影响：所有三种二元卤化物体系均存在混溶间隙，其范围与卤素离子尺寸失配相关；在混溶间隙以上温度（200 K 至 500 K），所有体系倾向于层状卤化物有序化，卤素优先占据八面体的顶点或赤道位置；在 CsPbBr3yI3-3y 中，这种有序化与结构相变相关联，使相变温度相对于随机混合结构偏移最多达 100 K，并解释了实验观测到的正交-四方相边界非线性组分依赖关系（先线性下降后出现平台）；在 A 位引入 Rb 会削弱卤化物有序化并消除非线性行为，同时缩小 Br-I 和 Br-Cl 体系的混溶间隙。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但可归纳为：通过 MLIPs 驱动的大规模混合 MC-MD 模拟，首次系统揭示了卤化物有序化对混合卤化物钙钛矿结构相变的强影响，并将实验观测到的正交-四方相边界非线性组分依赖关系归因于卤化物有序化，同时阐明了 A 位 Rb 掺杂对卤化物有序化和混溶间隙的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）参考数据训练机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），并利用其进行大规模混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学（hybrid Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics）模拟，以同时采样构型自由度和振动自由度。

papers.title: Configurational-space separation and structure selection in three hard squares
papers.abstract: Self-assembly of hard particles with diverse shapes gives rise to a rich variety of structures through excluded-volume constraints alone. Here we show that even a minimal system of three hard squares confined in a two-dimensional periodic box exhibits nontrivial configurational behavior relevant to structure selection. As the packing fraction increases, radial distribution functions obtained from Markov-chain Monte Carlo and uniform non-overlapping insertion sampling agree at low densities, deviate markedly over an intermediate range, and converge again at higher densities. Pressure measurements provide strong numerical evidence that the discrepancy originates from the separation of the allowed configurational space into two disconnected regions above a characteristic density. We identify the separation density as $φ_{\rm sep}=3/5$, construct explicit overlap-free transition pathways connecting the two regions immediately below it, and quantify their relative configurational-space volumes. At higher packing fractions, an approximately L-shaped arrangement of the particle centers becomes strongly favored over a staggered one, revealing a structural motif characteristic of tetratic and square-lattice ordering in larger hard-square systems. These results show that excluded-volume geometry can govern both configurational connectivity and local structure selection even in a three-particle system, revealing how signatures of many-particle self-assembly can already emerge in the few-particle limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：Markov-chain Monte Carlo、uniform non-overlapping insertion sampling、压力测量、数值证据（numerical evidence）。；研究对象：三个硬方块（hard squares）限制在二维周期性盒子中的最小体系，研究其构型空间行为与结构选择现象，涉及排除体积约束下的自组装、构型空间连通性以及局部结构有序化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当堆积分数增加超过特征密度 φ_sep = 3/5 时，允许的构型空间分裂为两个不连通区域，导致径向分布函数在中间密度区间出现显著偏差；在更高堆积分数下，粒子中心近似 L 形排列比交错排列更受青睐，呈现出与更大硬方块体系中四方（tetratic）和正方晶格有序相关的结构 motif。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当堆积分数增加超过特征密度 φ_sep = 3/5 时，允许的构型空间分裂为两个不连通区域，导致径向分布函数在中间密度区间出现显著偏差；在更高堆积分数下，粒子中心近似 L 形排列比交错排列更受青睐，呈现出与更大硬方块体系中四方（tetratic）和正方晶格有序相关的结构 motif。；创新点：首次在一个仅含三个硬方块的最小体系中揭示了排除体积几何可以同时主导构型连通性和局部结构选择，表明多粒子自组装的特征信号可以在少粒子极限中就已涌现。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Markov-chain Monte Carlo 模拟和均匀非重叠插入采样（uniform non-overlapping insertion sampling）计算径向分布函数；通过压力测量提供构型空间分离的数值证据；构建无重叠转变路径连接分离密度以下的两个区域，并量化其相对构型空间体积。

papers.title: Dimensional Control of Excitonic Interactions in Exfoliated 2D Molecular Crystals
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) materials provide unique opportunities to tailor excited-state properties through reduced dimensionality, altered dielectric screening and layer-dependent structural reconstruction. While such effects have been widely explored in norganic systems, their realization in molecular crystals has been limited by the difficulty of controlling thickness at the atomic scale while preserving crystalline order. Here we show that tetracene and three other molecular crystals can be mechanically exfoliated into mono-, few- or multilayer flakes, while retaining crystalline order. This capability enables new studies of molecular crystals across a well defined thickness range within the same structural organization. Thickness-dependent spectra of these samples reveal how out-of-plane confinement modifies the excited-state energy landscape of tetracene: With decreasing thickness, the Davydov splitting diminishes, the Stokes shift increases, and signatures of more delocalized excitons emerge. Electron diffraction and exciton model-based analyses correlate these trends to changes in molecular packing, intermolecular coupling and dielectric screening. Our results also demonstrate that key features of molecular excitons can be systematically tuned by layer number, extending dimensional control from inorganic 2D materials to molecular crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中明确使用“mechanically exfoliated”“Thickness-dependent spectra”“Electron diffraction”等实验手段描述，并基于实验数据进行模型分析，属于以实验为主的工作。；研究对象：可机械剥离的二维分子晶体，具体包括并四苯（tetracene）及另外三种分子晶体；研究其在单层、少层到多层厚度下的激子相互作用与激发态性质，以及层数依赖的Davydov分裂、Stokes位移和激子离域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着并四苯厚度减小，Davydov分裂减弱、Stokes位移增大，并出现更离域化激子的特征；这些趋势可归因于分子堆积、分子间耦合和介电屏蔽随层数的变化。该工作表明分子激子的关键特征可通过层数系统调控，将维度调控从无机二维材料拓展到分子晶体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着并四苯厚度减小，Davydov分裂减弱、Stokes位移增大，并出现更离域化激子的特征；这些趋势可归因于分子堆积、分子间耦合和介电屏蔽随层数的变化。该工作表明分子激子的关键特征可通过层数系统调控，将维度调控从无机二维材料拓展到分子晶体。；创新点：首次（据摘要表述）实现并四苯等分子晶体的机械剥离，并在保持晶体有序的前提下获得单层至多层可控厚度的薄片，从而在相同结构组织内系统研究分子晶体的厚度依赖激发态性质；将二维材料的维度调控概念拓展到分子晶体体系。
papers.method_zh: 采用机械剥离法制备单层、少层和多层分子晶体薄片；通过厚度依赖的光谱测量（摘要未明确说明具体光谱类型）研究激发态性质；利用电子衍射表征结构，并结合基于激子模型的分析，将光谱趋势与分子堆积、分子间耦合及介电屏蔽变化关联。

papers.title: Apparent Zero-Momentum Signals from Magnon--Magnon Interference in Near-Field Spin-Wave Imaging
papers.abstract: Spatially resolved measurements of coherent waves are commonly read as direct maps of the underlying eigenmode spectrum. We show that this interpretation fails in near-field imaging of multimode spin-wave transport. Scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry of yttrium iron garnet reveals pronounced apparent low-wave-vector signals at frequencies for which no propagating spin-wave mode exists. By tuning the probe-sample distance and modeling the anisotropic near-field response, we identify their origin as coherent mixing between directly excited Damon-Eshbach waves and defect- or transducer-scattered spin waves: the measured signal acquires spatial Fourier components at the difference wave vector $\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{exc}}-\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{scat}}$, which can vanish even though both constituent waves carry finite momentum. These results establish that near-field spectra of coherent excitations are interferometric field spectra rather than eigenmode maps, providing both a caution and a framework for identifying scattering processes in nanoscale magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模）。关键依据：扫描氮-空位磁测量（scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry）实验观测 + 各向异性近场响应建模。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（yttrium iron garnet, YIG）中的多模自旋波输运及其近场成像；具体现象为近场自旋波成像中出现的表观零动量（低波矢）信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 近场自旋波成像中观测到的表观低波矢信号并非真实存在的传播自旋波模式，而是直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射的自旋波之间的相干混合所致：测量信号在差波矢 $\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{exc}}-\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{scat}}$ 处获得空间傅里叶分量，该分量即使两列组成波均携带有限动量也可以消失。因此相干激发的近场谱是干涉场谱，而非本征模式图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：近场自旋波成像中观测到的表观低波矢信号并非真实存在的传播自旋波模式，而是直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射的自旋波之间的相干混合所致：测量信号在差波矢 $\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{exc}}-\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{scat}}$ 处获得空间傅里叶分量，该分量即使两列组成波均携带有限动量也可以消失。因此相干激发的近场谱是干涉场谱，而非本征模式图。；创新点：揭示了近场自旋波成像中"表观零动量信号"的干涉起源，纠正了将空间分辨相干波测量直接解读为本征模式谱的常见误解，并为纳米尺度磁振子器件中识别散射过程提供了警示与理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 扫描氮-空位（NV）磁测量术对钇铁石榴石进行空间分辨测量；通过调节探针-样品距离并建立各向异性近场响应模型来识别信号来源。

papers.title: Quantifying cell shape and density fluctuations in epithelial tissue in vivo
papers.abstract: Controlling changes in cell shape are crucial for many biological processes, such as tissue development and wound healing. Tissues typically are heterogeneous with a variety of cell shapes and sizes. Of particular interest are local deviations from an average cell shape and size. These fluctuations may extend and transmit across tissues, potentially offering valuable insights into tissue characteristics such as variations in effective "stiffness" or rigidity. In this study, we present a theoretical framework that captures the dynamics of epithelial cell shapes within tissue, incorporating both their average behaviour and fluctuation patterns. We model cells as interacting soft ellipsoids of varying size and aspect ratio. Coarse-graining our model, we obtain a set of continuum stochastic differential equations from which we derive spatial-temporal correlation functions. These correlation functions fit with our experimental data from the developmental process of the \textit{Drosophila} pupal wing. From the correlation functions, critical parameters representing active cell shape changes and effective tissue "stiffness" can be determined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含与实验数据对比）。判断依据的关键词：theoretical framework、model cells as interacting soft ellipsoids、coarse-graining、continuum stochastic differential equations、derive spatial-temporal correlation functions、fit with our experimental data。摘要以理论建模为主，实验数据用于验证拟合，故归为理论文章（混合倾向但以理论为核心）。；研究对象：上皮组织（epithelial tissue）中细胞形状与密度的涨落，具体体系为果蝇蛹翅（Drosophila pupal wing）发育过程中的上皮细胞。研究现象为细胞形状/尺寸相对平均值的局域偏离及其在组织中的传播，以及由此反映的有效组织“刚度”或刚性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了一个可同时描述上皮细胞平均行为与涨落模式的理论框架，并由此导出时空关联函数；这些关联函数能拟合果蝇蛹翅发育的实验数据，从中可确定表征活性细胞形状变化和有效组织“刚度”的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了一个可同时描述上皮细胞平均行为与涨落模式的理论框架，并由此导出时空关联函数；这些关联函数能拟合果蝇蛹翅发育的实验数据，从中可确定表征活性细胞形状变化和有效组织“刚度”的关键参数。；创新点：提出了一个统一刻画上皮细胞形状平均行为与涨落动力学的理论框架，并通过粗粒化得到连续随机微分方程及可解析的时空关联函数，进而从关联函数中提取活性细胞形状变化与有效组织“刚度”的关键参数，且能与活体实验数据定量拟合。
papers.method_zh: 将细胞建模为大小和长宽比可变的相互作用软椭球体（interacting soft ellipsoids）；对模型进行粗粒化（coarse-graining），得到一组连续随机微分方程，并由此推导时空关联函数；再与果蝇蛹翅发育的实验数据进行拟合。

papers.title: Photo-induced Wavelength-tuning of Telecom-band Quantum Dot Nanowires Embedded in a Phase Change Material
papers.abstract: Scalable quantum-photonic technologies require spatially separated emitters to emit at the same wavelength, yet epitaxially grown quantum dots naturally exhibit emitter-to-emitter variations in their emission energies. Here, we demonstrate a contact-free post-growth tuning approach for InAs quantum dots embedded in InP nanowires using the photo-induced transformation of an amorphous Sb2S3 shell. This photoinduced effect leads to a progressive relaxation of the strain imposed on the InP core, enabling controlled spectral tuning of the quantum-dot emission. The effect is observed both at room temperature and under cryogenic conditions for quantum dots emitting in the O-band of the telecommunications spectrum. Strain-induced redshifts of approximately 7 meV at room temperature and 28 meV under cryogenic conditions are observed, respectively. The use of an amorphous chalcogenide shell therefore provides a route to achieve local wavelength tuning at the single quantum-dot-in-a-nanowire level after growth. This approach could enable spectrally matched emitters for scalable quantum-photonic architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：demonstrate、photo-induced transformation、observed、spectral tuning 等，表明工作以实验观测与演示为主。；研究对象：嵌入非晶 Sb₂S₃ 壳层中的 InP 纳米线内的 InAs 量子点，研究其光致应变弛豫引起的量子点发光波长调谐现象，发光位于通信 O 波段。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用非晶 Sb₂S₃ 壳层的光致转变，可无接触地在生长后对 InP 纳米线中 InAs 量子点的发光进行可控光谱调谐；室温下观察到约 7 meV 的应变诱导红移，低温下约 28 meV。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用非晶 Sb₂S₃ 壳层的光致转变，可无接触地在生长后对 InP 纳米线中 InAs 量子点的发光进行可控光谱调谐；室温下观察到约 7 meV 的应变诱导红移，低温下约 28 meV。；创新点：提出并演示了一种利用非晶硫系化合物（Sb₂S₃）壳层的光致转变，在生长后实现单根纳米线中单个量子点局域波长调谐的无接触方法，为获得光谱匹配的可扩展量子光子发射器提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用非接触式（contact-free）生长后光致调谐方法，通过光照诱导非晶 Sb₂S₃ 壳层发生转变，使 InP 核所受应变逐步弛豫，从而调控量子点发光；在室温和低温条件下对通信 O 波段量子点发光进行光谱测量。摘要未明确说明具体使用的光谱设备或表征手段细节。

papers.title: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
papers.abstract: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate. We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only. On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Crystal structure prediction、generative models、MeanFlow、Transformer、MP-20 基准测试、CSPBench 评测。；研究对象：晶体结构预测（CSP）任务，即从化学组成出发预测稳定晶体结构；具体在 MP-20 数据集和 CSPBench 基准上评估，涉及结构匹配率、空间群一致率等指标。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: uFlowCSP 基于 MeanFlow 学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，可在 1–5 次网络评估内生成完整晶体结构，推理速度提升 5–58 倍，且在同等或更少评估次数下精度达到或超过 CrystalFlow、DiffCSP 等扩散/流匹配模型；其优势在于提升每次网络评估的精度，而非仅追求峰值精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：uFlowCSP 基于 MeanFlow 学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，可在 1–5 次网络评估内生成完整晶体结构，推理速度提升 5–58 倍，且在同等或更少评估次数下精度达到或超过 CrystalFlow、DiffCSP 等扩散/流匹配模型；其优势在于提升每次网络评估的精度，而非仅追求峰值精度。；创新点：首次将 MeanFlow 引入晶体结构预测，用平均速度替代瞬时速度，实现极少步数（1–5 步）高质量生成；训练时使用晶系 token 带来额外增益（尤其改善空间群一致性），但推理阶段不依赖该 token，保持仅需化学式的实用性；在评估效率与精度权衡上显著优于现有扩散/流匹配方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用 MeanFlow 生成模型框架，学习平均概率流速度；使用化学与对称性感知的 Transformer，结合规范原子排序、全局组成信息和逐 token 化学嵌入；训练时引入粗粒化晶系 token（推理时不使用，仅需化学式）；在 MP-20 上以每目标 20 个候选进行评估，并在 CSPBench 的能量排序前五结构-空间群准则下测试。

papers.title: Semi-Dirac States and Quantum Linear Magnetoresistance in Helimagnetic Pnictide MnP
papers.abstract: Large linear positive magnetoresistance (LPMR) in topological and magnetic materials remains a subject of intense debate, particularly in noncollinear spin systems where spin-dependent scattering complicates charge transport. Manganese phosphide (MnP), a helimagnetic binary pnictide with multiple field-induced magnetic transitions, provides a useful platform to investigate the interplay between complex magnetism and electronic topology. Here, we present a comprehensive experimental and theoretical investigation of phase-dependent magnetotransport in high-quality MnP single crystals. Hall measurements reveal an anomalous Hall effect dominated by skew scattering at high temperatures and a finite topological Hall effect in the noncollinear fan (FAN) and low-temperature screw (SCR) phases. At low temperatures, we observe a large, non-saturating LPMR reaching nearly 800 percent at 4 K and 15 T, with a pronounced linear field dependence in the field-polarized ferromagnetic (FM2) state. First-principles calculations reveal a strongly anisotropic semi-Dirac-like band at the Y point that progressively approaches the Fermi level from the SCR to FAN and FM2 states. Our analysis indicates that the resulting small Fermi pocket can access the extreme quantum-limit regime at experimentally accessible fields, providing a microscopic framework for the observed LPMR within Abrikosov's quantum magnetoresistance theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/理论）。判断依据关键词：论文摘要中明确提到“comprehensive experimental and theoretical investigation”，包含“Hall measurements”等实验手段与“First-principles calculations”等理论计算，且用Abrikosov量子磁阻理论框架解释实验结果。；研究对象：螺旋磁性二元磷族化合物MnP（磷化锰）单晶，具有多重场诱导磁相变。具体研究其不同磁相（螺旋SCR相、扇FAN相、场极化铁磁FM2相）中的磁输运行为，特别是线性正磁阻（LPMR）和拓扑/反常霍尔效应，以及复杂磁性（非共线自旋）与电子拓扑之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MnP单晶中观察到低温下大且不饱和的线性正磁阻（4 K、15 T下接近800%），并在FAN相和SCR相中观察到有限拓扑霍尔效应；第一性原理计算揭示Y点存在强各向异性的半狄拉克型能带，该能带从SCR到FAN再到FM2态逐渐靠近费米能级，形成的小费米口袋可在实验可及磁场下进入极端量子极限区域，从而在Abrikosov量子磁阻理论框架内为观测到的LPMR提供了微观解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MnP单晶中观察到低温下大且不饱和的线性正磁阻（4 K、15 T下接近800%），并在FAN相和SCR相中观察到有限拓扑霍尔效应；第一性原理计算揭示Y点存在强各向异性的半狄拉克型能带，该能带从SCR到FAN再到FM2态逐渐靠近费米能级，形成的小费米口袋可在实验可及磁场下进入极端量子极限区域，从而在Abrikosov量子磁阻理论框架内为观测到的LPMR提供了微观解释。；创新点：在螺旋磁性磷族化合物MnP中建立了复杂非共线磁性、半狄拉克型电子拓扑与极端量子极限线性磁阻之间的微观联系；具体新意包括：在不同磁相中分辨出反常霍尔效应（高温偏斜散射主导）与拓扑霍尔效应（FAN和SCR相），并将半狄拉克型能带随磁相演化趋近费米能级与实验可及的量子极限LPMR联系起来。摘要未明确说明与已有研究相比的具体增量细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：对高质量MnP单晶进行霍尔测量（Hall measurements）和磁输运测量（magnetotransport），覆盖不同磁相和温度/磁场范围。计算/理论方面：第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）揭示能带结构（半狄拉克型色散）；理论分析采用Abrikosov量子磁阻理论框架解释LPMR。摘要未明确说明第一性原理计算是否包含DFT+U等具体泛函细节。

papers.title: Facile hBN-hBN Interfacial Overlap Engineering for Enhanced Quantum Emitter Formation
papers.abstract: Quantum emitters in two-dimensional materials, particularly hBN, are promising platforms for quantum technologies. However, achieving high-density emitters at predetermined locations while preserving optical quality remains challenging. Here, we introduce a facile, cost-effective double-layer all-dry transfer approach to deterministically create overlap regions between hBN flakes. These pre-defined capped regions exhibit a significantly enhanced emitter density, with up to a 15-fold increase compared to uncapped areas. Importantly, this method does not compromise emitter quality: emitters within overlap regions demonstrate excellent optical performance, including high signal-to-background and signal-to-noise ratios, large Debye-Waller factors, high brightness, and strong spectral stability. Possible defect configurations are also discussed to contextualize the observed emission characteristics. This scalable strategy enables preferential formation of quantum emitters in targeted regions, achieving higher densities than simple treatments such as plasma irradiation while avoiding the complexity of advanced fabrication techniques. The approach provides a practical pathway for integrating high-quality quantum emitters into scalable quantum photonic platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中描述的是“double-layer all-dry transfer approach”（双层全干法转移方法）、“pre-defined capped regions”（预定义覆盖区域）、“emitter density”（发射体密度）、“optical performance”（光学性能）等实验制备与表征相关术语，未涉及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：二维材料（特别是hBN）中的量子发射体，具体为hBN薄片之间的界面重叠区域及其对量子发射体形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过双层全干法转移在hBN薄片间确定性构建重叠区域，可使发射体密度相比未覆盖区域提升高达15倍，且不损害发射体光学质量（高信噪比、大Debye-Waller因子、高亮度、强光谱稳定性）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过双层全干法转移在hBN薄片间确定性构建重叠区域，可使发射体密度相比未覆盖区域提升高达15倍，且不损害发射体光学质量（高信噪比、大Debye-Waller因子、高亮度、强光谱稳定性）。；创新点：提出了一种简便、低成本的双层全干法转移方法，可在预定位置确定性形成hBN-hBN重叠区域，从而实现量子发射体的优先高密度形成；相比等离子体辐照等简单处理可获得更高密度，同时避免了先进微纳加工技术的复杂性，且不牺牲发射体光学质量。
papers.method_zh: 采用简便、低成本的双层全干法转移（double-layer all-dry transfer）技术，在hBN薄片之间确定性创建重叠区域，并对这些预定义覆盖区域中的发射体进行光学性能表征（包括信号背景比、信噪比、Debye-Waller因子、亮度和光谱稳定性测量）。摘要未明确说明具体的光谱或显微表征设备型号。此外，摘要提到讨论了可能的缺陷构型以解释观测到的发射特征，但未说明具体采用何种计算方法。

papers.title: Morphology and depletion force-based large-scale self-assembly of nanocubes on surface
papers.abstract: Self-assembling nanoparticles is a highly efficient and facile way to form functional nano-, micro- and macrostructures. However, currently available methods lack precision and controllability in size, shape and composition, suffer from poor reproducibility and scalability, and require complex steps and expensive materials. Here, we present the uniform morphology-induced and depletion force-directed nanoparticle assembly on surface (MIDAS) method with gold nanocubes (AuNCs). Using this approach, morphology-sensitive depletion forces trigger shape-selective flocculation and assembly of the AuNCs with uniform size and shape. Importantly, the surface roughness-controlled substrate drives the large-scale formation of AuNC-assembled monolayers (2D AuNAMs) or three-dimensional AuNC-assembled multilayers (3D AuNAMs) in a highly specific manner without any complex ligand modification or preparation steps. Lattice-gas modeling and kinetic Monte Carlo simulations show the depletion force is the key parameter determining supercrystal morphology and corroborate the experimental findings. This work establishes a generalizable nanoparticle assembly mechanism and demonstrates the broad applicability of the MIDAS strategy for scalable fabrication and patterning of 2D and 3D nanoparticle architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算/理论）。判断依据关键词：实验方面有 gold nanocubes (AuNCs) 的组装、表面粗糙度控制基底驱动组装等；计算/理论方面有 lattice-gas modeling 和 kinetic Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：金纳米立方体（AuNCs）在表面上的自组装行为，具体包括二维 AuNC 组装单层（2D AuNAMs）和三维 AuNC 组装多层（3D AuNAMs）的形成，以及形貌敏感的耗尽力（depletion force）驱动的组装机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 形貌敏感的耗尽力可触发尺寸和形状均匀的 AuNCs 发生形状选择性絮凝和组装；基底表面粗糙度能够以高度特异的方式驱动大面积 2D 或 3D AuNC 组装结构的形成，且无需复杂配体修饰或制备步骤。耗尽力是决定超晶形貌的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：形貌敏感的耗尽力可触发尺寸和形状均匀的 AuNCs 发生形状选择性絮凝和组装；基底表面粗糙度能够以高度特异的方式驱动大面积 2D 或 3D AuNC 组装结构的形成，且无需复杂配体修饰或制备步骤。耗尽力是决定超晶形貌的关键参数。；创新点：提出了一种名为 MIDAS（uniform morphology-induced and depletion force-directed nanoparticle assembly on surface）的方法，利用形貌敏感的耗尽力实现形状选择性组装，并通过基底表面粗糙度控制实现大面积 2D 或 3D 纳米颗粒架构的制备，无需复杂配体修饰或昂贵材料，具有可扩展性和通用性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用金纳米立方体（AuNCs）进行表面组装，通过控制基底表面粗糙度实现 2D 或 3D 组装；理论上采用 lattice-gas modeling 和 kinetic Monte Carlo simulations 进行模拟，验证实验结果并确定耗尽力为决定超晶形貌的关键参数。

papers.title: Orbital-selective electronic modes induced by doping and originating from distinct spin excitations: an essential feature of orbital-selective Mott transition
papers.abstract: The nature of the orbital-selective Mott transition (OSMT) remains elusive. This study shows that, by doping an orbitally degenerate spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulator in the Kanamori-Hubbard model, electronic modes emerge in the band gap in an orbital-selective manner, exhibiting momentum-shifted spin-mode dispersion relations. Electronic modes originating from conventional spin excitations, including the low-energy one, appear in the doped orbital, while those from inter-orbital spin excitations appear in the undoped orbital. These emergent modes constitute an essential feature of the OSMT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Kanamori-Hubbard model、orbitally degenerate spin-1 antiferromagnetic insulator、doping，摘要中未出现实验手段或第一性原理计算细节，属于模型理论研究。；研究对象：轨道选择性Mott转变（OSMT）的本质。具体体系为Kanamori-Hubbard模型中的轨道简并spin-1反铁磁绝缘体，通过掺杂研究其电子模式的出现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对轨道简并spin-1反铁磁绝缘体进行掺杂后，带隙中以轨道选择性方式涌现出电子模式，这些模式呈现动量偏移的spin-mode色散关系。来源于常规自旋激发（包括低能自旋激发）的电子模式出现在掺杂轨道中，而来源于轨道间自旋激发的电子模式出现在未掺杂轨道中。这些涌现模式构成了OSMT的本质特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对轨道简并spin-1反铁磁绝缘体进行掺杂后，带隙中以轨道选择性方式涌现出电子模式，这些模式呈现动量偏移的spin-mode色散关系。来源于常规自旋激发（包括低能自旋激发）的电子模式出现在掺杂轨道中，而来源于轨道间自旋激发的电子模式出现在未掺杂轨道中。这些涌现模式构成了OSMT的本质特征。；创新点：揭示了掺杂后带隙中轨道选择性涌现的电子模式及其与不同自旋激发的对应关系（掺杂轨道对应常规自旋激发，未掺杂轨道对应轨道间自旋激发），提出这些涌现模式是OSMT的本质特征，为理解OSMT的本质提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用Kanamori-Hubbard模型进行理论研究，对轨道简并spin-1反铁磁绝缘体进行掺杂。摘要未明确说明具体的数值方法或解析技术。

papers.title: Intermittent continuous-time random walks under renewal reset mechanism
papers.abstract: Stochastic resetting as a practical and efficient search strategy in complex and disordered environments has long been a topic of interest to researchers. Based on the competition between jumping and resetting, this article proposes and investigates intermittent continuous-time random walks (CTRWs) under stochastic resetting, using the smaller waiting time for jump and reset as the renewal time, where the waiting times for both jump and reset can have arbitrary distributions. After each renewal event, the system will proceed with new waiting times for jump and reset regardless of their previous histories. We study the governing equation and Montroll-Weiss equation with renewal resetting, as well as the Markovian resetting for intermittent CTRWs. We prove the existence of non-equilibrium stationary states within the renewal reset mechanism when the jump and reset waiting times follow any exponential and power law distributions. For exponential and Gaussian distributed jump lengths, we examine the mean square displacements (MSDs) of particles to determine their monotonicity and asymptotic stability. Moreover, we calculate the first-arrival time to quantify search efficiency, and validate the intermittent CTRWs under renewal resetting lead to a finite mean first-arrival time (MFAT) to any fixed position for exponential jump and reset waiting time distributions (WTDs), power-law jump and exponential reset WTDs, as well as exponential jump and power-law reset WTDs. However, the MFAT diverges for power-law jump and reset WTDs. The intermittent CTRW model, which is based on the competition mechanism, can be applied to many physical scenarios, such as the foraging strategy of animals that return to their nests after an unsuccessful foraging attempt, or the work planning of intelligent robots that return to energy replenishment points after prolonged operation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：proposes and investigates、governing equation、Montroll-Weiss equation、prove the existence、calculate、validate——全文围绕模型构建与解析推导展开，摘要中未出现任何实验手段或数值模拟方法的描述。；研究对象：间歇性连续时间随机游走（intermittent continuous-time random walks, CTRWs）在随机重置（stochastic resetting）机制下的统计物理行为。具体研究跳跃与重置竞争过程中粒子的扩散、均方位移、非平衡稳态及首次到达时间等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文证明了在更新重置机制下，当跳跃和重置等待时间服从任意指数分布和幂律分布时，系统存在非平衡稳态；并发现对于指数跳跃/重置等待时间分布、幂律跳跃/指数重置分布以及指数跳跃/幂律重置分布，间歇性CTRW导致到达任意固定位置的有限平均首次到达时间（MFAT），而当跳跃和重置等待时间均为幂律分布时MFAT发散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文证明了在更新重置机制下，当跳跃和重置等待时间服从任意指数分布和幂律分布时，系统存在非平衡稳态；并发现对于指数跳跃/重置等待时间分布、幂律跳跃/指数重置分布以及指数跳跃/幂律重置分布，间歇性CTRW导致到达任意固定位置的有限平均首次到达时间（MFAT），而当跳跃和重置等待时间均为幂律分布时MFAT发散。；创新点：提出了基于跳跃与重置竞争机制的间歇性CTRW模型，采用跳跃和重置中较小的等待时间作为更新时间，且允许跳跃和重置等待时间服从任意分布；在此框架下证明了更新重置机制中非平衡稳态的存在性，并系统分析了不同等待时间分布组合下MFAT的有限性与发散条件。摘要未突出说明与已有CTRW或随机重置模型的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：构建以跳跃和重置中较小等待时间作为更新时间的间歇性CTRW模型；推导含更新重置的支配方程和Montroll-Weiss方程，以及间歇性CTRW的马尔可夫重置情形；对指数和高斯跳跃步长分布计算均方位移（MSD）以判定单调性和渐近稳定性；计算首次到达时间以量化搜索效率。

papers.title: Fractional Chern Insulators in Twisted Bilayer Optical Lattices
papers.abstract: Twisted bilayer materials provide a versatile platform for realizing novel topological states. Motivated by recent experimental realization of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates in twisted bilayer optical lattices, we theoretically investigate topological states for cold atoms trapped in such a system. At single-particle level, the system hosts nearly flat moiré bands under appropriate experimental parameters. Although these noninteracting bands are topologically trivial in the Altland-Zirnbauer classification, we find that atomic interactions can induce a flat Chern band based on self-consistent Hartree-Fock calculations. Furthermore, exact diagonalization identifies a fractional Chern insulator phase at fractional filling. Our work thus paves the way for exploring strongly correlated topological phases in highly tunable twisted bilayer optical lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：theoretically investigate、self-consistent Hartree-Fock calculations、exact diagonalization。；研究对象：冷原子在扭转双层光学晶格中的体系，具体研究其莫尔平带及相互作用诱导的拓扑态，包括分数量子陈绝缘体相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在适当的实验参数下，单粒子层面体系具有近简并的莫尔平带，但这些非相互作用能带在Altland-Zirnbauer分类中是拓扑平庸的；原子间相互作用可以通过自洽Hartree-Fock计算诱导出平的陈能带，并且精确对角化在分数填充下确认了分数量子陈绝缘体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在适当的实验参数下，单粒子层面体系具有近简并的莫尔平带，但这些非相互作用能带在Altland-Zirnbauer分类中是拓扑平庸的；原子间相互作用可以通过自洽Hartree-Fock计算诱导出平的陈能带，并且精确对角化在分数填充下确认了分数量子陈绝缘体相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自洽Hartree-Fock计算和精确对角化（exact diagonalization）。

papers.title: Record-Breaking Elemental Superconductivity in Tetralayer Kagome Borophene
papers.abstract: Superconductivity above the liquid-nitrogen temperature remains rare in two-dimensional elemental crystals, where strong covalent bonding often yields high phonon frequencies but insufficient electron-phonon coupling. Here, using first-principles calculations and fully anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory, we predict tetralayer kagome borophene (TKB) stabilized by ABAB covalent stacking, as a liquid-nitrogen-temperature elemental superconductor. With a predicted critical temperature of 102 K, TKB sets a record-high value among previously reported elemental superconductors. Unlike known high-Tc boron-based superconductors dominated by in-plane sigma-bonding states and high-frequency in-plane B-B stretching modes, TKB realizes an out-of-plane s-pz-bonding-mediated pairing mechanism, in which interlayer s-pz bonding states at the Fermi level are strongly coupled to low-frequency out-of-plane vibrations of boron atoms. These results reveal a distinct out-of-plane pairing channel in multilayer borophene and establish covalent stacking engineering as a potential route for high-Tc superconductivity in two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations、fully anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory、predict。；研究对象：四层Kagome硼烯（tetralayer kagome borophene, TKB），一种由ABAB共价堆叠稳定的二维元素晶体，研究其超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TKB被预测为临界温度102 K的元素超导体，创下已报道元素超导体的最高Tc纪录；其配对机制不同于已知硼基高温超导体（由面内σ键态和高频面内B-B伸缩模式主导），而是由面外s-pz键介导，费米能级处的层间s-pz键态与硼原子的低频面外振动强烈耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TKB被预测为临界温度102 K的元素超导体，创下已报道元素超导体的最高Tc纪录；其配对机制不同于已知硼基高温超导体（由面内σ键态和高频面内B-B伸缩模式主导），而是由面外s-pz键介导，费米能级处的层间s-pz键态与硼原子的低频面外振动强烈耦合。；创新点：首次预测四层Kagome硼烯为液氮温区元素超导体（Tc = 102 K），刷新元素超导体Tc纪录；揭示了多层硼烯中一种独特的面外配对通道（层间s-pz键态与低频面外振动耦合），并提出了共价堆叠工程（covalent stacking engineering）作为二维材料高温超导的潜在途径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合全各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg理论（fully anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory）。

papers.title: A discrete Stiefel-Whitney invariant with twofold rotation symmetry
papers.abstract: We review Stiefel--Whitney invariants and give a discrete formulation of an additional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant for two-dimensional spinful insulators with twofold rotation and time-reversal symmetries (layer group $p1121'$). A singular gauge transformation specifies a real bundle over the quotient of the Brillouin torus, whose second Stiefel--Whitney number defines the invariant. We derive its dependence on the choice of auxiliary gauge function and prove invariance under changes of Bloch frame and additivity under direct sums. The discrete formula uses overlaps of independently chosen Bloch frames and symmetry-compatible $\mathrm{Pin}_+$ lifts on the boundary of a half Brillouin zone. Atomic and topological-insulator models illustrate the formula and distinguish the additional invariant from the Kane--Mele index. Together with three quantized $\mathbb{Z}_2$ partial polarizations and the filling number, it labels the known stable classification $\mathbb{Z}\oplus\mathbb{Z}_2^{\oplus 4}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“review Stiefel–Whitney invariants”“give a discrete formulation”“derive its dependence”“prove invariance”“discrete formula”等表述，属于理论推导与公式构建，未涉及实验或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：具有二重旋转对称性和时间反演对称性的二维自旋绝缘体（layer group \(p1121'\)），以及其中区别于 Kane–Mele 指标的额外 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 拓扑不变量；并用原子模型和拓扑绝缘体模型进行说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者给出了该二维自旋绝缘体中一个额外 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 不变量的离散表述：通过奇异规范变换在布里渊环面商空间上构造实丛，其第二 Stiefel–Whitney 数定义该不变量；该不变量与 Kane–Mele 指标不同，并与三个量子化 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 部分极化及填充数一起标记已知稳定分类 \(\mathbb{Z}\oplus\mathbb{Z}_2^{\oplus 4}\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者给出了该二维自旋绝缘体中一个额外 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 不变量的离散表述：通过奇异规范变换在布里渊环面商空间上构造实丛，其第二 Stiefel–Whitney 数定义该不变量；该不变量与 Kane–Mele 指标不同，并与三个量子化 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 部分极化及填充数一起标记已知稳定分类 \(\mathbb{Z}\oplus\mathbb{Z}_2^{\oplus 4}\)。；创新点：主要新意在于为 layer group \(p1121'\) 的二维自旋绝缘体给出了一个额外 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 不变量的离散 Stiefel–Whitney 表述，并证明其规范与框架性质、直和可加性；同时用原子和拓扑绝缘体模型说明该不变量，并将其与 Kane–Mele 指标区分开来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为 Stiefel–Whitney 不变量、奇异规范变换、布里渊环面商空间上的实丛、第二 Stiefel–Whitney 数；推导该不变量对辅助规范函数选择的依赖，并证明其在 Bloch 框架变换下的不变性和直和下的可加性；离散公式使用独立选择的 Bloch 框架的重叠以及半布里渊区边界上对称兼容的 \(\mathrm{Pin}_+\) 提升。

papers.title: First-principles investigation of structural, mechanical, vibrational, thermal, electronic and optical properties of Na3Bi: a topological Dirac semimetal
papers.abstract: Exploring the properties of topological materials has remained an active area of research in condensed matter physics for the past few decades. Here, we present a first-principles investigation of the structural, elasto-mechanical, thermal, electronic, and optical properties of Na3Bi, one of the earliest discovered topological Dirac semimetals, using density functional theory. The hexagonal phase of Na3Bi is found to be both mechanically and dynamically stable, exhibiting moderate elastic anisotropy with a universal anisotropy index of 0.832. The compound displays a moderate machinability index of 2.386 alongside a low hardness value of 2.005, consistent with its predominantly brittle, covalently bonded character accompanied by a slight metallic contribution. Its comparatively low Debye temperature of 181.39K points to a mechanically soft lattice with loosely bound atoms. Electronic structure calculations confirm semimetallic behavior, with well-defined Dirac points pinned at the Fermi level and a Fermi surface composed of point-like pockets. Optical analysis across a wide spectral range reveals non-selective, moderate reflectivity of 40 to 45% and, in the visible region, an unusually high refractive index reaching between 2 and 4.5. Na3Bi is additionally found to be an efficient absorber of ultraviolet radiation. Together, these findings establish a comprehensive baseline for the mechanical, thermal, and optical behavior of hexagonal Na3Bi and point to its potential relevance for acoustic damping, UV-sensing, and optoelectronic applications
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles investigation、density functional theory（DFT）。；研究对象：拓扑狄拉克半金属 Na₃Bi 的六方相，具体研究其结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六方 Na₃Bi 在力学和动力学上均稳定，表现为以脆性共价键为主、伴有少量金属性贡献的特征；电子结构计算确认其半金属行为，狄拉克点钉扎在费米能级处，费米面由点状口袋组成；光学上具有40%–45%的非选择性中等反射率、可见光区高达2–4.5的异常高折射率，并且是高效的紫外吸收体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：六方 Na₃Bi 在力学和动力学上均稳定，表现为以脆性共价键为主、伴有少量金属性贡献的特征；电子结构计算确认其半金属行为，狄拉克点钉扎在费米能级处，费米面由点状口袋组成；光学上具有40%–45%的非选择性中等反射率、可见光区高达2–4.5的异常高折射率，并且是高效的紫外吸收体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但指出这些发现为六方 Na₃Bi 的力学、热学和光学行为建立了全面的基线，并指出其在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电子应用方面的潜在相关性。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，涵盖结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质的计算。摘要未明确说明具体使用的交换关联泛函或计算软件。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall Response Induced by Correlated Disorder in the Breathing Kagome Lattice Mn$_{3}$Sn
papers.abstract: Macroscopic transport tensors are generally constrained by the average crystallographic and magnetic symmetries of a material. In the kagome antiferromagnetic Weyl semimetals Mn$_{3+δ}X$ ($X=$~Sn or Ge), previous studies showed that the anomalous Hall conductivity $σ_{yx}$ is forbidden by the average \hexsg{} structure and coplanar inverse-triangular magnetic order. Here we report that nearly stoichiometric Mn$_3$Sn nevertheless exhibits a finite $σ_{yx}$ with large hysteresis, together with enhanced $σ_{zx}$ and $σ_{yz}$, in the inverse-triangular phase below $T_{\mathrm{N1}}\approx 440~\mathrm{K}$, whereas all AHE components vanish in the amplitude-modulated conical phase below $T_{\mathrm{N2}}\approx 280~\mathrm{K}$. Total scattering and magnetic pair distribution function analysis reveal correlated orthorhombic distortions and noncoplanar Mn moments. First-principles calculations show that this coupled lattice-spin distortion activates the average symmetry forbidden $σ_{yx}$ within the inverse-triangular phase. Its disappearance below $T_{\mathrm{N2}}$ indicates that the correlated disorder must cooperate with a long-range inverse-triangular antiferromagnetic order capable of supporting Berry curvature. Our results establish correlated disorder as an active symmetry-breaking degree of freedom that enables topological transport inaccessible from the Bragg-average structure alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算）。判断依据：摘要中既有实验观测（"we report that nearly stoichiometric Mn$_3$Sn nevertheless exhibits a finite $σ_{yx}$"），又有实验表征手段（"Total scattering and magnetic pair distribution function analysis"），还有第一性原理计算（"First-principles calculations show that..."）。；研究对象：近化学计量比的 Mn$_3$Sn 呼吸笼目晶格反铁磁外尔半金属，具体研究其在反三角磁相（$T < T_{\mathrm{N1}} \approx 440$ K）和振幅调制锥形磁相（$T < T_{\mathrm{N2}} \approx 280$ K）中的反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 近化学计量比 Mn$_3$Sn 在反三角相中尽管平均晶体结构和共面磁序对称性禁止 $σ_{yx}$，却表现出有限的反常霍尔电导 $σ_{yx}$（伴随大磁滞）以及增强的 $σ_{zx}$ 和 $σ_{yz}$；而在 $T_{\mathrm{N2}}$ 以下的锥形相中所有 AHE 分量消失。关联无序（正交畸变与非共面 Mn 磁矩）与长程反三角反铁磁序协同作用，打破了平均对称性限制，激活了拓扑输运响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：近化学计量比 Mn$_3$Sn 在反三角相中尽管平均晶体结构和共面磁序对称性禁止 $σ_{yx}$，却表现出有限的反常霍尔电导 $σ_{yx}$（伴随大磁滞）以及增强的 $σ_{zx}$ 和 $σ_{yz}$；而在 $T_{\mathrm{N2}}$ 以下的锥形相中所有 AHE 分量消失。关联无序（正交畸变与非共面 Mn 磁矩）与长程反三角反铁磁序协同作用，打破了平均对称性限制，激活了拓扑输运响应。；创新点：此前研究认为 Mn$_{3+\delta}X$ 中 $σ_{yx}$ 被平均六方结构和共面反三角磁序所禁止，本工作首次实验证明近化学计量比 Mn$_3$Sn 中仍存在有限 $σ_{yx}$，并揭示关联无序（正交畸变 + 非共面磁矩）作为一种主动的对称性破缺自由度，能够激活平均结构所禁止的拓扑输运；同时通过 $T_{\mathrm{N2}}$ 以下 AHE 的消失，表明该关联无序效应需要与能支撑贝里曲率的长程反三角反铁磁序协同才能实现。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：输运测量（霍尔电导 $σ_{yx}$、$σ_{zx}$、$σ_{yz}$ 的测量）、总散射（total scattering）和磁对分布函数（magnetic pair distribution function）分析。计算方面：第一性原理计算（具体泛函/方法摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Automated Generation of Commensurate Magnetic Structures based on Spin Space Groups and Graph Theory
papers.abstract: Magnetic structures with symmetry constraints are candidates for energetically favorable configurations. Enumerating these structures is essential for identifying experimental observations and provides unbiased, linearly stable, and optimally sampled reference configurations for energy fitting when extracting spin interactions. We present SpinGraph, an automated workflow generating symmetry-distinct magnetic configurations. SpinGraph is not only compatible with the more general spin space groups, but also allows precise control of the prescribed single- or multi-Q states superposition. For finite groups, we enumerate compatible subgroups directly. For spin space groups with a continuous or special spin-only part, the finite component is enumerated first and then combined with the compatible exact spin-only constraints. These actions are translated into graph constraints in real or Fourier space. The symmetry of every generated structure is re-evaluated after construction. Finally, we integrate SpinGraph with the magnetic analysis code AMATIS to perform a thorough calculation for the spin interactions of the insulating monolayer CrI3. SpinGraph complements the last part of AMATIS and realizes the fully automated workflow for the spin Hamiltonian construction, which is essential for studying phase transitions, spin textures, magnons, and spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（方法学工具开发为主，附带对具体材料的计算示例）。判断依据的关键词：automated workflow、enumerate、graph constraints、integrate with AMATIS、spin Hamiltonian construction。；研究对象：受对称性约束的磁结构（commensurate magnetic structures）的枚举与生成；具体应用示例为绝缘单层 CrI3 的自旋相互作用计算。涉及自旋空间群（spin space groups）、单Q/多Q态叠加、磁相变、自旋织构、磁振子、自旋动力学等相关物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了名为 SpinGraph 的自动化工作流，能够生成对称性上可区分的磁构型，兼容更一般的自旋空间群，并可精确控制单Q或多Q态叠加；将其与 AMATIS 集成后，实现了自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动化流程，并对单层 CrI3 完成了自旋相互作用的完整计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了名为 SpinGraph 的自动化工作流，能够生成对称性上可区分的磁构型，兼容更一般的自旋空间群，并可精确控制单Q或多Q态叠加；将其与 AMATIS 集成后，实现了自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动化流程，并对单层 CrI3 完成了自旋相互作用的完整计算。；创新点：现有枚举方法多局限于传统空间群或难以精确控制多Q态叠加；SpinGraph 的 new 之处在于兼容更一般的自旋空间群、可精确控制单Q/多Q态叠加、通过图论在实空间或傅里叶空间实现约束枚举，并与 AMATIS 互补形成自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动化工作流。
papers.method_zh: 基于自旋空间群与图论的枚举方法：对有限群直接枚举兼容子群；对含连续或特殊纯自旋部分的自旋空间群，先枚举有限分量，再与兼容的精确纯自旋约束组合；这些操作被转化为实空间或傅里叶空间的图约束；每个生成结构的对称性在构建后重新评估。最后与磁分析代码 AMATIS 集成，对绝缘单层 CrI3 进行自旋相互作用计算。

papers.title: Microscopic Understanding of Thermal-magnon Transport in a Low-damping Ferrimagnetic Thin Films
papers.abstract: Thermally generated magnons enable heat-driven spin transport in magnetic insulators, yet the microscopic mechanisms governing their propagation remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate thermal magnon transport in low-damping Li$_{0.5}$Al$_{1.0}$Fe$_{1.5}$O$_4$/Pt nanodevices using a nonlocal spin Seebeck geometry that separates magnon transport from local thermoelectric effects. Thermal imaging establishes a detector region outside the thermal healing length, enabling intrinsic nonlocal measurements. We find that thermal magnon transport is strongly suppressed by magnetic fields far above saturation. Brillouin light scattering reveals that increasing field reduces the group velocity of backward volume magnons, providing a microscopic origin for the observed reduction in magnon spin diffusion length. We further find that thermal magnon transport decreases with increasing temperature despite an increasing magnon population. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce this behavior only when a temperature-dependent exchange stiffness is included. These results identify magnon group velocity and exchange stiffness as key parameters governing thermal magnon transport in ferrimagnetic thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（混合数值模拟）。判断依据的关键词：非局域自旋塞贝克几何测量、热成像、布里渊光散射（BLS）等实验手段为主，同时结合微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）辅助解释，但核心是实验研究。；研究对象：低阻尼亚铁磁绝缘体薄膜 Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt 纳米器件中的热致磁振子（thermal magnon）输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热磁振子输运在远高于饱和磁场下被强烈抑制，其微观起源是磁场增大降低了背向体磁振子（backward volume magnons）的群速度，从而缩短了磁振子自旋扩散长度；此外，热磁振子输运随温度升高而减弱，这一行为只有在引入温度依赖的交换刚度后才能被微磁学模拟重现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热磁振子输运在远高于饱和磁场下被强烈抑制，其微观起源是磁场增大降低了背向体磁振子（backward volume magnons）的群速度，从而缩短了磁振子自旋扩散长度；此外，热磁振子输运随温度升高而减弱，这一行为只有在引入温度依赖的交换刚度后才能被微磁学模拟重现。；创新点：通过非局域自旋塞贝克几何结合热成像，实现了将磁振子输运与局域热电势效应的分离，从而获得本征非局域测量；首次将磁场对热磁振子输运的抑制归因于背向体磁振子群速度的降低，并识别出磁振子群速度和交换刚度为调控亚铁磁薄膜中热磁振子输运的关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 采用非局域自旋塞贝克几何（nonlocal spin Seebeck geometry）将磁振子输运与局域热电势效应分离；利用热成像确定探测器区域位于热愈合长度之外以实现本征非局域测量；使用布里渊光散射（BLS）测量磁振子群速度；结合微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）并引入温度依赖的交换刚度进行对比分析。

papers.title: Geodesic Trapping and Escape of Active Particles on Curved Surfaces
papers.abstract: Active particles on curved surfaces can become trapped along closed geodesics even without physical barriers. We show that escape from these geometric traps exposes a fundamental distinction between continuous and discrete reorientation. At high Péclet numbers, active Brownian particles escape efficiently through rotational diffusion, whereas run-and-tumble particles remain trapped much longer; at low Péclet numbers, both reduce to passive diffusion. Gaussian curvature controls escape by focusing or defocusing neighboring geodesics, producing distinct asymptotic scalings of the mean exit time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中讨论的是“active Brownian particles”与“run-and-tumble particles”的模型对比、Péclet 数依赖关系、渐近标度等，属于理论/模型分析，未提及具体实验或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：弯曲表面上的活性粒子（active particles），特别是其在无物理势垒情况下沿闭合测地线（closed geodesics）被捕获与逃逸的现象，以及连续与离散重取向机制对逃逸行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弯曲表面上的活性粒子可沿闭合测地线形成几何陷阱；逃逸行为在高 Péclet 数下区分连续与离散重取向：活性布朗粒子通过旋转扩散高效逃逸，而 run-and-tumble 粒子被困更久；低 Péclet 数下两者都退化为被动扩散。高斯曲率通过聚焦或散焦邻近测地线控制逃逸，并导致平均逃逸时间出现不同的渐近标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弯曲表面上的活性粒子可沿闭合测地线形成几何陷阱；逃逸行为在高 Péclet 数下区分连续与离散重取向：活性布朗粒子通过旋转扩散高效逃逸，而 run-and-tumble 粒子被困更久；低 Péclet 数下两者都退化为被动扩散。高斯曲率通过聚焦或散焦邻近测地线控制逃逸，并导致平均逃逸时间出现不同的渐近标度。；创新点：揭示了弯曲表面上几何陷阱逃逸对连续与离散重取向机制的根本区分，并指出高斯曲率通过聚焦或散焦邻近测地线控制逃逸，产生不同的平均逃逸时间渐近标度。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段、计算方法或理论框架，仅从模型层面提及活性布朗粒子与 run-and-tumble 粒子的对比、Péclet 数分析、旋转扩散、测地线聚焦/散焦以及平均逃逸时间的渐近标度分析。

papers.title: Renewal process's guide to fractional Navier-Stokes equations
papers.abstract: The Navier-Stokes equations, which remain unsolved, are crucial equations in fluid mechanics. Discovering the solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations is one of the challenging Millennium problems. In 1900, Hilbert proposed a potential approach to tackle this problem by establishing the relationship between microscopic dynamics and the macroscopic continuum equations. The key bridge is the derivation of Boltzmann equation and the theory of probability. In this paper, we shall use the collision renewal process with arbitrarily distributed waiting times to derive the Boltzmann equation for the time evolution of the probability of the velocity and the displacement of the particle, based on which we prove that the renewal process with exponential collision waiting time is equivalent to the classical Navier-Stokes equations, and that with power-law waiting time is equivalent to the fractional Navier-Stokes equations. Since the collision renewal process with arbitrarily distributed waiting times is a random process and is easy to perform the stochastic simulations of trajectories to obtain the corresponding solution, we actually find a stochastic approach to solve the classical and fractional Navier-Stokes equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derive、prove、equivalent、stochastic approach，全文为数学/理论推导，无实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：Navier-Stokes 方程（经典与分数阶）的求解问题，以及碰撞更新过程（collision renewal process）与 Boltzmann 方程、Navier-Stokes 方程之间的等价关系。属于流体力学与概率论交叉的数学物理问题，而非具体材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者证明：具有指数型碰撞等待时间的更新过程等价于经典 Navier-Stokes 方程，而具有幂律等待时间的更新过程等价于分数阶 Navier-Stokes 方程；由此提供了一条通过随机模拟粒子轨迹来求解经典和分数阶 Navier-Stokes 方程的随机方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者证明：具有指数型碰撞等待时间的更新过程等价于经典 Navier-Stokes 方程，而具有幂律等待时间的更新过程等价于分数阶 Navier-Stokes 方程；由此提供了一条通过随机模拟粒子轨迹来求解经典和分数阶 Navier-Stokes 方程的随机方法。；创新点：将任意分布等待时间的碰撞更新过程与 Boltzmann 方程及（经典/分数阶）Navier-Stokes 方程建立等价关系，并据此提出用随机轨迹模拟求解 Navier-Stokes 方程的随机途径，延续了 Hilbert 关于从微观动力学推导宏观连续方程的思路。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为碰撞更新过程（collision renewal process），允许任意分布的等待时间；据此推导粒子速度与位移概率随时间演化的 Boltzmann 方程，再建立其与经典/分数阶 Navier-Stokes 方程的等价性。摘要提到该方法便于进行轨迹的随机模拟，但未给出具体数值实现细节。

papers.title: Eight-unit-cell electronic modulations in cuprates originating from local molecular orbitals
papers.abstract: The pair density wave (PDW) state with eight-unit-cell (8a0) periodicity has been widely regarded as the primary order in cuprates, yet its existence and origin remain subjects of intense debate. Using spectroscopic imaging scanning tunneling microscopy, we observe spatial modulations of the electronic states with approximately 8a0 periodicity in both the superconducting and insulating regimes of hole-doped Ca2CuO2Cl2 cuprate. We find that the 8a0 spatial patterns are generated by the formation of molecular orbitals by doped holes, which organize into 4a0*4a0 plaquettes as the basic unit. Our results identify the 4a0 molecular orbital as the fundamental electronic building block in cuprates, while the 8a0 PDW represents a spatial subharmonic that emerges at sufficiently high doping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：spectroscopic imaging scanning tunneling microscopy（谱学成像扫描隧道显微镜）、observe（观测）。；研究对象：空穴掺杂的铜氧化物超导体 Ca2CuO2Cl2，以及其中电子态的空间调制现象（8a0 周期性与 4a0 分子轨道斑块）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Ca2CuO2Cl2 的超导和绝缘区域均观测到约 8a0 周期的电子态空间调制；该 8a0 图案源于掺杂空穴形成的分子轨道，这些分子轨道组织成 4a0×4a0 斑块作为基本单元。4a0 分子轨道是铜氧化物中基本的电子构筑单元，而 8a0 配对密度波（PDW）是足够高掺杂下出现的空间次谐波。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Ca2CuO2Cl2 的超导和绝缘区域均观测到约 8a0 周期的电子态空间调制；该 8a0 图案源于掺杂空穴形成的分子轨道，这些分子轨道组织成 4a0×4a0 斑块作为基本单元。4a0 分子轨道是铜氧化物中基本的电子构筑单元，而 8a0 配对密度波（PDW）是足够高掺杂下出现的空间次谐波。；创新点：提出 8a0 PDW 并非铜氧化物的初级序，而是由 4a0 分子轨道（掺杂空穴形成的局域分子轨道，组织为 4a0×4a0 斑块）所衍生的空间次谐波，从而将 4a0 分子轨道确立为铜氧化物的基本电子构筑单元。
papers.method_zh: 谱学成像扫描隧道显微镜（spectroscopic imaging scanning tunneling microscopy）。

papers.title: Twist and strain identification in moiré heterostructures
papers.abstract: The geometrical and electronic properties of moiré materials are highly sensitive to the twist and strain in the samples due to the moiré magnifying effect. Accurate identification of twist and strain in moiré materials is therefore essential. In this work, we establish a general framework to extract the twist and strain configurations from moiré images with either atomic or moiré scale resolution. With only moiré-wavelength information, we show that there is a continuous family of possible twist and strain configurations, each one accounting for different orientations of the moiré pattern. To estimate the most likely twist-strain configuration, we discuss additional constraints and methods involving the minimum elastic energy and the electronic spectra. The minimum elastic energy, in particular, reflects that shear configurations become much more favorable as the strain increases. As an example of the developed methodology, we discuss the formation and identification of strained triangular moiré patterns. Our framework provides a comprehensive approach to identify the twist and strain configurations in systems with moiré-scale resolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：establish a general framework、we discuss additional constraints and methods、minimum elastic energy、electronic spectra。摘要中未提及具体实验测量或第一性原理计算，属于理论框架构建与方法论文章。；研究对象：莫尔异质结构（moiré heterostructures）中的扭转（twist）与应变（strain）构型识别问题，以及莫尔图像（原子尺度或莫尔尺度分辨率）的解读。具体示例涉及应变三角莫尔图案（strained triangular moiré patterns）的形成与识别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭莫尔波长信息，扭转与应变构型存在连续简并族，每种构型对应莫尔图案的不同取向；通过引入最小弹性能与电子谱等额外约束，可以估计最可能的扭转-应变构型。最小弹性能分析表明，随着应变增大，剪切（shear）构型变得更加有利。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭莫尔波长信息，扭转与应变构型存在连续简并族，每种构型对应莫尔图案的不同取向；通过引入最小弹性能与电子谱等额外约束，可以估计最可能的扭转-应变构型。最小弹性能分析表明，随着应变增大，剪切（shear）构型变得更加有利。；创新点：提出了从莫尔图像中系统提取扭转与应变构型的通用框架，明确指出了仅凭莫尔波长信息时存在的连续简并问题，并提出利用最小弹性能和电子谱作为额外约束来筛选最可能构型，同时揭示了剪切构型随应变增大而更有利的规律。
papers.method_zh: 建立了一个从莫尔图像（原子或莫尔尺度分辨率）中提取扭转与应变构型的通用理论框架；使用最小弹性能约束和电子谱约束来破除简并；以应变三角莫尔图案为例进行方法演示。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值计算或第一性原理方法。

papers.title: Heteroepitaxial Growth of PbSe on InP Substrates via Lattice-Matched III-V Buffer Layers
papers.abstract: Detector cost remains a barrier to the widespread adoption of mid-wave infrared (3-5 micron) technology. PbSe, an inexpensive narrow band gap IV-VI semiconductor that has been used since the early 1940s, delivers high performance for infrared detection despite the abundance of grain boundaries in polycrystalline films. Epitaxial growth, however, could provide superior crystalline quality and interfaces, but suitable substrates remain limited for PbSe. Recent PbSe heteroepitaxy has focused primarily on III-V, II-VI and group-IV substrates that each offer a comparatively narrow range of lattice-matched alloys for heterostructure engineering. Here we show that InP-based heteroepitaxy provides access to a broader materials platform while limiting the lattice mismatch with PbSe to approximately 4%. We grow 150-nm thick PbSe films by molecular beam epitaxy on 200-nm thick In0.53Ga0.47As and In0.52Al0.48As buffers on (001) InP substrates. Reflection high-energy electron diffraction and X-ray diffraction show (001)-oriented rock-salt PbSe with an out-of-plane lattice constant of 6.12 Angstrom on both buffers. Photoluminescence (PL) is observed from room-temperature down to 12 K and the peak wavelength red-shifts from 3.7 to 5.0 microns. Under identical measurement conditions, the room-temperature peak PL intensities from films on In0.53Ga0.47As and In0.52Al0.48As are approximately 1.9x and 1.3x that of a PbSe on GaAs substrate reference, respectively. These results establish an InP-compatible platform for integrating narrow band-gap PbSe with a broad range of ternary and quaternary III-V alloys, including, for example, structures in which In0.53Ga0.47As serves as both a short-wave infrared absorber and a template for PbSe growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确使用“we grow...by molecular beam epitaxy”“Reflection high-energy electron diffraction and X-ray diffraction show...”“Photoluminescence (PL) is observed...”等实验制备与表征手段的描述，未涉及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：PbSe 薄膜在 InP 衬底上的异质外延生长，具体为通过分子束外延在 (001) InP 衬底上的 In0.53Ga0.47As 和 In0.52Al0.48As III-V 缓冲层上生长 150 nm 厚的 PbSe 薄膜，研究其结构质量和光致发光特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 InP 基 III-V 缓冲层上成功实现了 (001) 取向岩盐结构 PbSe 的异质外延生长，面外晶格常数为 6.12 Å，晶格失配约 4%；薄膜在室温至 12 K 范围内均观测到光致发光，峰值波长从 3.7 μm 红移至 5.0 μm，且室温 PL 强度优于 PbSe/GaAs 参考样品。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 InP 基 III-V 缓冲层上成功实现了 (001) 取向岩盐结构 PbSe 的异质外延生长，面外晶格常数为 6.12 Å，晶格失配约 4%；薄膜在室温至 12 K 范围内均观测到光致发光，峰值波长从 3.7 μm 红移至 5.0 μm，且室温 PL 强度优于 PbSe/GaAs 参考样品。；创新点：提出 InP 基异质外延作为 PbSe 生长的更广泛材料平台，相较于此前主要集中于 III-V、II-VI 和 IV 族衬底的 PbSe 异质外延研究，该方案可将与 PbSe 的晶格失配限制在约 4%，并能兼容多种三元和四元 III-V 合金，例如使 In0.53Ga0.47As 同时充当短波红外吸收层和 PbSe 生长模板。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长 150 nm PbSe 薄膜于 200 nm 厚的 In0.53Ga0.47As 和 In0.52Al0.48As 缓冲层/(001) InP 衬底上；反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）和 X 射线衍射（XRD）表征结构与取向；光致发光（PL）光谱测量，温度范围从室温至 12 K。

papers.title: An encoded asymmetric ligand for metal-selective topological assembly of two-dimensional metal-organic frameworks
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional metal-organic frameworks (2D MOFs), with diverse topological architectures, provide a powerful platform for exploring unconventional electronic and lattice-dynamical responses. Yet their structural diversity remains fundamentally constrained by the fixed geometry of high-symmetry ligands. Here, we introduce an encoded asymmetric ligand, benzo[b]triphenylene-2,3,6,7,11,12-hexaol (BTH), for metal-selective topological assembly. By integrating multi-site coordination fields with sterically differentiated environments, BTH exhibits distinct topological programmability: different divalent metal ions direct divergent framework architectures. Specifically, coordination of BTH with divalent Cu(II) and Zn(II) ions assembles Cu-BTH-MOF with a dual-mode hexagonal pore topology and Zn-BTH-MOF with uniform hexagonal channels, respectively, as supported by PXRD Pawley refinement, structural simulations, and pore-size distribution analysis. Furthermore, this topological divergence is accompanied by a significant divergence in charge-transport properties, with Cu-BTH-MOF reaching an electrical conductivity of 1.186 x 10-3 S cm-1, more than six orders of magnitude higher than that of Zn-BTH-MOF (3.38 x 10-10 S cm-1). This work establishes ligand desymmetrization as a programmable strategy for metal-selective topological diversification in 2D MOFs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有结构模拟与理论分析）。关键依据：合成与组装 Cu-BTH-MOF、Zn-BTH-MOF，PXRD Pawley 精修、结构模拟、孔径分布分析、电导率测量。；研究对象：一种编码型不对称配体 benzo[b]triphenylene-2,3,6,7,11,12-hexaol (BTH) 及其与二价金属离子（Cu(II)、Zn(II)）组装形成的二维金属-有机框架（2D MOFs），以及其中金属离子依赖的拓扑结构与电荷输运性质差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BTH 通过多位点配位场与空间位阻差异实现金属选择性拓扑编程：Cu(II) 组装出具有双模式六边形孔拓扑的 Cu-BTH-MOF，Zn(II) 组装出均匀六边形通道的 Zn-BTH-MOF；该拓扑差异伴随显著的电荷输运差异，Cu-BTH-MOF 电导率达 1.186×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹，比 Zn-BTH-MOF（3.38×10⁻¹⁰ S cm⁻¹）高六个数量级以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BTH 通过多位点配位场与空间位阻差异实现金属选择性拓扑编程：Cu(II) 组装出具有双模式六边形孔拓扑的 Cu-BTH-MOF，Zn(II) 组装出均匀六边形通道的 Zn-BTH-MOF；该拓扑差异伴随显著的电荷输运差异，Cu-BTH-MOF 电导率达 1.186×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹，比 Zn-BTH-MOF（3.38×10⁻¹⁰ S cm⁻¹）高六个数量级以上。；创新点：提出配体去对称化（ligand desymmetrization）作为金属选择性拓扑多样化的可编程策略，突破高对称配体固定几何对 2D MOF 结构多样性的限制，并揭示拓扑分化与电荷输运性质分化的关联。
papers.method_zh: 合成 BTH 配体并与二价 Cu(II)、Zn(II) 离子配位组装 2D MOF；采用 PXRD Pawley 精修、结构模拟和孔径分布分析表征结构；测量电导率以比较电荷输运性质。

papers.title: Coarse-graining to create minimalist models for dynamic, end-linked star-polymer networks
papers.abstract: Although minimalist models for patchy attractive particles have revealed powerful design rules for how particle valence directs colloidal assembly, less work has focused on comparably simple models of reversible, network-forming star polymers. Here, we use relative-entropy coarse-graining and simulation results from finer-resolution bead--spring star polymers to generate 5-bead models of dynamic, end-associating four-armed poly(ethylene glycol) macromers. Our results comparing structural correlations, network connectivity, and phase behavior of the coarse- and fine-grained models provide insight into how the accuracy and transferability of the coarse-grained models depend on the state point chosen for coarse-graining. The results also reveal intrinsic trade-offs between reducing degrees of freedom and expanding the range of effective interactions in coarse-graining that impact the total number of pairwise interactions in the resulting model, with implications for its computational efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：relative-entropy coarse-graining、simulation results、bead–spring models、coarse-grained models。；研究对象：动态、末端缔合的四臂聚乙二醇（PEG）大分子单体所形成的可逆网络型星形聚合物体系，以及用于描述该体系的粗粒化模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粗粒化模型的准确性和可迁移性取决于所选用的粗粒化状态点；在减少自由度和扩大有效相互作用范围之间存在内在权衡，这一权衡会影响模型中成对相互作用的总数，进而影响计算效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粗粒化模型的准确性和可迁移性取决于所选用的粗粒化状态点；在减少自由度和扩大有效相互作用范围之间存在内在权衡，这一权衡会影响模型中成对相互作用的总数，进而影响计算效率。；创新点：将相对熵粗粒化应用于动态、末端缔合的四臂PEG星形聚合物网络，构建极简5珠模型，并系统揭示了粗粒化状态点选择对模型准确性与可迁移性的影响，以及减少自由度与扩大有效相互作用范围之间的内在权衡。
papers.method_zh: 相对熵粗粒化方法，并结合精细分辨率的珠–弹簧（bead–spring）星形聚合物模拟结果，生成5珠模型；通过比较粗粒化与精细模型的结构关联、网络连通性和相行为来评估模型。

papers.title: Energy Transport Structure and Fluctuation Theorem in Nonreciprocal Harmonic Chains
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions fundamentally alter energy transport by breaking the symmetry between forward and backward responses. Here, we uncover an exact transport structure for a one-dimensional harmonic chain with asymmetric nearest-neighbor couplings. Using a Green-function approach, we demonstrate that the direction of heat transport is determined not solely by the temperature bias, but by its competition with an effective directional asymmetry. This competition can reverse the direction of heat flow, enabling cold-to-hot transport. We further show that nonreciprocity introduces an additional power channel associated with the antisymmetric sector of the interaction, leading to a generalized steady-state energy balance involving two reservoir heat currents and a nonreciprocal power current. At the fluctuation level, the heat exchanges with the two reservoirs constitute correlated yet distinct stochastic currents, whose joint scaled cumulant generating function obeys an exact Gallavotti-Cohen symmetry. Together, these results establish a unified energetic and fluctuation framework for nonreciprocal heat transport and demonstrate that directional interactions can serve as an active resource for controlling nonequilibrium energy flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Green-function approach、exact transport structure、fluctuation theorem、scaled cumulant generating function、Gallavotti-Cohen symmetry，均为理论推导与解析框架，摘要中未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：一维谐振子链（harmonic chain），具有不对称的最近邻耦合（asymmetric nearest-neighbor couplings），即非互易相互作用下的能量输运现象，具体涉及热流方向、稳态能量平衡以及涨落层面的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热输运方向并非仅由温度偏置决定，而是由温度偏置与有效方向不对称性之间的竞争决定，这种竞争可以逆转热流方向，实现从冷到热的输运；非互易性引入了与相互作用反对称部分相关的额外功率通道，导致包含两个热库热流和一个非互易功率流的广义稳态能量平衡；两个热库的热交换构成关联但不同的随机流，其联合标度累积生成函数满足精确的 Gallavotti-Cohen 对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热输运方向并非仅由温度偏置决定，而是由温度偏置与有效方向不对称性之间的竞争决定，这种竞争可以逆转热流方向，实现从冷到热的输运；非互易性引入了与相互作用反对称部分相关的额外功率通道，导致包含两个热库热流和一个非互易功率流的广义稳态能量平衡；两个热库的热交换构成关联但不同的随机流，其联合标度累积生成函数满足精确的 Gallavotti-Cohen 对称性。；创新点：揭示了非互易谐振子链中热流方向由温度偏置与方向不对称性的竞争共同决定，可实现冷到热输运；提出了非互易性引入的额外功率通道及广义稳态能量平衡；在涨落层面证明了两个热库随机流的联合标度累积生成函数满足精确的 Gallavotti-Cohen 对称性，从而建立了非互易热输运的统一能量与涨落框架，并表明方向性相互作用可作为控制非平衡能量流的主动资源。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Green 函数方法（Green-function approach）对一维非互易谐振子链进行解析理论分析，推导精确的输运结构、稳态能量平衡关系，并在涨落层面分析随机流的联合标度累积生成函数及其 Gallavotti-Cohen 对称性。

papers.title: The effect of Coulomb interactions of thermoelectric characteristics of Marcus molecular junctions
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study focused on the influence of Coulomb interactions on thermoelectric properties of molecular junctions assuming that electron transport is strongly affected by thermalized phonon modes in the molecular ambient. It is shown that the combined effect of Coulomb interactions between electrons on the molecular states and the reorganization processes in the ambient may significantly affect both Seebeck coefficient and the power factor. Specifically, we show that electron-electron interactions may counter-balance the effect of the ambient molecules reorganizations resulting in qualitative changes in the behavior of both zero-bias conductance and thermopower.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：We present a theoretical study。；研究对象：分子结（molecular junctions）的热电特性，具体关注电子间库仑相互作用对 Seebeck 系数和功率因数的影响，且假设电子输运强烈受分子环境中热化声子模式的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子间库仑相互作用与环境分子重组过程（reorganization processes）的联合效应可显著影响 Seebeck 系数和功率因数；具体而言，电子-电子相互作用可能抵消环境分子重组效应，从而导致零偏压电导和热电势的行为发生定性变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子间库仑相互作用与环境分子重组过程（reorganization processes）的联合效应可显著影响 Seebeck 系数和功率因数；具体而言，电子-电子相互作用可能抵消环境分子重组效应，从而导致零偏压电导和热电势的行为发生定性变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法或理论框架（如 DFT、NEGF 等），仅说明是理论研究，假设电子输运受分子环境中热化声子模式强烈影响，并考虑电子间库仑相互作用与环境重组过程。

papers.title: The validity of the Stokes-Einstein relation in ionic liquids
papers.abstract: Ionic liquids (ILs) exhibit supercooled liquids behavior even above room temperature and the Stokes-Einstein (SE) relation is often considered to be invalid in ILs as that in supercooled liquids. However, the conclusion is usually drawn based on some variants of SE relation. In this work, we have systematically investigated the validity of the Stokes-Einstein relation in ILs by performing molecular dynamics simulations of coarse-grained IL within the temperature range of 400-800 K. Both the original SE formulation, and two commonly employed variants, were examined to assess their applicability and consistency. These three formulas yield distinctly different results, indicating that the two variants are not reliable substitutes for the original SE relation. The inconsistency suggests the fact that the r in Stokes law varies with conditions. The breakdown arises from the ion correlations introduced by the strong electrostatic interactions. This proposition is further confirmed by simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“performing molecular dynamics simulations”（执行分子动力学模拟），属于计算/模拟研究。；研究对象：离子液体（Ionic Liquids, ILs）中 Stokes-Einstein 关系的有效性，具体为粗粒化离子液体模型在 400–800 K 温度范围内的扩散行为与 SE 关系及其变体的适用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始 SE 公式与两种常用变体给出明显不同的结果，说明两种变体不能可靠替代原始 SE 关系；这种不一致源于 Stokes 定律中的半径 r 随条件变化，而 SE 关系的失效来自强静电相互作用引起的离子关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始 SE 公式与两种常用变体给出明显不同的结果，说明两种变体不能可靠替代原始 SE 关系；这种不一致源于 Stokes 定律中的半径 r 随条件变化，而 SE 关系的失效来自强静电相互作用引起的离子关联。；创新点：系统比较了原始 SE 公式与两种常用变体在离子液体中的适用性和一致性，指出变体不可靠，并将 SE 关系失效归因于 Stokes 定律中半径 r 随条件变化以及强静电相互作用导致的离子关联，且通过模拟进一步证实了这一观点。
papers.method_zh: 对粗粒化离子液体进行分子动力学模拟，温度范围为 400–800 K；检验了原始 SE 公式及两种常用变体，并通过进一步模拟验证了离子关联导致 SE 关系失效的推论。

papers.title: Composition and Surface Termination Control Band Alignments in P3HT/Perovskite Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Hybrid organic-inorganic perovskite heterostructures are emerging platforms for energy conversion and optoelectronic devices, yet the effects of composition and surface terminations on band alignment remain poorly understood. Here, using high-throughput first-principles calculations, we systematically reveal the effect of composition and surface termination on the band alignment of 820 heterostructures formed between poly(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT) variants and conventional and mixed-cation metal halide perovskites. Band edge analysis predicts concentration dependent band alignments, with most Pb and Sn based perovskites exhibiting Type II and III behavior while mixed-cation CsMASnBr3 uniquely forms Type-I junctions with all P3HT variants. Explicit interface calculations reveal that surface termination can reverse the predicted alignment in conventional tin perovskites, while the mixed cation perovskite preserves Type-I alignment with P3HT regardless of termination. Despite negligible charge transfer, termination dependent band offsets produce markedly different carrier confinement, establishing design principles for engineering P3HT/perovskite interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确使用“high-throughput first-principles calculations”（高通量第一性原理计算）和“Explicit interface calculations”（显式界面计算），未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：P3HT（聚(3-己基噻吩)）变体与常规及混合阳离子金属卤化物钙钛矿形成的820种异质结，研究其能带对齐（band alignment）行为，以及组分和表面终止对其的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 能带边缘分析预测能带对齐随组分浓度变化：大多数Pb基和Sn基钙钛矿与P3HT形成Type-II和Type-III对齐，而混合阳离子CsMASnBr₃独特地与所有P3HT变体形成Type-I结。显式界面计算表明，表面终止可以逆转常规锡基钙钛矿中预测的对齐类型，但混合阳离子钙钛矿无论终止方式如何都保持与P3HT的Type-I对齐。尽管电荷转移可忽略不计，终止依赖的带偏移仍产生显著不同的载流子限域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：能带边缘分析预测能带对齐随组分浓度变化：大多数Pb基和Sn基钙钛矿与P3HT形成Type-II和Type-III对齐，而混合阳离子CsMASnBr₃独特地与所有P3HT变体形成Type-I结。显式界面计算表明，表面终止可以逆转常规锡基钙钛矿中预测的对齐类型，但混合阳离子钙钛矿无论终止方式如何都保持与P3HT的Type-I对齐。尽管电荷转移可忽略不计，终止依赖的带偏移仍产生显著不同的载流子限域。；创新点：系统揭示了组分和表面终止对P3HT/钙钛矿异质结能带对齐的调控规律，覆盖了820种异质结的大规模筛选；发现了混合阳离子钙钛矿CsMASnBr₃对表面终止不敏感、始终维持Type-I对齐的独特行为；建立了通过终止工程调控载流子限域的设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 高通量第一性原理计算（high-throughput first-principles calculations），包括能带边缘分析和显式界面计算。摘要未明确说明具体泛函或计算参数（如是否使用DFT+U、杂化泛函等）。

papers.title: Curvature-Induced Geometric Universality in Non-Hermitian Anderson Transitions
papers.abstract: In Euclidean space, universality classes of Anderson transitions are primarily determined by symmetry and spatial dimensionality. Here, we present evidence for a geometry-controlled universality class of non-Hermitian Anderson transitions on hyperbolic-like lattices. In this setting, critical behavior is influenced by the large-scale hyperbolic geometry, characterized by negative curvature, exponential volume growth, and a non-Euclidean notion of spatial scaling. Finite-size scaling of participation ratios across several distinct \( \{p,q\} \) tilings reveals one-parameter scaling collapses with a common critical exponent \( ν\simeq1 \) within numerical accuracy. A complementary phenomenological coarse-grained Landau-Ginzburg analysis shows how exponential correlation-volume growth suppresses critical fluctuations, offering a rationale for the observed mean-field-like scaling. Our results suggest that spatial curvature can act as an additional organizing principle for Anderson-transition universality beyond the conventional dimensionality- and symmetry-based classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：finite-size scaling、participation ratios、numerical accuracy、coarse-grained Landau-Ginzburg analysis、phenomenological。摘要中未提及任何实验手段，主要为数值计算与理论分析。；研究对象：双曲型（hyperbolic-like）晶格上的非厄米安德森转变（non-Hermitian Anderson transitions），涉及多种 {p,q} 镶嵌（tiling）结构。物理现象为安德森局域化转变的临界行为与普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在负曲率双曲型晶格上，非厄米安德森转变表现出由几何控制的普适类：不同 {p,q} 镶嵌的参与率有限尺寸标度可坍缩为单参数标度，具有共同临界指数 ν≃1（在数值精度内），呈类平均场标度行为。空间曲率可作为超越传统维度与对称性分类的额外组织原则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在负曲率双曲型晶格上，非厄米安德森转变表现出由几何控制的普适类：不同 {p,q} 镶嵌的参与率有限尺寸标度可坍缩为单参数标度，具有共同临界指数 ν≃1（在数值精度内），呈类平均场标度行为。空间曲率可作为超越传统维度与对称性分类的额外组织原则。；创新点：首次提出并给出证据表明空间曲率（双曲几何、负曲率、指数体积增长、非欧空间标度）可作为一种几何控制的普适类组织原则，突破了传统上安德森转变普适类仅由对称性和空间维度决定的分类框架。
papers.method_zh: 对多种 {p,q} 双曲镶嵌进行参与率（participation ratios）的有限尺寸标度分析，检验单参数标度坍缩并提取临界指数；辅以唯象的粗粒化 Landau-Ginzburg 理论分析，说明指数型关联体积增长如何抑制临界涨落。

papers.title: Comprehensive molecular dynamics study of the dynamical properties of a dense binary hard-sphere mixture
papers.abstract: We present an extensive molecular dynamics (MD) study of the dynamical properties of a binary hard-sphere fluid over a wide range of packing fractions, $φ\approx 0.357-0.582$. The self-diffusivity, $D$, and shear viscosity, $η$, are computed using an efficient implementation of the Einstein--Helfand method. The finite-size effects in $D$ scale as $1/N^α$, with $α$ increasing from approximately $1/3$ to $3/4$ with increasing $φ$, whereas those in $η$ are negligible except for $φ\gtrsim 0.554$, where they scale as $1/N$. The data are then extrapolated to the thermodynamic limit to obtain $D_{\infty}$ and $η_{\infty}$. Both coefficients show a super-Arrhenius dependence on $φ$ for dense states, accompanied by a breakdown of the Stokes--Einstein relation. Although both $D_{\infty}(φ)$ and $η_{\infty}(φ)$ data are well described by an exponential form, we demonstrate that these fits do not provide reliable estimates of the critical packing fraction, $φ_0$, owing to the substantial extrapolation required beyond the accessible equilibrium range. We find the commonly assumed proportionality between $η$ and the structural relaxation time, $τ_α$ , to not hold for this system. For $φ\gtrsim 0.570$, the van Hove self-correlation function $G_s(r, τ)$ exhibits a spatial exponential decay at intermediate times, $τ$, signaling dynamic heterogeneity. The characteristic decay length scales as $λ\sim τ^ν$, with $ν\approx 1/3$, in contrast to the conventional square-root scaling. We also investigate temporal heterogeneity through the four-point dynamic susceptibility, $χ_4(τ)$, and its peak time, $τ_4$. These findings provide rigorous benchmark MD data for computational studies of glassy dynamics and establish a reference for testing theoretical models in dense disordered systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：molecular dynamics (MD) study、computed、extrapolated to the thermodynamic limit。；研究对象：稠密二元硬球混合物的动力学性质，包括自扩散系数、剪切粘度、结构弛豫、van Hove自关联函数、四点动力学磁化率等，研究范围覆盖较宽的堆积分数 φ≈0.357–0.582。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自扩散系数和剪切粘度在稠密状态下对堆积分数呈超Arrhenius依赖，且Stokes–Einstein关系失效；常用的η与结构弛豫时间τ_α成正比关系的假设在该体系中不成立；在φ≳0.570时，van Hove自关联函数在中观时间尺度呈空间指数衰减，特征衰减长度满足λ∼τ^ν，ν≈1/3，不同于传统的平方根标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自扩散系数和剪切粘度在稠密状态下对堆积分数呈超Arrhenius依赖，且Stokes–Einstein关系失效；常用的η与结构弛豫时间τ_α成正比关系的假设在该体系中不成立；在φ≳0.570时，van Hove自关联函数在中观时间尺度呈空间指数衰减，特征衰减长度满足λ∼τ^ν，ν≈1/3，不同于传统的平方根标度。；创新点：提供了覆盖宽堆积分数范围的严格基准MD数据；系统分析了D和η的有限尺寸效应标度行为；指出指数形式拟合无法可靠估计临界堆积分数φ_0；揭示了η与τ_α正比关系不成立，以及van Hove自关联函数衰减长度呈ν≈1/3而非传统平方根标度。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，采用高效的Einstein–Helfand方法计算自扩散系数D和剪切粘度η；进行了有限尺寸效应分析并外推到热力学极限；还计算了四点动力学磁化率χ_4(τ)及其峰值时间τ_4。

papers.title: The Role of Concentration in Determining NaCl Nucleation Mechanism: A Story of Pathways Coexistence
papers.abstract: Deciphering the microscopic details of crystal nucleation remains a key open problem in chemical physics. For aqueous sodium chloride (NaCl), the extent to which nucleation involves amorphous ion aggregation, and the supersaturation regime in which two-step-like behavior emerges, remains actively debated. In this work, we examine NaCl nucleation at 12, 13, and 14 mol/kg ($S = 3.2, 3.5, 3.8$) using unbiased path sampling with $\infty$RETIS. Through a combination of reaction coordinate analysis, joint and conditional probability distributions, diffusion tensor analysis, and conditional free energy landscapes, we identify nucleation pathways without a priori mechanistic assumptions. While all concentrations are governed by the same reaction coordinate, indicating that nucleus growth and structural ordering are central to crossing the barrier, the nature of reactive trajectories changes with supersaturation. At lower concentrations, nucleation mainly occurs via tightly coupled increases in cluster size and ordering, compatible with a one-step-like mechanism. As concentration increases, amorphous aggregation becomes increasingly decoupled from crystallization, and pathways involving substantial amorphous growth prior to crystallization become progressively more probable. Importantly, these pathways coexist within a single broad reaction channel rather than proceeding through distinct metastable intermediate states. Together, these results reconcile earlier, contradictory reports on NaCl nucleation mechanisms and support a view of nucleation as an ensemble of competing reactive pathways whose relative probabilities vary continuously with supersaturation. More broadly, our findings illustrate that substantial mechanistic diversity can emerge within a classical nucleation framework, without requiring distinct non-classical descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键判断依据：使用无偏路径采样方法（∞RETIS）进行模拟研究，属于分子动力学/计算物理范畴，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：水溶液中氯化钠（NaCl）的晶体成核过程，具体研究浓度为12、13、14 mol/kg（对应过饱和度 S = 3.2、3.5、3.8）下的成核机制与路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有浓度下成核均由同一反应坐标主导（核生长与结构有序化是跨越势垒的核心），但随着过饱和度增加，反应轨迹的性质发生变化：低浓度下成核以团簇尺寸增长与有序化紧密耦合的一步式机制为主，高浓度下非晶态聚集与结晶逐渐解耦，先经历显著非晶生长再结晶的路径概率增大；这些路径共存于同一宽反应通道中，而非通过不同的亚稳中间态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有浓度下成核均由同一反应坐标主导（核生长与结构有序化是跨越势垒的核心），但随着过饱和度增加，反应轨迹的性质发生变化：低浓度下成核以团簇尺寸增长与有序化紧密耦合的一步式机制为主，高浓度下非晶态聚集与结晶逐渐解耦，先经历显著非晶生长再结晶的路径概率增大；这些路径共存于同一宽反应通道中，而非通过不同的亚稳中间态。；创新点：在不预设机制假设的条件下识别出NaCl成核路径的多样性，揭示了不同成核路径共存于同一宽反应通道中、其相对概率随过饱和度连续变化，从而调和了此前关于NaCl成核机制的矛盾报道，并表明在经典成核框架内即可涌现出显著的机制多样性，无需引入不同的非经典描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用无偏路径采样方法 ∞RETIS 进行模拟，并结合反应坐标分析、联合与条件概率分布、扩散张量分析以及条件自由能景观等多种分析手段，在不预设机制假设的前提下识别成核路径。

papers.title: Intrinsic (valley) thermal Hall conductivity of phonons in graphene for integer quantum Hall phases
papers.abstract: We calculate the intrinsic contribution to the (valley) thermal Hall conductivity of phonons in (Semenoff-gapped) graphene in the quantum Hall regime where bulk electron thermal transport is suppressed. The (valley) thermal Hall transport of phonons considered here originates from a phonon (valley) Hall viscosity induced by electron (valley) Hall conductivity and viscosity via geometric electron-phonon coupling. The so generated phonon (valley) Hall viscosity is identified with the emergent (valley) Hall viscosity recently introduced in \textit{Phys. Lett. A} \textbf{595}, 132096 (2026). While our calculations refer to graphene, they may very well be generalized to other Dirac materials like group-VI transition metal dichalcogenides. We discuss the prospect of measuring the phonon thermal Hall conductivity in graphene-based heterostructures and estimate the corresponding valley response induced by electrons in the inversion symmetry broken phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：We calculate、intrinsic contribution、geometric electron-phonon coupling、may very well be generalized，摘要中未提及任何实验测量手段，属于理论计算工作。；研究对象：石墨烯（Semenoff-gapped graphene）在整数量子霍尔相中的声子（谷）热霍尔输运现象，具体研究声子的内禀（谷）热霍尔电导率。摘要提到该计算可推广至其他狄拉克材料，如第VI族过渡金属硫族化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在体态电子热输运被抑制的量子霍尔区域，声子的（谷）热霍尔输运来源于电子（谷）霍尔电导率和黏度通过几何电子-声子耦合所诱导的声子（谷）霍尔黏度；该声子（谷）霍尔黏度被等同于近期在 Phys. Lett. A 595, 132096 (2026) 中引入的涌现（谷）霍尔黏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在体态电子热输运被抑制的量子霍尔区域，声子的（谷）热霍尔输运来源于电子（谷）霍尔电导率和黏度通过几何电子-声子耦合所诱导的声子（谷）霍尔黏度；该声子（谷）霍尔黏度被等同于近期在 Phys. Lett. A 595, 132096 (2026) 中引入的涌现（谷）霍尔黏度。；创新点：首次计算了量子霍尔区域中石墨烯声子的内禀（谷）热霍尔电导率，揭示了其来源于电子（谷）霍尔电导率和黏度通过几何电子-声子耦合诱导的声子（谷）霍尔黏度，并将该黏度与近期文献中提出的涌现（谷）霍尔黏度建立等同关系；同时讨论了在石墨烯基异质结中测量声子热霍尔电导率的前景，并估算了反转对称破缺相中电子诱导的谷响应。
papers.method_zh: 基于几何电子-声子耦合的理论计算框架，计算Semenoff-gapped石墨烯中声子的内禀（谷）热霍尔电导率贡献，涉及电子（谷）霍尔电导率、黏度与声子（谷）霍尔黏度之间的关系。摘要未明确说明具体的数值方法或模型细节。

papers.title: Topological instability and reentrant crystallization in active solids
papers.abstract: We extend the KTHNY theory of defect-mediated melting in two dimensions to the case of active solids exhibiting both non-reciprocal (odd) elasticity and Cosserat (micropolar) coupling. For perturbatively small values of non-reciprocity, melting still proceeds via defect unbinding, but the melting temperature shifts due to activity. However, at a threshold value of non-reciprocity, we discover a qualitatively distinct mechanism for 2D melting, which we call topological instability. This melting occurs through the proliferation of defect pairs at any temperature. We use a combination of field theory and simulations to characterize this zero-temperature transition in terms of the defect-pair fugacity. Surprisingly, for higher activity values, we find reentrant crystallization, where the quasi-long-range order survives even at temperatures for which the equilibrium crystal would melt. Although active solids present one realization of this topological instability, we envision core-energy-driven defect proliferation as a generic and unexplored route for two-dimensional melting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合数值模拟）。判断依据的关键词：extend the KTHNY theory、field theory、simulations、perturbatively small values、characterize this zero-temperature transition。；研究对象：二维活性固体（active solids）的熔化行为，具体研究同时具有非互易（odd）弹性和 Cosserat（微极性）耦合的二维活性固体中缺陷介导的熔化现象，以及拓扑不稳定性与重入结晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在微扰小的非互易性下，熔化仍通过缺陷解绑进行，但熔化温度因活性而移动；当非互易性达到阈值时，出现一种新的二维熔化机制——"拓扑不稳定性"，即缺陷对在任何温度下增殖，导致零温转变；在更高活性下，出现重入结晶，即准长程有序在平衡晶体本应熔化的温度下仍然存活。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在微扰小的非互易性下，熔化仍通过缺陷解绑进行，但熔化温度因活性而移动；当非互易性达到阈值时，出现一种新的二维熔化机制——"拓扑不稳定性"，即缺陷对在任何温度下增殖，导致零温转变；在更高活性下，出现重入结晶，即准长程有序在平衡晶体本应熔化的温度下仍然存活。；创新点：首次将 KTHNY 理论推广到同时含非互易弹性和 Cosserat 耦合的活性固体；发现了一种区别于传统缺陷解绑的、由核心能量驱动的缺陷增殖新机制（拓扑不稳定性），并揭示了高活性下的重入结晶现象；作者认为核心能量驱动的缺陷增殖是二维熔化的一条普适且尚未被探索的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 将 KTHNY 二维缺陷介导熔化理论推广到具有非互易（odd）弹性和 Cosserat（微极性）耦合的活性固体；结合场论（field theory）和模拟（simulations），以缺陷对逸度（defect-pair fugacity）来表征该零温转变。

papers.title: Gap-controlled thermalization in a SSH model version of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou chain
papers.abstract: In classical anharmonic lattices, the resonance structure driving nonlinear mode mixing is reshaped by band gaps. However, it remains unclear whether a spectral gap hinders or promotes long-time thermalization. Here we study a dimerized Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou chain - a classical SSH model analogue with alternating spring constants - and quantify how the acoustic-optical gap controls relaxation under alpha-type (cubic) nonlinearity. Tracking modal energies and spectral entropy via long-time symplectic simulations, we find a sharp isolation threshold when the dimerization strength reaches half its maximum value, set by the onset of the first umklapp process that allows two zone-boundary acoustic phonons to fuse into a zone-center optical phonon; below this threshold, three-wave acoustic-acoustic-optical scattering activates the optical branch on timescales of order 1e4 oscillation periods, while above it the bands remain dynamically isolated. We further show that boundary conditions reshape this picture, producing long-lived sticky states for specific mode excitations. These results establish the phononic gap as a tunable, momentum-selective filter for nonlinear energy transport, suggesting a general route to controlling thermalization in dimerized or topologically gapped nonlinear lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“long-time symplectic simulations”（长时间辛数值模拟），属于经典晶格动力学的数值计算研究，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：二聚化 Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou（FPUT）链——即经典 SSH 模型类比体系，具有交替的弹簧常数，研究其在 α 型（三次）非线性下声学支与光学支之间的能隙如何控制热化/弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当二聚化强度达到其最大值的一半时，出现一个尖锐的隔离阈值：该阈值由第一个 umklapp 过程（两个带边界声学声子融合为一个带中心光学声子）的开启所决定；低于该阈值时，三波声学-声学-光学散射在约 1e4 个振荡周期的时间尺度上激活光学支，高于该阈值时两能带保持动力学隔离。此外，边界条件会重塑这一图像，对特定模式激发产生长寿命的粘滞态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当二聚化强度达到其最大值的一半时，出现一个尖锐的隔离阈值：该阈值由第一个 umklapp 过程（两个带边界声学声子融合为一个带中心光学声子）的开启所决定；低于该阈值时，三波声学-声学-光学散射在约 1e4 个振荡周期的时间尺度上激活光学支，高于该阈值时两能带保持动力学隔离。此外，边界条件会重塑这一图像，对特定模式激发产生长寿命的粘滞态。；创新点：将声子能隙确立为非线性能量输运的可调、动量选择性滤波器，揭示了二聚化强度驱动的尖锐隔离阈值及其由 umklapp 过程开启所决定的物理机制，并指出边界条件可产生长寿命粘滞态，为在二聚化或拓扑能隙非线性晶格中控制热化提供了通用途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用长时间辛（symplectic）数值模拟，追踪模式能量和谱熵，研究经典二聚化 FPUT 链在三次非线性下的弛豫动力学。

papers.title: Light-Driven Ultrafast Control of Time-Reversal Symmetry in SrTiO3
papers.abstract: Light-driven control of material symmetry enables the engineering of phenomena forbidden in equilibrium. Although electromagnetic fields have been used to break time-reversal symmetry, its dynamic control on ultrafast timescales in nonmagnetic insulating oxides remains virtually unexplored. Here, we demonstrate simultaneous magnetic symmetry lowering and timereversal-symmetry breaking in cubic SrTiO3 driven by an off-resonant, elliptically polarized THz pulse. Second harmonic generation (SHG) polarimetry reveals emergent SHG circular dichroism inconsistent with third-order nonlinear processes under cubic m3m symmetry. The SHG polar patterns exhibit mirror-symmetry breaking, indicating a transient reduction to tetragonal 4/mm'm' magnetic symmetry. Furthermore, the SHG response scales linearly with the angular momentum of THz pulse, providing direct evidence for THz-field-induced timereversal-symmetry breaking. These results establish a direct pathway for ultrafast symmetry control in non-magnetic oxides, enabling dynamic manipulation of emergent phases on ultrafast timescales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“Second harmonic generation (SHG) polarimetry reveals”“SHG polar patterns exhibit”“SHG response scales linearly with...”等表述，表明工作以实验测量（SHG偏振测量）为核心手段。；研究对象：立方相钛酸锶（SrTiO₃），一种非磁性绝缘氧化物。研究的具体物理现象是：在非共振椭圆偏振太赫兹脉冲驱动下，材料的时间反演对称性破缺与磁对称性降低。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在立方SrTiO₃中，非共振椭圆偏振THz脉冲可同时诱导磁对称性降低和时间反演对称性破缺，SHG偏振测量显示体系从立方m3m对称性瞬态降低为四方4/mm'm'磁对称性；且SHG响应与THz脉冲角动量呈线性关系，直接证明了THz场诱导的时间反演对称性破缺。
