papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确写“We develop the theory of thermally activated phase slips”，并构建微观模型进行理论推导，未涉及具体实验测量或数值计算方法的描述。；研究对象：非中心对称超导窄线中的热激活相滑移（thermally activated phase slips）。具体体系为缺乏反演对称性的扩散导线，微观上建模为二维电子气中的Rashba自旋轨道耦合系统，并施加面内磁场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热激活相滑移电阻具有磁手性各向异性：固定电流下改变磁场方向、或固定磁场下改变电流方向，电阻均会变化；但线性响应电阻仍保持磁场对称（满足Onsager倒易关系）。该非互易性源于相滑移激活势垒中同时关于电流和磁场为奇函数的反对称项，其大小由同一导线的超导二极管效率通过一个普适数值比固定，无自由参数。由于不对称性存在于激活指数中，磁手性信号相对于二极管不对称性被势垒高度与温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻曲线上指数斜率的场反对称劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热激活相滑移电阻具有磁手性各向异性：固定电流下改变磁场方向、或固定磁场下改变电流方向，电阻均会变化；但线性响应电阻仍保持磁场对称（满足Onsager倒易关系）。该非互易性源于相滑移激活势垒中同时关于电流和磁场为奇函数的反对称项，其大小由同一导线的超导二极管效率通过一个普适数值比固定，无自由参数。由于不对称性存在于激活指数中，磁手性信号相对于二极管不对称性被势垒高度与温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻曲线上指数斜率的场反对称劈裂。；创新点：首次理论揭示了非中心对称超导窄线中热激活相滑移的磁手性各向异性，并证明其与超导二极管效应通过普适数值比直接关联，无需可调参数；同时指出动力学Lifshitz不变量仅影响涨落前因子且处于参数上次要地位，而主要效应来自激活指数中的势垒不对称性，这导致信号被势垒高度/温度比放大。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：微观模型构建（扩散导线 + 二维电子气 + Rashba自旋轨道耦合 + 面内磁场），基于自由能的Lifshitz不变量分析（包括立方梯度项和动量奇数次四阶顶点），结合螺旋基态效应，推导相滑移激活势垒的不对称性。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值方法（如Usadel方程数值求解等）。

papers.title: A unified description of flow-induced scission of wormlike micelles under shear and extensional flows
papers.abstract: We investigate flow-induced scission of wormlike micelles under different flow kinematics using dissipative particle dynamics simulations of surfactant solutions in shear, uniaxial extensional, planar extensional, and biaxial extensional flows. The average lifetime of wormlike micelles is used to quantify the degree of scission. While flow-induced scission occurs in all flow types when the deformation rate is sufficiently high, the dependence of the average lifetime on the deformation rate differs among flow types. To provide a unified description, we introduce an effective extension rate determined by the velocity gradient tensor and micellar orientation. When expressed in terms of this effective extension rate, the average lifetimes obtained under all flow types considered collapse onto a single curve. These results demonstrate that a unified description of flow-induced scission requires not only the strength and kinematics of the imposed flow, but also the micellar orientation relative to the extensional direction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：dissipative particle dynamics simulations（耗散粒子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：表面活性剂溶液中的蠕虫状胶束（wormlike micelles）在剪切流、单轴拉伸流、平面拉伸流和双轴拉伸流下的流动诱导断裂（flow-induced scission）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有流动类型在变形率足够高时都会发生流动诱导断裂，但平均寿命对变形率的依赖关系因流动类型而异；引入由速度梯度张量和胶束取向共同决定的有效拉伸率后，所有流动类型下的平均寿命坍缩到同一条曲线上，表明统一描述流动诱导断裂不仅需要流动的强度和运动学，还需要胶束相对于拉伸方向的取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有流动类型在变形率足够高时都会发生流动诱导断裂，但平均寿命对变形率的依赖关系因流动类型而异；引入由速度梯度张量和胶束取向共同决定的有效拉伸率后，所有流动类型下的平均寿命坍缩到同一条曲线上，表明统一描述流动诱导断裂不仅需要流动的强度和运动学，还需要胶束相对于拉伸方向的取向。；创新点：提出了由速度梯度张量和胶束取向决定的有效拉伸率，首次将不同流动运动学（剪切、单轴/平面/双轴拉伸）下的流动诱导断裂行为统一到单一曲线上，强调了胶束取向在统一描述中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟表面活性剂溶液，在剪切流、单轴拉伸流、平面拉伸流和双轴拉伸流四种流动条件下进行研究；以蠕虫状胶束的平均寿命量化断裂程度。

papers.title: Large-Chern-number flat bands, anomalous Dirac cones, and unconventional superfluidity in square-lattice systems with SU(N) non-Abelian gauge fields
papers.abstract: We study topological band structures and superfluid phases in two-dimensional square-lattice systems with homogeneous SU($N$) non-Abelian gauge fields. Starting from an SU(4) gauge-field model related to the Hofstadter model with flux $α=1/4$, we show that the lowest and highest bands are isolated Chern bands that carry Chern numbers $C=-4$ and give rise to four chiral edge modes in a strip geometry. Remarkably, although the two middle bands touch and form $16$ gapless Dirac cones, their combined Chern number is $C=8$. We then generalize the construction to SU($N$) systems and reveal an even--odd structure of the band topology: when $N$ is odd, all bands are isolated and carry nonzero Chern numbers; when $N$ is even, the two middle bands touch at $N^{2}$ Dirac points, while all other bands remain isolated and topologically nontrivial. We find that the uppermost and lowermost bands become increasingly flat and their Berry curvature becomes more uniform as $N$ increases, providing a promising platform for realizing fractional Chern insulating phases. We further examine the spin-$3/2$ SU(4) model with on-site attractive Hubbard interactions, exploring its superfluid phases at partial filling. We find that the non-Abelian gauge field breaks the hidden SO(5) degeneracy of the quintet pairing and selects distinct nematic superfluid states. For fillings in the middle-band regime, the resulting spectrum can host topologically protected Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. Our results provide a starting point for exploring both topological band physics and unconventional superfluidity in synthetic SU($N$) cold-atom systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We study”“We show”“We then generalize the construction”“We find”“We further examine”等表述，属于理论建模与数值/解析计算研究，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：二维方格子系统中的 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范场模型，具体包括与通量 α=1/4 的 Hofstadter 模型相关的 SU(4) 规范场模型，以及推广的 SU(N) 系统；并进一步研究带在位吸引 Hubbard 相互作用的 spin-3/2 SU(4) 模型中的超流相。涉及拓扑能带结构、陈能带、狄拉克锥、Bogoliubov 费米面等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最低和最高能带是携带陈数 C=-4 的孤立陈能带，产生四条手性边缘模；两个中间能带虽然相交形成 16 个无隙狄拉克锥，但其联合陈数为 C=8。推广到 SU(N) 后呈现奇偶结构：N 为奇数时所有能带孤立且带非零陈数；N 为偶数时中间两带在 N² 个狄拉克点相交，其余能带仍孤立且拓扑非平庸。随 N 增大，最上/最下能带趋于平坦且贝里曲率更均匀。在 SU(4) 吸引 Hubbard 模型中，非阿贝尔规范场打破五重态配对的隐藏 SO(5) 简并，选择不同的向列超流态；中间带填充区域的谱可承载拓扑保护的 Bogoliubov 费米面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最低和最高能带是携带陈数 C=-4 的孤立陈能带，产生四条手性边缘模；两个中间能带虽然相交形成 16 个无隙狄拉克锥，但其联合陈数为 C=8。推广到 SU(N) 后呈现奇偶结构：N 为奇数时所有能带孤立且带非零陈数；N 为偶数时中间两带在 N² 个狄拉克点相交，其余能带仍孤立且拓扑非平庸。随 N 增大，最上/最下能带趋于平坦且贝里曲率更均匀。在 SU(4) 吸引 Hubbard 模型中，非阿贝尔规范场打破五重态配对的隐藏 SO(5) 简并，选择不同的向列超流态；中间带填充区域的谱可承载拓扑保护的 Bogoliubov 费米面。；创新点：首次在方格子 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范场系统中揭示了能带拓扑的奇偶结构（奇数 N 全孤立陈能带，偶数 N 中间带相交形成 N² 个狄拉克点但联合陈数非零），并发现大陈数平坦陈能带随 N 增大而更平坦、贝里曲率更均匀；进一步在 SU(4) 吸引 Hubbard 模型中揭示了非阿贝尔规范场打破隐藏 SO(5) 简并并诱导向列超流态及拓扑 Bogoliubov 费米面，为合成 SU(N) 冷原子系统中拓扑能带物理与非常规超流研究提供了新起点。
papers.method_zh: 基于二维方格子上的 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范场模型进行理论构造与能带拓扑分析（陈数计算、边缘态分析、狄拉克锥识别、贝里曲率与能带平坦度分析）；对 spin-3/2 SU(4) 模型引入在位吸引 Hubbard 相互作用，通过平均场或类似理论框架分析部分填充下的超流相与 Bogoliubov 激发谱。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值方法（如精确对角化、DMRG 等）。

papers.title: Speed Limit for Information Acquisition in Stochastic Learning Dynamics
papers.abstract: Neural networks acquire internal representations through learning. In this work, we formulate stochastic gradient descent (SGD) as a Markovian stochastic process and derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit that bounds the rate at which trainable parameters can acquire information about latent variables in the data-generating process. The resulting inequality decomposes the information flow into drift and noise contributions, thereby quantifying the roles of deterministic learning forces and SGD-induced fluctuations from an information-theoretic perspective. We verify the bound in analytically tractable basis-function linear regression, where the information budget predicted by the bound reproduces the ordering and characteristic time scales with which different latent variables are encoded in the learned parameters. These results establish Fisher-information speed limits as a quantitative framework for diagnosing when and how different aspects of the data-generating mechanism are acquired during stochastic learning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：formulate...as a Markovian stochastic process、derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit、analytically tractable basis-function linear regression、verify the bound。摘要中未涉及实验或数值模拟的具体描述，属于理论推导与解析验证。；研究对象：神经网络的学习动力学，具体为随机梯度下降（SGD）过程中可训练参数对数据生成过程中潜在变量的信息获取。属于机器学习/统计物理交叉的随机学习动力学体系，而非具体材料或凝聚态物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文推导出一个 Fisher 信息流速度极限不等式，该不等式将信息流分解为漂移项和噪声项，从而从信息论角度量化了确定性学习力与 SGD 引起的涨落各自的作用；在可解析处理的基础函数线性回归中验证了该界限，其预测的信息预算再现了不同潜在变量被编码进学习参数时的排序和特征时间尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文推导出一个 Fisher 信息流速度极限不等式，该不等式将信息流分解为漂移项和噪声项，从而从信息论角度量化了确定性学习力与 SGD 引起的涨落各自的作用；在可解析处理的基础函数线性回归中验证了该界限，其预测的信息预算再现了不同潜在变量被编码进学习参数时的排序和特征时间尺度。；创新点：将 Fisher 信息速度极限引入随机学习动力学，给出信息流的速度上界，并将信息获取分解为漂移与噪声两部分，为诊断随机学习过程中数据生成机制的哪些方面、何时被习得提供了定量框架。
papers.method_zh: 将 SGD 表述为马尔可夫随机过程，推导 Fisher 信息流速度极限（Fisher-information flow speed limit），并在解析可解的基础函数线性回归（basis-function linear regression）中进行验证。

papers.title: Increase of Magnetic Trap Loading Efficiency for $^{39}\mathrm{K}$ Bose--Einstein Condensation Experiments
papers.abstract: During the experimental sequence, a large atom number is important for the creation of high-quality Bose--Einstein condensates. We report an experimental increase of about 15% in magnetic-trap (MT) loading efficiency by optimizing the MT loading process. The loading time is much shorter than the lifetime of the atoms in the MT, which means atom loss during loading due to the finite trap lifetime can be neglected. We obtain an almost pure $^{39}\mathrm{K}$ condensate with $1.2\times10^{5}$ atoms after evaporative cooling in our optical trap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：experimental sequence、report an experimental increase、we obtain。；研究对象：\(^{39}\mathrm{K}\) 玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）实验中的磁阱装载过程，以及磁阱装载效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化磁阱装载过程，磁阱装载效率提高了约 15%；装载时间远短于原子在磁阱中的寿命，因此装载期间由有限阱寿命导致的原子损失可以忽略。随后在光阱中经蒸发冷却获得了约 \(1.2\times10^{5}\) 个原子的几乎纯的 \(^{39}\mathrm{K}\) 凝聚体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化磁阱装载过程，磁阱装载效率提高了约 15%；装载时间远短于原子在磁阱中的寿命，因此装载期间由有限阱寿命导致的原子损失可以忽略。随后在光阱中经蒸发冷却获得了约 \(1.2\times10^{5}\) 个原子的几乎纯的 \(^{39}\mathrm{K}\) 凝聚体。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要主要报告的是通过优化磁阱装载过程使装载效率提高约 15%，并强调装载时间远短于磁阱中原子寿命、装载损失可忽略。
papers.method_zh: 实验上优化磁阱装载过程，并测量磁阱装载效率；随后在光阱中进行蒸发冷却以获得 \(^{39}\mathrm{K}\) BEC。摘要未明确说明具体的磁阱结构、优化参数或蒸发冷却细节。

papers.title: Viscoelasticity reshapes the frequency response of a rotating magnetic particle
papers.abstract: A magnetic particle driven by a rotating magnetic field undergoes a transition from synchronous to asynchronous rotation at a critical driving frequency. The asynchronous dynamics is well understood in Newtonian fluids but remains unclear in viscoelastic media. Here, we develop a theoretical description of the asynchronous rotation of a magnetic particle in a Jeffreys-type viscoelastic fluid. The particle's time-averaged angular velocity exhibits a nontrivial frequency dependence that changes from non-monotonic to monotonic as the polymer relaxation time increases. This behavior is explained by the interplay among magnetic driving, viscoelastic relaxation, and frequency-dependent viscous dissipation. We further derive an asymptotic expression that captures the non-monotonic dependence. These results clarify how solvent and polymer contributions jointly control asynchronous rotation and provide a physical basis for guiding relevant applications in complex fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：develop a theoretical description、derive an asymptotic expression。；研究对象：在旋转磁场驱动下，处于 Jeffreys 型黏弹性流体中的磁性颗粒的异步旋转（asynchronous rotation）行为，以及其时间平均角速度随驱动频率的变化关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁性颗粒的时间平均角速度表现出非平凡的频率依赖关系：随着聚合物弛豫时间增大，该频率依赖关系从非单调变为单调。这一行为由磁驱动力、黏弹性弛豫和频率依赖的黏性耗散三者之间的相互竞争所解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁性颗粒的时间平均角速度表现出非平凡的频率依赖关系：随着聚合物弛豫时间增大，该频率依赖关系从非单调变为单调。这一行为由磁驱动力、黏弹性弛豫和频率依赖的黏性耗散三者之间的相互竞争所解释。；创新点：已有研究对牛顿流体中磁性颗粒的异步旋转已有较好理解，但在黏弹性介质中尚不清楚。本工作首次针对 Jeffreys 型黏弹性流体建立异步旋转的理论描述，揭示了聚合物弛豫时间对频率响应单调性的调控机制，并阐明了溶剂与聚合物贡献如何共同控制异步旋转。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Jeffreys 型黏弹性流体的理论框架，建立磁性颗粒异步旋转的理论描述，并推导了一个渐近表达式来刻画非单调依赖关系。摘要未明确说明是否涉及数值计算或实验验证。

papers.title: Pressure Evolution of Atomic Volume Systematics in Transition Metals
papers.abstract: We investigated the evolution of the well-known parabolic dependence of atomic volume on atomic number in transition metals under extreme compression at pressures up to 400 GPa using density functional theory calculations. Our results reveal that the ambient-pressure parabolic trend transforms into a characteristic cubic-like behavior at high pressures. This evolution is attributed to the higher compressibility of bcc transition metals associated with comparatively large increases in the total energy. The present findings are discussed in relation to previous experimental observations and first-principles calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：density functional theory calculations（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：过渡金属中原子体积随原子序数变化的规律（即著名的抛物线依赖关系）在极端压缩条件下的演化行为，压力最高达400 GPa。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 常压下的抛物线趋势在高压下转变为特征性的类立方行为；这一演化归因于bcc过渡金属具有更高的可压缩性，并伴随总能量的较大增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：常压下的抛物线趋势在高压下转变为特征性的类立方行为；这一演化归因于bcc过渡金属具有更高的可压缩性，并伴随总能量的较大增加。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要仅提到结果与先前实验观测和第一性原理计算进行了讨论，但未明确阐述相对于已有研究的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，压力条件最高至400 GPa。

papers.title: Transport properties and topological phase transitions for a Creutz-Su-Schrieffer-Heeger ladder
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the electronic, topological, and transport properties of a Creutz-Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (CSSH) ladder. Using a tight-binding model within the Green's function formalism, we calculate the energy spectrum, local density of states (LDOS), and electronic transmission. We first determine the energy spectrum of the CSSH ladder and analyze the different topological phases present in the system, identifying one trivial phase and three distinct nontrivial regions. We then study electronic transport and show that the transmission reproduces the different topological phases through characteristic transport signatures. Finally, we derive the conditions for the emergence of non-topological flat bands and demonstrate that these bands also provide the necessary conditions for the formation of bound states in the continuum (BICs). Our results establish a direct connection between the topological properties, flat-band formation, and electronic transport in the CSSH ladder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：tight-binding model（紧束缚模型）、Green's function formalism（格林函数形式）、calculate（计算）——摘要中未提及任何实验手段，属于基于模型的理论计算工作。；研究对象：Creutz-Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（CSSH）梯子模型的电子性质、拓扑性质和输运性质，具体包括能谱、局域态密度（LDOS）、电子透射率、拓扑相变、平带以及连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该CSSH梯子中存在一个平庸相和三个不同的非平庸拓扑区域，电子透射谱能通过特征输运信号再现这些拓扑相；此外，非拓扑平带的出现条件同时也是形成连续谱中束缚态（BICs）的必要条件，从而建立了拓扑性质、平带形成与电子输运之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该CSSH梯子中存在一个平庸相和三个不同的非平庸拓扑区域，电子透射谱能通过特征输运信号再现这些拓扑相；此外，非拓扑平带的出现条件同时也是形成连续谱中束缚态（BICs）的必要条件，从而建立了拓扑性质、平带形成与电子输运之间的直接联系。；创新点：摘要中明确指出的新意在于：揭示了CSSH梯子中非拓扑平带的出现条件与BICs形成条件之间的关联，并建立了拓扑性质、平带形成与电子输运三者之间的直接联系。相对于已有研究的具体新意，摘要未进一步明确说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚模型（tight-binding model），并在格林函数形式（Green's function formalism）框架下计算能谱、局域态密度（LDOS）和电子透射率。

papers.title: Successive Phase Transitions from a Composite Fermion Liquid to a Fractional Quantum Hall State at ν=3/2 Driven by In-Plane Magnetic Field
papers.abstract: We report an even-denominator fractional quantum Hall state at ν = 3/2 induced entirely by in-plane magnetic field B_|| in an ultra-high-mobility GaAs quantum well. As B_|| increases, the system undergoes two successive transitions: from a composite fermion liquid to a soft-gap FQH state (B_||~12.2 T), then via a topological phase transition to a hard-gap robust FQH state (B_||~14.7 T), accompanied by a daughter state at ν = 19/13. We present systematic data, and discuss a possible scenario in interpreting these findings. Our work demonstrates that topological order may be engineered through k-space Fermi contour splitting under an in-plane magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：report、systematic data、ultra-high-mobility GaAs quantum well、in-plane magnetic field 驱动下的测量。；研究对象：超高迁移率 GaAs 量子阱中的 ν=3/2 分数量子霍尔体系，以及面内磁场驱动的连续相变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超高迁移率 GaAs 量子阱中，面内磁场 B_|| 可完全诱导出 ν=3/2 的偶分母分数量子霍尔态；随 B_|| 增大，系统经历两次连续相变：从复合费米液体到软能隙 FQH 态（B_||~12.2 T），再经拓扑相变到硬能隙稳健 FQH 态（B_||~14.7 T），并伴随 ν=19/13 的子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超高迁移率 GaAs 量子阱中，面内磁场 B_|| 可完全诱导出 ν=3/2 的偶分母分数量子霍尔态；随 B_|| 增大，系统经历两次连续相变：从复合费米液体到软能隙 FQH 态（B_||~12.2 T），再经拓扑相变到硬能隙稳健 FQH 态（B_||~14.7 T），并伴随 ν=19/13 的子态。；创新点：首次展示面内磁场可完全诱导 ν=3/2 偶分母 FQH 态，并揭示其经历从复合费米液体到软能隙 FQH 态再到硬能隙 FQH 态的两次连续相变；提出通过面内磁场下的 k 空间费米轮廓劈裂来工程化拓扑序的可能机制。
papers.method_zh: 在超高迁移率 GaAs 量子阱中施加面内磁场 B_|| 并进行系统测量（摘要未明确说明具体的测量手段，如输运测量等）。

papers.title: Observation of multipartite spin entanglement in a cuprate chain
papers.abstract: Quantum materials are believed to host highly entangled states of matter, but probing and quantifying such entanglement has long remained experimentally elusive. Here, we use resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) as a probe of multipartite spin entanglement. By projecting the RIXS cross section onto the appropriate spin excitation channel, we show that the Quantum Fisher Information can be extracted directly from the measured spin fluctuation spectrum. We detect at least 7-partite spin entanglement in the model one-dimensional cuprate Sr$_2$CuO$_3$, revealing one of the largest entanglement depths yet reported in a solid. The observed entanglement depth agrees with Hubbard-model expectations and persists to elevated temperatures. Our results establish RIXS as an experimental probe of many-body spin entanglement and provide a platform for extensions to charge and orbital sectors and nonequilibrium settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：Observation、use ... as a probe、we detect、measured spin fluctuation spectrum、RIXS 实验手段。；研究对象：一维铜氧化物链模型材料 Sr$_2$CuO$_3$ 中的多体自旋纠缠（multipartite spin entanglement）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将 RIXS 散射截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道，从测量的自旋涨落谱中直接提取量子费舍尔信息（Quantum Fisher Information），在 Sr$_2$CuO$_3$ 中探测到至少 7 体自旋纠缠，这是固体中已报道的最大纠缠深度之一；该纠缠深度与 Hubbard 模型预期一致，并可持续到较高温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将 RIXS 散射截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道，从测量的自旋涨落谱中直接提取量子费舍尔信息（Quantum Fisher Information），在 Sr$_2$CuO$_3$ 中探测到至少 7 体自旋纠缠，这是固体中已报道的最大纠缠深度之一；该纠缠深度与 Hubbard 模型预期一致，并可持续到较高温度。；创新点：首次将 RIXS 确立为多体自旋纠缠的实验探针，实现了从自旋涨落谱直接提取量子费舍尔信息，并在固体中观测到迄今最大的纠缠深度之一；同时为向电荷、轨道自由度以及非平衡情形的扩展提供了平台。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS），将 RIXS 截面投影到合适的自旋激发通道以提取量子费舍尔信息；并与 Hubbard 模型预期进行对比。

papers.title: Textures as a phase-transition probe for quantum spin chains
papers.abstract: The idea of quantum texture has been recently proposed and used as a tool for quantifying coherences and for quantum gate identification. In this work we offer a study on its usage to quantum phase transitions, demonstrating the rugosity metric as a simple tool for effective phase-transition probing. We establish the link between rugosity in the computational basis and the hierarchy of spin correlators, and analyze rugosities defined in the global ground-state and in ground-states belonging to different magnetization sectors (to which we refer to as global vs symmetry-resolved rugosities) to study the phase diagram of the Heisenberg XXZ model. We find distinct rugosity signatures at both transition points. In particular, a sharp feature appears at $Δ=1$ already for small systems, revealing a pronounced sensitivity of the correlation hierarchy encoded by the texture to this point. Since the BKT transition coincides with the isotropic $SU(2)$ point of the XXZ model, this behavior may reflect a particular sensitivity of rugosity to the structure of the spin-correlation hierarchy at isotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提出并建立“quantum texture / rugosity”与自旋关联函数层级之间的联系，并用于分析 Heisenberg XXZ 模型的相图，属于理论框架与模型分析，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：量子自旋链的量子相变，具体为 Heisenberg XXZ 模型的相图；研究对象包括全局基态以及不同磁化扇区中的基态（对称性分辨的 rugosity），以及量子 texture 的 rugosity 度量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: rugosity 在 Heisenberg XXZ 模型的两个相变点均表现出不同的特征信号；特别是在 Δ=1 处，即使在小系统中也出现尖锐特征，表明 texture 所编码的关联层级对该点（各向同性 SU(2) 点，同时对应 BKT 转变）具有显著敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：rugosity 在 Heisenberg XXZ 模型的两个相变点均表现出不同的特征信号；特别是在 Δ=1 处，即使在小系统中也出现尖锐特征，表明 texture 所编码的关联层级对该点（各向同性 SU(2) 点，同时对应 BKT 转变）具有显著敏感性。；创新点：将近期提出的 quantum texture 概念用于量子相变探测，提出 rugosity 度量作为有效的相变探针；建立 rugosity 与自旋关联函数层级之间的理论联系，并区分全局与对称性分辨的 rugosity 来分析 XXZ 相图，发现 Δ=1 处小系统即出现尖锐特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，建立计算基下 rugosity 与自旋关联函数层级之间的联系；定义并比较全局基态与不同磁化扇区基态中的 rugosity（全局 vs 对称性分辨 rugosity），用于研究 Heisenberg XXZ 模型的相图。摘要未明确说明是否采用具体数值方法（如 DMRG、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Signatures of nodal superconductivity in stoichiometric FeTe
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in stoichiometric FeTe opens access to the FeTe endpoint of the Fe(Se,Te) phase diagram, yet the nature of its superconducting pairing state remains unresolved. In this work, we combine scanning superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscopy, electrical transport, scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/S), and mean-field calculations to investigate the local superfluid response and pairing state of FeTe thin films with tunable stoichiometry. Even in stoichiometric FeTe, we observe micrometer-scale spatial variations in both superfluid stiffness and superconducting transition temperature $T_c$, while the London penetration depth remains non-saturating down to 0.02$T_c$ and follows a power-law temperature dependence with an exponent of approximately 1-1.5. Together with a V-shaped low-energy density of states and two-gap modeling, these results indicate a superconducting state with gap nodes or deep minima, consistent with either a $d$-wave or nodal $s$-wave superconducting state. Our findings establish stoichiometric FeTe as a distinct superconducting regime that departs from the trend toward more isotropic gaps at intermediate Se/Te compositions, providing a new benchmark for modern microscopic theories of iron-chalcogenide superconductivity. Our work also reveals a crossover from weak to rapid suppression of $T_c$ as superfluid stiffness decreases, connecting FeTe to the broader phenomenology observed in unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，结合理论计算）。判断依据关键词：扫描 SQUID 显微镜、电输运、STM/S（实验手段）与平均场计算（理论方法）相结合。；研究对象：化学计量比 FeTe 薄膜（可调化学计量比）的超导配对态与局域超流响应，属于铁基硫族化合物超导体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使在化学计量比 FeTe 中，超流刚度与超导转变温度 $T_c$ 仍存在微米尺度空间不均匀性；伦敦穿透深度在低至 0.02$T_c$ 仍不饱和并呈幂律温度依赖（指数约 1–1.5），结合 V 形低能态密度和双能隙建模，表明其超导态具有能隙节点或深极小值，与 $d$-波或节点 $s$-波超导一致。此外还观察到随超流刚度降低，$T_c$ 从弱抑制到快速抑制的渡越行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使在化学计量比 FeTe 中，超流刚度与超导转变温度 $T_c$ 仍存在微米尺度空间不均匀性；伦敦穿透深度在低至 0.02$T_c$ 仍不饱和并呈幂律温度依赖（指数约 1–1.5），结合 V 形低能态密度和双能隙建模，表明其超导态具有能隙节点或深极小值，与 $d$-波或节点 $s$-波超导一致。此外还观察到随超流刚度降低，$T_c$ 从弱抑制到快速抑制的渡越行为。；创新点：确立了化学计量比 FeTe 作为一个区别于中间 Se/Te 组分（趋向更各向同性能隙）的独特超导区域，为铁基硫族超导的微观理论提供新基准；并揭示了超流刚度降低时 $T_c$ 抑制行为的渡越，将 FeTe 与非常规超导体的更广泛现象学联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 扫描 SQUID 显微镜（局域超流响应）、电输运测量、扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/S）、平均场计算。

papers.title: Atomistic modeling of molecular beam epitaxy growth of SrTiO3 and Sr2TiO4 thin films
papers.abstract: Molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) is renowned for its potential for atomic layer control, but unexpected growth mechanisms can potentially compromise this level of precision. In this study, we employ first-principles calculations to investigate the atomistic processes governing the MBE growth of perovskite SrTiO3 and Ruddlesden-Popper Sr2TiO4 films on a SrTiO3 substrate. We systematically explore the potential molecular species in the gas phase and their reactions and diffusion dynamics on the film surfaces and layer edges. Our analyses uncover three mechanisms of importance for understanding this type of growth. First, oxygen vacancies can be dynamically induced during surface diffusion on defect-free substrate and noticeably accelerate the diffusion processes. Second, while the SrO layer is expected to grow in a single-layer growth mode, the presence of potential TiSr defects may promote the formation of SrO islands. Lastly, adsorbed Ti atoms and TiO2 molecules on the SrO bilayer can insert into SrO bilayers, resulting in an unexpected growth sequence. These findings may have broader implications for the MBE growth of metal oxide films and provide guidance for achieving improved control over their growth processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles calculations、atomistic processes、systematically explore。；研究对象：钙钛矿 SrTiO₃ 和 Ruddlesden-Popper 相 Sr₂TiO₄ 薄膜在 SrTiO₃ 衬底上的分子束外延（MBE）生长过程，具体关注气相中的潜在分子种类及其在薄膜表面和层边缘的反应与扩散动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究揭示了三种重要机制：(1) 在无缺陷衬底表面扩散过程中可动态诱导氧空位，并显著加速扩散过程；(2) 虽然 SrO 层预期以单层生长模式生长，但潜在 TiSr 缺陷的存在可能促进 SrO 岛的形成；(3) 吸附在 SrO 双层上的 Ti 原子和 TiO₂ 分子可插入 SrO 双层中，导致意外的生长序列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究揭示了三种重要机制：(1) 在无缺陷衬底表面扩散过程中可动态诱导氧空位，并显著加速扩散过程；(2) 虽然 SrO 层预期以单层生长模式生长，但潜在 TiSr 缺陷的存在可能促进 SrO 岛的形成；(3) 吸附在 SrO 双层上的 Ti 原子和 TiO₂ 分子可插入 SrO 双层中，导致意外的生长序列。；创新点：从原子尺度揭示了 MBE 生长 SrTiO₃ 和 Sr₂TiO₄ 薄膜中三种此前未被充分认识的生长机制（氧空位动态诱导加速扩散、TiSr 缺陷促进 SrO 岛形成、Ti/TiO₂ 插入 SrO 双层导致意外生长序列），这些发现对金属氧化物薄膜的 MBE 生长具有更广泛的启示意义，并为改进生长过程控制提供指导。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），系统探究气相潜在分子种类及其在薄膜表面和层边缘的反应与扩散动力学。摘要未明确说明具体是否使用 DFT+U 等特定泛函方法。

papers.title: Tunable topological narrow bands in twisted bilayer-trilayer graphene
papers.abstract: We investigate the low-energy band structure and topology of twisted bilayer--trilayer graphene with four stacking configurations: AB--ABC, BA--ABC, AB--ABA, and BA--ABA. Using both tight-binding and continuum models, we first establish that the two approaches show good agreement in the band structure in low-energy regime. We then study the evolution of the flat bands and their valley Chern numbers as functions of twist angle, perpendicular electric field, and the self-consistent Hartree potential. At relatively large twist angles and under electric field, we find a topological transition between the narrow bands, with the total Chern number of the flat bands following the Chern number sum rules derived from the chiral-limit description. We also observe another type of topological transition when the flat bands hybridize with adjacent remote bands, where gap closing and reopening processes lead to Chern number and charge density transfer. By constructing topological phase diagrams in the space of twist angle and electric field, we show that the perpendicular electric field provides an efficient tuning knob for controlling the stability and transitions of the Chern bands. Finally, we find that the Hartree potential mainly induce weak band shifts and reshaping in the narrow bands. However, with a combination of Hartree potential and the electric fields, the narrow bands show rich topological phase diagram. Our results clarify the interplay between the stacking, twist angle and electric field in manipulating the narrow bands and their topology in twisted bilayer--trilayer graphene, and provide guidance for engineering topological narrow bands with tunable Chern numbers in realistic twisted multilayer graphene systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：tight-binding and continuum models、self-consistent Hartree potential、topological phase diagrams、Chern number sum rules。；研究对象：扭转双层-三层石墨烯（twisted bilayer-trilayer graphene），具体研究四种堆叠构型：AB–ABC、BA–ABC、AB–ABA、BA–ABA 中的低能能带结构与拓扑性质，以及平带（窄带）随扭转角、垂直电场和 Hartree 势的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在较大扭转角和电场下，窄带之间发生拓扑相变，平带总陈数遵循手性极限导出的陈数求和规则；平带与相邻远程带杂化时会出现另一类拓扑相变，伴随能隙闭合-重开以及陈数和电荷密度转移。垂直电场是调控陈数带稳定性和相变的高效调节手段；Hartree 势主要引起窄带的弱能带移动和重塑，但与电场结合时可产生丰富的拓扑相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在较大扭转角和电场下，窄带之间发生拓扑相变，平带总陈数遵循手性极限导出的陈数求和规则；平带与相邻远程带杂化时会出现另一类拓扑相变，伴随能隙闭合-重开以及陈数和电荷密度转移。垂直电场是调控陈数带稳定性和相变的高效调节手段；Hartree 势主要引起窄带的弱能带移动和重塑，但与电场结合时可产生丰富的拓扑相图。；创新点：系统比较了四种双层-三层石墨烯堆叠构型中窄带拓扑随扭转角、垂直电场和 Hartree 势的演化，揭示了两类拓扑相变（窄带间相变及窄带与远程带杂化引起的相变），并证明垂直电场可高效调控陈数带的稳定性和相变，为实际扭转多层石墨烯体系中可调陈数拓扑窄带的工程化提供了指导。
papers.method_zh: 紧束缚模型（tight-binding）与连续模型（continuum models）相结合，并引入自洽 Hartree 势；通过计算能带结构、谷陈数，构建扭转角-电场空间的拓扑相图。

papers.title: Electronic Orbital Angular Momentum Driven by Finite-Momentum Phonons: Beyond Chiral and Axial Phonons
papers.abstract: We show that finite-momentum phonons generate electronic orbital angular momentum (OAM) even without phonon axiality or chirality, with the response controlled by the phonon wave vector $q$ and frequency $ω$. We develop a general gauge-field theory in which a unitary transformation absorbs the phonon displacement into emergent vector and scalar potentials acting on the electrons, providing a perturbative classification of the OAM response in $q$ and $ω$. We derive $q$- and $ω$-scaling laws for AC and DC responses. Notably, AC OAM arises even for linearly polarized phonons, with its magnitude and sign tunable by $q$. Its generation is governed by the matching between the phonon geometry and the electronic orbital texture rather than solely by the phonon angular momentum. The connection of the DC response to the electronic Berry curvature further supports that phonon angular momentum is not the only degree of freedom governing electronic OAM generation. Time-dependent tight-binding simulations under acoustic-phonon driving independently confirm the core predictions. Our results extend phonon-driven OAM beyond chiral and axial phonons and establish a wave-vector-tunable route to orbitronics, accessible with surface acoustic waves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章为主，结合数值模拟验证。判断依据关键词：develop a general gauge-field theory、perturbative classification、derive scaling laws、time-dependent tight-binding simulations independently confirm——以理论推导为核心，辅以紧束缚数值模拟验证，摘要中未提及任何实验测量。；研究对象：有限动量声子（finite-momentum phonons）驱动电子轨道角动量（OAM）的物理现象，不涉及具体材料，属于一般性理论框架下的声子-电子耦合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限动量声子即使不具备手性（chirality）或轴向性（axiality），也能产生电子轨道角动量；该响应由声子波矢 q 和频率 ω 控制，且AC响应即使在线性偏振声子下也能出现，其大小和符号可通过 q 调控。电子OAM的产生取决于声子几何与电子轨道织构（orbital texture）之间的匹配，而非仅由声子角动量决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限动量声子即使不具备手性（chirality）或轴向性（axiality），也能产生电子轨道角动量；该响应由声子波矢 q 和频率 ω 控制，且AC响应即使在线性偏振声子下也能出现，其大小和符号可通过 q 调控。电子OAM的产生取决于声子几何与电子轨道织构（orbital texture）之间的匹配，而非仅由声子角动量决定。；创新点：将声子驱动电子OAM的机制从传统的手性声子和轴向声子推广到一般的有限动量声子，证明手性和轴向性并非必要条件；揭示了声子几何与电子轨道织构匹配这一新机制，并指出声子角动量不是决定电子OAM产生的唯一自由度；提出了一种波矢可调的轨道电子学（orbitronics）路径，可通过表面声波（surface acoustic waves）实现。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一种规范场理论（gauge-field theory），通过幺正变换将声子位移吸收为作用于电子的涌现矢量和标量势，从而对OAM响应在 q 和 ω 上进行微扰分类；推导了AC和DC响应的 q 和 ω 标度律；并用含时紧束缚模拟（time-dependent tight-binding simulations）在声学声子驱动下独立验证核心预言。

papers.title: Selective coupling of high-order phonons in La2-xSrxCuO4
papers.abstract: In crystals and molecules with strong coupling between the charge carriers and atomic vibrations, high order harmonics of the vibrational excitations can be observed with intensity following the Franck-Condon envelope. Here, we uncover a new regime of electron-phonon coupling in La2-xSrxCuO4 using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering. In the undoped compound, we find sharp peaks at approximately 85$\pm$5 meV, 180$\pm$7 meV, and 330$\pm$5 meV with no observable dispersion, and an absence of appreciable intensity from other modes observed in Raman spectroscopy in this energy range. The 180 meV and 330 meV excitations have energies approximately consistent with two-phonon and four-phonon in-plane Cu-O bond stretching mode, suggesting that the resonantly excited valence electrons strongly couple to this mode. These excitations exhibit significant doping dependence, eventually becoming unresolvable at 10% hole doping, where the low energy charge excitations are dominated by dispersive plasmons. The observation of selective coupling to even-ordered phonons and stark contrast with the Raman spectra indicate anomalous electron-phonon coupling beyond the Franck-Condon picture. One intriguing possibility is the existence of locally paired quasiparticles in insulating cuprates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：使用共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS）作为主要研究手段，并报告了具体测量结果（峰位、能量、掺杂依赖等）。；研究对象：空穴掺杂铜氧化物超导体 La2-xSrxCuO4（LSCO），重点研究其中的电子-声子耦合以及高阶声子激发行为，特别是面内 Cu-O 键伸缩模式及其掺杂演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在未掺杂的 La2-xSrxCuO4 中观察到约 85±5 meV、180±7 meV 和 330±5 meV 的尖锐无色散峰，其中 180 meV 和 330 meV 分别与双声子和四声子面内 Cu-O 键伸缩模式能量一致，表明价电子与该模式发生选择性强耦合；这些激发随掺杂显著变化，在 10% 空穴掺杂时变得不可分辨，此时低能电荷激发由色散等离激元主导。该选择性偶数阶声子耦合与拉曼光谱形成鲜明对比，暗示超出 Franck-Condon 图像的异常电子-声子耦合，并可能指向绝缘铜氧化物中局域配对准粒子的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在未掺杂的 La2-xSrxCuO4 中观察到约 85±5 meV、180±7 meV 和 330±5 meV 的尖锐无色散峰，其中 180 meV 和 330 meV 分别与双声子和四声子面内 Cu-O 键伸缩模式能量一致，表明价电子与该模式发生选择性强耦合；这些激发随掺杂显著变化，在 10% 空穴掺杂时变得不可分辨，此时低能电荷激发由色散等离激元主导。该选择性偶数阶声子耦合与拉曼光谱形成鲜明对比，暗示超出 Franck-Condon 图像的异常电子-声子耦合，并可能指向绝缘铜氧化物中局域配对准粒子的存在。；创新点：揭示了 La2-xSrxCuO4 中一种新的电子-声子耦合区域：对偶数阶（双声子、四声子）面内 Cu-O 键伸缩模式的选择性耦合，且与拉曼光谱中观察到的其他模式缺乏显著强度形成强烈反差，表明该耦合超出传统 Franck-Condon 图像；同时展示了该激发随掺杂的显著演化，并提出了绝缘铜氧化物中局域配对准粒子存在的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS）；并与拉曼光谱结果进行对比。

papers.title: Edge energy fluctuation: A unified theory of friction scaling laws in twisted layered material interfaces
papers.abstract: Interlayer twisting in van der Waals (vdW) layered materials generates moire superlattices, unlocking unique opportunities for engineering their electronic and mechanical functionalities. Here, building on two key insights - the invariance of the potential energy of complete moire tiles during sliding, and the symmetry-breaking effect induced by the slider edge - we propose the concept of edge energy fluctuation (EEF) and demonstrate that the EEF governs the sliding energy barrier of finite-sized sliders. Interestingly, we found that even at a fixed twist angle and sliding direction, significant frictional anisotropy emerges when the slider edge is cut along different directions, resulting in distinct friction scaling laws. Furthermore, we present a friction engineering paradigm for twisted layered material interfaces through the deliberate introduction of hierarchical edges, offering a promising route for friction control in superlubric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：propose the concept、demonstrate、found、present a paradigm，摘要中未提及具体实验测量或第一性原理计算细节，以概念提出和理论分析为主。；研究对象：范德华（vdW）层状材料界面中的层间扭转体系，即扭转双层/多层材料形成的莫尔超晶格界面，以及有限尺寸滑块在该界面上的滑动摩擦行为与摩擦各向异性、摩擦标度律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出“边缘能量涨落（EEF）”概念，指出有限尺寸滑块的滑动能垒由EEF主导；即使在固定扭转角和滑动方向下，当滑块边缘沿不同方向切割时会出现显著摩擦各向异性，并导致不同的摩擦标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出“边缘能量涨落（EEF）”概念，指出有限尺寸滑块的滑动能垒由EEF主导；即使在固定扭转角和滑动方向下，当滑块边缘沿不同方向切割时会出现显著摩擦各向异性，并导致不同的摩擦标度律。；创新点：提出边缘能量涨落（EEF）这一统一理论来解释扭转层状材料界面的摩擦标度律；揭示了固定扭转角和滑动方向下由边缘切割方向引起的摩擦各向异性；并提出通过刻意引入分级边缘（hierarchical edges）进行摩擦调控的范式，为超润滑器件的摩擦控制提供途径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段、计算方法或理论框架（如DFT、分子动力学等），仅说明基于两个关键认识——完整莫尔瓦片在滑动过程中势能不变、以及滑块边缘诱导的对称性破缺效应——来提出EEF概念并进行理论论证。

papers.title: Leveraged Learning: entropy destroyed per bit received
papers.abstract: A learner holds a prior belief over boolean maps that answer a finite set of $Q$ questions, and receives answers one by one. Each answer costs surprisal and destroys uncertainty, not only about the question asked but every question still unasked. We call the ratio the leverage: table entropy destroyed per bit of surprisal received. It is unit for a uniform prior, but with an intelligent prior can be higher (not lower). Averaged over the truth prior and over the question order, the leverage is found exactly, and is generated by one sequence: the mean entropy $G_\ell$ of the answers to $\ell$ questions. Sending the number of input bits to infinity at fixed asked fraction $t = \ell/Q$, the increments of that sequence become a profile $γ(t)$, and initial question entropy $η_0$. The leverage closes to a thermodynamic limit. $L(t) = [η_0 - (1-t)γ(t)]/\int_0^t γ$. Exchangeable priors, by de Finetti, all give a flat $γ(t)$ and hence a hyperbolic $L(t)$, their deduction confined to a boundary layer at $t = 0$. We construct a simplicity prior that escapes this, grading Boolean maps by the degree of their polynomial over $\mathbb{F}_2$ and budgeting weight across degree shells by a CDF $F$. Reed-Muller capacity then gives $γ(t) = 1 - F(t)$ exactly, so any nonincreasing profile, and any leverage curve it generates, is realizable at macroscopic times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中未涉及任何实验测量或数值模拟细节，全文围绕先验信念、熵、信息量等概念进行数学推导与解析求解，属于信息论/统计物理交叉的理论框架构建。；研究对象：一个学习者在有限布尔映射（boolean maps）上的先验信念，以及其逐个接收答案时的信息获取过程。具体研究的是“杠杆率”（leverage）——每接收一比特意外量（surprisal）所摧毁的表格熵（table entropy），以及该杠杆率在问题数趋于无穷时的热力学极限行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 杠杆率（每比特意外量摧毁的熵）在均匀先验下为1，智能先验下可以更高但不会更低；对真值先验和问题顺序取平均后，杠杆率可精确求出，并由答案平均熵序列 \(G_\ell\) 生成；在固定提问比例 \(t=\ell/Q\) 且输入比特数趋于无穷时，杠杆率趋于热力学极限 \(L(t)=[\eta_0-(1-t)\gamma(t)]/\int_0^t\gamma\)。可交换先验（exchangeable priors）给出平坦的 \(\gamma(t)\) 和双曲型 \(L(t)\)，其推断被限制在 \(t=0\) 的边界层；而通过按 \(\mathbb{F}_2\) 上多项式次数分级并利用 Reed-Muller 容量构造的“简单性先验”可精确给出 \(\gamma(t)=1-F(t)\)，从而实现任意非增剖面及对应的杠杆率曲线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：杠杆率（每比特意外量摧毁的熵）在均匀先验下为1，智能先验下可以更高但不会更低；对真值先验和问题顺序取平均后，杠杆率可精确求出，并由答案平均熵序列 \(G_\ell\) 生成；在固定提问比例 \(t=\ell/Q\) 且输入比特数趋于无穷时，杠杆率趋于热力学极限 \(L(t)=[\eta_0-(1-t)\gamma(t)]/\int_0^t\gamma\)。可交换先验（exchangeable priors）给出平坦的 \(\gamma(t)\) 和双曲型 \(L(t)\)，其推断被限制在 \(t=0\) 的边界层；而通过按 \(\mathbb{F}_2\) 上多项式次数分级并利用 Reed-Muller 容量构造的“简单性先验”可精确给出 \(\gamma(t)=1-F(t)\)，从而实现任意非增剖面及对应的杠杆率曲线。；创新点：首次提出并精确求解了“杠杆率”这一信息获取效率度量，揭示了其热力学极限形式；指出可交换先验的局限性（推断被限制在边界层），并构造了基于布尔映射多项式次数分级的简单性先验，证明任意非增剖面和杠杆率曲线在宏观时间尺度上均可实现。摘要未突出说明与已有具体文献的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为贝叶斯学习/信息论分析，结合 de Finetti 定理处理可交换先验，利用 \(\mathbb{F}_2\) 上布尔映射的多项式次数分级、累积分布函数（CDF）\(F\) 进行权重分配，并借助 Reed-Muller 容量精确求解 \(\gamma(t)\)。属于解析推导，无实验手段或数值计算方法。

papers.title: Nonlinear Topological Orbital Responses of Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions evade the skyrmion Hall effect, but compensation suppresses their conventional topological charge Hall signal. We predict a semiclassical nonlinear topological orbital response of an isolated skyrmion in a $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric hexagonal antiferromagnet without spin-orbit coupling. In the diffusive, weak-emergent-field regime, the spin-dependent emergent Lorentz force reshapes the carrier distribution, generating a local orbital Hall-current correction and a local orbital accumulation, both quadratic in the applied electric field. The current correction requires spin-asymmetric longitudinal scattering, whereas the accumulation survives spin-symmetric scattering. When the spin-diffusion length greatly exceeds the strip width, the current correction persists while the accumulation approaches zero. Both signals are even under electric-field reversal, odd under reversal of the skyrmion topological charge $Q$, and helicity independent within this model. These symmetries enable rectified detection and distinguish this mechanism from the $Q$-even quantum-regime topological orbital Hall effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中使用“We predict”（我们预测）、“semiclassical nonlinear topological orbital response”等理论预测性表述，未提及任何实验测量或数值计算方法，属于纯理论/模型分析工作。；研究对象：$\mathcal{PT}$对称六角反铁磁体中的孤立反铁磁斯格明子（antiferromagnetic skyrmion），研究其在无自旋轨道耦合条件下的非线性拓扑轨道响应，包括局部轨道霍尔电流修正和局部轨道积累。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁斯格明子虽因补偿效应抑制了常规拓扑电荷霍尔信号，但在扩散区弱涌现场条件下，自旋依赖的涌现洛伦兹力会重塑载流子分布，产生正比于电场平方的局部轨道霍尔电流修正和局部轨道积累；前者需要自旋非对称纵向散射，后者在自旋对称散射下仍可存活。当自旋扩散长度远大于条带宽度时，电流修正持续存在而积累趋于零。两种信号在电场反向下为偶、在斯格明子拓扑荷$Q$反向下为奇，且在该模型中与螺旋度无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁斯格明子虽因补偿效应抑制了常规拓扑电荷霍尔信号，但在扩散区弱涌现场条件下，自旋依赖的涌现洛伦兹力会重塑载流子分布，产生正比于电场平方的局部轨道霍尔电流修正和局部轨道积累；前者需要自旋非对称纵向散射，后者在自旋对称散射下仍可存活。当自旋扩散长度远大于条带宽度时，电流修正持续存在而积累趋于零。两种信号在电场反向下为偶、在斯格明子拓扑荷$Q$反向下为奇，且在该模型中与螺旋度无关。；创新点：首次预测了反铁磁斯格明子中由非线性拓扑轨道响应产生的局部轨道霍尔电流修正和轨道积累，揭示了其与$Q$-偶的量子区拓扑轨道霍尔效应在对称性上的本质区别（该机制信号在$Q$反向下为奇），并指出这些对称性可用于整流检测，从而将反铁磁斯格明子的拓扑响应从被抑制的电荷霍尔信号拓展到非线性轨道通道。
papers.method_zh: 采用半经典理论框架，在扩散区、弱涌现场近似下分析自旋依赖的涌现洛伦兹力对载流子分布的重塑效应，结合自旋扩散长度与条带宽度关系的输运分析。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值方法（如DFT、紧束缚模型等）。

papers.title: Substrate-induced crystallisation in polymers: Exceptional impact of prefreezing versus heterogeneous nucleation on kinetics and morphology
papers.abstract: Crystallisation of liquids often occurs at solid surfaces, via heterogeneous nucleation or prefreezing. Understanding this process is crucial for controlling crystal morphology in thin films and developing efficient nucleating agents - especially for polymers, typically processed in a molten state. However, the efficiency of nucleation and prefreezing with respect to crystallisation kinetics and semicrystalline polymer morphology has not been well studied and remains unclear. Here, we address this challenge by conducting a systematic study of substrate-induced crystallisation in dewetted droplets of the model polymer poly($\varepsilon$-caprolactone) (PCL) on various crystalline and amorphous substrates. Using polarized light optical microscopy, droplet crystallisation temperature was monitored and varied across the substrates, revealing three scenarios: close-to-homogeneous nucleation on glass and silicon; heterogeneous nucleation on ordered and disordered carbon-rich substrates; and prefreezing on graphene. The temperature-dependent nucleation rate was analysed and found to obey classical nucleation theory for all systems except PCL on graphene, where it diverges as all the droplets crystallise simultaneously. The highest in- and out-of-plane PCL crystal orientation is found on graphene, where the epitaxially grown lamellae extend vertically over several hundred nanometres. These results demonstrate that prefreezing has a superior influence on crystallisation kinetics and crystal morphology, making prefreezing substrates perfect nucleating agents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：使用偏光光学显微镜（polarized light optical microscopy）监测液滴结晶温度，属于实验观测研究。；研究对象：模型聚合物聚己内酯（PCL）去润湿液滴在不同基底（玻璃、硅、有序和无序富碳基底、石墨烯）上的基底诱导结晶行为，关注异质成核与预冻结（prefreezing）两种机制对结晶动力学和晶体形貌的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同基底上PCL液滴的结晶行为呈现三种情形：玻璃和硅上接近均质成核，有序和无序富碳基底上为异质成核，石墨烯上为预冻结。预冻结（石墨烯体系）使所有液滴同时结晶，偏离经典成核理论，且石墨烯上PCL晶体取向度最高，外延生长的片晶可垂直延伸数百纳米，表明预冻结对结晶动力学和晶体形貌的影响优于异质成核。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同基底上PCL液滴的结晶行为呈现三种情形：玻璃和硅上接近均质成核，有序和无序富碳基底上为异质成核，石墨烯上为预冻结。预冻结（石墨烯体系）使所有液滴同时结晶，偏离经典成核理论，且石墨烯上PCL晶体取向度最高，外延生长的片晶可垂直延伸数百纳米，表明预冻结对结晶动力学和晶体形貌的影响优于异质成核。；创新点：系统比较了预冻结与异质成核两种基底诱导结晶机制对聚合物结晶动力学和半晶形貌的影响差异，揭示了预冻结在动力学和形貌控制上优于异质成核，提出预冻结基底可作为理想成核剂。摘要指出此前关于成核与预冻结在结晶动力学和半晶聚合物形貌方面的效率尚未被充分研究。
papers.method_zh: 采用偏光光学显微镜监测去润湿PCL液滴在不同基底上的结晶温度，分析温度依赖的成核速率并与经典成核理论对比；表征PCL晶体的面内和面外取向及片晶形貌。

papers.title: Limit Cycles in a Photonic Dimer with Tuneable Non-Hermitian Interactions
papers.abstract: Interactions govern the emergence of collective behaviour in classical and quantum many-body systems. While conservative interactions are well known to generate nonlinear phenomena ranging from self-trapping to pattern formation, it remains largely unexplored whether purely dissipative -- i.e., non-Hermitian -- interactions can give rise to similarly rich dynamics and nontrivial system states. Here, we experimentally realise tuneable non-Hermitian interactions in two coupled condensates of light confined within a dye-filled double-well microcavity. Local coupling to molecular reservoirs generates the effective dissipative photon interactions. We show that the interplay between coherent tunnelling and interactions stabilises limit-cycle oscillations, a hallmark of nonlinear dynamics traditionally associated with Hermitian nonlinearities. By tuning the reservoir coupling, we map out the dynamical phase diagram comprising stable fixed points and limit cycles, thereby demonstrating direct control over the interaction strength. Our experimentally validated model reveals both supercritical and subcritical Hopf bifurcations, giving rise to hysteresis, bistability and excitability. These results validate dissipative interactions as a mechanism for organising collective nonlinear dynamics in driven-dissipative systems and pave the way towards exploring nonequilibrium many-body physics through controlled dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（混合类型，含实验与理论建模）。判断依据关键词：“experimentally realise”“experimentally validated model”“we map out the dynamical phase diagram”。；研究对象：染料填充双势阱微腔中两个耦合的光凝聚体（photonic dimer），以及其中由耗散性相互作用驱动的非线性动力学现象（极限环振荡、Hopf 分岔等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纯耗散（非厄米）相互作用下，相干隧穿与相互作用的竞争可以稳定极限环振荡；通过调节储库耦合强度可控制系统进入稳定不动点或极限环，并观察到超临界与亚临界 Hopf 分岔，导致迟滞、双稳和可激性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纯耗散（非厄米）相互作用下，相干隧穿与相互作用的竞争可以稳定极限环振荡；通过调节储库耦合强度可控制系统进入稳定不动点或极限环，并观察到超临界与亚临界 Hopf 分岔，导致迟滞、双稳和可激性。；创新点：首次在实验上实现可调的非厄米相互作用，并证明纯耗散相互作用（而非传统的厄米非线性）足以组织丰富的集体非线性动力学（极限环、Hopf 分岔、双稳等），为通过受控耗散探索非平衡多体物理提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上在染料填充双势阱微腔中实现两个耦合光凝聚体，通过局域耦合到分子储库产生有效的耗散型光子相互作用；结合实验验证的理论模型进行动力学相图分析。

papers.title: Steady reservoir-mediated self-trapping of polariton condensates
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium bosonic condensates of exciton-polaritons generated by tightly focused incoherent optical beams are typically expected to form a stationary ballistically expanding state with the notable exception of experimentally observed compact self-trapped states [Phys. Rev. Lett. 123, 047401 (2019)]. We show that the back-action of the condensate on the optically pumped excitonic reservoir via bosonic stimulated scattering can cause local reservoir depletion, producing a steady condensate confined in a self-induced potential trap. Notably, this self-trapped state is formed by persistent converging rather than radially expanding polariton currents and exists even below the conventionally defined condensation threshold. This state remains steady over nanosecond-scale times and is eventually ejected from the self-induced trap due to a bullet-type instability, enabling spiking neuromorphic dynamics in networks of polariton condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We show that... can cause...”“is formed”“exists”等理论推导与机制阐述语言，未提及具体实验测量手段或计算细节，属于理论模型分析。；研究对象：由紧聚焦非相干光束产生的激子-极化激元非平衡玻色凝聚体，具体研究其中实验已观测到的紧凑自束缚态（self-trapped state）的形成机制，以及凝聚体与光学泵浦激子库之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 凝聚体通过玻色受激散射对激子库产生反作用，导致局域库耗尽，从而形成一个由自诱导势阱束缚的稳态凝聚体；该自束缚态由持续会聚（而非径向膨胀）的极化激元流形成，且可在常规定义的凝聚阈值以下存在，并在纳秒尺度保持稳定，最终因“子弹型”不稳定性被弹出势阱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：凝聚体通过玻色受激散射对激子库产生反作用，导致局域库耗尽，从而形成一个由自诱导势阱束缚的稳态凝聚体；该自束缚态由持续会聚（而非径向膨胀）的极化激元流形成，且可在常规定义的凝聚阈值以下存在，并在纳秒尺度保持稳定，最终因“子弹型”不稳定性被弹出势阱。；创新点：揭示了自束缚态的形成源于凝聚体对激子库的反作用导致的局域库耗尽与自诱导势阱，而非传统的径向膨胀图像；指出该态由持续会聚的极化激元流形成，且可存在于常规凝聚阈值以下；并指出其最终因子弹型不稳定性被弹出，从而可实现极化激元凝聚体网络中的脉冲神经形态动力学。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段、计算方法或理论框架，仅提及基于玻色受激散射的反作用机制进行理论分析。

papers.title: Vertical quantum confinement in bulk MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: We experimentally observe quantum confinement states in bulk MoS$_2$ using Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES). The band structure at the $\overlineΓ$ point reveals quantum well states (QWSs) linked to vertical quantum confinement of the electrons, confirmed by the absence of dispersion in k$_z$ and a strong intensity modulation with photon energy. Notably, the binding energy dependence of the QWSs vs $n$ does not follow the quadratic dependence of a two-dimensional electron gas. Instead, a linear behaviour is observed that is consistent with a parabolic-like quantum well. This confinement arises from the mechanical exfoliation preparation method, which leads to the detachment of a multilayer stack from the underlying bulk. This is confirmed by Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations. The quantum confinement in bulk-like MoS$_2$ not only offers the opportunity to explore intersubband transitions to exploit optical properties but also provides a means to study fundamental quantum phenomena in multilayer stacks of different thicknesses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章，结合计算验证。关键依据：摘要以“We experimentally observe”开头，主要使用 ARPES 实验观测，并用 DFT 计算进行确认。；研究对象：体态（bulk）MoS₂ 中的垂直量子限域效应及量子阱态（QWSs），具体观测位于布里渊区 Γ̄ 点的能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在体态 MoS₂ 中实验观测到由垂直量子限域引起的量子阱态，其 k_z 方向无色散且强度随光子能量强烈调制；QWSs 的结合能随量子数 n 呈线性依赖，而非二维电子气的二次方依赖，符合抛物线型量子阱的特征。该限域来源于机械剥离制备过程导致多层堆叠从底层体材料脱离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在体态 MoS₂ 中实验观测到由垂直量子限域引起的量子阱态，其 k_z 方向无色散且强度随光子能量强烈调制；QWSs 的结合能随量子数 n 呈线性依赖，而非二维电子气的二次方依赖，符合抛物线型量子阱的特征。该限域来源于机械剥离制备过程导致多层堆叠从底层体材料脱离。；创新点：首次在体态 MoS₂ 中实验观测到垂直量子限域导致的量子阱态，并发现其结合能随 n 呈线性依赖而非二维电子气的二次方依赖；揭示了机械剥离制备方法可诱导多层堆叠从体材料脱离从而产生量子限域，为研究不同厚度多层堆叠中的基本量子现象及子带间跃迁的光学应用提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量能带结构，通过 k_z 无色散和光子能量依赖的强度调制确认量子阱态；理论上使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行验证。

papers.title: Hysteretic Coherence Collapse Across the First Order CDW Transition in 1T-TaS2
papers.abstract: The first order phase transition between the nearly commensurate (NC-CDW) and commensurate (C-CDW) charge density wave phases in 1T-TaS2 underpins its exotic electronic behavior, yet the spectroscopic evolution of the low energy electronic structure across this transition remains crucial to understand. Using angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we investigate the low temperature C-CDW phase, characterized by a flat band commonly associated with the lower Hubbard band and a distinct in-gap state located closer to the Fermi level. Photon energy dependent measurements distinguish these two low energy features through their different spectral weight evolution. Temperature dependent ARPES across heating and cooling cycles reveals that the in-gap state undergoes an abrupt collapse upon heating into the NC-CDW phase and re-emerges sharply upon cooling back into the C-CDW phase. This pronounced thermal hysteresis provides direct spectroscopic evidence of the first order nature of the transition. Furthermore, the disappearance and recovery of the in-gap state closely track the corresponding changes in resistivity, highlighting its intimate connection to the electronic reconstruction across the C-CDW/NC-CDW phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：使用 ARPES（角分辨光电子能谱）进行测量，属于实验研究。；研究对象：1T-TaS₂ 中近公度电荷密度波（NC-CDW）与公度电荷密度波（C-CDW）之间的第一性相变，以及该相变过程中低能电子结构的光谱演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 C-CDW 相中存在一个靠近费米能级的带隙内态（in-gap state），该态在升温进入 NC-CDW 相时突然消失、降温回到 C-CDW 相时又骤然重现，表现出显著的热滞现象，直接以光谱证据证实了该相变的第一性本质；且该带隙内态的消失与恢复与电阻率变化密切对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 C-CDW 相中存在一个靠近费米能级的带隙内态（in-gap state），该态在升温进入 NC-CDW 相时突然消失、降温回到 C-CDW 相时又骤然重现，表现出显著的热滞现象，直接以光谱证据证实了该相变的第一性本质；且该带隙内态的消失与恢复与电阻率变化密切对应。；创新点：首次通过变温 ARPES 直接观测到带隙内态在 C-CDW/NC-CDW 相变中的突然坍缩与重现及其热滞行为，为 1T-TaS₂ 该相变的第一性本质提供了直接的光谱学证据，并揭示了该带隙内态与相变中电子重构及电阻率变化的紧密关联。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）；通过变光子能量测量区分平带与带隙内态的光谱权重演化；在升温和降温循环中进行变温 ARPES 测量。

papers.title: Tensor network investigation of the monomer-dimer model on the honeycomb lattice
papers.abstract: The monomer-dimer model is one of the most well-known unsolved lattice models. In this paper we study the monomer-dimer model on the honeycomb lattice using the tensor network method, in the case that the dimer and monomer activities are 1. The monomer-dimer configurations are exactly mapped into the ground states of the antiferromagnetic Ising model on the Kagomé lattice in the critical field $H_{\rm{ex}}=4J$, and the tensor network is constructed based on the local ground states of each Ising triangle. The VUMPS approach is employed to contract the tensor network, providing a high-precision result of the monomer-dimer problem. We also revisit the edge coloring problem on the honeycomb lattice and discuss its relationship to the monomer-dimer model. Finally we formulate the monomer-dimer problem in the language of the sixteen-vertex model, and discuss the non-integrability of the general monomer-dimer model and the integrability of the pure dimer model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键判断依据：使用张量网络方法（tensor network method）、VUMPS 算法进行数值收缩计算，属于计算物理研究；同时包含对模型可积性、十六顶点模型表述等理论讨论，因此兼具计算与理论性质。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上的单体-二聚体模型（monomer-dimer model），具体为二聚体和单体活度均为 1 的情形；同时涉及 Kagomé 晶格上的反铁磁 Ising 模型、蜂窝晶格上的边着色问题，以及十六顶点模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将单体-二聚体构型精确映射为 Kagomé 晶格上反铁磁 Ising 模型在临界场 \(H_{\rm{ex}}=4J\) 下的基态，并基于此获得了单体-二聚体问题的高精度数值结果；同时讨论了边着色问题与单体-二聚体模型的关系，以及一般单体-二聚体模型的不可积性和纯二聚体模型的可积性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将单体-二聚体构型精确映射为 Kagomé 晶格上反铁磁 Ising 模型在临界场 \(H_{\rm{ex}}=4J\) 下的基态，并基于此获得了单体-二聚体问题的高精度数值结果；同时讨论了边着色问题与单体-二聚体模型的关系，以及一般单体-二聚体模型的不可积性和纯二聚体模型的可积性。；创新点：通过将单体-二聚体模型精确映射到 Kagomé 晶格反铁磁 Ising 模型在临界场下的基态，并基于局域基态构造张量网络结合 VUMPS 收缩，给出了该问题的高精度结果；同时重新审视了蜂窝晶格边着色问题与单体-二聚体模型的关系，并在十六顶点模型框架下讨论了模型的可积性。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法：将单体-二聚体构型精确映射到 Kagomé 晶格反铁磁 Ising 模型在临界场 \(H_{\rm{ex}}=4J\) 的基态，基于每个 Ising 三角形的局域基态构造张量网络，并采用 VUMPS（变分均匀矩阵乘积态）方法收缩张量网络。此外还使用了边着色问题的分析以及十六顶点模型的表述框架。

papers.title: Valency-bounding correction potential for coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations
papers.abstract: Many systems in soft and living matter bind through a limited number of bonds per particle: proteins associate via discrete surface patches, nucleic acids form one-to-one contacts, and the phase behaviour of multivalent biomolecules is governed by the number of binding sites they carry. In simulations, valency limits are typically enforced with patchy particles, whose anisotropic potentials require integration of rotational degrees of freedom and combine hard cores with narrow patches, which forces small timesteps and commits the model to a fixed binding-site geometry that is often unknown, flexible or mobile. We introduce the valency-bounding correction (VBC), a many-body modification of generic short-range pairwise potentials that smoothly suppresses attraction once the neighbour count of either interacting particle exceeds a prescribed valency. The correction carries no angular degrees of freedom, applies on top of soft repulsive cores and evaluates in two passes over the neighbour list at the cost of a standard pairwise potential. The VBC drives the coordination number to the prescribed valency with low error, while its cluster statistics depart from Wertheim and Flory-Stockmayer predictions through unrestricted ring formation. A tuned variant exchanges bonded partners through ordinary molecular dynamics, reducing bond lifetimes at high saturation by an order of magnitude. On GPUs the cost of the correction is nearly independent of valency, reaching an almost tenfold advantage over a patchy-particle reference. We illustrate large-scale applications by reproducing the reentrant aggregation of repeat-expanded RNA, and show that the VBC also remedies the Fisher-Ruelle thermodynamic instability of soft-core potentials with attraction. The VBC is available as an open-source GPU plugin for HOOMD-blue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations”“GPU plugin for HOOMD-blue”“evaluates in two passes over the neighbour list”，属于分子动力学模拟方法开发与计算应用。；研究对象：软物质与生命物质中通过有限键数（价数）结合的体系，包括蛋白质通过离散表面斑块缔合、核酸形成一对一接触、多价生物分子的相行为，以及重复扩增RNA的再入聚集现象。研究对象是粗粒化分子动力学中的价数限制机制及相关的多体相互作用势修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种价数限制修正（VBC），即在通用短程对势上做多体修正，当任一相互作用粒子的邻居数超过预设价数时平滑抑制吸引作用；该修正无角度自由度，可将配位数驱动至预设价数且误差低，其团簇统计因无限制成环而偏离Wertheim和Flory-Stockmayer预测；调优变体可通过普通分子动力学交换键合伙伴，在高饱和度下将键寿命降低一个数量级；在GPU上计算成本几乎与价数无关，相比斑块粒子参考实现近十倍加速；VBC还能修复软核吸引势的Fisher-Ruelle热力学不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种价数限制修正（VBC），即在通用短程对势上做多体修正，当任一相互作用粒子的邻居数超过预设价数时平滑抑制吸引作用；该修正无角度自由度，可将配位数驱动至预设价数且误差低，其团簇统计因无限制成环而偏离Wertheim和Flory-Stockmayer预测；调优变体可通过普通分子动力学交换键合伙伴，在高饱和度下将键寿命降低一个数量级；在GPU上计算成本几乎与价数无关，相比斑块粒子参考实现近十倍加速；VBC还能修复软核吸引势的Fisher-Ruelle热力学不稳定性。；创新点：相对于传统斑块粒子模型，VBC无需积分旋转自由度、不依赖固定的结合位点几何、可叠加在软排斥核上、计算成本与价数几乎无关且GPU加速显著；能通过普通分子动力学实现键合伙伴交换；还能修复软核吸引势的Fisher-Ruelle热力学不稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 粗粒化分子动力学模拟；提出价数限制修正（VBC），作为通用短程对势的多体修正，在软排斥核上叠加，通过对邻居列表两遍扫描实现；在GPU上实现为HOOMD-blue的开源插件；通过配位数、团簇统计、键寿命等指标进行验证；应用于重复扩增RNA的再入聚集模拟。

papers.title: Exact fermionic dual of the Bose-Hubbard model
papers.abstract: Recent developments have established exact bosonization and fermionization with a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry as dualities through gauging. In this work, we apply fermionic gauging, which realizes generalized Jordan-Wigner transformations, to the Bose-Hubbard (BH) model with a global $U(1)$ symmetry and derive an exact dual description in terms of fermionic composites, built from bosons and fermions. In 1D, this duality generalizes the exact mapping between the extended hard-core BH model and the spinless Fermi-Hubbard model to now cover soft-core interactions. At low energies, the mapping reduces to the well-known equivalence between the sine-Gordon model and the Thirring model. The oscillation wave vector of the fermionic composite correlation function in the gapless phase is fixed by their density, providing a novel manifestation of Luttinger's theorem. We verify the exact duality using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations and demonstrate that the gapless phase and the phase transition are governed by the compact boson conformal field theory. Our construction naturally extends to generic bosonic systems and higher dimensions, opening new avenues for studying Bose-Fermi mixtures in optical lattices and other strongly correlated quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：exact bosonization and fermionization、gauging、derive an exact dual description、generalized Jordan-Wigner transformations。摘要中虽提到 DMRG 计算验证，但属于数值验证理论构造，整体为理论研究。；研究对象：具有全局 U(1) 对称性的 Bose-Hubbard（BH）模型，以及由其玻色子和费米子构成的费米子复合体的精确对偶描述；具体物理现象包括无能隙相、相变，以及一维软核相互作用下的玻色-费米对应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者对带全局 U(1) 对称性的 Bose-Hubbard 模型施加费米子化 gauging，得到了以玻色子与费米子组成的费米子复合体表示的精确对偶描述；在一维情形下，该对偶将扩展硬核 BH 模型与无自旋 Fermi-Hubbard 模型之间的精确映射推广到软核相互作用，低能下约化为 sine-Gordon 模型与 Thirring 模型的已知等价关系。费米子复合体关联函数在无能隙相中的振荡波矢由其密度固定，给出了 Luttinger 定理的一种新表现形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者对带全局 U(1) 对称性的 Bose-Hubbard 模型施加费米子化 gauging，得到了以玻色子与费米子组成的费米子复合体表示的精确对偶描述；在一维情形下，该对偶将扩展硬核 BH 模型与无自旋 Fermi-Hubbard 模型之间的精确映射推广到软核相互作用，低能下约化为 sine-Gordon 模型与 Thirring 模型的已知等价关系。费米子复合体关联函数在无能隙相中的振荡波矢由其密度固定，给出了 Luttinger 定理的一种新表现形式。；创新点：将此前建立的 Z₂ 对称性下精确玻色化/费米子化对偶（通过 gauging）应用于带全局 U(1) 对称性的 Bose-Hubbard 模型，构造出由玻色子和费米子组成的费米子复合体的精确对偶描述；在一维中把扩展硬核 BH 模型与无自旋 Fermi-Hubbard 模型的精确映射推广到软核相互作用；给出 Luttinger 定理的新表现形式；该构造可自然推广到一般玻色子系统和高维情形，为光晶格中 Bose-Fermi 混合物及其他强关联量子系统的研究开辟新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：通过 gauging 实现的精确玻色化/费米子化对偶、广义 Jordan-Wigner 变换、费米子化 gauging；低能有效理论对应 sine-Gordon 模型与 Thirring 模型；数值方法：密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算用于验证该精确对偶，并表明无能隙相与相变由紧致玻色子共形场论（compact boson conformal field theory）支配。

papers.title: Creation and characterization of leviton excitations in tight-binding chains
papers.abstract: Levitons are minimal-excitation electronic wave packets generated by Lorentzian voltage pulses and constitute a central resource for electron quantum optics. Their creation and defining properties are usually formulated in continuum scattering descriptions, whereas many candidate platforms for integrated electronic quantum circuits are finite, discrete, and strongly shaped by lattice dispersion. We study leviton generation in finite one-dimensional tight-binding chains of non-interacting fermions driven by time-dependent voltage pulses. Using the single-particle density matrix, we resolve the excitation above the initial Fermi sea and quantify its quality through the average excitation number and its fluctuations. We find that clean leviton-like states emerge only in an intermediate regime where the pulse is slow enough to be resolved by the dynamics on the lattice, but not so slow that truncation and finite-size effects distort the Lorentzian profile in the time domain. Lorentzian pulses (even if truncated) systematically outperform non-Lorentzian pulse shapes in approaching the low-noise limit with increasing system size. We further identify finite-lattice signatures associated with band filling, pulse amplitude, linear voltage-drop geometry, and residual deviations from the continuum integer-charge condition. These results establish a microscopic framework for understanding leviton formation beyond the ideal continuum limit and for evaluating lattice-based platforms for coherent few-electron transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键依据：摘要中使用“We study...”“Using the single-particle density matrix”“microscopic framework”等表述，属于理论建模与数值计算研究，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：有限一维紧束缚链中的非相互作用费米子体系，研究由含时电压脉冲驱动的 leviton（莱维顿）激发——即由洛伦兹电压脉冲产生的最小激发电子波包，属于电子量子光学与相干少电子输运的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 干净的类 leviton 态只在中间脉冲时间尺度区间出现：脉冲需足够慢以便被晶格动力学分辨，但又不能太慢，否则截断和有限尺寸效应会扭曲时域中的洛伦兹波形。洛伦兹脉冲（即使被截断）在系统尺寸增大时，比非洛伦兹脉冲形状更系统地趋近低噪声极限。此外还识别出与能带填充、脉冲幅度、线性电压降几何以及偏离连续整数电荷条件的残余偏差相关的有限晶格特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：干净的类 leviton 态只在中间脉冲时间尺度区间出现：脉冲需足够慢以便被晶格动力学分辨，但又不能太慢，否则截断和有限尺寸效应会扭曲时域中的洛伦兹波形。洛伦兹脉冲（即使被截断）在系统尺寸增大时，比非洛伦兹脉冲形状更系统地趋近低噪声极限。此外还识别出与能带填充、脉冲幅度、线性电压降几何以及偏离连续整数电荷条件的残余偏差相关的有限晶格特征。；创新点：将 leviton 的产生与定义性质从传统的连续散射描述推广到有限、离散且受晶格色散强烈影响的紧束缚链框架，建立了超越理想连续极限理解 leviton 形成的微观框架，并为评估基于晶格的相干少电子输运平台提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 采用单粒子密度矩阵方法，在有限一维紧束缚链模型中处理非相互作用费米子，通过含时电压脉冲驱动，解析初始费米海之上的激发，并用平均激发数及其涨落量化激发质量。

papers.title: Temperature-Dependent nonlinear optics from first-principles: Second-Harmonic Generation in few-layers MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles real-time approach to study non-linear response of solids at finite temperature. Finite temperature effects are included as renormalization of the quasiparticle energies and a dephasing term proportional to the quasiparticle lifetimes. We evaluate electron-phonon matrix elements from Density-Functional Perturbation Theory for lattice dynamics and then calculate quasiparticles renormalization and lifetime from the Fan and Debye-Waller terms of the electron self-energy. Electron excitations are treated at the independent particle level of approximation. We apply the approach to the second-harmonic generation (SHG) in monolayer and trilayer MoS$_2$. We observe a nontrivial temperature-dependence of the SHG due to a strong crystal-momentum dependent quasiparticle renormalization. From the phonon-mode analysis we find that the coupling with acoustic and shear modes determines the overall crystal-momentum dependence respectively in monolayer and trilayer MoS$_2$. The nontrivial temperature-dependence of the SHG can help rationalize the increase of SHG intensity with increasing temperature observed in monolayer MoS$_2$ at a given laser energy [Adv. Optical Mater. 8, 2000441 (2020)].
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles real-time approach、Density-Functional Perturbation Theory、electron self-energy（Fan 和 Debye-Waller 项）、independent particle level of approximation。；研究对象：少层 MoS₂（单层和三层）中的二次谐波产生（SHG）及其有限温度下的非线性光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SHG 表现出非平庸的温度依赖性，源于强烈的依赖于晶格动量的准粒子重整化；在单层 MoS₂ 中声学声子模的耦合、在三层 MoS₂ 中剪切模的耦合分别决定了整体的晶格动量依赖关系。该非平庸温度依赖性有助于解释实验上单层 MoS₂ 在给定激光能量下 SHG 强度随温度升高而增强的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SHG 表现出非平庸的温度依赖性，源于强烈的依赖于晶格动量的准粒子重整化；在单层 MoS₂ 中声学声子模的耦合、在三层 MoS₂ 中剪切模的耦合分别决定了整体的晶格动量依赖关系。该非平庸温度依赖性有助于解释实验上单层 MoS₂ 在给定激光能量下 SHG 强度随温度升高而增强的现象。；创新点：提出了一个有限温度下研究固体非线性响应的第一性原理实时方法，将电子-声子耦合导致的准粒子能量重整化和退相位（寿命）效应纳入 SHG 计算，并揭示了 SHG 非平庸温度依赖性的微观声子模起源（单层为声学模、三层为剪切模）。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理实时方法研究固体有限温度非线性响应。有限温度效应通过准粒子能量重整化和与准粒子寿命成正比的退相位项引入；用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）计算晶格动力学得到电子-声子矩阵元，再由电子自能中的 Fan 项和 Debye-Waller 项计算准粒子重整化和寿命；电子激发在独立粒子近似下处理。应用于单层和三层 MoS₂ 的 SHG。

papers.title: Simple invariants for band topology
papers.abstract: Despite the exhaustive understanding gathered around non-interacting topological states of matter, there is no single method capable of systematically delivering simple, numerically efficient topological invariants that is applicable to all crystalline and non-crystalline systems alike. Here we revisit the spectral localizer operator, constructed from the Hamiltonian and position operators, and show how it can be treated it as an auxiliary zero-dimensional Hamiltonian whose topology encodes the higher dimensional phases of the parent Hamiltonian. Its classification reduces every topological invariant to a matrix signature or the sign of a Pfaffian for an appropriate localizer, both of which are simple to interpret and efficient to compute in real space. We validate this approach by deriving simple real-space invariants for weak and rotationally invariant crystalline phases that were previously beyond the grasp of the spectral localizer formalism, atomic limits that escape scattering invariants, phases that evade symmetry-based indicator methods, as well as phases that had no previously known invariant. Our work provides a systematic way to construct any non-interacting topological invariant for a crystalline or non-crystalline systems, opening avenues to classify and predict the topology of previously unexplored classes of materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提及“revisit the spectral localizer operator”“show how it can be treated as an auxiliary zero-dimensional Hamiltonian”“deriving simple real-space invariants”等，均为理论推导与形式化工作，未涉及具体实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非相互作用拓扑物态中的拓扑不变量，涵盖晶体（crystalline）与非晶体（non-crystalline）系统。具体涉及弱拓扑相、旋转不变晶体相、原子极限（atomic limits）、逃避对称性指标方法的相，以及此前无已知不变量的相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将谱局域算子（spectral localizer）视为一个辅助的零维哈密顿量，其拓扑性质可编码母哈密顿量的高维拓扑相；通过该框架，所有拓扑不变量均可约化为某个局域算子的矩阵签名（matrix signature）或Pfaffian的符号，且这些量在实空间中易于解释和高效计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将谱局域算子（spectral localizer）视为一个辅助的零维哈密顿量，其拓扑性质可编码母哈密顿量的高维拓扑相；通过该框架，所有拓扑不变量均可约化为某个局域算子的矩阵签名（matrix signature）或Pfaffian的符号，且这些量在实空间中易于解释和高效计算。；创新点：首次系统性地将谱局域算子形式化推广至此前无法处理的多个拓扑相类别，包括弱拓扑相、旋转不变晶体相、原子极限、逃避对称性指标方法的相以及此前无已知不变量的相；提供了一种适用于任意晶体和非晶体系统的、构造任意非相互作用拓扑不变量的通用方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为谱局域算子方法，由哈密顿量和位置算符构造；将其作为辅助零维哈密顿量进行拓扑分类，把拓扑不变量归结为矩阵签名或Pfaffian符号的计算。摘要未明确说明是否包含具体数值计算或模型验证的细节。

papers.title: High-Field Electron Transport in AlGaN alloys: A Full-Band Monte Carlo Study Based on Ab Initio Supercell Calculations
papers.abstract: AlGaN alloys are promising wide and ultra-wide-bandgap semiconductors for next-generation power and RF electronics applications. To realize the full potential of AlGaN based devices, it is important to understand the electron transport to accurately predict device performance and identify material limits under various operating conditions. In this work, the high-field electron transport properties of AlxGa1-xN are investigated using a supercell based full band Monte Carlo method. The supercell approach is employed to explicitly capture the true disorder of the alloy system, enabling a more realistic description of carrier transport. The velocity field characteristics are calculated across a range of Al compositions to evaluate key transport metrics, including peak velocity, saturation velocity, and critical electric field. The role of different scattering mechanisms is studied in detail to understand the high field transport mechanism in the AlGaN alloy system. In addition to steady state transport, transient electron dynamics are examined for various Al fractions to study velocity-overshoot behavior, which is especially important for improving the performance of scaled RF devices. Finally, the temperature dependence of the velocity field characteristics in ultra-wide-bandgap Al0.75Ga0.25N is investigated to assess its transport performance under high temperature conditions. These results provide a detailed understanding of high-field transport in AlGaN alloys and offer guidance for the design of AlGaN-based RF and power electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：full band Monte Carlo method、Ab Initio Supercell Calculations、supercell based。；研究对象：AlₓGa₁₋ₓN 合金体系的高场电子输运性质，包括稳态输运（速度-电场特性）和瞬态电子动力学（速度过冲行为），以及温度依赖的输运性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用基于超胞的全能带蒙特卡洛方法计算了不同 Al 组分下 AlGaN 合金的速度-电场特性，获得了峰值速度、饱和速度和临界电场等关键输运指标，并揭示了不同散射机制在高场输运中的作用；同时研究了速度过冲行为及超宽禁带 Al₀.₇₅Ga₀.₂₅N 中输运特性的温度依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用基于超胞的全能带蒙特卡洛方法计算了不同 Al 组分下 AlGaN 合金的速度-电场特性，获得了峰值速度、饱和速度和临界电场等关键输运指标，并揭示了不同散射机制在高场输运中的作用；同时研究了速度过冲行为及超宽禁带 Al₀.₇₅Ga₀.₂₅N 中输运特性的温度依赖性。；创新点：采用超胞方法显式捕捉合金的真实无序性，从而实现对载流子输运更真实的描述；系统计算了多种 Al 组分下的高场输运特性，并详细研究了各散射机制的作用，以及瞬态速度过冲和高温下的输运性能。
papers.method_zh: 基于从头算（ab initio）超胞计算的全能带蒙特卡洛（full band Monte Carlo）方法；超胞方法用于显式捕捉合金体系的真实无序性，以更真实地描述载流子输运。

papers.title: Directional memory of early spectral selection during spinodal decomposition in finite systems
papers.abstract: Cahn-Hilliard phase separation turns small composition fluctuations into coarsening domains. In Fourier space, the pattern forms a ring whose angular intensity favors an axis. We ask whether the axis favored early in an evolution remains related to the axis favored later in the same evolution. We analyze two-dimensional simulations with isotropic initial fluctuations and no imposed direction. We introduce $Q_2$, a normalized angular average over the Fourier spectrum, as a measure of the strength and direction of spectral anisotropy. Linear growth amplifies different wave numbers at different rates, selecting an early axis from the angular imbalances in the initial spectrum. This axis remains correlated with the late axis during coarsening. At a fixed time, shallow quenches show stronger early-late alignment. This advantage disappears when the quenches are compared at similar stages of domain growth. Adding the early $Q_2$ to a prediction based on quench depth, mean composition, and box size reduces the mean absolute error for late $Q_2$ by $3.53\%$. This reduction disappears when only the magnitude of the early $Q_2$ is retained, or when its direction is replaced by the direction from another evolution. The early Fourier intensity therefore carries information about the later state of the same evolving field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确说明“We analyze two-dimensional simulations”，即通过二维数值模拟开展研究，未涉及实验测量或纯理论解析推导。；研究对象：有限体系中的旋节分解（spinodal decomposition）过程，具体为 Cahn-Hilliard 相分离中组分涨落演化形成的共格畴图案，以及其傅里叶空间中环状图案的角度各向异性（谱各向异性）的早期-晚期关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线性生长阶段从初始谱的角度不平衡中选出的早期优势轴，在后续粗化过程中与晚期优势轴保持关联；早期傅里叶强度携带了同一演化场晚期状态的信息。将早期 Q₂ 加入基于淬火深度、平均组分和盒子尺寸的预测后，晚期 Q₂ 的平均绝对误差降低 3.53%，但仅保留早期 Q₂ 的大小或用另一次演化的方向替换其方向时，该改善消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：线性生长阶段从初始谱的角度不平衡中选出的早期优势轴，在后续粗化过程中与晚期优势轴保持关联；早期傅里叶强度携带了同一演化场晚期状态的信息。将早期 Q₂ 加入基于淬火深度、平均组分和盒子尺寸的预测后，晚期 Q₂ 的平均绝对误差降低 3.53%，但仅保留早期 Q₂ 的大小或用另一次演化的方向替换其方向时，该改善消失。；创新点：提出 Q₂ 这一归一化角度平均量来量化傅里叶谱各向异性的强度与方向；揭示旋节分解中早期谱选择的方向与晚期粗化方向之间存在记忆关联；证明早期 Q₂ 的方向信息（而非仅大小）对预测晚期 Q₂ 有实质贡献，且该贡献不能由其他演化的方向替代。
papers.method_zh: 二维 Cahn-Hilliard 相分离数值模拟，初始涨落为各向同性且不施加任何方向；引入 Q₂ 作为傅里叶谱上的归一化角度平均量，用以度量谱各向异性的强度和方向；通过比较早期与晚期 Q₂ 的关联、不同淬火深度下的对齐程度，以及将早期 Q₂ 纳入晚期 Q₂ 预测模型来验证信息传递。

papers.title: Topographic Disorder, Wind Coupling, and Directional Fire Spread: Critical Behavior in a Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model
papers.abstract: We introduce the Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model (TFFM), a lattice model in which fire spreads on a spatially correlated Gaussian height field with the asymmetric bond probability $p_{i\to j}=\mathrm{clip}[e^{-β+γ(h_j-h_i)},0,1]$, plus an additive wind bias. Simulations up to $L=8192$ reveal a sharp active-to-inactive transition whose critical suppression threshold $β_c$ is even in $γ$, decreases with $|γ|$, and decreases as the terrain correlation length $σ_h$ is reduced: slope asymmetry acts as a suppressant because downhill bonds are penalized and fire stalls at local elevation maxima. For rough terrain and low tree density, the fire fails to percolate even at zero suppression. Finite-size scaling gives a front-velocity exponent $δ=0.34\pm0.02$, identical for smooth and rough terrain and matching neither directed percolation ($ν_\parallel-ν_\perp\approx0.56$) nor isotropic percolation ($\approx0.18$). The single-seed survival probability at $β_c$ is independent of $L$ and decays extremely slowly, with a running exponent falling from $\approx0.09$ to $\approx0.04$, excluding directed percolation and suggesting a survival probability that remains finite at criticality, consistent with the $L$-independent value $P^*\approx0.5$ at which $P_{\rm surv}$ drops to zero. The correlation-length exponent cannot be resolved at these sizes, consistent with slow crossover corrections from quenched correlated disorder. Wind raises $β_c$ by a factor of 2--4, produces a sharp onset of downwind fire-scar drift at weak coupling, and, at high terrain coupling, decreases the burned fraction at boundary crossing---a terrain-wind competition effect absent from isotropic bond-disorder models. The model yields fire-risk thresholds and fire-scar signatures comparable to satellite burn-scar data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：lattice model（格点模型）、Simulations（模拟）、Finite-size scaling（有限尺寸标度）、临界指数测量。属于基于数值模拟的统计物理/复杂系统研究，非实验、非纯解析理论。；研究对象：一个地形加权的森林火灾模型（Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model, TFFM）：火在具有空间关联的高斯高度场上传播的格点系统，键概率带有坡度不对称项和附加风偏置。研究的物理现象是火灾的活跃—非活跃相变（percolation 型临界行为）、临界抑制阈值、火前沿速度标度、单种子存活概率，以及风与地形的竞争效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 坡度不对称性（γ）会抑制火势传播（下坡键被惩罚、火在局部高点停滞），临界抑制阈值 β_c 随 |γ| 和地形关联长度 σ_h 的减小而降低；在粗糙地形和低树密度下即使零抑制火也无法逾渗。临界前沿速度指数 δ=0.34±0.02，既不匹配定向逾渗也不匹配各向同性逾渗；临界点单种子存活概率与系统尺寸 L 无关且衰减极慢，暗示临界处存活概率保持有限。风使 β_c 提高 2–4 倍，并在弱耦合下产生顺风火烧迹地漂移的急剧起始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：坡度不对称性（γ）会抑制火势传播（下坡键被惩罚、火在局部高点停滞），临界抑制阈值 β_c 随 |γ| 和地形关联长度 σ_h 的减小而降低；在粗糙地形和低树密度下即使零抑制火也无法逾渗。临界前沿速度指数 δ=0.34±0.02，既不匹配定向逾渗也不匹配各向同性逾渗；临界点单种子存活概率与系统尺寸 L 无关且衰减极慢，暗示临界处存活概率保持有限。风使 β_c 提高 2–4 倍，并在弱耦合下产生顺风火烧迹地漂移的急剧起始。；创新点：提出了带地形坡度不对称项与风偏置耦合的森林火灾格点模型，揭示了坡度不对称作为抑制剂的机制以及地形—风竞争效应（高地形耦合下边界穿越时燃烧比例下降），这是各向同性键无序模型中所没有的；临界行为（δ 指数、L 无关的存活概率）无法用定向逾渗或各向同性逾渗描述，并指出可能源于淬火关联无序带来的慢交叉修正；模型给出的火险阈值和火烧迹地特征可与卫星火烧迹地数据相比。
papers.method_zh: 构建并数值模拟 Terrain-Weighted Forest Fire Model（TFFM）格点模型，键概率为 p_{i→j}=clip[e^{-β+γ(h_j-h_i)},0,1] 加风偏置；在空间关联高斯高度场上进行模拟，系统尺寸最大至 L=8192；采用有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）分析临界指数（如前沿速度指数 δ、关联长度指数、存活概率的 running exponent）。

papers.title: A Bifurcation Theory for the Equilibria of Modern Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract: Modern Hopfield networks provide a unifying framework for associative memory, transformer attention, diffusion-based generative models, and biological attractor dynamics, linking these systems through a common energy-based dynamics in which states are updated toward weighted combinations of stored patterns. Across these settings, network dynamics is determined by the organization of the energy landscape and the bifurcations of its fixed points. Despite their central role, a general theory of these bifurcations has remained unavailable beyond specific architectures and idealized pattern ensembles. Here we derive stability and bifurcation criteria for the fixed points of general convex-dual Modern Hopfield networks for a general statistics of the stored patterns. Applying this framework to random, block-correlated, and infinitely hierarchical pattern ensembles, we show how memory correlations systematically organize the emergence of hierarchical attractors through successive bifurcations. We further demonstrate that these predictions quantitatively describe retrieval bifurcations in MHNs storing patterns sampled from MNIST, and recapitulate the hierarchical organization of hematopoietic cell identities. Our results establish a general bifurcation theory for Modern Hopfield networks and identify the organization of fixed points as a unifying principle underlying their computational and biological behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derive stability and bifurcation criteria、general convex-dual Modern Hopfield networks、general statistics of the stored patterns、establish a general bifurcation theory。摘要中虽有与 MNIST 数据和造血细胞身份的实验对比，但属于用理论预测定量描述已有数据，而非本文开展实验。；研究对象：现代 Hopfield 网络（Modern Hopfield Networks, MHNs）的平衡态（不动点）及其分岔行为，涉及随机、块关联（block-correlated）和无限层级（infinitely hierarchical）三类存储模式集合，以及存储 MNIST 模式和造血细胞身份模式的 MHN。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者为一般凸对偶现代 Hopfield 网络在任意存储模式统计下导出了不动点的稳定性与分岔判据；并证明记忆之间的关联会通过一系列连续分岔系统性地组织出层级化吸引子，该预测能定量描述 MNIST 的检索分岔并重现造血细胞身份的层级组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者为一般凸对偶现代 Hopfield 网络在任意存储模式统计下导出了不动点的稳定性与分岔判据；并证明记忆之间的关联会通过一系列连续分岔系统性地组织出层级化吸引子，该预测能定量描述 MNIST 的检索分岔并重现造血细胞身份的层级组织。；创新点：此前缺乏超越特定架构和理想化模式集合的一般分岔理论，本文首次给出适用于一般凸对偶 MHN 和一般模式统计的稳定性与分岔判据，并将不动点的组织方式确立为统一其计算行为与生物行为的原理。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为凸对偶现代 Hopfield 网络（convex-dual MHNs）的能量图景分析，推导不动点的稳定性与分岔判据；将该框架应用于随机、块关联和无限层级模式集合；并与 MNIST 采样模式及造血细胞身份数据的检索分岔进行定量对比。

papers.title: Where Is the \(p\)-Wave Superfluid? Correlated Phase Diagram of Microwave-Shielded Polar Molecules
papers.abstract: Chiral $p_x\!\pm\! i p_y$ superfluidity in fermionic polar molecules offers a direct route to topological quantum matter with non-Abelian excitations, yet the parameter regime in which pairing survives strong correlations and competing instabilities has remained unresolved. Here we determine this regime for microwave-shielded polar molecules. Under tight confinement along the \(z\) direction, the microscopic molecular interaction collapses onto a universal quasi-two-dimensional form specified by an interaction length $σ$, defined as the position of its attractive minimum, and a single dimensionless coupling. We combine Fermi-hypernetted-chain Euler--Lagrange theory with correlated-basis pairing theory, thereby treating the correlation hole, density response, stability of the homogeneous fluid, and $p$-wave pairing within one framework. The largest pairing gap occurs immediately on the stable side of a long-wavelength spinodal instability at a two-dimensional density $4\times10^{-2}/σ^2$. Mapping this universal regime onto microscopic shielding schemes exposes an intrinsic limitation of single-microwave dressing: weakening the attraction to the optimal pairing range simultaneously weakens collisional shielding. Dual-microwave dressing removes this constraint by compensating the long-range attraction while retaining a large repulsive core. Imposing explicit requirements on collisional loss, confinement, and microwave-amplitude stability, we identify the regime of molecular mass and dipole moment favorable for \(p\)-wave superfluidity and determine experimentally realistic microwave and confinement conditions for its realization. These results turn the search for molecular $p$-wave superfluidity into a quantitative optimization problem and define a route toward the topological weak-pairing phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：Fermi-hypernetted-chain Euler–Lagrange theory、correlated-basis pairing theory、phase diagram determination、mapping onto microscopic shielding schemes——摘要中未提及任何具体实验测量，全部为理论框架与数值计算。；研究对象：微波屏蔽（microwave-shielded）的极性分子费米子系统，具体研究其中的手性 \(p_x \pm i p_y\) 超流相及其在强关联和竞争不稳定性下的相图。物理现象聚焦于 \(p\)-波配对与长波长自旋odal不稳定性之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最大的配对能隙出现在长波长自旋odal不稳定性稳定侧紧邻处，对应二维密度 \(4\times10^{-2}/\sigma^2\)；单微波 dressing 存在内禀限制——减弱吸引至最优配对区间的同时会削弱碰撞屏蔽，而双微波 dressing 可通过补偿长程吸引并保留大排斥核来解除该限制；在此基础上给出了有利于 \(p\)-波超流的分子质量与偶极矩区间以及实验可行的微波和束缚条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最大的配对能隙出现在长波长自旋odal不稳定性稳定侧紧邻处，对应二维密度 \(4\times10^{-2}/\sigma^2\)；单微波 dressing 存在内禀限制——减弱吸引至最优配对区间的同时会削弱碰撞屏蔽，而双微波 dressing 可通过补偿长程吸引并保留大排斥核来解除该限制；在此基础上给出了有利于 \(p\)-波超流的分子质量与偶极矩区间以及实验可行的微波和束缚条件。；创新点：首次在统一理论框架内同时处理关联孔、密度响应、均匀流体稳定性与 \(p\)-波配对，确定了强关联下 \(p\)-波超流存活的参数区间；揭示了单微波 dressing 的内禀限制并提出双微波 dressing 作为解决方案；将分子 \(p\)-波超流的寻找转化为定量优化问题，并给出实验可行的微波与束缚条件。
papers.method_zh: 将 Fermi-hypernetted-chain Euler–Lagrange 理论与关联基配对理论（correlated-basis pairing theory）相结合，在同一框架内统一处理关联孔、密度响应、均匀流体的稳定性以及 \(p\)-波配对；并将微观分子相互作用在 \(z\) 方向紧束缚下约化为由相互作用长度 \(\sigma\)（吸引极小值位置）和单一无量纲耦合刻画的普适准二维形式；随后将该普适区间映射到具体微波屏蔽方案（单微波与双微波 dressing）。

papers.title: Exciton Coherence in CsPbBr3 Nanocrystals is Bounded by Phonon-Mediated Bright-Triplet Relaxation
papers.abstract: Scalable sources of indistinguishable single photons or entangled photon pairs are fundamental to many quantum photonic technologies. Colloidal lead halide perovskite nanocrystals are promising such sources, but their exciton coherent properties are not fully understood. We show that in single CsPbBr3 nanocrystals at 4 K, acoustic phonon-mediated exciton fine structure relaxation (EFSR) drives leakage of population between the bright exciton triplet states, competing with the radiative lifetime. The leakage pathway reaches 0.64 $\pm$ 0.04 of the radiative rate, bounding state coherence to 0.81 times the transform limit at 4 K. This pathway is intrinsic to the nanocrystal, not its environment, making it a tractable target for materials and device design. We identify fine structure and acoustic phonon engineering as effective intrinsic routes to higher coherence in perovskite quantum light sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“We show that in single CsPbBr3 nanocrystals at 4 K”（在4 K下对单个CsPbBr3纳米晶进行测量）、“leakage pathway reaches 0.64 ± 0.04 of the radiative rate”（给出实验测量数值及误差），属于对具体样品进行测量并报告定量结果的实验工作。；研究对象：单个CsPbBr3（溴化铅铯）胶体纳米晶在4 K低温下的激子相干性质，具体涉及激子精细结构弛豫（EFSR）以及亮激子三重态之间的布居泄漏现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在4 K下的单个CsPbBr3纳米晶中，声学声子介导的激子精细结构弛豫（EFSR）驱动亮激子三重态之间的布居泄漏，该泄漏速率与辐射寿命相竞争，达到辐射速率的0.64 ± 0.04倍，从而将态相干性限制在4 K下变换极限的0.81倍。该泄漏通道是纳米晶固有的，而非源于其环境。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在4 K下的单个CsPbBr3纳米晶中，声学声子介导的激子精细结构弛豫（EFSR）驱动亮激子三重态之间的布居泄漏，该泄漏速率与辐射寿命相竞争，达到辐射速率的0.64 ± 0.04倍，从而将态相干性限制在4 K下变换极限的0.81倍。该泄漏通道是纳米晶固有的，而非源于其环境。；创新点：摘要指出该泄漏通道是纳米晶固有的而非环境所致，从而使其成为材料和器件设计中可调控的目标；并据此提出激子精细结构和声学声子工程是提高钙钛矿量子光源相干性的有效内禀途径。摘要未明确说明相对于已有研究的具体新意细节。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段（如具体光谱技术、测量装置等），仅提及在4 K下对单个CsPbBr3纳米晶进行测量，并涉及激子精细结构弛豫、声学声子介导过程以及辐射速率的定量分析。摘要未明确说明是否包含计算方法或理论框架。

papers.title: Metal-Insulator Coexistence and Gap-Crossing Domain-Wall Modes in an Aubry-André Model with Nonlocal Hopping
papers.abstract: Nonequilibrium transport remains a central theme in modern physics, spanning from condensed matter to synthetic systems.
