Here, we investigate particle transport in an extended Aubry-André model with system-scale hopping, namely nonlocal hopping with a range proportional to the system size, and uncover a metal-insulator coexistence regime in real space, where metallic and insulating spatial domains coexist within the same system and are separated by sharp spatial boundaries. In the insulating region, particles exhibit flat-band-like localization in the absence of quasiperiodic potentials, while a quasiperiodic potential induces distinct multi-point localization, different from conventional exponential localization. Meanwhile, particles can freely propagate and tunnel across spatially disconnected metallic domains separated by the insulating region. Beyond this coexistence phase, we identify unconventional gap-crossing domain-wall modes with comb-like spatial profiles that mediate nonlocal, multi-point transport across separated metallic domains. Our findings reveal a rich interplay between localization, nonlocality, and transport in systems with nonlocal hopping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“we investigate”“uncover”“identify”等表述，研究扩展的 Aubry-André 模型中的粒子输运，未提及具体实验测量手段或实验平台，属于理论模型研究。；研究对象：扩展的 Aubry-André 模型中的粒子输运，其关键特征是具有系统尺度的非局域跃迁（跃迁范围与系统尺寸成正比）。研究的具体物理现象包括实空间中的金属-绝缘体共存、绝缘区中的局域化行为以及跨畴壁模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该非局域跃迁的 Aubry-André 模型中，实空间可出现金属与绝缘空间畴共存、由尖锐空间边界分隔的金属-绝缘体共存区；绝缘区中粒子在无准周期势时表现为类平带局域化，而准周期势诱导出不同于常规指数局域化的多点局域化；此外还发现了具有梳状空间分布的非常规跨能隙畴壁模式，可介导跨分离金属畴的非局域多点输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该非局域跃迁的 Aubry-André 模型中，实空间可出现金属与绝缘空间畴共存、由尖锐空间边界分隔的金属-绝缘体共存区；绝缘区中粒子在无准周期势时表现为类平带局域化，而准周期势诱导出不同于常规指数局域化的多点局域化；此外还发现了具有梳状空间分布的非常规跨能隙畴壁模式，可介导跨分离金属畴的非局域多点输运。；创新点：将非局域跃迁（跃迁范围与系统尺寸成正比）引入扩展 Aubry-André 模型，揭示了实空间金属-绝缘体共存相，以及其中类平带局域化、多点局域化和跨能隙畴壁模式等非常规局域化与输运行为，展现了局域化、非局域性与输运之间的丰富相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法或理论框架（如 DMRG、精确对角化、传输矩阵等），仅说明是对扩展 Aubry-André 模型（含系统尺度非局域跃迁）中粒子输运的理论研究。

papers.title: General solution of the Dirac equation for electrons bound by a charged atomic chain
papers.abstract: The system of electrons bound by a charged atom chain is studied within the Dirac theory. The general analytical solution of the Dirac equation is obtained. Analytical expression for electron energy is derived from which it follows that the principal quantum number can be introduced for electron states in such a system, similar to the case of a hydrogen atom. We prove that electrons bound by the atomic chain, are fully collectivized and the energy can be calculated as a function of the occupation number. The spectral band with the principal quantum number $n$ is shown to be split into $n$ subbands forming the fine structure. The scale of the fine structure splitting is calculated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：within the Dirac theory、general analytical solution、analytical expression、prove。；研究对象：被带电原子链束缚的电子体系，在狄拉克理论框架下研究其束缚态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 获得了狄拉克方程的通用解析解，推导出电子能量的解析表达式；证明主量子数可类似氢原子那样引入；证明被原子链束缚的电子是完全集体化的（fully collectivized），能量可作为占据数的函数计算；具有主量子数 n 的谱带分裂为 n 个子带，形成精细结构，并计算了精细结构分裂的尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：获得了狄拉克方程的通用解析解，推导出电子能量的解析表达式；证明主量子数可类似氢原子那样引入；证明被原子链束缚的电子是完全集体化的（fully collectivized），能量可作为占据数的函数计算；具有主量子数 n 的谱带分裂为 n 个子带，形成精细结构，并计算了精细结构分裂的尺度。；创新点：首次给出该体系中狄拉克方程的通用解析解；证明主量子数可引入该体系；证明电子完全集体化且能量可由占据数决定；揭示谱带因精细结构分裂为 n 个子带并给出分裂尺度。
papers.method_zh: 狄拉克理论框架下的解析求解方法，推导狄拉克方程的通用解析解及电子能量的解析表达式。

papers.title: Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and the Helmholtz Theorem
papers.abstract: The recently proposed Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo algorithm has not yet been studied in detail from a thermodynamic point of view; this work aims to fill that gap. We demonstrate how thermodynamical state variables and potentials can be derived and thereby demonstrate that the construction of the algorithm formally represents a microcanonical thermodynamic ensemble. In particular, we demonstrate (analytically and numerically) that the algorithm fulfils the Helmholtz theorem, an alternative formulation of the first law of thermodynamics. Furthermore, we construct a new sampling algorithm that extends the original to lower-dimensional inference problems. Finally, we argue that canonical Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithms are more natural than Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo from the thermodynamic and information-theoretic point of view.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：thermodynamic point of view、demonstrate analytically and numerically、formally represents、construct a new sampling algorithm、argue。摘要以理论推导和算法构建为主，数值部分仅用于验证理论结论，不涉及具体物理材料或实验测量。；研究对象：Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo（微正则哈密顿蒙特卡洛）算法本身，以及该算法与微正则热力学系综、Helmholtz 定理之间的关系。属于算法/统计力学基础层面的研究，而非特定材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该算法的构造在形式上对应一个微正则热力学系综，并且（通过解析和数值方法证明）满足 Helmholtz 定理——热力学第一定律的另一种表述形式。此外，作者从热力学和信息论角度论证，正则 Markov Chain Monte Carlo 算法比 Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 更自然。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该算法的构造在形式上对应一个微正则热力学系综，并且（通过解析和数值方法证明）满足 Helmholtz 定理——热力学第一定律的另一种表述形式。此外，作者从热力学和信息论角度论证，正则 Markov Chain Monte Carlo 算法比 Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 更自然。；创新点：首次从热力学角度详细研究 Microcanonical Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 算法，建立了其与微正则系综的形式对应关系，证明其满足 Helmholtz 定理，并构造了可处理低维推断问题的新采样算法；同时提出了正则 MCMC 在热力学与信息论意义上更自然的论点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（热力学状态变量与势函数的导出）、解析证明、数值验证，以及基于上述理论构建新的采样算法以扩展到低维推断问题。摘要未明确说明具体数值实验的细节或所用模型体系。

papers.title: Topological Edge States and Collective Radiation in a One-Dimensional Atomic Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the topological and collective radiative properties of a one-dimensional diatomic chain of identical quantum emitters with alternating spacing, coupled to the electromagnetic vacuum. The system realizes an extended, non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-type model with vacuum-mediated long-range interactions and collective dissipation. We focus on the single-excitation manifold, where the dynamics are described by an effective Hamiltonian. For an infinite chain, the complex band structure reveals subradiant modes associated with wave vectors outside the light line, as well as parameter regimes where real-part band crossings occur. The bulk topology is characterized by a complex Berry phase, which remains quantized in the presence of inversion symmetry and a spectral gap. For finite chains, using exact diagonalization, we identify superradiant, subradiant, and edge states with distinct decay rates and spatial profiles. Edge states emerge in the topologically nontrivial regime when a bulk gap in the real part of the energy spectrum is present, while subradiant states exhibit strongly suppressed decay with system-size dependence. Finally, we analyze the far-field radiation patterns associated with different classes of eigenstates and show that the emission characteristics reflect the decay properties, spatial localization, and the parity of the unit-cell amplitudes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：investigate、effective Hamiltonian、complex band structure、exact diagonalization、complex Berry phase——摘要中未提及任何实验测量或具体材料平台，属于纯理论/数值计算研究。；研究对象：一维双原子链（diatomic chain）量子发射体体系：由相同量子发射体以交替间距排列构成，耦合到电磁真空。研究的是该体系在单激发流形（single-excitation manifold）中的拓扑性质与集体辐射性质，对应一个扩展的非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）型模型，包含真空介导的长程相互作用与集体耗散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系在实部能谱存在体带隙时，于拓扑非平庸区域出现边缘态；亚辐射（subradiant）模式对应光锥之外的波矢，其衰减被强烈抑制且具有系统尺寸依赖性。体拓扑由复Berry相位刻画，在反演对称性和谱隙存在时保持量子化。远场辐射图案反映了本征态的衰减特性、空间局域化和原胞振幅的宇称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系在实部能谱存在体带隙时，于拓扑非平庸区域出现边缘态；亚辐射（subradiant）模式对应光锥之外的波矢，其衰减被强烈抑制且具有系统尺寸依赖性。体拓扑由复Berry相位刻画，在反演对称性和谱隙存在时保持量子化。远场辐射图案反映了本征态的衰减特性、空间局域化和原胞振幅的宇称。；创新点：将非厄米SSH模型推广至包含真空介导长程相互作用与集体耗散的量子发射体链，在单激发流形中同时研究拓扑边缘态与集体辐射（超辐射/亚辐射）的关联，并用复Berry相位刻画体拓扑，揭示了辐射图案与拓扑/局域化性质之间的对应关系。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有效哈密顿量描述单激发子空间动力学；对无限链计算复能带结构；用复Berry相位刻画体拓扑；对有限链采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）识别超辐射、亚辐射和边缘态；并分析各类本征态的远场辐射图案。

papers.title: Encapsulated macroscopic WS$_2$ monolayers enable room-temperature exciton-polariton lattices
papers.abstract: Large-area, optically homogeneous monolayer semiconductors are a critical prerequisite for scalable room-temperature polaritonics and for realizing polariton lattices extending across many unit cells. Yet, the small size, optical inhomogeneity, and device-to-device variability of conventional exfoliated flakes have remained major obstacles. Here, we overcome these limitations using 1-dodecanol-encapsulated WS$_2$ monolayers that combine millimeter-scale coverage with remarkably uniform optical properties over lateral distances approaching $300\,$$μ\mathrm{m}$. Integrated into a tunable open microcavity, these monolayers exhibit robust room-temperature exciton-photon strong coupling, evidenced by a pronounced anti-crossing and a Rabi splitting of $\hbar Ω_{\mathrm{R}} \approx 31\,\mathrm{meV}$. Leveraging the exceptional uniformity of this platform, we realize a two-dimensional polaritonic kagome lattice and directly resolve its characteristic band structure. Angle-resolved spectroscopy reveals Dirac dispersive bands together with a weakly dispersive flat-band-like branch within the $s$-band, in good agreement with a linear non-interacting model. Complementary momentum- and real-space imaging further identifies the associated bond-centered and site-centered mode profiles. These results establish large-area WS$_2$ monolayers in open microcavities as a scalable platform for engineering polariton band structures and exploring synthetic quantum materials under ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：论文以样品制备（1-十二醇封装 WS₂ 单层）、微腔集成、角分辨光谱测量、动量空间与实空间成像等实验手段为主，并辅以线性非相互作用模型进行对比。；研究对象：1-十二醇封装的宏观尺度 WS₂ 单层及其集成到可调开放式微腔中形成的室温激子-极化激元体系，具体包括室温强耦合现象以及二维极化激元 kagome 晶格的能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该封装 WS₂ 单层可实现毫米级覆盖且光学性质在接近 300 μm 的横向距离上高度均匀，在可调开放式微腔中展现出稳健的室温激子-光子强耦合，Rabi 劈裂约为 31 meV；基于该平台实现的二维极化激元 kagome 晶格中，角分辨光谱直接观测到狄拉克色散带以及 s 带内弱色散的平带型分支，与线性非相互作用模型吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该封装 WS₂ 单层可实现毫米级覆盖且光学性质在接近 300 μm 的横向距离上高度均匀，在可调开放式微腔中展现出稳健的室温激子-光子强耦合，Rabi 劈裂约为 31 meV；基于该平台实现的二维极化激元 kagome 晶格中，角分辨光谱直接观测到狄拉克色散带以及 s 带内弱色散的平带型分支，与线性非相互作用模型吻合良好。；创新点：克服了传统剥离薄片尺寸小、光学不均匀和器件间差异大的障碍，利用封装 WS₂ 单层实现了毫米级、光学高度均匀的室温强耦合平台，并在此基础上实现了二维极化激元 kagome 晶格，直接解析其能带结构（包括狄拉克色散带和平带型分支）及对应的模式分布，为在环境条件下工程化极化激元能带结构和探索合成量子材料提供了可扩展平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用 1-十二醇封装 WS₂ 单层；将其集成到可调开放式微腔中；通过角分辨光谱测量观测反交叉和 Rabi 劈裂；利用动量空间与实空间成像识别键心（bond-centered）和格点心（site-centered）模式分布；并与线性非相互作用模型进行对比。

papers.title: Aggressive Phase Separation in Dense Mixtures of Passive and Active Particles
papers.abstract: Using Vicsek-like self-propulsion rule, we study kinetics of liquid-liquid phase separation in mixtures of passive and active particles. For evolutions following temperature quenches of homogeneous configurations to the immiscible region of the phase diagram, we identify a remarkably strong dependence of the domain growth exponent on the choice of final state point. The singular dependence is indicative of the possibility of even an exponentially fast growth for suitable choices of system parameters. This striking observation, supported by finite-size scaling and other advanced analyses, is despite the fact that the overall mixture density is quite high that risks congestion with the prospect of slowing down particle transport. From flocking in pure biological systems to robotic swarming, these results are of much practical relevance. Theoretical pictures suitable for interpreting such high growth rates are discussed. In this regard, we discuss coarsening in the velocity field as well that describes how the density field coarsening follows the latter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Vicsek-like self-propulsion rule、temperature quenches、finite-size scaling、domain growth exponent、theoretical pictures。；研究对象：被动粒子与活性粒子密集混合物中的液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）动力学，以及其中的畴生长（domain growth）和速度场粗化（coarsening in the velocity field）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在被动/活性粒子密集混合物中，畴生长指数对最终态相点的选择有异常强烈的依赖，这种奇异依赖暗示在合适参数下甚至可能出现指数级快速的畴生长；尽管混合体系总密度很高、可能因拥堵而减慢粒子输运，这一快速生长仍然发生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在被动/活性粒子密集混合物中，畴生长指数对最终态相点的选择有异常强烈的依赖，这种奇异依赖暗示在合适参数下甚至可能出现指数级快速的畴生长；尽管混合体系总密度很高、可能因拥堵而减慢粒子输运，这一快速生长仍然发生。；创新点：摘要未明确与传统研究进行直接对比，但新意主要体现在：发现密集被动/活性混合物中畴生长指数对最终态相点选择具有异常强依赖，并指出在合适参数下可能出现指数级快速生长；同时讨论了速度场粗化与密度场粗化之间的关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用类 Vicsek 自驱动规则（Vicsek-like self-propulsion rule）进行动力学模拟/计算，通过从均匀构型温度淬火到相图非互溶区来研究演化，并使用有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）及其他先进分析手段；理论上还讨论了适用于解释高生长速率的理论图像，以及速度场中的粗化如何描述密度场粗化跟随速度场粗化的过程。

papers.title: Raman signatures of a non-reciprocal magnetic phase transition in Ca$_2$RuO$_4$
papers.abstract: The magnetic behavior of Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ represents a unique puzzle due to the interplay of strong electronic correlations, magneto-elastic interactions, and large spin-orbit coupling. At low temperatures, an anomalous Mott insulating state emerges, characterized by a complex antiferromagnetic order with a collective amplitude excitation of the magnetic moment which has been discussed in analogy with the Higgs mode. We report here evidence of a magnetic first-order phase transition driven by an out-of-plane magnetic field along the crystallographic $c$-axis of Ca$_2$RuO$_4$. Raman measurements in magnetic field reveal the emergence of mode of magnetic origin and a concomitant modification of the coupling between a phonon and the Higgs amplitude mode. Both the Raman features are characterized by a non-reciprocal hysteresis in magnetic field. Surprisingly, the observed phase transition does not affect the Raman scattering from the in-plane magnons, indicating that the dipolar antiferromagnetic order is preserved. This is consistent with the onset of a new quadrupolar field-controlled state, whose fluctuations structure can trigger an hybridization between the lattice and the magnetic Higgs mode resulting in the observed Raman features.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“Raman measurements in magnetic field reveal...”，属于以拉曼光谱测量为主的实验研究，辅以对实验现象的理论解释。；研究对象：Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ 单晶中由面外磁场（沿晶体学 $c$ 轴）驱动的磁性一级相变，以及该相变与晶格声子、磁 Higgs 振幅模式之间的耦合行为。涉及的具体物理现象包括：非互易磁相变、Higgs 振幅模式的演化、声子-磁模式杂化、面内磁振子散射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ 中，沿 $c$ 轴施加磁场可驱动一个磁性一级相变，表现为拉曼谱中出现磁起源新模式以及声子与 Higgs 振幅模式耦合的改变，且两者均呈现非互易磁滞行为；但面内磁振子的拉曼散射不受该相变影响，说明偶极反铁磁序仍然保持，相变更可能对应一种新的四极场控态的出现，其涨落结构可触发晶格与磁 Higgs 模式的杂化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ 中，沿 $c$ 轴施加磁场可驱动一个磁性一级相变，表现为拉曼谱中出现磁起源新模式以及声子与 Higgs 振幅模式耦合的改变，且两者均呈现非互易磁滞行为；但面内磁振子的拉曼散射不受该相变影响，说明偶极反铁磁序仍然保持，相变更可能对应一种新的四极场控态的出现，其涨落结构可触发晶格与磁 Higgs 模式的杂化。；创新点：首次报道了 Ca$_2$RuO$_4$ 中由面外磁场驱动的磁性一级相变，并揭示该相变具有非互易磁滞特征；发现该相变可选择性地改变声子与 Higgs 振幅模式的耦合，却不影响面内磁振子散射，从而提出了一种新的四极场控态图像，为理解该材料中强关联、磁弹耦合与自旋轨道耦合交织下的磁性行为提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 在磁场下进行拉曼光谱测量，追踪磁起源模式的出现及声子与 Higgs 振幅模式耦合的变化，并分析其非互易磁滞特征；同时通过面内磁振子拉曼散射判断偶极反铁磁序是否保持。摘要未明确说明具体实验温度、磁场范围、拉曼激发波长或是否结合其他互补实验手段。

papers.title: Switchable Altermagnetism in a Layered van der Waals Metal-Organic Framework Driven by Spin-Crossover
papers.abstract: Dynamical control of altermagnetism is a key requirement for translating its unique spin-dependent functionalities into practical spintronic devices, yet effective switching mechanisms remain largely unexplored. Here, we open an unprecedented, versatile and programmable route based on spin-crossover to switch altermagnetism on demand in molecular materials. Using density functional calculations, we demonstrate an altermagnetic ground state in the layered van der Waals MOFs MnX$_2$(tdz)$_2$ (X = Cl, Br; tdz = thiadiazole), stabilized by anisotropic interlayer exchange interactions, which gives rise to a characteristic d-wave momentum-space spin splitting and an associated spin-splitter transport response. Our findings reveal that under hydrostatic pressure, a high-spin to low-spin transition reconfigures the Mn d-orbital occupation, thus modifying the magnetic exchange network, and stabilizing a different antiferromagnetic ground state whose symmetry suppresses the nonrelativistic spin splitting. Crucially, spin-crossover switches altermagnetism not by directly altering the electronic structure, but by changing the symmetry of the magnetic ground state. These results establish molecular spin-crossover altermagnets as a platform for externally reconfigurable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：“Using density functional calculations”“we demonstrate”。；研究对象：层状范德华金属-有机框架 MnX₂(tdz)₂（X = Cl, Br；tdz = thiadiazole）中的交替磁性（altermagnetism）及其通过自旋交叉（spin-crossover）的可切换性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料具有由各向异性层间交换相互作用稳定的交替磁基态，表现出特征性的 d 波动量空间自旋劈裂和自旋分裂输运响应；在静水压下，高自旋到低自旋的转变重构 Mn d 轨道占据，改变磁交换网络，稳定另一种反铁磁基态，其对称性抑制了非相对论性自旋劈裂。关键的是，自旋交叉切换交替磁性并非通过直接改变电子结构，而是通过改变磁基态的对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料具有由各向异性层间交换相互作用稳定的交替磁基态，表现出特征性的 d 波动量空间自旋劈裂和自旋分裂输运响应；在静水压下，高自旋到低自旋的转变重构 Mn d 轨道占据，改变磁交换网络，稳定另一种反铁磁基态，其对称性抑制了非相对论性自旋劈裂。关键的是，自旋交叉切换交替磁性并非通过直接改变电子结构，而是通过改变磁基态的对称性。；创新点：首次提出基于自旋交叉在分子材料中按需切换交替磁性的途径，并揭示其切换机制是通过改变磁基态对称性而非直接改变电子结构来实现的，将分子自旋交叉交替磁体确立为外部可重构自旋电子器件的平台。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函计算（density functional calculations）。摘要未明确说明是否使用 DFT+U 等具体泛函修正方案。

papers.title: Interference-controlled magnetic bound states and subgap transport in a Square--octagon superconductor
papers.abstract: The square--octagon lattice provides a useful setting for studying magnetic adatoms because its multisublattice structure allows different adsorption geometries to probe distinct combinations of the host electronic states. We study magnetic adatoms in an $s$-wave superconducting square--octagon lattice, focusing on the interplay between adsorption geometry, narrow and flat-band states, and subgap transport. We find that the large spectral weight associated with a flat band does not necessarily imply strong impurity--host coupling. For symmetric square-hollow adsorption, destructive interference strongly suppresses the overlap with the flat-band manifold, whereas top and octagon-hollow adsorption retain substantial overlap. This selectivity is reflected in the magnetic bound states, with the square-hollow channel supporting a predominantly atomic state, while the top and octagon-hollow states are strongly hybridized with the superconducting host. The effect develops continuously as the relevant band becomes flatter and remains pronounced in a material-motivated parameter regime. In a normal--superconductor--normal geometry, these differences are also reflected in the nonlocal subgap conductance. At a representative exchange splitting, square-hollow adsorption suppresses the low-bias conductance relative to the clean device, whereas octagon-hollow adsorption enhances it, with the square-hollow response showing a much sharper dependence on exchange splitting. Our results show that the magnetic-adatom response in narrow and flat-band superconductors is governed by the available spectral weight and by the symmetry and wave-function structure of the impurity--host hybridization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We study…”“We find…”“In a normal–superconductor–normal geometry, these differences are also reflected in the nonlocal subgap conductance”等表述，属于理论建模与数值计算研究，未提及具体实验测量手段。；研究对象：s-波超导方-八边形晶格（square–octagon lattice）中的磁性吸附原子，以及吸附几何、窄带/平带电子态与子能隙输运之间的相互作用；具体关注方形空心（square-hollow）、顶位（top）和八边形空心（octagon-hollow）等不同吸附构型下的磁束缚态与非局域子能隙电导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平带对应的大谱权重并不必然意味着强的杂质-宿主耦合：对称的方形空心吸附会因破坏性干涉强烈抑制与平带流形的重叠，而顶位和八边形空心吸附仍保持显著重叠；这导致方形空心通道主要支持近原子态，顶位和八边形空心态则与超导宿主强烈杂化。在正常-超导-正常结中，代表性交换劈裂下方形空心吸附相对洁净器件抑制低偏压电导，八边形空心吸附则增强低偏压电导，且方形空心响应随交换劈裂变化更尖锐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平带对应的大谱权重并不必然意味着强的杂质-宿主耦合：对称的方形空心吸附会因破坏性干涉强烈抑制与平带流形的重叠，而顶位和八边形空心吸附仍保持显著重叠；这导致方形空心通道主要支持近原子态，顶位和八边形空心态则与超导宿主强烈杂化。在正常-超导-正常结中，代表性交换劈裂下方形空心吸附相对洁净器件抑制低偏压电导，八边形空心吸附则增强低偏压电导，且方形空心响应随交换劈裂变化更尖锐。；创新点：主要新意在于揭示平带大谱权重与强杂质-宿主耦合之间没有必然联系，指出吸附几何所决定的对称性和波函数结构可通过干涉选择性地抑制或保留与平带流形的杂化；并将这种吸附几何选择性与磁束缚态及非局域子能隙输运响应联系起来，说明窄带/平带超导体中磁性吸附原子响应由可用谱权重以及杂质-宿主杂化的对称性和波函数结构共同决定。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架（如是否使用Bogoliubov–de Gennes方程、格林函数、紧束缚模型等），仅说明研究了s-波超导方-八边形晶格中的磁性吸附原子，并分析了磁束缚态及正常-超导-正常几何下的非局域子能隙电导。摘要未明确说明具体数值技术或参数细节。

papers.title: Doping-controlled topological superconducting transition in misfit layer compounds
papers.abstract: Achieving topological superconductivity is a key goal in quantum physics, offering a path to fault-tolerant quantum computers. A central challenge in this field is to continuously drive a material through a topological quantum phase transition to directly observe the evolution from trivial to topological superconductivity. However, finding a robust platform that allows such extreme and precise tuning remains a challenge. Here, we demonstrate a doping-controlled phase transition from a conventional to a topological superconducting state in the bulk misfit layer compound (LaxPb1-xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2. We reveal a non-monotonic phase diagram characterized by two distinct superconducting regimes separated by a non-superconducting phase at a precise doping. In the highly doped regime, the superconducting phase becomes remarkably sensitive to non-magnetic disorder, and orientation-selective in-gap modes emerge at atomic step edges. Supported by Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations, these emergent spatial signatures are consistent with a time-reversal-symmetric crystalline-topological order parameter. Our results establish misfit compounds as a platform to engineering topological superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有理论计算支持）。判断依据关键词：实验上实现了掺杂调控的相变、观察到对非磁性无序的敏感性和原子台阶边缘的取向选择性带隙内模式，同时用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 计算对实验现象进行支持。；研究对象：失配层化合物 (LaxPb1-xSe)1.14(NbSe2)2 体材料中的超导态，以及通过掺杂调控的从常规超导到拓扑超导的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该失配层化合物中实现了由掺杂控制的从常规超导到拓扑超导的相变，相图呈现非单调特征：两个不同的超导区域被一个精确掺杂下的非超导相分隔；高掺杂区域的超导相对非磁性无序异常敏感，并在原子台阶边缘出现取向选择性的带隙内模式，这些特征与时间反演对称的晶体拓扑序参量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该失配层化合物中实现了由掺杂控制的从常规超导到拓扑超导的相变，相图呈现非单调特征：两个不同的超导区域被一个精确掺杂下的非超导相分隔；高掺杂区域的超导相对非磁性无序异常敏感，并在原子台阶边缘出现取向选择性的带隙内模式，这些特征与时间反演对称的晶体拓扑序参量一致。；创新点：首次在体失配层化合物中展示了掺杂控制的常规超导到拓扑超导的相变，揭示了由非超导相分隔两个超导区域的非单调相图，并观察到与时间反演对称晶体拓扑序参量相符的原子台阶边缘取向选择性带隙内模式，从而确立了失配化合物作为工程化拓扑超导的平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过掺杂调控并测量了相图、超导对非磁性无序的响应以及原子台阶边缘的带隙内模式（摘要未明确说明具体的实验测量手段，如 STM/STS、输运测量等）；理论上采用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 计算来支持实验观察到的空间特征。

papers.title: Nearly Isotropic Vortex Solid in $\mathbf{(La,Pr)_{3}Ni_{2}O_{7}}$ Thin Films
papers.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in bulk bilayer nickelates has established a new platform for exploring high-$T_c$ superconductivity beyond the cuprates. The role of the Ni $3d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band in the superconductivity of bilayer nickelates remains unresolved. By performing simultaneous resistance and diamagnetism measurements on (La,Pr)$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ thin films, we map the vortex melting phase diagram for both in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields. For $H\parallel c$, the geometric confinement effect gives rise to pancake vortices. Remarkably, the anisotropy parameter of the vortex melting field $γ_{H_m} \equiv H_m^{ab}/H_m^c$ decreases monotonically with decreasing temperature and approaches unity at low temperatures. Within the anisotropic Ginzburg--Landau scaling, $H_m^{ab}/H_m^c = \sqrt{ρ_s^{ab}/ρ_s^c}$ tracks the superfluid-density anisotropy. Such a vortex solid implies a nearly isotropic superfluid density, which is irreconcilable with the strictly two-dimensional $3d_{x^2-y^2}$-derived bands, but naturally explained by a substantial interlayer superfluid contribution from the $3d_{z^2}$-derived $γ$ band. Our results provide thermodynamic evidence for a substantial contribution of the $γ$ band to superconductivity in bilayer nickelate thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中明确提到“performing simultaneous resistance and diamagnetism measurements”（同时进行电阻与抗磁性测量）、“map the vortex melting phase diagram”（绘制涡旋熔化相图），属于以实验测量为主的工作。；研究对象：研究对象是 (La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇ 薄膜中的超导涡旋固态（vortex solid）及涡旋熔化相图，涉及面内磁场（H∥ab）和面外磁场（H∥c）两种取向下的涡旋熔化行为，以及双层镍氧化物中超流密度各向异性与 Ni 3d_{z²} 衍生 γ 带对超导的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 (La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇ 薄膜中，涡旋熔化场的各向异性参数 γ_{H_m} ≡ H_m^{ab}/H_m^c 随温度降低单调减小，并在低温下趋近于 1，表明涡旋固态近乎各向同性，对应近乎各向同性的超流密度；这一结果无法用严格二维的 3d_{x²-y²} 衍生能带解释，但可由 3d_{z²} 衍生 γ 带提供显著层间超流贡献来自然解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 (La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇ 薄膜中，涡旋熔化场的各向异性参数 γ_{H_m} ≡ H_m^{ab}/H_m^c 随温度降低单调减小，并在低温下趋近于 1，表明涡旋固态近乎各向同性，对应近乎各向同性的超流密度；这一结果无法用严格二维的 3d_{x²-y²} 衍生能带解释，但可由 3d_{z²} 衍生 γ 带提供显著层间超流贡献来自然解释。；创新点：首次在双层镍氧化物薄膜中通过同时电阻与抗磁性测量绘制涡旋熔化相图，发现低温下涡旋熔化场各向异性趋近于 1（近各向同性涡旋固态），为 3d_{z²} 衍生 γ 带对双层镍氧化物超导具有显著贡献提供了热力学证据。
papers.method_zh: 对 (La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇ 薄膜同时进行电阻和抗磁性测量，绘制面内与面外磁场下的涡旋熔化相图；并采用各向异性 Ginzburg–Landau 标度关系 H_m^{ab}/H_m^c = √(ρ_s^{ab}/ρ_s^c) 来分析超流密度各向异性。

papers.title: Exact Hamiltonian Dynamics of Rare Events in Active Matter
papers.abstract: Active systems navigate complex environments through non-equilibrium fluctuations, rendering standard equilibrium transition-rate theories inadequate. Moreover, transition rates provide only partial information on how non-equilibrium dynamics explore metastable states, whereas knowledge of the optimal paths offers deeper physical insight. Using an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle as a paradigmatic model, i.e., a stochastic dynamics driven by exponentially correlated noise, we establish an exact mapping of the non-Markovian optimal path onto a higher-dimensional Hamiltonian dynamical system so that, for arbitrary force fields, optimal paths can be computed systematically by solving the corresponding Hamilton equations. Tuning the conserved energy allows us to explore diverse dynamical regimes: ranging from classical instanton trajectories strictly confined to the zero-energy surface, to closed periodic orbits that emerge only at non-zero energies, representing a distinct signature of the non-Markovian active dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“establish an exact mapping”“Hamiltonian dynamical system”“solving the corresponding Hamilton equations”等理论推导与数学框架构建的表述，未涉及实验测量或数值模拟平台。；研究对象：活性物质中的稀有事件动力学，具体以活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子（active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle）为范式模型，即由指数关联噪声驱动的随机动力学系统，研究其非马尔可夫最优路径及亚稳态间的跃迁行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了非马尔可夫最优路径到高维哈密顿动力系统的精确映射，使得对任意力场均可通过求解哈密顿方程系统计算最优路径；通过调节守恒能量可探索不同动力学区域——从严格限制在零能面上的经典瞬子轨迹，到仅在非零能量下出现的闭合周期轨道，后者是非马尔可夫活性动力学的独特标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了非马尔可夫最优路径到高维哈密顿动力系统的精确映射，使得对任意力场均可通过求解哈密顿方程系统计算最优路径；通过调节守恒能量可探索不同动力学区域——从严格限制在零能面上的经典瞬子轨迹，到仅在非零能量下出现的闭合周期轨道，后者是非马尔可夫活性动力学的独特标志。；创新点：相对于传统平衡态跃迁速率理论，该工作针对非平衡活性系统提供了超越跃迁速率的最优路径信息；其核心新意在于对非马尔可夫最优路径建立了精确的哈密顿映射，从而可系统计算任意力场下的最优路径，并揭示了非零能量下闭合周期轨道这一非马尔可夫活性动力学的独特特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为将活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子的非马尔可夫最优路径精确映射为高维哈密顿动力学系统，通过求解相应的 Hamilton 方程获得最优路径；利用守恒能量作为调控参数来探索不同动力学区域。摘要未明确说明是否结合数值计算或具体求解细节。

papers.title: Benchmarking Universal Machine Learning Force Fields for Crystal Structure Prediction of High-Energy Molecular Systems
papers.abstract: Recent developments of universal machine learning interatomic potentials (UMLIPs) offer a fast route for screening molecular crystals based on geometry relaxation and energy ranking, but their reliability across chemically diverse energetic materials remains elusive. In particular, it is unclear whether or not these UMLIPs are over-sensitive to break the desired molecular connectivity for relaxing the periodic crystals. Herein we tested the hypothesis that classical force-field pre-relaxation can provide a more suitable starting geometry for subsequent UMLIP relaxation on a large database of high energy molecular crystals. Three models (MACE, MACE-OFF and UMA) in conjunction with the General Amber Force Field (GAFF) were applied to test this hypothesis. Among them, direct MACE-OFF and UMA showed very high relaxation success and preserved the reference geometries most closely, but they still exhibit failures for some rare cases. Using GAFF pre-relaxation can systematically reduce the number of failed relaxations with lower computational costs. Our comparative failure and robustness analyses revealed distinct trade-offs among the evaluated models. Among them, MACE-OFF achieves a better compromise between potential energy surface smoothness, structural fidelity, and stress convergence, serving as a good choice to provide a reliable foundation for automated structural optimization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要中提及“geometry relaxation and energy ranking”“classical force-field pre-relaxation”“UMLIP relaxation”，以及使用 MACE、MACE-OFF、UMA 和 GAFF 等模型进行测试，属于典型的计算/模拟研究。；研究对象：高能分子晶体（high-energy molecular crystals）的晶体结构预测，具体关注通用机器学习原子间势（UMLIPs）在几何弛豫和能量排序中的可靠性，以及弛豫过程中分子连接性是否被破坏的问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 直接使用 MACE-OFF 和 UMA 进行弛豫的成功率很高且能最紧密地保持参考几何结构，但在少数罕见情况下仍会失败；使用 GAFF 预弛豫可以系统性地减少弛豫失败次数并降低计算成本。在评估的模型中，MACE-OFF 在势能面平滑性、结构保真度和应力收敛之间取得了较好的折中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：直接使用 MACE-OFF 和 UMA 进行弛豫的成功率很高且能最紧密地保持参考几何结构，但在少数罕见情况下仍会失败；使用 GAFF 预弛豫可以系统性地减少弛豫失败次数并降低计算成本。在评估的模型中，MACE-OFF 在势能面平滑性、结构保真度和应力收敛之间取得了较好的折中。；创新点：系统测试了经典力场（GAFF）预弛豫对 UMLIP 弛豫成功率的改善效果，并在大规模高能分子晶体数据库上比较了 MACE、MACE-OFF 和 UMA 三种模型的失败模式与鲁棒性，揭示了各模型在势能面平滑性、结构保真度和应力收敛之间的权衡关系。
papers.method_zh: 使用三种通用机器学习原子间势（MACE、MACE-OFF、UMA）结合通用 Amber 力场（GAFF）进行晶体结构弛豫测试，并在大规模高能分子晶体数据库上验证“经典力场预弛豫可为后续 UMLIP 弛豫提供更合适初始几何”的假设；进行了失败案例比较分析和鲁棒性分析。

papers.title: Graph neural networks and the energetic cavity method for combinatorial optimization
papers.abstract: We study the use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for finding approximate ground states of Ising models. Efficiently finding these ground states is of broad significance because many combinatorial optimization problems can be formulated as an Ising model with the appropriate choice of couplings and fields. Exactly solving these problems is hard but there are many good heuristic methods. A lineage of these heuristics build from mean-field approximations: one approach uses the leading eigenvector of an appropriately defined matrix, another is the min-sum algorithm, also known as the energetic cavity method. Without modification, GNNs perform worse than both of these methods. We consider small modifications to the GNN to incorporate these heuristics and find that this considerably improves performance. While the modified approach is competitive against other deep-learning approaches, we still find that simulated annealing is reliably at least as good as deep learning methods for the same computational cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：graph neural networks、Ising models、combinatorial optimization、heuristic methods、simulated annealing、deep-learning approaches，全文围绕算法性能比较与改进展开，不涉及具体实验或材料。；研究对象：Ising 模型的近似基态求解问题，以及可被表述为 Ising 模型的组合优化问题。摘要未明确说明具体针对哪一类组合优化问题或具体物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 未经修改的图神经网络（GNN）在求解 Ising 模型近似基态时表现劣于基于平均场近似的两种启发式方法（矩阵主特征向量方法和 min-sum 算法/能量腔方法）；对 GNN 做小幅修改以融入这些启发式后，性能显著提升，可与其他深度学习方法竞争，但在相同计算代价下，模拟退火至少与深度学习方法一样可靠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：未经修改的图神经网络（GNN）在求解 Ising 模型近似基态时表现劣于基于平均场近似的两种启发式方法（矩阵主特征向量方法和 min-sum 算法/能量腔方法）；对 GNN 做小幅修改以融入这些启发式后，性能显著提升，可与其他深度学习方法竞争，但在相同计算代价下，模拟退火至少与深度学习方法一样可靠。；创新点：将基于平均场近似的启发式方法（主特征向量方法、min-sum/能量腔方法）融入 GNN 的小幅修改中，从而显著提升 GNN 在 Ising 基态求解上的性能，并系统比较了修改后 GNN 与其他深度学习方法及模拟退火在相同计算代价下的表现。
papers.method_zh: 使用图神经网络（GNN）求解 Ising 模型近似基态；对比方法包括基于适当定义矩阵的主特征向量方法、min-sum 算法（能量腔方法 energetic cavity method）以及模拟退火；并对 GNN 进行小幅修改以融入上述平均场启发式。摘要未明确说明具体的网络架构、训练细节或测试基准。

papers.title: Direct Realization of Near-Ideal Carbyne in Ultrathin Boron Nitride Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Carbyne, the sp-hybridized one-dimensional allotrope of carbon, is predicted to be the stiffest known material, with electronic and optical properties set by a single structural parameter, the bond length alternation. However, its intrinsic properties have never been measured: chains synthesized through molecular chemistry carry endgroup and finite-length perturbations that persist even in the longest molecules available, while chains grown inside carbon nanotubes strongly couple to the host, which renormalizes their vibrational frequency by up to 110 cm$^{-1}$ in a diameter-dependent manner. Here, we show that encapsulating and thermally converting hydrogen-capped polyynes inside ultrathin boron nitride nanotubes, structural analogues of carbon nanotubes but electrically insulating, yields carbyne chains in a near-ideal regime, where endgroup, finite length, and host-guest perturbations are reduced to secondary effects. Statistical Raman spectroscopy across 245 locations returns a vibrational frequency distribution an order of magnitude narrower than in carbon nanotubes, an anharmonicity consistent with the universal law for carbyne-like materials, and a bond length alternation matching correlated calculations for the free chain. No photoluminescence is detected, despite the transparent host, as expected for the dipole-forbidden emission of an unperturbed carbyne chain. Boron nitride nanotubes give experimental access to carbyne in its near-ideal form.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中描述了“封装并热转化”（encapsulating and thermally converting）的制备过程、统计拉曼光谱（Statistical Raman spectroscopy across 245 locations）的测量、以及光致发光（photoluminescence）的检测等实验手段，属于以实验为主的工作。；研究对象：研究对象是卡宾（carbyne），即碳的 sp 杂化一维同素异形体，具体为封装在超薄氮化硼纳米管（boron nitride nanotubes）内部的卡宾链。关注的是其在近理想（near-ideal）状态下的振动频率、非谐性、键长交替（bond length alternation）以及光致发光行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将氢封端的聚炔（hydrogen-capped polyynes）封装在电绝缘的超薄氮化硼纳米管中并进行热转化，可获得处于近理想状态的卡宾链，其中端基、有限长度和主客体相互作用等扰动被降为次要效应。统计拉曼光谱显示其振动频率分布比碳纳米管中的卡宾窄一个数量级，非谐性符合卡宾类材料的普适规律，键长交替与自由链的关联计算结果一致；尽管宿主透明，但未检测到光致发光，符合无扰动卡宾链偶极禁戒发射的预期。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将氢封端的聚炔（hydrogen-capped polyynes）封装在电绝缘的超薄氮化硼纳米管中并进行热转化，可获得处于近理想状态的卡宾链，其中端基、有限长度和主客体相互作用等扰动被降为次要效应。统计拉曼光谱显示其振动频率分布比碳纳米管中的卡宾窄一个数量级，非谐性符合卡宾类材料的普适规律，键长交替与自由链的关联计算结果一致；尽管宿主透明，但未检测到光致发光，符合无扰动卡宾链偶极禁戒发射的预期。；创新点：已有卡宾合成方法存在局限：分子化学合成的链带有端基和有限长度扰动，而在碳纳米管中生长的链与宿主强耦合，导致振动频率被重整化（直径依赖，最高达 110 cm⁻¹）。本工作首次利用电绝缘的氮化硼纳米管作为宿主，将端基、有限长度和主客体扰动降至次要效应，从而实验上获得了近理想形式的卡宾，并首次测量到其本征振动频率分布、非谐性和键长交替等性质。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法包括：将氢封端聚炔封装进超薄氮化硼纳米管并进行热转化以制备卡宾链；在 245 个位置进行统计拉曼光谱测量以获取振动频率分布、非谐性和键长交替信息；进行光致发光检测。摘要中提到的理论对比为“关联计算”（correlated calculations），但未明确说明具体的计算方法（如 DFT、DMRG 等）。

papers.title: Charge-spin conversion in altermagnets: electronic anisotropy versus magnon-mediated spin drag
papers.abstract: Altermagnets acquire a momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization or spin-orbit coupling. This raises the question of whether the transport anisotropy originates in the electrons or the magnons, and whether the magnon-mediated channel distinguishes an altermagnet from a conventional antiferromagnet. We compute the spin-resolved conductivity of a metallic ferromagnet, antiferromagnet, and altermagnet within a common model, treating the spin-diagonal channel with the magnon self-energy and the spin-flip channel to leading order in the electron-magnon coupling. The anisotropy of the charge-spin conversion is dominated by the electronic spin splitting, the magnon branches contributing only marginally. The magnon-mediated spin-flip channel is even under $C_{4}$, so it carries no signature at first order in the anisotropy and cannot on its own distinguish an altermagnet from a conventional antiferromagnet. It does, however, respond linearly to a sublattice-selective perturbation that lowers the bulk $B_{1g}$ symmetry. The resulting susceptibility vanishes identically in the antiferromagnet, is small in the ferromagnet, and is finite in the altermagnet, where the electronic anisotropy ties spin and sublattice together, so that among magnets with no net magnetization it is unique to altermagnetic order. Being even in the magnetic domain index, this response can be measured without preparing a single magnetic-domain sample.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键依据：摘要明确说明“We compute the spin-resolved conductivity...within a common model”，属于理论建模与计算工作，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：金属性铁磁体、反铁磁体与交错磁体（altermagnet）中的电荷-自旋转换（charge-spin conversion）及各向异性，重点比较电子自旋劈裂与磁子介导的自旋拖拽两种通道的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷-自旋转换的各向异性主要由电子自旋劈裂主导，磁子支的贡献很小；磁子介导的自旋翻转通道在C₄下为偶，一阶各向异性中无信号，不能单独区分交错磁体与常规反铁磁体。但该通道对降低体态B₁g对称性的子晶格选择性微扰有线性响应，该响应在反铁磁体中恒为零、在铁磁体中很小、在交错磁体中有限，因而在无净磁化磁体中为交错磁序所独有；且该响应关于磁畴指标为偶，无需制备单磁畴样品即可测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷-自旋转换的各向异性主要由电子自旋劈裂主导，磁子支的贡献很小；磁子介导的自旋翻转通道在C₄下为偶，一阶各向异性中无信号，不能单独区分交错磁体与常规反铁磁体。但该通道对降低体态B₁g对称性的子晶格选择性微扰有线性响应，该响应在反铁磁体中恒为零、在铁磁体中很小、在交错磁体中有限，因而在无净磁化磁体中为交错磁序所独有；且该响应关于磁畴指标为偶，无需制备单磁畴样品即可测量。；创新点：在统一模型中系统比较了电子各向异性与磁子介导自旋拖拽对电荷-自旋转换各向异性的贡献，明确指出磁子自旋翻转通道一阶不能区分交错磁体与常规反铁磁体，但通过子晶格选择性微扰（降低B₁g对称性）可产生对交错磁序独有的响应，且该响应为磁畴偶，无需单磁畴样品即可测量。
papers.method_zh: 在统一模型框架下计算自旋分辨电导率；对自旋对角通道处理至磁子自能级别，对自旋翻转通道处理至电子-磁子耦合的最低阶；并分析C₄对称性及B₁g对称性降低下的响应。

papers.title: Layer-Dependent Phonons, Excitons, and Magneto-Optical Phenomena in CrSBr: A Mini Review
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional layered magnetic materials offer a versatile platform for exploring low-dimensional magnetism and coupled many-body interactions in these materials. Chromium sulfur bromide (CrSBr) is a promising candidate for advanced spintronic and optoelectronic applications because of its intrinsic air stability, semiconducting nature, strong in-plane anisotropy, and A-type antiferromagnetic ordering. This review summarizes recent advances in the understanding of the layer-dependent vibrational and excitonic properties of CrSBr, as well as its magneto-optical response, from bulk crystals to the monolayer limit. We examined its crystal structure, magnetic anisotropy, and interlayer spin reorientation, followed by insights into vibrational dynamics and spin-phonon coupling. Particular emphasis is placed on the excitonic landscape, including magnetic-field-sensitive photoluminescence, localized excitonic states, and the coexistence of Frenkel- and Wannier-Mott excitons in the bandgap. Finally, we discuss the challenges and prospects of harnessing the unique layer-dependent properties of CrSBr in spintronic, magneto-optical, and quantum photonic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Mini Review）。判断依据的关键词：标题中的“A Mini Review”，摘要中的“This review summarizes recent advances”“We examined”“we discuss the challenges and prospects”。；研究对象：二维层状磁性半导体 CrSBr（溴硫化铬），具体关注其从体材料到单层的层依赖振动性质（声子）、激子性质以及磁光响应，涉及晶体结构、磁各向异性、层间自旋重取向、自旋-声子耦合、激子态（包括局域激子态、Frenkel 激子与 Wannier-Mott 激子共存）等现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrSBr 因其本征空气稳定性、半导体性、强面内各向异性和 A 型反铁磁序，是自旋电子学和光电子学应用的候选材料；该综述总结了其在层依赖振动与激子性质以及磁光响应方面的近期进展，并指出其带隙内存在 Frenkel 激子与 Wannier-Mott 激子共存，且光致发光对磁场敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrSBr 因其本征空气稳定性、半导体性、强面内各向异性和 A 型反铁磁序，是自旋电子学和光电子学应用的候选材料；该综述总结了其在层依赖振动与激子性质以及磁光响应方面的近期进展，并指出其带隙内存在 Frenkel 激子与 Wannier-Mott 激子共存，且光致发光对磁场敏感。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该综述相对于已有研究的独特新意，仅说明其系统总结了 CrSBr 从体材料到单层的层依赖振动与激子性质及磁光响应，并讨论了其在自旋电子学、磁光和量子光子技术中的应用挑战与前景。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段、计算方法或理论框架（作为综述，摘要仅说明总结了近期进展，未列出所涉及的具体技术如 DFT、ARPES、PL 测量等）。

papers.title: Quantifying thermal and driven magnon populations with femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Precise knowledge of the total number of magnons, including both coherent and incoherent (e.g. thermal) excitations, is imperative for the advancement of fundamental spin-wave physics and the development of next-generation magnonic devices. In particular, quantifying magnons is key to understanding magnon transport phenomena, the nonlinear regime, or ultrafast magnetization dynamics. Typically, incoherent magnons are accessed by frequency-domain techniques, which lack the temporal resolution required for ultrafast processes, while ultrafast time-domain methods are generally sensitive only to the coherent dynamics. In this work, we demonstrate that femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy enables a fully quantitative, time-domain measurement of both thermal and coherently excited magnon modes in bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet driven by a free-running microwave. We model the experimental data and extract the magnon number by simulating the magnon band structure of the sample, the magneto-optical response function, and the optical spot size used in the experiment. Our analysis establishes a connection between magnon mode calculations and experimentally accessible magnetic properties and fiducially reproduces the waveform and amplitude of the magneto-optical correlation signal for different experimental conditions. These results open a new pathway towards the optical tomography of magnon modes in non-linear or non-equilibrium conditions and can be readily extended to study ultrafast incoherent dynamics in other condensed matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合建模分析）。关键判断依据：摘要明确说明“we demonstrate that femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy enables...measurement”“We model the experimental data”，属于以实验为主、辅以理论建模的工作。；研究对象：铋掺杂钇铁石榴石（bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet, Bi:YIG）中的磁振子（magnon）模式，包括热激发的非相干磁振子和由自由运行微波驱动的相干磁振子。研究现象为超快磁振子动力学及磁光响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 飞秒噪声关联光谱学能够在时域中定量测量热磁振子和相干激发的磁振子模式；通过模拟磁振子能带结构、磁光响应函数和光斑尺寸，可以从实验数据中提取磁振子数，并忠实再现不同实验条件下磁光关联信号的波形和振幅。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：飞秒噪声关联光谱学能够在时域中定量测量热磁振子和相干激发的磁振子模式；通过模拟磁振子能带结构、磁光响应函数和光斑尺寸，可以从实验数据中提取磁振子数，并忠实再现不同实验条件下磁光关联信号的波形和振幅。；创新点：已有频域技术缺乏超快过程所需的时间分辨率，而超快时域方法通常仅对相干动力学敏感；本工作证明飞秒噪声关联光谱学可同时定量测量热磁振子和相干磁振子模式，实现了全定量的时域磁振子数提取，并为非线性或非平衡条件下的磁振子光学层析成像开辟了新路径，且可推广至其他凝聚态体系的超快非相干动力学研究。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为飞秒噪声关联光谱学（femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy），在自由运行微波驱动下测量Bi:YIG的磁光关联信号。理论/建模方面：模拟样品的磁振子能带结构、磁光响应函数以及实验所用光斑尺寸，并将磁振子模式计算与实验可及的磁学性质建立联系。

papers.title: Spontaneous counterflow in rotating supersolids
papers.abstract: Rotating supersolids challenge the conventional notion of superfluid flow: quantized vortices coexist with crystalline order arising from the system's intrinsic density modulation. Drawing on concepts developed in the context of superfluid helium, this seemingly paradoxical state is often described phenomenologically in terms of a dual response, combining superfluid flow with rigid-body-like motion. Here we show that these apparently distinct behaviors emerge from a single microscopic velocity field, globally constrained by irrotationality. By applying a Helmholtz decomposition, we disentangle a divergence-free incompressible component, which carries vortex circulation, from a curl-free compressible component generated by the intrinsic density modulation. In absence of vortices, the response is entirely encoded in the compressible field: the droplets co-rotate with the external drive, while the interstitial fluid develops an oppositely directed counterflow that preserves vanishing circulation. Above the vortex nucleation threshold, the incompressible component carries the usual quantized circulation, whereas the compressible field counteracts the vortex-induced angular momentum, reducing the total jump with respect to an unmodulated condensate. Our results recast supersolid rotation in terms of a flow-counterflow response, providing a microscopic interpretation of the phenomenological rigid/superfluid partitioning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“we show that...emerge from a single microscopic velocity field”“By applying a Helmholtz decomposition”“providing a microscopic interpretation”，全文围绕理论框架和微观速度场分析展开，未提及具体实验测量或数值计算方法。；研究对象：旋转的超固体（rotating supersolids）中量子化涡旋与晶体序共存的超流响应问题，具体涉及超固体在旋转下的速度场结构、涡旋成核阈值上下的流动行为，以及液滴与间隙流体的反向流动现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超固体的旋转响应可由单一微观速度场统一描述：无涡旋时，液滴随外驱共转，而间隙流体产生反向逆流以保持零环量；超过涡旋成核阈值后，不可压缩分量携带量子化环量，可压缩分量抵消涡旋诱导的角动量，使总角动量跳变小于无调制凝聚体。这一结果将超固体旋转重新表述为“流动-逆流”响应，为唯象的刚体/超流分区提供了微观解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超固体的旋转响应可由单一微观速度场统一描述：无涡旋时，液滴随外驱共转，而间隙流体产生反向逆流以保持零环量；超过涡旋成核阈值后，不可压缩分量携带量子化环量，可压缩分量抵消涡旋诱导的角动量，使总角动量跳变小于无调制凝聚体。这一结果将超固体旋转重新表述为“流动-逆流”响应，为唯象的刚体/超流分区提供了微观解释。；创新点：首次从单一微观速度场出发，统一解释了超固体旋转中看似矛盾的超流流动与刚体式运动，并通过Helmholtz分解给出了可压缩/不可压缩分量的明确物理分工，为长期使用的唯象“刚体/超流分区”图像提供了微观理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于微观速度场的全局无旋约束，应用Helmholtz分解将速度场拆分为无散度的不可压缩分量（携带涡旋环量）和无旋度的可压缩分量（由内禀密度调制产生）。摘要未明确说明是否涉及具体数值计算或模型哈密顿量。

papers.title: How to enhance the applicability of Murnaghan equation of state
papers.abstract: The paper presents the brief overview of known isothermal equations of state for solids and of theoretical background to construct them, focusing on widely used Murnaghan equation. Since the latter has a limited range of application, failing to reproduce reliably both near-equilibrium and high-pressure regions simultaneously, the paper proposes simple, but rather efficient way to improve it. The suggested modification favors its applicability at high pressures, allowing to expand considerably the region of reliable reproducing of experimental or computational data. The proposed improved equation has been tested in fitting of U(V) data, obtained within ab initio computations, as well as of experimental V-P data for a representative selection of solids. In comparison with ordinary Murnaghan equation, it has found significant advantages, extending the range, where the computational data may be reproduced trustworthy (from the equilibrium state to the pressures, appreciably higher, the ordinary equation could). As for the fitting of experimental data, the proposed improved Murnaghan equation reproduces them, in the presented examples, at least not worse than other well-known equations (Vinet, Birch-Murnaghan, Mao) do. Some aspects of fitting process, as well as some alternative approaches to obtain the proposed equation of state in various forms are also discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方法学文章（偏计算与数据拟合）。关键依据：摘要以“isothermal equations of state”“theoretical background”“proposes simple...way to improve it”“tested in fitting of U(V) data...ab initio computations...experimental V-P data”为主，属于对状态方程形式的理论改进与拟合验证，而非单一新材料实验发现。；研究对象：固体的等温状态方程（equations of state, EOS），重点是广泛使用的 Murnaghan 状态方程及其适用性问题；并用一系列代表性固体的 U(V) 从头算数据与实验 V-P 数据进行检验。摘要未明确说明具体材料清单或具体物理现象（如某类相变、输运等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出一种简单而有效的 Murnaghan 状态方程改进形式，使其更适合高压区域，从而显著扩展能够可靠再现实验或计算数据的压力范围；在拟合从头算 U(V) 数据和实验 V-P 数据时，改进方程相较普通 Murnaghan 方程具有明显优势，并且在实验数据拟合上至少不劣于 Vinet、Birch-Murnaghan、Mao 等知名方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出一种简单而有效的 Murnaghan 状态方程改进形式，使其更适合高压区域，从而显著扩展能够可靠再现实验或计算数据的压力范围；在拟合从头算 U(V) 数据和实验 V-P 数据时，改进方程相较普通 Murnaghan 方程具有明显优势，并且在实验数据拟合上至少不劣于 Vinet、Birch-Murnaghan、Mao 等知名方程。；创新点：主要新意在于：针对 Murnaghan 方程难以同时可靠描述近平衡区与高压区的问题，提出一种简单但高效的改进方案，使其在高压下适用性增强，并大幅扩展可靠拟合实验/计算数据的范围；同时讨论了拟合过程的一些方面以及获得该改进状态方程不同形式的替代途径。
papers.method_zh: 方法上包括：对已知等温状态方程及构造它们的理论背景进行简要综述；提出对 Murnaghan 方程的修正形式；用从头算计算得到的 U(V) 数据进行拟合测试；用代表性固体的实验 V-P 数据进行拟合测试；并与普通 Murnaghan、Vinet、Birch-Murnaghan、Mao 等方程比较。摘要未明确说明具体采用哪种从头算方法（如 DFT、DFT+U 等）或具体实验测量手段。

papers.title: Fragility from Enthalpy Fluctuations and Fictive-Temperature Dynamics
papers.abstract: Fragility and fictive temperature are two central measures of glass formation, but their connection is usually expressed indirectly through structural relaxation times or cooling-rate dependence. Here we formulate this connection in terms of configurational enthalpy fluctuations. The time evolution of the fictive temperature during cooling or aging is controlled by the enthalpy--enthalpy correlation function that also determines the frequency-dependent configurational heat capacity. Fragility enters through the strong temperature dependence of the structural relaxation time and therefore controls how rapidly the corresponding enthalpy-relaxation spectrum shifts to long times near the glass transition. This leads to a direct time-domain description of the onset and growth of the fictive-temperature lag, including the Debye limit, and connects calorimetric relaxation, fragility, and nonequilibrium structural arrest within a common framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：formulate、framework、description、controlled by the enthalpy–enthalpy correlation function，摘要中未涉及具体实验或数值计算，属于理论框架构建。；研究对象：玻璃形成过程中的 fragility（脆性）与 fictive temperature（虚构温度）之间的关联，以及冷却或老化过程中虚构温度的动力学行为。具体材料体系摘要未明确说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: fictive temperature 在冷却或老化过程中的时间演化由 enthalpy–enthalpy 关联函数控制，该关联函数同时决定了频率依赖的构型热容；fragility 通过结构弛豫时间的强温度依赖性进入理论，从而控制焓弛豫谱在玻璃转变附近向长时间移动的速率，最终给出了虚构温度滞后起始与增长的直接时域描述（包括 Debye 极限），并将量热弛豫、fragility 与非平衡结构冻结统一在同一框架内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：fictive temperature 在冷却或老化过程中的时间演化由 enthalpy–enthalpy 关联函数控制，该关联函数同时决定了频率依赖的构型热容；fragility 通过结构弛豫时间的强温度依赖性进入理论，从而控制焓弛豫谱在玻璃转变附近向长时间移动的速率，最终给出了虚构温度滞后起始与增长的直接时域描述（包括 Debye 极限），并将量热弛豫、fragility 与非平衡结构冻结统一在同一框架内。；创新点：将 fragility 与 fictive temperature 之间的联系从通常间接通过结构弛豫时间或冷却速率依赖性的表述，改为直接用构型焓涨落来表述，从而建立了虚构温度滞后的时域描述，并在统一框架内连接了量热弛豫、fragility 和非平衡结构冻结。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：以构型焓涨落（configurational enthalpy fluctuations）为基础，利用 enthalpy–enthalpy 关联函数描述 fictive temperature 的时间演化，并结合结构弛豫时间的温度依赖性来引入 fragility。摘要未明确说明是否涉及具体数值计算或实验验证。

papers.title: Static-Dynamic Correlations and Complex Spin-Wave Eigenmodes in Single- and Multilayer Diamond-Shaped Nanomagnets Without Bias Field
papers.abstract: Diamond-shaped nanomagnets provide a suitable platform for developing microwave devices with reconfigurable characteristics. In this study, the static and dynamic magnetic behaviour of single layer and multilayer diamond-shaped nanomagnets was systematically investigated using micromagnetic simulations. Two distinct remanent magnetic configurations were obtained through a simple magnetic field initialization process. These configurations exhibited different magnetization patterns and dynamic responses. Their resonance characteristics could be modified by applying a nanosecond-scale magnetic field pulse, enabling reconfigurable microwave operation. A clear resonance frequency shift in the sub-GHz (0.9 GHz) range was observed for the single-layer structure, while the multilayer structure exhibited a significantly larger frequency shift in the GHz range (3 GHz). The larger frequency tunability observed in the multilayer configuration arises primarily from the enhanced dipolar coupling between the vertically coupled magnetic layers, which modifies the local effective magnetic field and consequently influences the magnetization dynamics. These findings demonstrate that diamond-shaped nanomagnets can provide a simple and effective route toward reconfigurable microwave functionality, with potential applications in ultralow-power, ultrafast, and frequency tunable microwave devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：micromagnetic simulations（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：单层和多层菱形纳米磁体（diamond-shaped nanomagnets）的静态与动态磁行为，包括其剩磁组态、自旋波本征模式及共振特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过简单的磁场初始化过程可获得两种不同的剩磁组态，它们具有不同的磁化图案和动态响应；施加纳秒级磁场脉冲可调控其共振特性，实现可重构微波操作。单层结构的共振频率偏移在亚GHz（0.9 GHz）范围，而多层结构的频率偏移显著更大，达GHz范围（3 GHz），这主要源于垂直耦合磁性层之间增强的偶极耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过简单的磁场初始化过程可获得两种不同的剩磁组态，它们具有不同的磁化图案和动态响应；施加纳秒级磁场脉冲可调控其共振特性，实现可重构微波操作。单层结构的共振频率偏移在亚GHz（0.9 GHz）范围，而多层结构的频率偏移显著更大，达GHz范围（3 GHz），这主要源于垂直耦合磁性层之间增强的偶极耦合。；创新点：展示了菱形纳米磁体（尤其是多层结构）无需偏置场即可通过磁场脉冲实现可重构微波功能，多层结构因层间偶极耦合增强而具有更大的频率可调性（3 GHz），为超低功耗、超快、频率可调的微波器件提供了简单有效的途径。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），通过磁场初始化过程获得剩磁组态，并施加纳秒级磁场脉冲研究动态响应。

papers.title: Trion-mediated quantum operations on a double-dot charge qubit
papers.abstract: A scheme for controlling a charge qubit on a semiconductor asymmetric double quantum dot with suppressed tunnel coupling between individual quantum dots is proposed. Laser pulses convert the logical single-electron states of the qubit into auxiliary trion states, for which the resonant tunneling condition is restored due to the compensation of structural asymmetry by the Coulomb interaction of the particles. The conditions for performing orthogonal single-qubit rotations are formulated. For a two-dimensional structure, the parameters of the qubit are calculated, and the dependence of the fidelity of the inversion operation on the parameters of the laser field and the rates of dissipative processes is obtained. It is shown that the considered algorithm is characterized by high speed and reliability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：提出方案（proposed a scheme）、制定条件（conditions are formulated）、计算参数（parameters are calculated）、获得保真度依赖关系（dependence of the fidelity is obtained），摘要中未提及具体实验测量。；研究对象：半导体非对称双量子点上的电荷量子比特（charge qubit），其中单个量子点之间的隧穿耦合被抑制；涉及激光脉冲驱动的逻辑单电子态与辅助 trion 态之间的转换。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激光脉冲可将量子比特的逻辑单电子态转换为辅助 trion 态，由于粒子间库仑相互作用补偿了结构不对称性，共振隧穿条件得以恢复；该方案可实现正交单量子比特旋转，且具有高速和高可靠性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激光脉冲可将量子比特的逻辑单电子态转换为辅助 trion 态，由于粒子间库仑相互作用补偿了结构不对称性，共振隧穿条件得以恢复；该方案可实现正交单量子比特旋转，且具有高速和高可靠性。；创新点：利用 trion 态作为辅助态，通过库仑相互作用补偿双量子点结构不对称性来恢复共振隧穿条件，从而在隧穿耦合被抑制的非对称双量子点中实现电荷量子比特的正交单量子比特旋转操作。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计与计算。针对二维结构计算了量子比特参数，并获得了翻转操作保真度对激光场参数和耗散过程速率的依赖关系。摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法或理论框架（如有效质量近似、主方程等）。

papers.title: Storing Infinite Dynamical Attractors in Nonreciprocal Associative Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We develop a dynamical mean-field theory for nonreciprocal associative networks that store an extensive number of dynamical attractors, from limit cycles to strange attractors. Using a path integral calculation under quenched disorder, we derive self-consistent dynamical mean-field equations for pattern overlaps, autocorrelations and response functions. Memory retrieval capacity is governed by the spectral structure of the coupling matrices encoding stored patterns. When their eigenvalues are coherently aligned, retarded self-interactions and quenched noise feed back destructively: at zero eigenphase (fixed point attractors) the classical equilibrium capacity bound is recovered, while for limit cycles retrieval collapses far below it. In contrast, for uniformly distributed eigenphases, retarded self-interactions and much of the quenched noise cancels, reducing the dynamics to an effective single-spin process and amplifying capacity substantially. We validate the theory against microscopic simulations for limit-cycle and chaotic attractors, identifying eigenvalue decoherence as the mechanism enabling enhanced storage of dynamical memories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a dynamical mean-field theory”“path integral calculation under quenched disorder”“derive self-consistent dynamical mean-field equations”，并以“validate the theory against microscopic simulations”作为验证，属于以理论推导为主、数值模拟为辅的工作。；研究对象：非互易联想神经网络（nonreciprocal associative neural networks），即能够存储大量动力学吸引子（从极限环到奇异吸引子）的神经网络体系。研究的具体物理现象是网络的记忆检索能力（memory retrieval capacity）与耦合矩阵谱结构之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 记忆检索容量由编码存储模式的耦合矩阵的谱结构决定：当本征相位相干对齐时，延迟自相互作用与淬火噪声产生破坏性反馈，零本征相位（不动点吸引子）下可恢复经典平衡容量上限，而极限环下检索容量远低于该上限；当本征相位均匀分布时，延迟自相互作用与大部分淬火噪声相互抵消，动力学约化为有效单自旋过程，容量显著放大。本征相位退相干（eigenvalue decoherence）是增强动力学记忆存储的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：记忆检索容量由编码存储模式的耦合矩阵的谱结构决定：当本征相位相干对齐时，延迟自相互作用与淬火噪声产生破坏性反馈，零本征相位（不动点吸引子）下可恢复经典平衡容量上限，而极限环下检索容量远低于该上限；当本征相位均匀分布时，延迟自相互作用与大部分淬火噪声相互抵消，动力学约化为有效单自旋过程，容量显著放大。本征相位退相干（eigenvalue decoherence）是增强动力学记忆存储的机制。；创新点：将动力学平均场理论推广到存储大量动力学吸引子（极限环至奇异吸引子）的非互易联想网络，揭示了耦合矩阵本征相位结构（相干对齐 vs. 均匀分布）对记忆检索容量的决定性作用，并识别出本征相位退相干是增强动力学记忆存储的机制。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 动力学平均场理论（dynamical mean-field theory），具体采用淬火无序下的路径积分计算（path integral calculation under quenched disorder），推导出关于模式重叠、自相关和响应函数的自洽动力学平均场方程；并用微观模拟（microscopic simulations）对极限环和混沌吸引子的理论结果进行验证。

papers.title: Emergent Equilibrium Structure Along a Critical Cluster Recursion
papers.abstract: Critical universality does not determine the microscopic conditional structure of a probability measure. We study a bicolored cluster recursion constrained to remain critical at every generation, with no equilibrium spin measure or fixed coupling imposed. In both two and three dimensions, the resulting history-dependent sequence develops a common Ising/Fortuin--Kasteleyn (FK) compatibility structure: the second-shell dependence of a one-site conditional law is strongly suppressed, nearest-neighbor effective couplings move progressively toward one another near the critical Ising value, and cluster and interface observables organize around the corresponding FK geometry. An exact cluster-coloring factorization singles out $q=2$ as the point where the residual connectivity weight disappears from the two-color spin marginal. Thus equilibrium-compatible conditional structure can emerge along a trajectory that remains critical throughout.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：cluster recursion、conditional law、effective couplings、exact cluster-coloring factorization、Ising/Fortuin–Kasteleyn compatibility structure，均为理论/模型层面的分析，摘要中未涉及实验或数值模拟平台的具体描述。；研究对象：一个双色（bicolored）集团递归（cluster recursion）过程，该过程被约束为在每一代都保持临界（critical）。研究关注的是该递归序列所涌现出的微观条件概率结构，以及其与 Ising/Fortuin–Kasteleyn（FK）结构的兼容性。摘要未明确说明具体的物理材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维和三维中，这一历史依赖的递归序列都会发展出共同的 Ising/FK 兼容结构：单点条件律对第二壳层的依赖被强烈抑制，最近邻有效耦合逐渐相互靠近并趋近临界 Ising 值，集团与界面可观测量围绕相应的 FK 几何组织起来；此外，一个精确的集团着色因子分解表明 q=2 是双色自旋边缘分布中残余连通权重消失的点。因此，与平衡态兼容的条件结构可以沿着一条始终临界的轨迹涌现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维和三维中，这一历史依赖的递归序列都会发展出共同的 Ising/FK 兼容结构：单点条件律对第二壳层的依赖被强烈抑制，最近邻有效耦合逐渐相互靠近并趋近临界 Ising 值，集团与界面可观测量围绕相应的 FK 几何组织起来；此外，一个精确的集团着色因子分解表明 q=2 是双色自旋边缘分布中残余连通权重消失的点。因此，与平衡态兼容的条件结构可以沿着一条始终临界的轨迹涌现。；创新点：已有研究通常认为临界普适性不能决定概率测度的微观条件结构；本文表明，在不施加平衡自旋测度或固定耦合、仅要求每一代保持临界的条件下，仍可沿递归轨迹涌现出与平衡态兼容的 Ising/FK 条件结构，并通过精确的集团着色因子分解将 q=2 识别为残余连通权重消失的特殊点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为双色集团递归，并施加每一代保持临界的约束；摘要中未引入平衡自旋测度或固定耦合。分析手段包括：考察单点条件律的第二壳层依赖、最近邻有效耦合的演化、集团与界面可观测量的组织方式，以及推导精确的集团着色因子分解。摘要未明确说明是否使用了具体数值模拟方法（如 Monte Carlo、DMRG 等）。

papers.title: Unveiling the Scaling Potential of Drain Merge through Active (DMtA) in CFETs: Breaking the Super-Via Bottlenecks and Unlocking New PPA Boosters
papers.abstract: Drain merge (DM), a super via vertically connecting the common S/D terminals of stacked n/pFETs in Complementary FETs (CFETs), blocks further parasitic optimization and cell scaling. For the first time, this work systematically investigates the state-of-the-art Drain Merge through Active (DMtA), a revolutionary technology reported recently with the DM embedded in the active region, through a comprehensive DTCO framework spanning process integration, contact-configuration-dependent (CTCD) compact modeling, standardcell design, RO evaluation and block-level PPA benchmark on a 32-bit RISC-V Ibex core. By reducing DM parasitics and enabling DM-width optimization, DMtA improves RO frequency by 11.7% over its conventional Drain Merge through field (DMtF) counterpart. Active widening and Area Borrowing, the latter first reported in [8] and exploiting spatial slack in adjacent cells to further enlarge the nanosheet width (WNS), increase the maximum Ibex-core frequency by up to 34.8%. More importantly, DMtA also enables the once GAA-exclusive Hyper-cells on CFETs by merging the active regions across adjacent cell rows, providing a further 8.7% frequency gain. A post-routing floating-output-pin-aware optimization further removes redundant S/D contacts (CTs) and reduces power by 5.3%. Finally, DMtA facilitates more area-efficient 2.5T cell scaling by preserving single-row cell compatibility, reducing post-PR core area by 25.7%.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/设计类文章（TCAD/DTCO 研究）。判断依据的关键词：DTCO framework、compact modeling、standard-cell design、RO evaluation、block-level PPA benchmark。摘要中未提及实际流片或实验测量。；研究对象：互补场效应晶体管（CFETs）中的漏极合并（Drain Merge, DM）结构，具体为将 DM 嵌入有源区的“Drain Merge through Active (DMtA)”技术，以及其在标准单元、环形振荡器（RO）和 32 位 RISC-V Ibex 核心层面的面积、频率与功耗表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DMtA 通过降低 DM 寄生并实现 DM 宽度优化，使 RO 频率相比传统 DMtF 提升 11.7%；结合有源区加宽与 Area Borrowing，Ibex 核心最高频率最多提升 34.8%；DMtA 还使 CFET 上实现原本 GAA 专属的 Hyper-cells，带来额外 8.7% 频率增益；后布线浮空输出引脚感知优化减少冗余 S/D 接触（CT），功耗降低 5.3%；并支持更面积高效的 2.5T 单元缩放，使后布线核心面积减少 25.7%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DMtA 通过降低 DM 寄生并实现 DM 宽度优化，使 RO 频率相比传统 DMtF 提升 11.7%；结合有源区加宽与 Area Borrowing，Ibex 核心最高频率最多提升 34.8%；DMtA 还使 CFET 上实现原本 GAA 专属的 Hyper-cells，带来额外 8.7% 频率增益；后布线浮空输出引脚感知优化减少冗余 S/D 接触（CT），功耗降低 5.3%；并支持更面积高效的 2.5T 单元缩放，使后布线核心面积减少 25.7%。；创新点：首次系统研究 DMtA 这一将 DM 嵌入有源区的新技术；通过降低 DM 寄生和实现 DM 宽度优化突破 super-via 瓶颈；结合 Area Borrowing 与有源区加宽提升频率；首次使 CFET 支持原本 GAA 专属的 Hyper-cells；并提出后布线浮空输出引脚感知优化以减少冗余 CT 并降低功耗。
papers.method_zh: 采用覆盖工艺集成、接触配置相关（CTCD）紧凑建模、标准单元设计、RO 评估以及 32 位 RISC-V Ibex 核心的块级 PPA 基准测试的综合 DTCO 框架。摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段或原子级计算方法。

papers.title: Modular and Cost-effective Scanning Photocurrent Microscopy System for Sub-micron characterization of 2D optoelectronic devices
papers.abstract: Scanning photocurrent microscopy (SPCM) is a powerful technique for probing local optoelectronic phenomena in 2D semiconducting devices. However, commercial setups remain costly, complex and often lack flexibility and adaptability. In this work, we present a home-built SPCM platform built around the retrofitting of a conventional metallographic microscope by coupling it with different light sources (single-mode fiber-coupled lasers and multimode fiber-coupled high-power LEDs), a motorized XY stage, a digital camera and an electronic readout module. This system enables simultaneous acquisition of photocurrent and reflection intensity maps, requiring minimal modifications of the microscope. We reached sub-micron spatial resolution and high imaging fidelity by correlating photocurrent maps with reflection maps, optical micrographs and AFM topography data on different devices fabricated with different materials (InSe, MoS2, WSe2, Gr), on different substrates (Si/SiO2, compact disk). This work provides a reliable, accessible and reproducible high-performance SPCM platform that can be easily implemented in most laboratories for microscale optoelectronic characterization of 2D devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：论文描述了一套自建 SPCM 平台的搭建、改装与表征测试，属于仪器/实验方法类工作。；研究对象：二维半导体光电器件中的局域光电现象，具体测试材料包括 InSe、MoS2、WSe2、石墨烯（Gr），衬底包括 Si/SiO2 和光盘（compact disk）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将传统金相显微镜与多种光源、电动 XY 位移台、数码相机和电子读出模块耦合，搭建了可同时采集光电流与反射强度图的自制 SPCM 平台，并实现了亚微米空间分辨率和高成像保真度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将传统金相显微镜与多种光源、电动 XY 位移台、数码相机和电子读出模块耦合，搭建了可同时采集光电流与反射强度图的自制 SPCM 平台，并实现了亚微米空间分辨率和高成像保真度。；创新点：提出了一种模块化、低成本、可复现的高性能 SPCM 平台，通过对商用金相显微镜的少量改装即可实现亚微米分辨的二维光电器件表征，克服了商用系统昂贵、复杂且缺乏灵活性的问题，便于在大多数实验室推广。
papers.method_zh: 自制扫描光电流显微镜（SPCM）平台：对常规金相显微镜进行最小改装，耦合单模光纤耦合激光器和多模光纤耦合高功率 LED 作为光源，配备电动 XY 位移台、数码相机和电子读出模块；通过将光电流图与反射图、光学显微图和 AFM 形貌数据进行关联来验证成像质量。

papers.title: Metallic-Phase-Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ Enabled Interface Engineering for Self-Powered and High-Gain WS$_2$ Photodetectors
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides offer strong light-matter interaction but suffer from inefficient carrier separation and contact-related losses in photodetectors. Here, we demonstrate a high-gain WS$_2$/Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure photodetector, where metallic Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ serves as an active interfacial contact. The work-function mismatch, together with interfacial charge redistribution and asymmetric contact geometry, contributes to a built-in field that supports self-powered photodetection at zero bias. Under 450 nm illumination, the device delivers a zero-bias responsivity of 23.5 A/W and an apparent external quantum efficiency of 6.4 x 10$^3$%. At -1 V biasing, the heterostructure exhibits photoresponse at 450, 520 and 633 nm, achieving a responsivity of 9.7 x 10$^3$ A/W and a noise derived specific detectivity of 2.3 x 10$^13$ Jones at 100 Hz under 450 nm illumination. The high photoresponse is attributed to interfacial carrier separation, efficient extraction, and a likely contribution from trap-assisted photogating in multilayer WS$_2$. These results establish Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$-enabled interface engineering as an effective route for self-powered, highly sensitive 2D photodetectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：论文以器件制备与光电性能测量为主，摘要中出现“demonstrate”“device delivers”“responsivity”“detectivity”等典型实验表征词汇，未提及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：WS₂/Fe₃GaTe₂ 范德华异质结光电探测器，其中金属性 Fe₃GaTe₂ 作为活性界面接触，研究其界面工程对自供电、高增益光电探测性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金属性 Fe₃GaTe₂ 与 WS₂ 形成的异质结中，功函数失配、界面电荷重分布及非对称接触几何共同构建内建电场，使器件在零偏压下实现自供电光电探测；在 450 nm 光照下零偏压响应度为 23.5 A/W、表观外量子效率达 6.4×10³%，在 -1 V 偏压、450 nm 光照下响应度达 9.7×10³ A/W、比探测率达 2.3×10¹³ Jones（100 Hz）。高光响应归因于界面载流子分离、高效提取以及多层 WS₂ 中可能的陷阱辅助光栅效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金属性 Fe₃GaTe₂ 与 WS₂ 形成的异质结中，功函数失配、界面电荷重分布及非对称接触几何共同构建内建电场，使器件在零偏压下实现自供电光电探测；在 450 nm 光照下零偏压响应度为 23.5 A/W、表观外量子效率达 6.4×10³%，在 -1 V 偏压、450 nm 光照下响应度达 9.7×10³ A/W、比探测率达 2.3×10¹³ Jones（100 Hz）。高光响应归因于界面载流子分离、高效提取以及多层 WS₂ 中可能的陷阱辅助光栅效应。；创新点：将金属性 Fe₃GaTe₂ 作为活性界面接触引入 WS₂ 光电探测器，通过功函数失配、界面电荷重分布与非对称接触几何构建内建电场，实现零偏压自供电探测，并获得高响应度与高比探测率，提出 Fe₃GaTe₂ 界面工程作为实现自供电、高灵敏二维光电探测器的有效途径。
papers.method_zh: 制备 WS₂/Fe₃GaTe₂ 范德华异质结构光电探测器，进行光电性能测量：在 450 nm 光照下测零偏压响应度与外量子效率；在 -1 V 偏压下测 450、520、633 nm 的光响应、响应度及 100 Hz 下的噪声衍生比探测率。摘要未明确说明具体的材料生长/转移方法、器件制备工艺细节及表征手段（如 AFM、TEM、XPS 等）。

papers.title: Lindbladian Phase Geometry and Hall Transport in Open Bloch Systems
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry underlies a wide range of transport phenomena in Bloch systems. How quantum-geometric transport is modified when Bloch electrons are coupled to an environment, however, remains largely unexplored, even though the environment can alter both the electronic state and the physical current operator. Here we formulate dc linear response within a trace-preserving Lindblad kinetic theory by defining the physical velocity as the Liouvillian time derivative of the position operator. This construction reveals an environment-induced contribution to the current vertex whose momentum-space curl generates new Hall responses governed by the gauge-invariant phase geometry encoded by Lindblad jump amplitudes, which characterize electron-environment coupling. To leading order in the dissipative coupling, this geometry gives rise to interband shift-vector and diagonal-vorticity Hall responses arising from off-diagonal and diagonal jump amplitudes, respectively. Remarkably, both mechanisms can produce a finite Hall conductivity even when the conventional Berry-curvature anomalous Hall effect vanishes identically. Our work establishes Lindbladian phase geometry as an independent geometric origin of transverse transport in open quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“formulate dc linear response within a trace-preserving Lindblad kinetic theory”“defining the physical velocity as the Liouvillian time derivative”等理论构建表述，未涉及具体实验测量或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：开放 Bloch 系统中电子与环境耦合时的量子几何输运现象，具体为直流线性响应下的 Hall 输运（Hall transport），以及由 Lindblad 跳跃振幅编码的相位几何。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保迹 Lindblad 动力学框架下，环境耦合会通过电流顶点修正产生新的 Hall 响应；在耗散耦合领头阶，Lindblad 跳跃振幅的相位几何可产生带间 shift-vector Hall 响应和带内 diagonal-vorticity Hall 响应，且即使传统 Berry 曲率反常 Hall 效应严格为零，这两种机制仍可给出有限 Hall 电导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保迹 Lindblad 动力学框架下，环境耦合会通过电流顶点修正产生新的 Hall 响应；在耗散耦合领头阶，Lindblad 跳跃振幅的相位几何可产生带间 shift-vector Hall 响应和带内 diagonal-vorticity Hall 响应，且即使传统 Berry 曲率反常 Hall 效应严格为零，这两种机制仍可给出有限 Hall 电导。；创新点：首次将 Lindbladian 相位几何确立为开放量子物质中横向输运的独立几何来源；揭示了环境诱导的电流顶点修正可产生由 Lindblad 跳跃振幅编码的规范不变相位几何所主导的新 Hall 响应，包括带间 shift-vector 和带内 diagonal-vorticity 机制，并指出这些机制在传统 Berry 曲率反常 Hall 效应消失时仍可产生有限 Hall 电导。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为保迹 Lindblad 动力学理论（trace-preserving Lindblad kinetic theory）；通过将物理速度定义为位置算符的 Liouvillian 时间导数来构造直流线性响应，并分析电流顶点中环境诱导贡献的动量空间旋度。

papers.title: Finite-rank multiplicative perturbations of rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrices
papers.abstract: We study finite-rank multiplicative deformations of rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrices. More precisely, we consider models of the form $\mathbf{A}(\mathbf{I}+\mathbf{T})$, where $\mathbf{A}$ is a large rotationally invariant non-Hermitian random matrix, $\mathbf{T}$ is a finite-rank normal perturbation, and $\mathbf{I}$ denotes the identity matrix. We characterize the emergence of outlier eigenvalues, their fluctuations, and the associated eigenvector overlaps. Our results provide a multiplicative non-Hermitian counterpart to the classical Baik--Ben Arous--Péché framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：随机矩阵模型、有限秩扰动、特征值涨落与特征向量交叠的解析刻画，属于随机矩阵理论与数学物理的理论研究，摘要中未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：旋转不变的非厄米随机矩阵的有限秩乘性微扰，具体形式为 A(I+T)，其中 A 是大尺寸旋转不变非厄米随机矩阵，T 是有限秩正规扰动，I 为单位矩阵。研究现象为离群特征值的出现、其涨落以及相关的特征向量交叠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 刻画了该类乘性有限秩扰动下离群特征值的出现、涨落及特征向量交叠，给出了经典 Baik–Ben Arous–Péché 框架在乘性非厄米情形下的对应结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：刻画了该类乘性有限秩扰动下离群特征值的出现、涨落及特征向量交叠，给出了经典 Baik–Ben Arous–Péché 框架在乘性非厄米情形下的对应结果。；创新点：将经典的 Baik–Ben Arous–Péché（加性微扰）框架推广到乘性、非厄米的情形，即研究旋转不变非厄米随机矩阵的有限秩乘性扰动。摘要未进一步说明与既有文献的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 随机矩阵理论中的解析方法，研究形如 A(I+T) 的矩阵模型，分析离群特征值、涨落与特征向量交叠。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值模拟或其它技术工具。

papers.title: Atomistic origin and strain control of the finite-temperature dielectric response in BaTiO3
papers.abstract: The dielectric response of BaTiO3 (BTO) varies strongly with temperature, yet its local atomic origin remains unclear. Using electric-field-coupled molecular dynamics with a machine-learning force field, we show that the permittivity tracks the field-induced angular redistribution of local Ti-O off-centering rather than its magnitude or mean polar angle. Temperature and biaxial strain modify the local structure differently, but both responses follow a common relation with the same orientational descriptor, providing a real-space counterpart to soft-mode behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：electric-field-coupled molecular dynamics、machine-learning force field，属于计算/模拟方法，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：BaTiO3（BTO）的介电响应，具体研究其随温度变化的介电常数以及局域Ti-O偏心（off-centering）的原子尺度起源，并涉及双轴应变对局域结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 介电常数（permittivity）跟随的是电场诱导的局域Ti-O偏心的角度重分布（angular redistribution），而不是偏心的大小或平均极角；温度和双轴应变以不同方式改变局域结构，但两者的响应都遵循与同一个取向描述符（orientational descriptor）相关的共同关系，为软模行为提供了实空间对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：介电常数（permittivity）跟随的是电场诱导的局域Ti-O偏心的角度重分布（angular redistribution），而不是偏心的大小或平均极角；温度和双轴应变以不同方式改变局域结构，但两者的响应都遵循与同一个取向描述符（orientational descriptor）相关的共同关系，为软模行为提供了实空间对应。；创新点：揭示了BTO有限温度介电响应的原子尺度起源，指出介电常数由Ti-O偏心的角度重分布而非大小或平均极角决定，并发现温度与双轴应变虽改变局域结构的方式不同，却遵循同一取向描述符的普适关系，从而为软模行为提供了实空间对应。
papers.method_zh: 采用电场耦合的分子动力学（electric-field-coupled molecular dynamics），结合机器学习力场（machine-learning force field）。

papers.title: Groove-shaped defects in as-grown (001)-oriented $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ epilayers prepared by halide vapor phase epitaxy
papers.abstract: Groove-shaped defects (GSDs) degrade the surface flatness of as-grown (001)-oriented $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ epilayers and necessitate chemical mechanical polishing before device fabrication, increasing processing costs and the risk of damage. We investigated the morphology, subsurface structure, and formation mechanism of GSDs in a homoepitaxial layer grown by halide vapor phase epitaxy using synchrotron X-ray topography and electron microscopy. The GSDs extended several millimeters along [010] and consisted predominantly of (-102) basal facets bounded by steep (100) sidewalls. Their wafer-scale distribution showed a spatial correspondence with variations in wafer curvature, suggesting that local surface orientation influences GSD formation. Careful alignment of surface images with transmission X-ray topographs revealed no one-to-one correspondence between GSDs and substrate defects, providing no evidence that substrate dislocations serve as their nucleation sites. Instead, transmission electron microscopy revealed planar defects localized near the terminal boundaries where the faceted GSD sectors met the surrounding (001) growth region; no such defects were observed in specimens extracted from the middle of GSDs. These defects exhibited α-fringe contrast characteristic of inclined translational planar defects, with the dominant segments assigned to the (1-21) plane. The observations suggest that variations in local surface orientation and step supply may promote three-dimensional faceted growth, producing persistent (-102)/(100) sectors. The localized planar defects are therefore interpreted as consequences of growth-sector coalescence rather than the origins of GSD nucleation. These findings provide insight into the roles of wafer curvature and surface step supply in GSD formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：使用同步辐射X射线形貌术（synchrotron X-ray topography）和电子显微镜（electron microscopy）对HVPE生长的外延层进行表征，属于实验研究。；研究对象：卤化物气相外延（HVPE）生长的(001)取向β-Ga₂O₃同质外延层中的沟槽状缺陷（groove-shaped defects, GSDs），包括其形貌、亚表面结构及形成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GSDs沿[010]方向延伸数毫米，主要由(-102)基面小面和陡峭的(100)侧壁组成；其晶圆级分布与晶圆曲率变化存在空间对应关系，表明局部表面取向影响GSD形成。GSDs与衬底缺陷无一一对应关系，无证据表明衬底位错是其形核位点；GSD末端边界附近存在面缺陷（主要为(1-21)面），被解释为生长扇区合并的后果而非GSD形核的起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GSDs沿[010]方向延伸数毫米，主要由(-102)基面小面和陡峭的(100)侧壁组成；其晶圆级分布与晶圆曲率变化存在空间对应关系，表明局部表面取向影响GSD形成。GSDs与衬底缺陷无一一对应关系，无证据表明衬底位错是其形核位点；GSD末端边界附近存在面缺陷（主要为(1-21)面），被解释为生长扇区合并的后果而非GSD形核的起源。；创新点：首次系统揭示了HVPE生长(001)β-Ga₂O₃外延层中GSDs的形貌、亚表面缺陷结构及形成机制，明确了GSDs并非由衬底位错形核，而是与局部表面取向变化和台阶供给相关的三维小面生长有关，面缺陷是生长扇区合并的结果。摘要未明确说明该工作相对于已有文献的具体增量创新点。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射X射线形貌术（包括透射X射线形貌术）、电子显微镜（透射电子显微镜TEM用于观察面缺陷及α-fringe衬度分析）、表面形貌成像，并结合晶圆曲率分布分析。

papers.title: Precision tests of nonlinear and stochastic modifications of quantum mechanics with a 1D quantum gas
papers.abstract: We propose a cold-atom platform for precision tests of nonlinear and stochastic modifications to the Schrödinger equation, utilizing strongly correlated ultracold $^{133}$Cs in a uniform array of one-dimensional tubes formed by a two-dimensional optical lattice. Objective collapse models can be tested using the metastable super-Tonks-Girardeau gas. Based on a calibration test performed on our existing experimental setup, we project a sensitivity to the Continuous Spontaneous Localization collapse rate of $λ_c \simeq 1.8\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$ at a correlation length of $r_c = 10^{-7}\,$m. This would establish a new bound an order of magnitude below the strongest existing constraint that remains robust against a cutoff in the collapse noise spectrum. Additionally, we can test deterministic nonlinear modifications by probing the symmetry-protected breathing mode frequency of the Tonks-Girardeau gas in harmonic traps. Crucial to both measurement schemes is the capability to independently tune the atom number and the linear density. By exploiting the different scaling laws associated with these parameters, we can cleanly distinguish genuine new physics signals from technical systematics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论提案 + 基于已有实验装置的标定）。判断依据关键词：propose a cold-atom platform（提出平台）、calibration test performed on our existing experimental setup（在已有装置上完成标定）、project a sensitivity（预测灵敏度）。；研究对象：强关联超冷 \(^{133}\)Cs 原子气体，装载于由二维光学晶格形成的一维管状均匀阵列中；具体涉及超 Tonks-Girardeau 气体（亚稳态）和 Tonks-Girardeau 气体在谐振阱中的呼吸模式。物理现象为量子力学非线性与随机修正（客观坍缩模型、确定性非线性修正）的精密检验。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该冷原子平台可对连续自发定域（CSL）坍缩模型给出灵敏度约 \(\lambda_c \simeq 1.8\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}\)（关联长度 \(r_c = 10^{-7}\,\)m），比现有最强约束低一个数量级，且该约束在坍缩噪声谱存在截断时仍然稳健；同时可通过探测 Tonks-Girardeau 气体对称性保护的呼吸模式频率来检验确定性非线性修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该冷原子平台可对连续自发定域（CSL）坍缩模型给出灵敏度约 \(\lambda_c \simeq 1.8\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}\)（关联长度 \(r_c = 10^{-7}\,\)m），比现有最强约束低一个数量级，且该约束在坍缩噪声谱存在截断时仍然稳健；同时可通过探测 Tonks-Girardeau 气体对称性保护的呼吸模式频率来检验确定性非线性修正。；创新点：提出了一种可同时检验非线性与随机量子力学修正的冷原子平台；通过独立调控原子数与线密度并利用不同标度律，能干净地区分真实新物理信号与技术系统误差；所预测的 CSL 坍缩率灵敏度比现有最强约束低一个数量级，且在坍缩噪声谱截断下仍保持稳健。
papers.method_zh: 冷原子实验方案：利用二维光学晶格形成一维管状均匀阵列中的强关联超冷 \(^{133}\)Cs；用亚稳态超 Tonks-Girardeau 气体检验客观坍缩模型；用谐振阱中 Tonks-Girardeau 气体的对称性保护呼吸模式频率检验确定性非线性修正；关键能力是独立调节原子数和线密度，并利用二者不同的标度律区分新物理信号与技术系统误差。摘要未明确说明具体的探测或读出手段。

papers.title: Reverse engineering of mechano-kinetic parameters from stochastic force profiles in heterogeneous ensembles of molecular motors and tracks
papers.abstract: Heterogeneity in contractile systems of molecular motors interacting with their tracks plays a key role in numerous cellular physiological and pathological processes. However, its effects cannot be captured by theoretical models assuming identical mechano-kinetic properties for all motors. We developed a stochastic framework to describe heterogeneous ensembles of myosin motors comprising two populations with distinct mechano-kinetic properties. Assuming that motors interact with the actin filament (their track) as independent force generators, we derived the probability distribution of the isometric force and characterised the statistics of finite-size force fluctuations. The proposed framework includes an estimation procedure that simultaneously infers the mechano-kinetic parameters and the size of the motor ensemble, eliminating the need to prescribe it a priori. Validation against synthetic and experimental data shows the model accurately captures force fluctuations and provides realistic estimates of the ensemble size. Furthermore, the framework enables a quantitative assessment of ensemble heterogeneity and the inference of an unknown motor species properties. This approach provides a quantitative tool for characterising heterogeneous actin-myosin systems, such as those arising from the co-presence of different protein isoforms in cardiac and skeletal muscle, or from the partial replacement of native proteins with mutation-derived or engineered variants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（混合类型，含实验数据验证）。判断依据关键词：developed a stochastic framework、derived the probability distribution、estimation procedure、validation against synthetic and experimental data。属于以理论建模为主、并用合成与实验数据验证的工作。；研究对象：与肌动蛋白丝（actin filament）相互作用的肌球蛋白（myosin）马达异质集合体，即由两种具有不同力学-动力学（mechano-kinetic）性质的马达群体组成的异质系统，关注其等长力（isometric force）的概率分布与有限尺寸力涨落统计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在假设马达作为独立力发生器与肌动蛋白丝相互作用的条件下，该随机框架能够推导出等长力的概率分布并刻画有限尺寸力涨落统计；模型能准确捕捉力涨落，并给出合理的集合体尺寸估计，同时可定量评估集合体异质性并推断未知马达种类的性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在假设马达作为独立力发生器与肌动蛋白丝相互作用的条件下，该随机框架能够推导出等长力的概率分布并刻画有限尺寸力涨落统计；模型能准确捕捉力涨落，并给出合理的集合体尺寸估计，同时可定量评估集合体异质性并推断未知马达种类的性质。；创新点：针对以往假设所有马达具有相同力学-动力学性质、无法捕捉异质性效应的模型局限，提出了描述含两种不同性质马达群体的异质集合体的随机框架；其估计程序可同时推断力学-动力学参数与集合体尺寸，无需先验指定尺寸；并能定量评估集合体异质性及推断未知马达种类的性质。
papers.method_zh: 随机理论框架（stochastic framework）：假设马达为独立力发生器，推导等长力的概率分布，刻画有限尺寸力涨落统计；并包含一个估计程序，可同时推断力学-动力学参数与马达集合体尺寸（无需预先给定尺寸）；用合成数据和实验数据进行验证。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium full counting statistics of multicomponent strongly-interacting quantum gases with defects
papers.abstract: We investigate the full counting statistics of a one-dimensional multicomponent impenetrable gas released from a bipartite state in the presence of a local defect. Spin--charge separation reduces the multivariate generating function to an exact Fredholm determinant whose kernel is built from time-evolved single-particle orbitals. Expressing these orbitals in terms of scattering data gives access to both transient dynamics and the nonequilibrium steady state. We derive the leading long-time asymptotics and identify persistent oscillations in densities and currents caused by multiple bound states at the junction. We argue that interactions between components lead to a linear low-temperature correction to the current, in contrast to the quadratic correction in the single-component case. At equilibrium, we obtain the M-Wright distribution of spin transfer with $t^{1/4}$ scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：exact Fredholm determinant、scattering data、derive the leading long-time asymptotics、argue that…——全文为解析推导与理论论证，无实验或数值模拟平台描述。；研究对象：一维多组分不可穿透量子气体（multicomponent impenetrable gas），从二分态（bipartite state）释放后在存在局域缺陷（local defect）情形下的非平衡全计数统计（full counting statistics），涉及自旋-电荷分离、瞬态动力学、非平衡稳态、密度与电流振荡、自旋转移分布等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-电荷分离将多变量生成函数化为精确的 Fredholm 行列式；长时渐近行为中，结处的多个束缚态导致密度和电流出现持续振荡；组分间相互作用使电流的低温修正为线性（单组分情形为二次）；平衡态下自旋转移服从 M-Wright 分布，具有 t^{1/4} 标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-电荷分离将多变量生成函数化为精确的 Fredholm 行列式；长时渐近行为中，结处的多个束缚态导致密度和电流出现持续振荡；组分间相互作用使电流的低温修正为线性（单组分情形为二次）；平衡态下自旋转移服从 M-Wright 分布，具有 t^{1/4} 标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的直接对比，但可归纳的新意为：将多组分不可穿透气体在局域缺陷下的非平衡全计数统计约化为精确 Fredholm 行列式并借助散射数据求解；揭示多束缚态导致的持续振荡；指出多组分相互作用使电流低温修正由单组分的二次变为线性；给出平衡态自旋转移的 M-Wright 分布与 t^{1/4} 标度。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用自旋-电荷分离将多变量生成函数表示为精确的 Fredholm 行列式，其核由时间演化的单粒子轨道构建；将轨道用散射数据（scattering data）表达，从而获得瞬态动力学与非平衡稳态；推导长时渐近展开；分析结处束缚态对振荡的贡献；讨论低温下电流修正；在平衡态导出自旋转移的 M-Wright 分布及 t^{1/4} 标度。

papers.title: Probing magnetic correlations in space and time within predefined topological sectors of a macroscopic spin liquid
papers.abstract: The triangular Ising antiferromagnet, with its residual entropy density and critical correlations at absolute zero, is the archetype of a two-dimensional spin liquid. Its ground state is partitioned into topological sectors connected by global spin flip events that wrap the lattice boundaries, and become statistically irrelevant in the thermodynamic limit where magnetic fluctuations are restricted to the dominant sector. Thus far, these properties have been mainly investigated from a theoretical perspective, and one might wonder to what extent they can be transposed to real materials.
