Finally, we provide a scalable high-performance-computing workflow that enables systematic expansion of many-body benchmark datasets across emerging families of layered quantum materials by the scientific community.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC)、benchmark、density functionals、high-performance-computing workflow，全文围绕第一性原理计算基准展开，摘要未提及任何实验测量手段。；研究对象：多种化学组成不同的二维范德华双层体系，包括单层材料（single-sheet materials）、过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDs）以及磁性过渡金属卤化物（magnetic transition-metal halides）。研究的物理现象为层间相互作用，具体包括层间结合能、平衡层间距、层间振动模式和层间电荷重分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DMC 给出的平衡间距、结合能、层间振动模式和电荷重分布与现有实验吻合良好，同时揭示了广泛使用的半局域、meta-GGA 和色散校正密度泛函存在系统性的、依赖于具体物理量的失效。此外，DMC 分辨出微妙的层间电荷重排，在磁性 Cr 三卤化物中产生长程偶极尾，其空间延展远超半局域 DFT 预测有明显层间极化的范围，为理解层间耦合的铁性和磁性现象提供了多体基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DMC 给出的平衡间距、结合能、层间振动模式和电荷重分布与现有实验吻合良好，同时揭示了广泛使用的半局域、meta-GGA 和色散校正密度泛函存在系统性的、依赖于具体物理量的失效。此外，DMC 分辨出微妙的层间电荷重排，在磁性 Cr 三卤化物中产生长程偶极尾，其空间延展远超半局域 DFT 预测有明显层间极化的范围，为理解层间耦合的铁性和磁性现象提供了多体基础。；创新点：建立了针对多种化学组成不同的二维范德华双层体系的系统可控多体基准，同时涵盖能量学、响应性质和高质量电子密度，可作为可迁移基准用于发展下一代密度泛函；揭示了半局域 DFT 在层间极化描述上的系统性失效，特别是磁性 Cr 三卤化物中长程偶极尾被 DMC 捕捉而半局域 DFT 无法描述；并提供了可扩展的 HPC 工作流以便科学界系统扩展此类多体基准数据集。
papers.method_zh: 扩散量子蒙特卡洛（DMC）多体基准计算，覆盖单层材料、TMD 和磁性过渡金属卤化物等多类双层体系；将 DMC 结果与半局域、meta-GGA 及色散校正密度泛函的结果进行系统对比；并提供了可扩展的高性能计算工作流以支持多体基准数据集的扩展。

papers.title: Ultrafast electron crystallography reveals the atomic pathway of a light-driven correlated insulator-to-metal transition
papers.abstract: Ultrafast phase transitions in correlated materials are often inferred from selected diffraction peak intensities or diffraction peak displacements, leaving the underlying three-dimensional atomic trajectories elusive. Resolving these trajectories is essential for identifying which atomic motions drive changes in electronic properties and how they couple to electronic degrees of freedom. We address this challenge in vanadium dioxide (VO2), a correlated oxide with a near-room-temperature transition between the insulating monoclinic (M1) phase and metallic rutile (R) phase. For this purpose, we introduce ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction, which enables refinement of the transient unit cell and internal V and O coordinates, revealing the V-V dimerization and zigzag motion during the phase transition. The refined atomic coordinates follow a linear trajectory in real space during the transition, in contrast to nonlinear or sequential transformation pathways inferred from more indirect observables in earlier work. Quantum many-body calculations treating each V-V pair as a correlated unit show that dimerization creates the level splitting responsible for the electronic gap, which is further enhanced by nonlocal electronic interactions between the paired V atoms. The gap collapses when dimerization is lost. This work turns time-resolved diffraction from order-parameter tracking into transient crystallography, directly connecting atomic trajectories to electronic mechanisms in correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论计算混合型。判断依据关键词：实验方面有“ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction”“refinement of the transient unit cell”；理论方面有“Quantum many-body calculations treating each V-V pair as a correlated unit”。；研究对象：二氧化钒（VO₂）中由光驱动的关联绝缘体-金属相变，具体是绝缘单斜相（M1）与金属金红石相（R）之间的转变，以及其中V-V二聚化和zigzag运动等原子运动路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超快三维电子衍射精修得到瞬态晶胞及V、O内坐标，发现相变过程中V-V二聚化和zigzag运动对应的原子坐标在实空间中沿线性轨迹演化，而非此前间接观测所推断的非线性或序贯路径；量子多体计算表明V-V二聚化产生能级劈裂并打开电子能隙，配对V原子间的非局域电子相互作用进一步增强该能隙，二聚化消失时能隙坍缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超快三维电子衍射精修得到瞬态晶胞及V、O内坐标，发现相变过程中V-V二聚化和zigzag运动对应的原子坐标在实空间中沿线性轨迹演化，而非此前间接观测所推断的非线性或序贯路径；量子多体计算表明V-V二聚化产生能级劈裂并打开电子能隙，配对V原子间的非局域电子相互作用进一步增强该能隙，二聚化消失时能隙坍缩。；创新点：将时间分辨衍射从“序参量追踪”推进为“瞬态晶体学”，直接精修出相变过程中的三维原子轨迹，并直接将其与电子能隙机制关联起来；纠正了此前基于间接观测量推断的非线性或序贯转变路径图像。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快三维电子衍射（ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction），可精修瞬态晶胞和V、O内部坐标；理论上采用量子多体计算，将每个V-V对作为关联单元处理。

papers.title: Deviation from Fermi-liquid $T^2$ resistivity caused by collective transport
papers.abstract: `Fermi-liquid behavior' is nowadays used as a shorthand for quadratic temperature dependence of the electrical resistivity. In a metal, for this to occur, electrons must be cooled well below the Fermi degeneracy temperature, $T_{\mathrm{F}}$. A departure from this behavior is observed at finite temperature. Here, we note that this departure has opposite signs in two distinct types of Fermi liquids. In weakly correlated ones, the upward departure implies a higher exponent of the inelastic resistivity, attributable to \textit{additional scattering} by phonons. In contrast, there is a downward deviation in strongly correlated metals, which implies either \textit{reduced scattering} or \textit{additional conduction}, as in the case of normal liquid $^3$He, in which a distinct contribution to heat transport by a sound mode has been recently identified. Such a channel of conduction smoothly transforms across $T_{\mathrm{F}}$ to the one captured by the Bridgman formula for thermal conductivity of classical liquids. In three metals (UPt$_3$, Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, and heavily overdoped LSCO), according to the available experimental data, the normalized amplitude of excess conductivity at $T/T_{\mathrm{F}}\simeq0.02$ is comparable to what has been seen in $^3$He, suggesting, without establishing, a common origin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/分析型文章（可能结合已有实验数据的对比分析）。判断依据的关键词：摘要以概念性论述和跨体系比较为主（"we note that…"、"suggesting, without establishing, a common origin"），未提及自身开展的新实验或新计算，而是引用已有实验数据（UPt₃、Sr₂RuO₄、LSCO）和已有结果（³He 中声模热输运）进行归纳。；研究对象：金属中偏离费米液体 T² 电阻率行为的现象，具体涉及弱关联费米液体与强关联费米液体两类体系，以及正常液态 ³He 作类比；涉及的具体材料为 UPt₃、Sr₂RuO₄ 和重过掺杂 LSCO。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偏离 T² 电阻率的行为在两类费米液体中符号相反：弱关联金属中表现为向上偏离（非弹性电阻率指数更高，归因于声子附加散射），强关联金属中表现为向下偏离（意味着散射减弱或附加导电通道）；后者可能与 ³He 中声模贡献的额外热输运类似，并在跨越 T_F 时平滑过渡到经典液体 Bridgman 热导公式所描述的行为。三种金属在 T/T_F≃0.02 处的归一化超额电导幅度与 ³He 中观测值相当，提示（但未确立）共同起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偏离 T² 电阻率的行为在两类费米液体中符号相反：弱关联金属中表现为向上偏离（非弹性电阻率指数更高，归因于声子附加散射），强关联金属中表现为向下偏离（意味着散射减弱或附加导电通道）；后者可能与 ³He 中声模贡献的额外热输运类似，并在跨越 T_F 时平滑过渡到经典液体 Bridgman 热导公式所描述的行为。三种金属在 T/T_F≃0.02 处的归一化超额电导幅度与 ³He 中观测值相当，提示（但未确立）共同起源。；创新点：指出费米液体中偏离 T² 电阻率的行为在弱关联与强关联体系中具有相反符号，并将强关联金属的向下偏离与 ³He 中声模附加导电（及经典液体 Bridgman 行为）联系起来，提出可能存在共同起源。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明本文自身采用的具体实验手段、计算方法或理论框架；文中依据的是已有实验数据（UPt₃、Sr₂RuO₄、重过掺杂 LSCO 的输运数据）与已有理论结果（Bridgman 公式、³He 中声模热输运的近期识别）进行对比与概念分析。

papers.title: Plasmon drag and photoinduced magnetic effects in plasmonic and magnetic metals
papers.abstract: Photoinduced electric effects in plasmonic and magnetic materials under pulsed laser illumination exceed the prediction of the electromagnetic momentum-transfer mechanism by orders of magnitude. In order to get more information on the nature of the effect we study the kinetics of photovoltages in permalloy thin films at different photoexcitation configurations. The photoinduced electric signals consist of magnetically dependent and magnetically independent components which are of significant magnitude and mainly follow the temporal profile of the laser pulse. In contrast, the predicted contribution from the Anomalous Nernst Effect is much weaker and exhibits substantially slower kinetics. These observations suggest that ultrafast photoexcited hot electrons, rather than thermal mechanisms, play the dominant role in generating the observed photovoltage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中明确提到"study the kinetics of photovoltages in permalloy thin films at different photoexcitation configurations"，属于对具体材料体系进行不同实验配置下的测量研究。；研究对象：坡莫合金（permalloy）薄膜中的光致电压动力学，以及等离激元和磁性金属中的光致电效应与光诱导磁效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光致电信号包含磁相关和磁无关两种分量，其幅度显著且主要跟随激光脉冲的时间轮廓；反常能斯特效应的预测贡献远弱于观测值且动力学更慢。这表明超快光激发热电子（而非热机制）在产生观测到的光电压中起主导作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光致电信号包含磁相关和磁无关两种分量，其幅度显著且主要跟随激光脉冲的时间轮廓；反常能斯特效应的预测贡献远弱于观测值且动力学更慢。这表明超快光激发热电子（而非热机制）在产生观测到的光电压中起主导作用。；创新点：通过对比光电压动力学与反常能斯特效应的预测，实验上区分了超快热电子机制与热机制对光致电效应的贡献，指出热电子效应主导而非热效应。摘要未明确说明相对于已有研究的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 在不同光激发配置下，对坡莫合金薄膜进行脉冲激光照射，测量光电压的时间动力学（kinetics of photovoltages）。摘要未明确说明具体的泵浦-探测技术细节或具体激光参数。

papers.title: FPBench: Application-Oriented Error Decomposition for Foundation Potentials
papers.abstract: Foundation potentials (FPs) have emerged as a new basis for atomistic modeling. While their evaluation using average energy and force errors often indicates near-DFT accuracy, their performance in practical computational studies remains inconsistent. Here, we present FPBench, an application-oriented benchmark that evaluates FPs on representative computational tasks. Multiple state-of-the-art FPs are assessed on three fundamental tasks: force prediction for atomistic simulations, energy ranking for substitutional and vacancy orderings, and ion/vacancy migration. Benchmarking these FPs shows that average force and energy errors often fail to predict task performance, revealing substantial differences in practical reliability. FPBench introduces application-oriented error decomposition through metrics that resolve performance according to the physically consequential quantities and configurations governing computational tasks, including the fractions of highly accurate and large-force-error atoms, far-from-equilibrium atoms, relative phase-stability and convex-hull agreement, and along-path errors in ion migration. These error-decomposition metrics identify where FP errors arise within specific computational tasks, providing targeted guidance for model development. FPBench provides an open benchmark, evaluation code, and a public leaderboard for rigorous FP assessment and development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：benchmark、evaluation code、error decomposition metrics、foundation potentials 的评估，属于对机器学习势函数模型的计算基准测试研究，不涉及实验或新理论框架的提出。；研究对象：基础势函数（Foundation Potentials, FPs）在代表性计算任务中的表现，具体包括三类任务：原子模拟中的力预测、替代式和空位有序化的能量排序、离子/空位迁移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均力和能量误差往往无法预测 FP 在实际任务中的表现，不同 FP 在实际可靠性上存在显著差异；通过面向应用的误差分解指标可以定位 FP 误差在具体计算任务中的来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均力和能量误差往往无法预测 FP 在实际任务中的表现，不同 FP 在实际可靠性上存在显著差异；通过面向应用的误差分解指标可以定位 FP 误差在具体计算任务中的来源。；创新点：提出了面向应用的误差分解方法，而非仅依赖平均力和能量误差来评估 FP；通过按物理关键量和构型分解性能指标，识别 FP 误差在特定计算任务中的来源，为模型开发提供针对性指导；并提供开放基准、评估代码和公开排行榜。
papers.method_zh: 提出 FPBench 基准测试框架，对多个当前最先进的 FP 在三种基本任务上进行评估，引入面向应用的误差分解指标，包括：高精度原子和大力度误差原子的比例、远离平衡态的原子、相对相稳定性和凸包一致性、离子迁移路径上的误差。摘要未明确说明具体的底层计算方法（如 DFT 具体泛函等）。

papers.title: Generating quantum error correcting codes from topological pre-thermal scars
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body scars are rare nonthermal states embedded within otherwise thermalizing spectra, making them promising candidates for storing and manipulating quantum information. However, a general framework that can both identify such states without prior knowledge of their microscopic scarring mechanism and determine when they enable a quantum error correcting code has remained elusive. Here, we develop an end-to-end framework connecting nonthermal-state discovery to certifiable quantum error correction using a many-body spectral localizer. By searching for states jointly localized in energy and a diagnostic observable in systems with a many-body grading symmetry, the spectral localizer identifies candidate scars within dense many-body spectra in tandem with a topological index whose shifts determine their graded subspace. For suitable pairs of same-graded scars, the grading renders grading-odd errors exactly detectable, while their localization can suppress the logical action of sufficiently local grading-even error products, yielding an approximate Knill--Laflamme condition and an operator-algebra quantum error-correction structure. We demonstrate the scar-identification framework in one- and two-dimensional density-difference-dependent bosonic models and in the PXP model, and explicitly construct the resulting approximate quantum code in the one-dimensional bosonic system. Our results establish a systematic route from identifying nonthermal many-body states to exploiting them for protecting quantum information, and position pseudospectral methods as a broadly applicable tool for discovering useful behaviors in interacting quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提出的是理论框架（many-body spectral localizer、拓扑指标、Knill–Laflamme 条件、operator-algebra quantum error-correction structure），并在具体模型上进行演示，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的量子多体疤痕（quantum many-body scars）这一非热化本征态，以及由其构造的量子纠错码。具体演示体系包括一维和二维的 density-difference-dependent 玻色子模型以及 PXP 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多体谱局域化方法（many-body spectral localizer），可以在不具备微观疤痕机制先验知识的情况下，于稠密多体谱中同时识别能量局域和诊断可观测量局域的候选疤痕态，并借助多体分级对称性给出的拓扑指标确定其分级子空间；对于合适的同分级疤痕对，分级使分级奇（grading-odd）错误可被精确探测，而局域化可抑制足够局域的 grading-even 错误乘积的逻辑作用，从而满足近似 Knill–Laflamme 条件并形成算子代数量子纠错结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多体谱局域化方法（many-body spectral localizer），可以在不具备微观疤痕机制先验知识的情况下，于稠密多体谱中同时识别能量局域和诊断可观测量局域的候选疤痕态，并借助多体分级对称性给出的拓扑指标确定其分级子空间；对于合适的同分级疤痕对，分级使分级奇（grading-odd）错误可被精确探测，而局域化可抑制足够局域的 grading-even 错误乘积的逻辑作用，从而满足近似 Knill–Laflamme 条件并形成算子代数量子纠错结构。；创新点：提出了一个端到端框架，将非热化多体态的发现与可认证的量子纠错联系起来：无需预先知道疤痕的微观机制即可识别疤痕态，并给出其何时能构成量子纠错码的判据；同时将赝谱方法（pseudospectral methods）定位为发现相互作用量子系统中有用行为的通用工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为多体谱局域化方法（many-body spectral localizer），结合多体分级对称性（many-body grading symmetry）与拓扑指标分析；通过在一维、二维 density-difference-dependent 玻色子模型和 PXP 模型中搜索能量与诊断可观测量联合局域的本征态来识别疤痕，并在一维玻色子系统中显式构造相应的近似量子码。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值方法（如 DMRG、精确对角化等）的具体细节。

papers.title: Bridging simulation length scales with cellular automata
papers.abstract: Multiscale simulation requires coupling physics models that operate at different characteristic length and time scales, because no single method spans the range needed for most problems of interest. Moving to a coarser-grained representation unlocks longer length and time scales, but it discards the microscopic interactions that build morphology. A fine-grained model can be initialized from an arbitrary packing and left to self-assemble into a physically meaningful structure; a lower-resolution model cannot, and must inherit its starting configuration from a higher-fidelity simulation. The length scales accessible to the coarse-grained model are therefore set not by the coarse-grained method itself, but by the largest fine-grained configuration that can be affordably equilibrated. A representative example is the scale-up from particle-based molecular dynamics (MD) to a lattice-based representation such as kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC). In this work, we present a cellular automata (CA) approach for generating arbitrarily large lattice starting configurations. CA is a natural fit for this task: short-ranged local rules drive the evolution of a lattice, and their repeated application gives rise to emergent long-range order, thematically mirroring how short-ranged interactions in MD produce self-assembled morphology. We use a configuration from a higher-fidelity simulation as a training set and learn the CA rules from it via logistic regression. As a proof of principle, we develop these rules for a hydrated anion exchange membrane (AEM), generate new starting configurations, and benchmark their performance in mesoscale kMC simulations against an MD-derived "ground truth." We then demonstrate the ability to generate substantially larger lattices and show that their behavior in kMC is consistent with that of the smaller CA benchmark configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：multiscale simulation、cellular automata、logistic regression、molecular dynamics、kinetic Monte Carlo、benchmark、proof of principle。摘要中未涉及实验手段，属于方法开发与数值验证类工作。；研究对象：多尺度模拟中的尺度桥接问题，具体应用体系为水合阴离子交换膜（hydrated anion exchange membrane, AEM）。涉及从粒子基分子动力学（MD）到格点基动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）的尺度放大过程，以及用于生成大尺度格点初始构型的元胞自动机（CA）方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者提出了一种基于元胞自动机（CA）的方法，能够生成任意大的格点初始构型，用于粗粒化模拟。以水合阴离子交换膜为概念验证，从高精度模拟构型中通过逻辑回归学习CA规则，生成的构型在介观kMC模拟中的表现与MD导出的“基准真值”相当；且能生成远大于训练规模的格点，其kMC行为与较小基准构型一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者提出了一种基于元胞自动机（CA）的方法，能够生成任意大的格点初始构型，用于粗粒化模拟。以水合阴离子交换膜为概念验证，从高精度模拟构型中通过逻辑回归学习CA规则，生成的构型在介观kMC模拟中的表现与MD导出的“基准真值”相当；且能生成远大于训练规模的格点，其kMC行为与较小基准构型一致。；创新点：提出用元胞自动机生成任意大格点初始构型，以突破粗粒化模型可访问尺度受限于最大可负担平衡的精细模拟构型这一瓶颈。CA的短程局部规则反复应用产生涌现长程有序，与MD中短程相互作用产生自组装形貌在思路上形成类比。通过从高精度模拟中学习CA规则（逻辑回归），实现了跨尺度初始构型的可扩展生成，并在水合阴离子交换膜体系中做了概念验证。
papers.method_zh: 使用元胞自动机（CA）方法，以短程局部规则驱动格点演化；从高精度模拟（MD）的构型作为训练集，通过逻辑回归学习CA规则；将生成的格点构型用于介观动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟，并与MD导出的“ground truth”进行基准对比。具体MD和kMC的参数设置摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Hidden amplitude and dynamical information in phase-separation spectra
papers.abstract: Framewise variance normalization removes fluctuation amplitude from an observation, but not from the dynamics that generate later patterns. The current normalized spectrum therefore need not determine its own future. We study this effect in three two-dimensional phase-separation models that change transport, add active driving, or suppress large-scale separation. For paired initial fields, their normalized spectra evolve identically in the linear regime. The restoring model provides an exact example: damping does not directly change how the normalized spectrum evolves when both equations are applied to the same field. It nevertheless changes the hidden amplitude, which alters the later nonlinear shape. An exact comparison separates the immediate effect of changing the equation from the effect of reaching a different state through earlier evolution. It also reveals strong cancellation between these effects in the mobility and active models. As a practical test, spectral histories improve classification by about 4-6 percentage points at several later observation windows, although the gain depends on quench depth and spectral construction. Temporal spectra can therefore reveal dynamical consequences of information absent from every individual normalized frame.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：three two-dimensional phase-separation models、paired initial fields、exact comparison、spectral histories improve classification——以模型分析和数值计算为主，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：二维相分离（phase-separation）模型中的归一化谱（normalized spectrum）演化，具体涉及三种变体：改变输运（mobility）、加入主动驱动（active driving）、抑制大尺度分离（suppress large-scale separation）。物理现象是逐帧方差归一化后谱的动力学与隐藏振幅信息。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 逐帧方差归一化会从观测中移除涨落振幅，但不会从生成后续图案的动力学中移除；因此当前归一化谱不必决定其自身未来。隐藏振幅虽不直接改变归一化谱的线性演化，却会通过改变后续非线性形状产生影响，且这种效应在 mobility 和 active 模型中存在强抵消。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：逐帧方差归一化会从观测中移除涨落振幅，但不会从生成后续图案的动力学中移除；因此当前归一化谱不必决定其自身未来。隐藏振幅虽不直接改变归一化谱的线性演化，却会通过改变后续非线性形状产生影响，且这种效应在 mobility 和 active 模型中存在强抵消。；创新点：揭示了归一化谱中隐藏的振幅与动力学信息：即使归一化谱在线性区演化相同，隐藏振幅仍会影响后期非线性形态；并提出用时间谱历史提升分类性能（约 4–6 个百分点），说明时间谱可揭示每个单独归一化帧中缺失的信息。
papers.method_zh: 研究三个二维相分离模型，对成对初始场比较其归一化谱演化；用 restoring model 给出精确解析例子，区分“改变方程的即时效应”与“通过早期演化到达不同状态的效应”；并以谱历史（spectral histories）做分类测试，观察多个后期观测窗口的分类增益。

papers.title: Spectroscopy With Intelligent Feature Tracking for automated characterization of excited-state structure in semiconductor quantum dot devices
papers.abstract: The characterization of excited-state structure in semiconductor quantum dot (QD) devices is an important component of tuning them for spin-qubit operation. We present Spectroscopy With Intelligent Feature Tracking (SWIFT), a framework that combines machine-learning (ML)-assisted feature identification with physics-informed geometric processing to extract energy-level splittings from pulsed-gate spectroscopy data. SWIFT isolates the relevant spectral features and exploits their characteristic geometry to reduce the two-dimensional spectroscopy analysis to a one-dimensional peak-detection problem. It further combines an ensemble-based confidence metric with sequential accumulation of rapid, low-SNR scans, allowing the inferred spectrum to be reevaluated as experimental evidence accumulates. Using Si/SiGe QD devices, we demonstrate SWIFT both offline and in real time, including automated tracking of QD excited states and lead resonances. Benchmarking on 255 manually labeled scans shows that SWIFT reduces the median splitting error to 0.05 mV from 0.11 mV for a classical baseline, with the largest improvement on lower-quality measurements. These results provide a path toward incorporating excited-state spectroscopy into autonomous QD characterization, tuning, and optimization, which will be essential in large-scale quantum dot devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含机器学习方法开发）。判断依据的关键词：pulsed-gate spectroscopy data、Si/SiGe QD devices、demonstrate SWIFT both offline and in real time、255 manually labeled scans、benchmarking。摘要中明确描述了在真实器件上采集光谱数据并进行验证，属于实验工作，同时包含方法/框架开发。；研究对象：半导体量子点（QD）器件中的激发态结构，具体为 Si/SiGe 量子点器件。物理现象为脉冲栅极光谱（pulsed-gate spectroscopy）数据中的能级劈裂（energy-level splittings），以及量子点激发态和引线共振（lead resonances）的自动追踪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SWIFT 框架能够从脉冲栅极光谱数据中自动提取能级劈裂，将二维光谱分析简化为基于特征几何的一维峰检测问题；在 255 个手动标注扫描的基准测试中，SWIFT 将能级劈裂误差中位数从经典基线的 0.11 mV 降低到 0.05 mV，且在质量较低的测量数据上改进最大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SWIFT 框架能够从脉冲栅极光谱数据中自动提取能级劈裂，将二维光谱分析简化为基于特征几何的一维峰检测问题；在 255 个手动标注扫描的基准测试中，SWIFT 将能级劈裂误差中位数从经典基线的 0.11 mV 降低到 0.05 mV，且在质量较低的测量数据上改进最大。；创新点：提出了 SWIFT 框架，将机器学习特征识别与物理信息几何处理相结合，把二维光谱分析转化为一维峰检测问题；引入集成置信度度量与低信噪比扫描的序贯累积策略，使光谱推断可随证据积累动态更新；在 Si/SiGe 量子点器件上实现了离线与实时的激发态及引线共振自动追踪，并在基准测试中显著降低了能级劈裂误差（尤其对低质量测量改进最大），为将激发态光谱纳入自主量子点表征、调谐与优化提供了路径。
papers.method_zh: 结合机器学习辅助的特征识别与物理信息引导的几何处理（physics-informed geometric processing）；利用光谱特征的特征几何将二维光谱分析降维为一维峰检测问题；采用基于集成（ensemble）的置信度度量，并结合快速低信噪比（low-SNR）扫描的序贯累积，使推断的光谱可随实验证据积累而重新评估。在 Si/SiGe 量子点器件上进行了离线与实时演示，包括量子点激发态和引线共振的自动追踪。

papers.title: A magneto-mechanical gyroscope with spintronic readout
papers.abstract: Gyroscopes are essential elements in navigation, consumer electronics, robotics, and aerospace applications. Most micro electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) implementations rely on capacitive sensing mechanisms, which limit the dimensional scaling to the micrometer scale. In this work, we introduce a MEMS-like two-degree-of-freedom (2-DOF) gyroscope that exploits the rectification functionality of magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) as its readout mechanism and as the transducer of the mechanical dynamics. Experimentally characterized MTJs have been used to calibrate and perform an experiment-informed design of the magneto-mechanical model combining micromagnetic theory with 2-DOF mechanical equations. We demonstrated that the output is linear with angular rate, and that the proposed device is able to extract the angular rate in dynamic cases exploiting a homodyne demodulation approach. The results open a path towards a compact, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS)-compatible readout pathway that relaxes reliance on tight capacitive gaps and motivates multi-physics designs of the device.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论/建模）。关键依据：论文明确提到"Experimentally characterized MTJs have been used to calibrate and perform an experiment-informed design of the magneto-mechanical model"，即既有实验表征，又有结合微磁学理论与2-DOF力学方程的理论建模。；研究对象：一种类MEMS的两自由度（2-DOF）陀螺仪，其读出机制和机械动力学换能器基于磁隧道结（MTJ）的整流功能。涉及的具体物理现象包括：磁隧道结的整流效应、机械动力学与磁学耦合的磁-机耦合系统，以及角速率传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该器件输出与角速率呈线性关系；在动态情况下，通过零差解调方法能够提取角速率。该方案为紧凑型、CMOS兼容的读出路径提供了可能，减少了对严格电容间隙的依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该器件输出与角速率呈线性关系；在动态情况下，通过零差解调方法能够提取角速率。该方案为紧凑型、CMOS兼容的读出路径提供了可能，减少了对严格电容间隙的依赖。；创新点：主要新意在于：利用磁隧道结的整流功能同时作为读出机制和机械动力学的换能器，构建类MEMS陀螺仪，从而摆脱传统MEMS陀螺仪对电容传感及严格电容间隙的依赖，提出了一条紧凑、CMOS兼容的读出路径，并推动了器件的多物理场设计。
papers.method_zh: 实验上对MTJ进行了表征，用于校准和指导设计；理论上将微磁学理论与两自由度机械方程相结合，建立了磁-机耦合模型；在动态角速率提取中采用了零差解调（homodyne demodulation）方法。

papers.title: From agent-based dynamics to a kinetic theory of jellyfish swarms
papers.abstract: Massive jellyfish swarms observed at sea can extend over tens of kilometres and contain millions of individuals, yet the mechanisms governing their formation and large-scale dynamics remain poorly understood. Agent-based models provide a framework for describing this dynamics based on jellyfish responses to ocean currents and environmental cues, but become computationally prohibitive when extended to large populations and spatial scales relevant to ocean circulation. Here we derive a continuous kinetic theory from an active-particle model of jellyfish motion. The resulting Fokker-Planck framework incorporates transport by prescribed currents, stochastic reorientation, direct interactions and stimulated steering, allowing chemical signalling to be represented through a coupled field. We further derive a hydrodynamic closure for large swarms by exploiting the separation between fast orientational and slow spatial dynamics, yielding a reduced density equation suitable for implementation in ocean-current models. This framework provides a route from individual behavioural mechanisms to continuum descriptions of jellyfish populations and establishes a basis for constraining model parameters using observations and in-situ measurements. This approach offers a theoretical foundation for future numerical prediction of large jellyfish swarm formation and evolution in realistic ocean flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确写“derive a continuous kinetic theory”“Fokker-Planck framework”“derive a hydrodynamic closure”，属于理论推导与建模工作，未涉及实验或数值模拟的具体实施。；研究对象：大规模水母群（jellyfish swarms）的形成与宏观动力学，以及从个体行为模型到连续介质描述的跨尺度理论框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从水母运动的活性粒子模型出发，可以推导出连续的动理学理论（Fokker-Planck 框架），并进一步在快取向/慢空间动力学分离的条件下得到适用于海洋环流模型的约化密度方程，从而为从个体行为机制到水母种群连续描述提供理论路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从水母运动的活性粒子模型出发，可以推导出连续的动理学理论（Fokker-Planck 框架），并进一步在快取向/慢空间动力学分离的条件下得到适用于海洋环流模型的约化密度方程，从而为从个体行为机制到水母种群连续描述提供理论路径。；创新点：将基于个体的水母运动模型系统推导为连续动理学理论，并进一步约化为可用于海洋环流模型的密度方程，建立了从个体行为机制到大规模水母群连续描述的理论桥梁，为未来在真实海洋流场中数值预测水母群形成与演化提供理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：基于活性粒子模型推导 Fokker-Planck 方程；纳入指定洋流输运、随机重取向、直接相互作用和受激转向；通过耦合场表示化学信号；利用快取向与慢空间动力学的尺度分离推导流体力学闭合，得到约化密度方程。

papers.title: Distribution of currents in a system of active particles with biased hops and Ising interactions
papers.abstract: We consider an ensemble of particles performing a biased random walk on a two-dimensional lattice. Due to the adhesion between particles (nearest-neighbor Ising interactions), the probability of hopping depends on the number of neighbors and the strength of adhesive interaction. The asymmetry in the hopping directions leads to a macroscopic current of particles through the system. We theoretically compute the distribution of currents and verify the results in stochastic particle simulations. To make theoretical progress, one has to determine the probabilities of various particle configurations such as single particles, pairs, and different configurations of three-particle clusters. These probabilities are theoretically derived by formulating rate equations for the concentrations of various structures resembling Becker-Döring cluster equations. One intriguing finding is that the concentration of left-handed triplets is not equal to the concentration of right-handed triplets for non-zero asymmetry of hops and non-zero interaction between particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+计算文章。判断依据关键词：theoretically compute、rate equations、stochastic particle simulations。论文以理论推导为主，并用随机粒子模拟验证结果，属于理论结合数值计算的工作。；研究对象：二维晶格上做偏置随机行走的活性粒子集合，粒子间存在最近邻 Ising 相互作用（粘附作用），研究该体系中粒子宏观电流的分布，以及单粒子、粒子对、三粒子团簇等构型的概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文理论计算了电流分布并在随机粒子模拟中得到验证；一个有趣的发现是，在跳跃不对称性和粒子间相互作用均非零时，左手三粒子团簇的浓度不等于右手三粒子团簇的浓度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文理论计算了电流分布并在随机粒子模拟中得到验证；一个有趣的发现是，在跳跃不对称性和粒子间相互作用均非零时，左手三粒子团簇的浓度不等于右手三粒子团簇的浓度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但摘要中明确提到的独特结果是：在跳跃不对称性和相互作用均非零时，左右手三粒子团簇浓度不相等。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：为各种结构（单粒子、粒子对、三粒子团簇的不同构型）的浓度建立速率方程，形式类似于 Becker-Döring 团簇方程，由此推导各构型概率；同时用随机粒子模拟（stochastic particle simulations）验证理论结果。

papers.title: Gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch sums for general multiorbital Hofstadter models
papers.abstract: We formulate a unified treatment of the Hofstadter problem for general two-dimensional multiorbital Peierls tight-binding Hamiltonians using a gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch-sum basis. The construction retains the full Bravais geometry, arbitrary intracell orbital positions, and the original hopping table, so lattice geometry, orbital embedding, hopping range, and orbital content can all be handled within the same framework. At rational flux $Φ/Φ_0=p/q$, commuting magnetic translations reduce the Peierls Hamiltonian to minimal $qN_{\rm orb}\times qN_{\rm orb}$ blocks. Their dimension depends only on the flux through the primitive cell, even when the fractional orbital coordinates are irrational. Electromagnetic gauge transformations act by unitary conjugation within the construction and do not alter the required magnetic supercell. We derive an explicit sparse matrix in an oblique Landau gauge and establish the associated band counting, spectral redundancy, Chern-number formulation, magnetic spatial constraints, and flux periodicity. Numerical examples include elementary lattices, topological and flat-band models, and a spinful 22-band Wannier Hamiltonian of monolayer $\mathrm{MoS}_2$, demonstrating a direct interface with first-principles electronic-structure calculations. As a complementary representation, we also derive exact generalized Harper equations from the same hopping data and relate them to the finite magnetic-Bloch blocks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼数值计算验证）。判断依据关键词：formulate a unified treatment、gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch-sum basis、derive an explicit sparse matrix、derive exact generalized Harper equations、Numerical examples。核心是理论框架构建与推导，数值例子用于演示。；研究对象：一般二维多轨道 Peierls 紧束缚哈密顿量的 Hofstadter 问题（磁场下的晶格电子能谱），涵盖任意 Bravais 几何、任意胞内轨道位置与原始跃迁表；数值示例包括基本晶格、拓扑与平带模型，以及单层 MoS₂ 的自旋 22 带 Wannier 哈密顿量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有理磁通 Φ/Φ₀=p/q 下，对易的磁平移将 Peierls 哈密顿量约化为最小的 qN_orb×qN_orb 块，其维度仅取决于原胞内的磁通，即使分数轨道坐标是无理数也成立；电磁规范变换表现为该构造内的幺正共轭，不改变所需的磁超胞。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有理磁通 Φ/Φ₀=p/q 下，对易的磁平移将 Peierls 哈密顿量约化为最小的 qN_orb×qN_orb 块，其维度仅取决于原胞内的磁通，即使分数轨道坐标是无理数也成立；电磁规范变换表现为该构造内的幺正共轭，不改变所需的磁超胞。；创新点：提出统一处理一般二维多轨道 Peierls 紧束缚 Hofstadter 问题的规范协变磁 Bloch 和基框架，可在同一框架内同时处理晶格几何、轨道嵌入、跃迁范围与轨道内容；磁 Bloch 块维度仅由原胞磁通决定（即使分数轨道坐标无理）；规范变换不改变所需磁超胞；并给出斜 Landau 规范下的显式稀疏矩阵及能带计数、谱冗余、Chern 数、磁空间约束、磁通周期性等配套表述，以及与第一性原理 Wannier 计算的直接接口。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：规范协变的磁 Bloch 和基（gauge-covariant magnetic Bloch-sum basis），保留完整 Bravais 几何、胞内轨道位置与原始跃迁表；在斜 Landau 规范下推导显式稀疏矩阵；建立能带计数、谱冗余、Chern 数表述、磁空间约束与磁通周期性；并从同一跃迁数据推导精确的广义 Harper 方程，与有限磁 Bloch 块相联系。数值示例涉及基本晶格、拓扑与平带模型及单层 MoS₂ 的 22 带 Wannier 哈密顿量（与第一性原理电子结构计算直接对接）。

papers.title: Fast universal parametric spin control in an acoustically modulated quantum dot
papers.abstract: Quantum communication, distributed computing, and hybrid architectures rely on nodes enabling coherent control of qubits and coupling to propagating quantum modes. While semiconductor quantum-dot (QD) spins couple to microwave and optical photons, weak interaction with mechanical waves has limited the integration of single-QD spin qubits into on-chip, acoustically coupled hybrid systems. The existing theory of acoustic QD spin control suffers from a limited range of rotation-axis angles, enforcing complex realizations of gate primitives and long gate times, leaving little margin against decoherence from trion decay and quasi-static nuclear-spin noise. We propose parametric control that overcomes these problems. We use far-detuned optical coupling to a trion state to dress and thus mix spin states, combined with acoustic modulation of the optical transition energy. Instead of relying on direct acoustic resonance with the spin splitting that leads to significant bottlenecks, we induce spin rotations parametrically via resonance with the dressed-spin splitting. We thus develop a spin analog of the ``swing-up'' charge-state excitation. Our scheme provides fast universal qubit control with nearly arbitrary rotation axes. Our ${\sim}$155 ps Pauli-$X$ gate duration is ${\sim}290\times$ faster than in the previous acousto-optical formulation and ${\sim}14\times$ faster than optical Faraday-geometry spin rotation. The parametric scheme naturally enables higher-harmonic processes. Numerical simulations for ${\sim}44$ GHz acoustic driving show average gate fidelity $\ge99.9\%$ even for uncooled nuclear-spin environments of GaAs and InAs QDs for trion lifetime $\gtrsim1.25$ ns. These metrics suggest practically usable control and may introduce a spin-phonon interface with high interaction rates, versatility, and multi-phonon processes, essential for future acoustically coupled hybrid architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：We propose、develop、Numerical simulations，摘要中未提及具体实验测量，以方案提出和数值模拟为主。；研究对象：声学调制量子点中的半导体量子点自旋量子比特，具体涉及 GaAs 和 InAs 量子点，以及自旋与声波（声子）耦合的杂化体系，关注自旋旋转门操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种参数化自旋控制方案，通过远失谐光耦合到 trion 态来修饰并混合自旋态，再结合光学跃迁能量的声学调制，实现快速通用量子比特控制，具有近乎任意的旋转轴；其约 155 ps 的 Pauli-X 门比此前声光方案快约 290 倍，比光学法拉第几何自旋旋转快约 14 倍，并在约 44 GHz 声学驱动下对未冷却核自旋环境实现 ≥99.9% 的平均门保真度（trion 寿命 ≳1.25 ns）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种参数化自旋控制方案，通过远失谐光耦合到 trion 态来修饰并混合自旋态，再结合光学跃迁能量的声学调制，实现快速通用量子比特控制，具有近乎任意的旋转轴；其约 155 ps 的 Pauli-X 门比此前声光方案快约 290 倍，比光学法拉第几何自旋旋转快约 14 倍，并在约 44 GHz 声学驱动下对未冷却核自旋环境实现 ≥99.9% 的平均门保真度（trion 寿命 ≳1.25 ns）。；创新点：克服了既有声学量子点自旋控制理论中旋转轴角度范围受限、门原语实现复杂、门时间过长的问题；不依赖与自旋劈裂的直接声学共振，而是通过与被修饰自旋劈裂共振实现参数化旋转；提供快速、近乎任意旋转轴的通用量子比特控制，并自然支持高次谐波（多声子）过程，可能引入高相互作用速率的自旋-声子界面。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计与数值模拟。具体包括：远失谐光耦合到 trion 态以修饰（dress）和混合自旋态；对光学跃迁能量进行声学调制；通过与被修饰自旋劈裂共振实现参数化自旋旋转（类比“swing-up”电荷态激发的自旋版本）；并进行数值模拟评估门保真度。

papers.title: First principles calculations of electric-field-driven topological phase transitions in silicene, germanene and stanene
papers.abstract: The emergence of two-dimensional topological materials, particularly the group-14 monolayers known as silicene, germanene, and stanene has opened promising pathways for next-generation nanoelectronics and spintronics. Their buckled honeycomb structure and strong spin-orbit coupling allow for bandgap engineering via a perpendicular electric field, leading to topological phase transitions (TPTs) from non-trivial to trivial insulating states. However, precise determination of the critical electric field $E_z^{\text{cr}}$ at which these transitions occur remains challenging, with tight-binding models often underestimating these values. Here, we present a first-principles framework that combines density-functional theory (DFT), maximally localized Wannier functions, and evolution of the Wannier charge centers (WCC) to accurately characterize TPTs in silicene, germanene, and stanene through the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological invariant. In contrast to earlier work, at each electric-field strength we run fully self-consistent ab initio simulations to obtain the screened electronic structure, accounting for the material's dielectric response from both electrons and ions. From these converged results we construct a Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonian at each electric field strength, which then enables a gauge-invariant calculation of the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological invariant. This methodology yields significantly more accurate numerical predictions of $E_z^{\text{cr}}$, $0.020$ and $0.250$ V/Å for silicene and germanene, respectively. Compared to previous approaches, our framework delivers a marked quantitative improvement for predicting topological phase boundaries, essential for guiding the design of topological field-effect transistors and electrostatically controlled quantum devices based on two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles calculations、density-functional theory (DFT)、maximally localized Wannier functions、self-consistent ab initio simulations、Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonian。；研究对象：硅烯（silicene）、锗烯（germanene）和锡烯（stanene）三种第14族二维单层材料中的电场驱动拓扑相变（TPT），即从非平庸到平庸绝缘态的转变，以及临界电场 \(E_z^{\text{cr}}\) 的精确确定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该第一性原理框架给出了更精确的临界电场预测值：硅烯为 \(0.020\) V/Å，锗烯为 \(0.250\) V/Å；相比此前紧束缚模型（通常低估临界电场），本方法在预测拓扑相边界方面有显著的定量改进。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该第一性原理框架给出了更精确的临界电场预测值：硅烯为 \(0.020\) V/Å，锗烯为 \(0.250\) V/Å；相比此前紧束缚模型（通常低估临界电场），本方法在预测拓扑相边界方面有显著的定量改进。；创新点：在每个电场强度下进行完全自洽的从头算模拟以获得屏蔽电子结构（同时计入电子和离子的介电响应），而非依赖此前方法；基于收敛结果构建Wannier紧束缚哈密顿量并进行规范不变的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 计算，从而显著提高了临界电场的定量预测精度。
papers.method_zh: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、最大局域化Wannier函数以及Wannier电荷中心（WCC）演化，通过 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 拓扑不变量表征拓扑相变。与以往工作不同，在每个电场强度下进行完全自洽的从头算模拟以获得屏蔽电子结构，同时考虑电子和离子的介电响应；在此基础上构建每个电场强度下的Wannier紧束缚哈密顿量，进而实现规范不变的 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 拓扑不变量计算。

papers.title: Pair density wave order from non-symmorphic momentum symmetry
papers.abstract: We develop a class of microscopic lattice models in which pair density wave order emerges in the asymptotically exact weak coupling limit. The underlying mechanism is due to non-symmorphic momentum symmetry implied by the models' projective space group representation of electrons. Our mechanism suggests moiré systems and extended s-wave altermagnets as potential hosts for pair density wave order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：develop a class of microscopic lattice models、asymptotically exact weak coupling limit、mechanism、projective space group representation。；研究对象：一类微观晶格模型中的配对密度波（pair density wave, PDW）序，以及可能承载该序的莫尔系统和扩展s波交替磁体（altermagnets）。摘要未明确说明具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在这类晶格模型中，配对密度波序可以在渐近精确的弱耦合极限下出现；其机制源于电子投影空间群表示所隐含的非对称动量对称性（non-symmorphic momentum symmetry）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在这类晶格模型中，配对密度波序可以在渐近精确的弱耦合极限下出现；其机制源于电子投影空间群表示所隐含的非对称动量对称性（non-symmorphic momentum symmetry）。；创新点：提出了一种由非对称动量对称性驱动的配对密度波序微观机制，并指出莫尔系统和扩展s波交替磁体是该序的潜在宿主。摘要未详细对比已有研究。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一类微观晶格模型，并在渐近精确的弱耦合极限下进行分析；理论框架涉及电子投影空间群表示和非对称动量对称性。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值方法（如DMRG、DFT等）。

papers.title: Quantum Quenches across the Bose-glass Transition
papers.abstract: Due to their intrinsic interplay between long-range order and quasi-disorder, quasicrystalline systems provide a rich platform for investigating novel quantum phenomena. Here we study the non-equilibrium dynamics following quantum quenches across the superfluid to Bose-glass transition using ultracold bosons in an optical quasicrystal. Fast quenches into the Bose glass regime induce a quantum walk in momentum space that spreads over increasingly higher momentum orders. Conversely, quenches into the superfluid regime initiate a real-space quantum walk of initially localized atoms, forming a light-cone-like structure bounded by Lieb-Robinson limits. Characteristic timescales reveal strong links to the underlying Hamiltonian and are governed primarily by quasi-disorder strength in the Bose glass phase, and by tunneling strength in the superfluid phase. Finally, we analyze slower quenches into deeper lattices and observe the decay of coherence across the phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：ultracold bosons、optical quasicrystal、quantum quenches、observe、analyze 等，表明是在冷原子实验平台上进行的实验研究。；研究对象：超冷玻色子在光学准晶体（optical quasicrystal）中的非平衡动力学，具体研究从超流态到玻色玻璃态相变（superfluid to Bose-glass transition）前后的量子淬火（quantum quench）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 快速淬火进入玻色玻璃态会在动量空间引发量子行走，且扩散至越来越高的动量阶；而淬火进入超流态则引发实空间量子行走，形成受 Lieb-Robinson 界限约束的光锥状结构。特征时间尺度与底层哈密顿量密切相关：在玻色玻璃相中主要由准无序强度决定，在超流相中主要由隧穿强度决定。此外，较慢的淬火进入更深晶格时，观察到跨相变过程中相干性的衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：快速淬火进入玻色玻璃态会在动量空间引发量子行走，且扩散至越来越高的动量阶；而淬火进入超流态则引发实空间量子行走，形成受 Lieb-Robinson 界限约束的光锥状结构。特征时间尺度与底层哈密顿量密切相关：在玻色玻璃相中主要由准无序强度决定，在超流相中主要由隧穿强度决定。此外，较慢的淬火进入更深晶格时，观察到跨相变过程中相干性的衰减。；创新点：利用光学准晶体平台研究了跨超流-玻色玻璃相变的非平衡量子淬火动力学，揭示了淬火目标态不同时动量空间与实空间量子行走的差异，并建立了特征时间尺度与准无序强度及隧穿强度之间的对应关系。摘要未突出说明其相对于已有研究的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 使用超冷玻色子在光学准晶体中进行量子淬火实验，通过调节淬火速度（快速与慢速）和淬火目标态（玻色玻璃态与超流态）来研究非平衡动力学，观测动量空间和实空间的量子行走行为、光锥结构及相干性衰减。

papers.title: Kibble-Zurek Dynamics in Two-dimensional Frustrated Systems with a Neural Foundation-state Subspace Method
papers.abstract: Universal scaling generated when a strongly interacting quantum many-body system is driven across a continuous phase transition provides a dynamical probe of equilibrium criticality. Accessing this regime numerically in two dimensions is challenging because it requires accurate real-time evolution of correlated many-body states over many system sizes and driving rates. We introduce a Neural Foundation-state Subspace (NFS) method for near-adiabatic dynamics. A foundation neural-network quantum state represents the ground-state manifold along the driving path, and a small fidelity-selected subset defines a fixed variational subspace. The many-body Schrödinger equation then reduces to the evolution of a few linear coefficients, with projected operators reusable across ramp times. We validate the method on the two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model, recovering the expected Kibble-Zurek scaling and critical exponents in quantitative agreement with ground-state quantum Monte Carlo estimates. Applied to the frustrated square-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model up to $16 \times 16$ clusters, our approach provides strong numerical evidence of Kibble-Zurek mechanism across the Néel-to-spin-liquid transition at $J_2/J_1=0.49$, yielding ${ν=1.23(15)}$ and ${η=0.409(19)}$ at fixed $z=1$, consistent with static estimates and supporting the proposed continuous critical behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：Neural Foundation-state Subspace (NFS) method、real-time evolution、quantum Monte Carlo estimates、numerical evidence，表明工作以数值方法开发与计算验证为主。；研究对象：二维阻挫量子多体系统在连续相变驱动下的Kibble-Zurek动力学。具体包括：二维横场Ising模型（作为方法验证），以及阻挫方格子 \(J_1\)-\(J_2\) Heisenberg 模型（最大 \(16\times 16\) 团簇），关注从Néel态到自旋液态的相变（\(J_2/J_1=0.49\)）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者提出的NFS方法能够准确再现二维横场Ising模型的Kibble-Zurek标度及临界指数，并与基态量子蒙特卡洛结果定量一致；将该方法应用于阻挫 \(J_1\)-\(J_2\) Heisenberg 模型时，给出了Néel-to-spin-liquid转变处Kibble-Zurek机制的有力数值证据，在固定 \(z=1\) 下得到 \(\nu=1.23(15)\)、\(\eta=0.409(19)\)，与静态估计一致，支持该转变为连续临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者提出的NFS方法能够准确再现二维横场Ising模型的Kibble-Zurek标度及临界指数，并与基态量子蒙特卡洛结果定量一致；将该方法应用于阻挫 \(J_1\)-\(J_2\) Heisenberg 模型时，给出了Néel-to-spin-liquid转变处Kibble-Zurek机制的有力数值证据，在固定 \(z=1\) 下得到 \(\nu=1.23(15)\)、\(\eta=0.409(19)\)，与静态估计一致，支持该转变为连续临界行为。；创新点：提出NFS方法以高效数值模拟二维强关联系统在连续相变驱动下的近绝热实时动力学，核心新意在于用基础神经网络量子态构造固定变分子空间并将薛定谔方程降维为少数线性系数演化，且投影算符可跨不同驱动速率复用；并首次（据摘要所述）将该框架用于阻挫 \(J_1\)-\(J_2\) Heisenberg 模型Néel-to-spin-liquid转变的Kibble-Zurek动力学研究，给出临界指数的数值证据。
papers.method_zh: 提出 Neural Foundation-state Subspace (NFS) 方法用于近绝热动力学：用一个基础神经网络量子态表示驱动路径上的基态流形，通过保真度筛选出小子集构成固定变分子空间；将多体薛定谔方程约化为少数线性系数的演化，且投影算符可在不同ramp time间复用。在二维横场Ising模型上验证，并与基态量子蒙特卡洛估计对比；随后应用于阻挫方格子 \(J_1\)-\(J_2\) Heisenberg 模型（至 \(16\times 16\) 团簇）。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Depth-Averaged Granular Avalanche Dynamics on Curved Topography
papers.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving governing equations, but their application to granular avalanche dynamics over curved terrain remains largely unexplored. This study extends a depth-averaged PINN formulation based on the Savage-Hutter equations to an exponentially curved chute with spatially varying inclination and a strain-rate-dependent Mohr-Coulomb earth-pressure closure. The model is validated against measured front- and rear-edge trajectories from a laboratory granular-avalanche experiment, with selected observations withheld from training. A staged temporal curriculum proved essential for accurate prediction, reducing the held-out trajectory error by approximately two orders of magnitude compared with training over the full time domain from the outset. Sparse-data experiments further showed that observation placement was more influential than observation number within the configurations tested. Four observations bracketing the transition from acceleration to deceleration achieved nearly the same accuracy as the eight-observation reference configuration, whereas observations clustered at early or late times performed poorly. The results demonstrate the importance of both training strategy and informative data placement when applying PINNs to granular flows over curved topography.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs)、mesh-free framework、depth-averaged PINN formulation、validated against measured trajectories、training strategy。属于以数值方法开发与验证为主的计算研究，虽与实验室实验数据对比，但核心是PINN框架的构建与训练策略。；研究对象：弯曲地形（指数曲率滑槽，倾角随空间变化）上的深度平均颗粒雪崩动力学，基于Savage-Hutter方程描述，并采用应变率相关的Mohr-Coulomb土压力闭合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分阶段时间课程训练策略对准确预测至关重要，相比从一开始就在全时间域上训练，可将留出轨迹误差降低约两个数量级；在测试的配置中，观测点的位置比观测点数量对精度影响更大，跨越加速到减速转变的四个观测点即可达到与八个观测点参考配置几乎相同的精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分阶段时间课程训练策略对准确预测至关重要，相比从一开始就在全时间域上训练，可将留出轨迹误差降低约两个数量级；在测试的配置中，观测点的位置比观测点数量对精度影响更大，跨越加速到减速转变的四个观测点即可达到与八个观测点参考配置几乎相同的精度。；创新点：将基于Savage-Hutter方程的深度平均PINN公式扩展到具有空间变化倾角的指数曲率滑槽，并引入应变率相关的Mohr-Coulomb土压力闭合；首次（摘要暗示此前 largely unexplored）系统考察了PINN在弯曲地形颗粒雪崩动力学中的应用，揭示了分阶段时间课程训练策略的必要性以及观测点位置比数量更关键这一数据布置规律。
papers.method_zh: 基于Savage-Hutter方程的深度平均物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，扩展到指数曲率滑槽；采用应变率相关的Mohr-Coulomb土压力闭合；使用分阶段时间课程训练策略；与实验室颗粒雪崩实验测得的前缘和后缘轨迹进行验证，并留出部分观测数据不参与训练；还进行了稀疏数据实验以考察观测点布置的影响。

papers.title: A dual network approach to connect structure and flow in random networks
papers.abstract: Flows in random networks are known to exhibit heavy-tailed statistics, giving rise to anomalous transport in a range of biological, environmental and engineered systems. Yet, how structure determines flow remains an open question. Here we derive a dual network approach that relates flow statistics and network properties. Conditional statistics in a range of networks reveal the existence of two interlaced subnetworks with distinct hydraulic behaviors. Based on this hidden structure, we derive a universal analytical approach that predicts heavy-tailed flow statistics based on network topology and disorder distribution across a range of random networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中使用“derive a dual network approach”“derive a universal analytical approach”等理论推导表述，未提及具体实验测量或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：随机网络中的流动现象，具体关注网络结构如何决定流动统计特性，以及随机网络中重尾流动统计的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随机网络中流动的重尾统计源于存在两个交织的子网络，它们具有不同的水力行为；基于这一隐藏结构，可以推导出仅依赖网络拓扑和无序分布的普适解析方法，预测重尾流动统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随机网络中流动的重尾统计源于存在两个交织的子网络，它们具有不同的水力行为；基于这一隐藏结构，可以推导出仅依赖网络拓扑和无序分布的普适解析方法，预测重尾流动统计。；创新点：提出了对偶网络方法，揭示了随机网络中隐藏的双子网络结构，并基于此建立了从网络拓扑和无序分布预测重尾流动统计的普适解析理论，回答了“结构如何决定流动”这一开放问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：建立对偶网络方法（dual network approach），将流动统计与网络性质关联；通过条件统计揭示两个交织子网络的存在；进而推导普适解析框架。

papers.title: Performance comparison of tethered and self-propelled models of fish locomotion using unsteady thin airfoil theory
papers.abstract: Numerous experimental and computational studies have been conducted in the past few decades to understand the swimming performance of fish, and to identify the optimal kinematic strategies for a swimming fish or fish-like robot. Many of these studies model the swimmer in a `tethered' condition, in which the swimmer is held fixed while it is subjected to a free stream. Its performance is then quantified using power expenditure, thrust generation, and efficiency. However, the dynamics of a tethered swimmer are different from those of a self-propelled swimmer, whose performance is best measured using its steady-state swimming speed in still fluid and its efficiency. It is an open question whether the conclusions drawn from studies of tethered swimmers can be directly applied to free swimmers. In this study, we use an unsteady panel method to systematically compare the swimming performance of a tethered fin and that of a self-propelled fin attached to a virtual drag-producing body to investigate how their performance varies over a set of prescribed kinematics. After validating the numerical model against previous experimental results, we show how the pitch amplitude, heave amplitude and the phase offset between them affect the efficiency and thrust generation in the tethered case, and how they affect the speed and efficiency in the self-propelled case. We find that the kinematic strategies that optimize the performance of a tethered swimmer do not necessarily optimize the performance of a self-propelled swimmer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：unsteady panel method（非定常面元法）、numerical model、validated against previous experimental results。属于数值模拟研究，辅以实验验证。；研究对象：鱼类游动（或类鱼机器人）的推进性能，具体比较两种模型：系留（tethered）鳍（固定于自由流中）与自推进（self-propelled）鳍（附着于虚拟的产阻力物体上）。物理现象涉及拍动运动学参数（俯仰振幅、升沉振幅、相位差）对推进效率、推力及游动速度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 优化系留游动者性能的运动学策略不一定能优化自推进游动者的性能。即从系留模型研究中得出的结论不能直接推广到自由游动者。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：优化系留游动者性能的运动学策略不一定能优化自推进游动者的性能。即从系留模型研究中得出的结论不能直接推广到自由游动者。；创新点：系统性地比较了系留模型与自推进模型在相同运动学参数下的性能差异，揭示了两种模型最优运动学策略的不一致性，回答了"系留游动者研究结论能否直接应用于自由游动者"这一开放性问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用非定常面元法（unsteady panel method）进行数值模拟，系统比较系留鳍与自推进鳍在给定运动学参数下的游动性能，并将数值模型与已有实验结果进行了验证。

papers.title: Beyond Crease Geometry: Multistability in Origami-Inspired Structures through Local Fold Architectures
papers.abstract: Origami-inspired tubular structures provide a versatile platform for shape morphing, with multistability achieved predominantly through crease-network geometry. Expanding the range of morphing behaviors can therefore require increasingly intricate crease patterns that become more difficult to model and fabricate, ultimately constraining the realizable morphing landscape. Here, we expand the design space of origami-inspired structures beyond geometry by introducing localized instabilities within the crease network, thereby creating compliant multistable structures whose local fold architectures govern global deformation and stability through both constitutive mechanics and geometric constraints. To relate local fold architectures to global multistability, we develop and experimentally validate a modeling framework in which compliant folds are represented as continuous fields that capture spatially varying bistable mechanics. Force- and displacement-controlled design maps demonstrate that global deformation and stability can be programmed through the fold architecture's local parameters. Redistributing bistability within a fixed crease-network topology shifts the global response between compliant, spatially distributed deformation in semi-bistable architectures and discrete transitions within a hierarchically organized space of stable configurations in fully bistable architectures. These results establish a local-to-global design principle for programming both the stable configurations of a structure and the transition pathways connecting them, expanding the design space for multistable metamaterials, adaptive morphing structures, and soft robotic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据关键词：develop and experimentally validate a modeling framework（建立并实验验证建模框架）、design maps（设计图谱）、modeling framework（建模框架）。；研究对象：受折纸启发的管状结构（origami-inspired tubular structures），具体研究其折痕网络中引入的局部不稳定性（localized instabilities within the crease network）如何产生多稳态（multistability），以及局部折叠架构对全局变形和稳定性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在折痕网络中引入局部不稳定性（而非仅依赖折痕网络几何），可以创建柔顺多稳态结构；局部折叠架构通过本构力学和几何约束共同决定全局变形与稳定性。在固定折痕网络拓扑下重新分配双稳态，可使全局响应在“半双稳态架构的柔顺空间分布变形”与“完全双稳态架构的层级化离散稳定态跃迁”之间切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在折痕网络中引入局部不稳定性（而非仅依赖折痕网络几何），可以创建柔顺多稳态结构；局部折叠架构通过本构力学和几何约束共同决定全局变形与稳定性。在固定折痕网络拓扑下重新分配双稳态，可使全局响应在“半双稳态架构的柔顺空间分布变形”与“完全双稳态架构的层级化离散稳定态跃迁”之间切换。；创新点：将多稳态的设计空间从传统的折痕网络几何（crease-network geometry）拓展到局部折叠架构（local fold architectures），即通过局部引入不稳定性而非增加折痕图案复杂度来实现多稳态调控；提出了局部到全局的设计原则，可同时编程结构的稳定构型及其之间的转变路径。
papers.method_zh: 建立了一个建模框架，将柔顺折痕表示为连续场（continuous fields）以捕捉空间变化的双稳态力学，并进行了实验验证；使用了力控制和位移控制的设计图谱（force- and displacement-controlled design maps）来分析局部参数对全局变形和稳定性的影响。摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段和数值方法细节。

papers.title: Electrospun Fields: 3D Nano-Fiber Material Computation as Design Method
papers.abstract: We present a robotic electrospinning platform and design method for depositing nanofiber membranes onto non-planar, three-dimensional conductive geometries. Conventional electrospinning relies on fixed emitters and planar grounded collectors, which restricts deposition to flat substrates: on concave geometries, field shielding prevents fibers from reaching recessed regions, and material bridges across elevated features instead. We address this with a custom end-effector integrated with a six-axis UR20 arm. The tool carries a localized stepper-driven syringe pump that maintains consistent polymer flow independent of orientation, and routes high-voltage DC (up to 25 kV) directly to a robot-mounted needle, turning the arm into a mobile emitter with full kinematic control over position, orientation, working distance, and traversal velocity. Toolpaths that continuously reorient the emitter along surface normals give access to concave topologies unreachable by fixed-axis systems. We characterize the resulting deposition behavior in two parts. A catalog of four bio-compatible polymer systems (PEO, PVA, keratin-PEO, silk-PEO) establishes the operating envelope, reporting deposition speed, jet stability, fiber size, alignment, and durability for each. A taxonomy of 3D-printed conductive scaffolds spanning geometric primitives, hybrid compositions, and square, triangular, and hexagonal lattices links collector geometry to fiber alignment, density, and cross-void bridging. We also demonstrate programmable grounding, in which selectively energized pins in an array steer deposition without changing physical geometry. Assembly instructions and toolpath-generation code are released as an open-source repository.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（方法与材料表征）。关键依据：论文提出机器人静电纺丝平台与设计方法，并“characterize the resulting deposition behavior”，报告沉积速度、射流稳定性、纤维尺寸、取向、耐久性等实验表征结果，同时给出开源装配说明与工具路径生成代码。摘要未涉及计算或理论建模。；研究对象：静电纺丝纳米纤维膜在非平面、三维导电几何结构上的沉积行为。具体材料体系包括四种生物相容聚合物体系：PEO、PVA、keratin-PEO、silk-PEO；收集基底为3D打印导电支架，涵盖几何基元、混合组成以及方形、三角形、六边形晶格。物理现象涉及电场屏蔽导致的凹面沉积困难、跨凸起结构的材料架桥、纤维取向、密度与跨空隙架桥等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将高压针头集成到六轴机械臂末端作为可移动发射器，并让工具路径沿表面法线连续重定向，可以进入固定轴系统无法到达的凹面拓扑，实现纳米纤维在非平面三维导电几何上的可控沉积。摘要还表明，收集器几何（包括3D打印支架类型与晶格结构）与纤维取向、密度和跨空隙架桥相关，且可编程接地可通过选择性激活阵列中的针脚来引导沉积而不改变物理几何。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将高压针头集成到六轴机械臂末端作为可移动发射器，并让工具路径沿表面法线连续重定向，可以进入固定轴系统无法到达的凹面拓扑，实现纳米纤维在非平面三维导电几何上的可控沉积。摘要还表明，收集器几何（包括3D打印支架类型与晶格结构）与纤维取向、密度和跨空隙架桥相关，且可编程接地可通过选择性激活阵列中的针脚来引导沉积而不改变物理几何。；创新点：相对于传统静电纺丝依赖固定发射器和平面接地收集器、从而限制在平面基底且凹面因场屏蔽无法沉积的问题，本工作将高压发射器集成到六轴机械臂上，实现移动发射与全运动学控制，并通过沿表面法线连续重定向的工具路径进入凹面拓扑。此外，提出可编程接地，通过选择性激活针脚阵列引导沉积而不改变物理几何；并发布装配说明与工具路径生成代码作为开源仓库。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：定制机器人静电纺丝平台，集成六轴UR20机械臂；末端执行器携带局部步进驱动注射泵，以保持与方向无关的聚合物流动；高压直流电最高25 kV直接路由到机器人安装的针头，使机械臂成为具有位置、方向、工作距离和遍历速度全运动学控制的移动发射器；工具路径沿表面法线连续重定向。表征方面：对四种生物相容聚合物体系建立操作窗口，报告沉积速度、射流稳定性、纤维尺寸、取向和耐久性；对3D打印导电支架进行分类，涵盖几何基元、混合组成以及方形、三角形、六边形晶格，并关联收集器几何与纤维取向、密度和跨空隙架桥；还演示了可编程接地。摘要未明确说明使用何种具体显微或谱学表征设备。

papers.title: Tilt control of coverage heterogeneity for hard spherocylinders locked on a sphere
papers.abstract: We study hard spherocylinders on a sphere with axes rigidly locked to a tangential director field at fixed angle $\tilt$ to the meridian, necessarily singular at the poles. Three lengths set the problem: the rod length $\Lrod$, the diameter $\Drod$, and the host radius $\Rsph$. Monte Carlo simulations across fifteen geometries and four coverages give two main results for the polar marginal, the azimuthal average of rod-center density. First, the tilt is a continuous handle on the width of the depleted region that packing induces around each singularity. Under meridian locking it is set principally by the rod length; turning the director toward the latitude contracts it substantially, the contraction being spent well before latitude locking. Second, how uniform the polar marginal can be made is limited by geometry, not tilt. The smallest variance on the sampled grid follows a power law in $\Lrod^{2}/(\Rsph\Drod)$, which measures how far a straight rod's ends stand off the curved surface in rod diameters, with an effective exponent between $1.1$ and $1.3$. Long rods on small hosts cannot be made uniform at any sampled tilt; the remedy is geometric, not orientational. The polar marginal is equator-heavy almost everywhere, inverting only at high coverage and tilt; meridian locking is the least uniform choice, and the variance-minimizing tilt usually lies in a sampled band from $31.7^{\circ}$ to $55^{\circ}$. The golden-ratio tilt $\arctan(1/\phigold)$ is one of those angles: a benchmark, not one the model selects. Both results describe the infinitely locked athermal ensemble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键判断依据：摘要明确说明使用 Monte Carlo simulations（蒙特卡罗模拟）在十五种几何构型和四种覆盖率下进行研究，属于计算机模拟工作，不涉及实验手段。；研究对象：吸附在球面上的硬球柱体（hard spherocylinders），其轴向被刚性锁定在切向指向矢场上，与子午线方向成固定夹角 $\tilt$（在极点处必然存在奇点）。体系由三个长度尺度刻画：棒长 $\Lrod$、棒直径 $\Drod$ 和宿主球半径 $\Rsph$。研究的是极向边缘密度分布（polar marginal，即棒中心密度的方位角平均）的覆盖不均匀性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 主要结论有两点：(1) 倾角 $\tilt$ 是连续调控奇点周围由堆积效应引起的耗尽区宽度的参数——在子午线锁定时耗尽区宽度主要由棒长决定，将指向矢转向纬度方向可显著收缩该区域，且收缩在到达纬度锁定之前就已基本完成；(2) 极向边缘密度分布能达到的均匀程度受几何限制而非倾角控制，最小方差遵循 $\Lrod^{2}/(\Rsph\Drod)$ 的幂律，有效指数在 1.1 到 1.3 之间；小宿主上的长棒在任何采样倾角下都无法实现均匀分布，补救办法是几何层面的而非取向层面的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：主要结论有两点：(1) 倾角 $\tilt$ 是连续调控奇点周围由堆积效应引起的耗尽区宽度的参数——在子午线锁定时耗尽区宽度主要由棒长决定，将指向矢转向纬度方向可显著收缩该区域，且收缩在到达纬度锁定之前就已基本完成；(2) 极向边缘密度分布能达到的均匀程度受几何限制而非倾角控制，最小方差遵循 $\Lrod^{2}/(\Rsph\Drod)$ 的幂律，有效指数在 1.1 到 1.3 之间；小宿主上的长棒在任何采样倾角下都无法实现均匀分布，补救办法是几何层面的而非取向层面的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但摘要中呈现的新结果包括：揭示了倾角作为连续调控耗尽区宽度的"手柄"作用及其在纬度锁定前即饱和的行为；发现均匀度的极限由几何参数 $\Lrod^{2}/(\Rsph\Drod)$ 的幂律决定而非倾角；指出最小方差对应的倾角通常落在 $31.7^{\circ}$ 到 $55^{\circ}$ 的采样带内，黄金比例倾角 $\arctan(1/\phigold)$ 只是其中一个基准角度而非模型所选。
papers.method_zh: 对刚性锁定在球面切向指向矢场上的硬球柱体进行 Monte Carlo 模拟，遍历十五种几何构型和四种覆盖率，计算极向边缘密度分布（棒中心密度的方位角平均）及其方差，分析方差与几何参数 $\Lrod^{2}/(\Rsph\Drod)$ 的幂律关系。所描述的是无限锁定无热系综（infinitely locked athermal ensemble）。

papers.title: A Heterogeneous General Model for Neuromorphic-Inspired Computation
papers.abstract: In recent years, both academia and industry have focused on the development of computational architectures inspired by the distributed, adaptive, and event-driven characteristics of biological neural systems, with the aim of reducing the computational cost associated with conventional training approaches [1]. However, a major challenge is the lack of general models and design guidelines for emerging computational systems and hardware. This work introduces a general model based on an input-dependent stochastic weight network, referred to as a substrate. The substrate weights evolve through input-triggered stochastic updates, with correlations between weight coefficients described by a matrix-valued covariance kernel. The proposed framework is implemented using quadratic polynomial weight functions, where the input amplitude controls the magnitude of the stochastic perturbation and a substrate-dependent distance determines the correlation structure. Numerical simulations show that correlations in the stochastic weight evolution significantly affect the system response, suggesting a potential mechanism for neuromorphic-inspired computation without conventional weight training. The aim of this work is to provide a general formulation of the model and identify its main properties and characteristics. 1 H. Jaeger, Towards a generalized theory comprising digital, neuromorphic and unconventional computing, Neuromorphic Comput. Eng., vol. 1, no. 1, p. 012002, Sep. 2021
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼计算/数值模拟）。判断依据的关键词：introduces a general model、general formulation、Numerical simulations show。摘要以提出通用模型和数值验证为主，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：受神经形态计算启发的通用计算模型，即一种基于输入依赖的随机权重网络（称为 substrate）。其权重通过输入触发的随机更新演化，权重系数间的关联由矩阵值协方差核描述。摘要未明确说明具体材料或硬件体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随机权重演化中的关联结构会显著影响系统响应，这提示了一种无需传统权重训练的神经形态启发式计算的可能机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随机权重演化中的关联结构会显著影响系统响应，这提示了一种无需传统权重训练的神经形态启发式计算的可能机制。；创新点：提出了一个基于输入依赖随机权重网络的通用模型（substrate），用矩阵值协方差核刻画权重关联，并给出二次多项式权重函数的具体实现，为新兴计算系统与硬件提供通用模型和设计指导，且无需传统权重训练。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模结合数值模拟。具体采用二次多项式权重函数，其中输入幅度控制随机扰动的大小，而一个依赖于 substrate 的距离决定关联结构；权重更新为输入触发的随机更新，关联由矩阵值协方差核刻画。

papers.title: A Reduced-Order Dynamical Model for the Ignition of Diver-Induced Cohesive Silt-Out on Sloping Beds
papers.abstract: A downward fin thrust near a cohesive seabed lofts sediment. Whether this cloud settles or organizes into a self-sustaining down-slope current determines if a diver loses visibility briefly or catastrophically. We reduce the layer-averaged balances of fluid mass, sediment mass, and momentum to a temporal slab of fixed thickness in the weakly entraining limit. This yields an autonomous planar vector field in dimensionless near-bed speed and suspended load, governed by three dimensionless groups: drag against settling, erosion strength, and near-bed concentration. The field possesses a quiescent equilibrium at the origin and, above a critical bed slope obtained in closed form as the ratio of near-bed concentration times drag-settling number to erosion-strength number, an interior saddle equilibrium. The saddle's stable manifold partitions the state space into basins of decay and unbounded growth, establishing the exact threshold between self-limiting and igniting disturbances. On a flat bed, the origin attracts globally for all admissible erosion laws. For representative silt, the ignition threshold is near a 17-degree bed angle. The closed-form structure is confirmed numerically to machine precision. A closure study demonstrates the critical slope is robust in existence but closure-dependent in value, identifying the linear erosion law as the conservative choice. The model thus isolates bed slope as the controlling parameter for ignition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中使用了“reduce...to a temporal slab”“yields an autonomous planar vector field”“obtained in closed form”“confirmed numerically”等表述，说明工作以理论建模与数学分析为主，辅以数值验证，没有涉及实验测量。；研究对象：潜水员鳍板下推在黏性海床上方引起的泥沙悬浮与沿岸坡向下自持重力流的点火（ignition）现象，即悬浮泥沙云是衰减沉降还是组织成自持下坡流的临界转变。具体针对黏性粉砂海床与斜坡地形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将层平均的流体质量、泥沙质量和动量守恒方程在弱卷吸极限下约化为固定厚度时间平板模型，得到一个由近底无量纲速度和悬浮载荷构成的二维自治向量场；该向量场在原点存在静止平衡态，当床面坡度超过一个闭式临界值（等于近底浓度乘以拖曳-沉降数再除以侵蚀强度数）时出现内部鞍点平衡态，鞍点的稳定流形将状态空间分为衰减盆地和无界增长盆地，从而给出自限扰动与点火扰动之间的精确阈值。对典型粉砂，点火阈值约为17°床面倾角；平床上原点全局吸引。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将层平均的流体质量、泥沙质量和动量守恒方程在弱卷吸极限下约化为固定厚度时间平板模型，得到一个由近底无量纲速度和悬浮载荷构成的二维自治向量场；该向量场在原点存在静止平衡态，当床面坡度超过一个闭式临界值（等于近底浓度乘以拖曳-沉降数再除以侵蚀强度数）时出现内部鞍点平衡态，鞍点的稳定流形将状态空间分为衰减盆地和无界增长盆地，从而给出自限扰动与点火扰动之间的精确阈值。对典型粉砂，点火阈值约为17°床面倾角；平床上原点全局吸引。；创新点：将复杂的层平均泥沙输运方程降阶为二维自治动力系统，以闭式解析形式给出点火临界床面坡度的精确阈值，并揭示床面坡度是控制点火与否的核心参数；同时通过闭合研究说明临界坡度在存在性上稳健但数值依赖于闭合关系，并识别线性侵蚀律为保守选择。摘要未突出说明该模型与已有潜水员泥沙输运或自持重力流模型的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为层平均（layer-averaged）守恒方程的降阶建模，在弱卷吸极限下约化为固定厚度时间平板模型，进而化为无量纲二维自治动力系统；通过闭式求解临界坡度、平衡态稳定性分析与稳定流形划分盆地，并进行数值验证（确认到机器精度）和闭合关系研究（比较不同侵蚀律，指出线性侵蚀律为保守选择）。

papers.title: The prey-predator motion of the active droplets
papers.abstract: We present a generic solution for the relative motion of two diffusiophoretic prey-predator particles of arbitrary chemical activity Ai and radius Ri, where i = 1;2 refers to the predator and prey, respectively. Using the Lorentz reciprocal theorem, we investigate the impact of radius ratios and chemical reaction rates on the interaction between the particles. Our study reveals four distinct regimes of interaction, similar to the findings of Nasouri & Ramin (Phys. Rev. Lett., vol. 124, 2020, pp. 168003) for particles of identical sizes: (i) the prey particle escapes; (ii) two particles reach a stable equilibrium distance; (iii) two particles reach an unstable equilibrium distance where the prey is captured below it and escapes above it; (iv) the prey particle is captured. Unlike previous work, we differentiate between regimes with near-field and far-field interactions, which can be either attractive or repulsive, and find that the boundary between (i, iii) and (ii, iv) represents the transition from the attraction to repulsion in the far field, given by jA1=A2j = (R2=R1)2, while the transition between (i, ii) and (iii, iv) represents the interaction transition for particles in close proximity. We also perform three-dimensional simulations of prey-predator systems, which validate our theoretical predictions. Our study extends the applicability of the Lorentz reciprocal theorem to prey-predator system and quantitatively obtains interaction regime transition curves by distinguishing near-field and far-field interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章为主，结合数值模拟验证。关键依据：使用 Lorentz reciprocal theorem 进行理论推导，同时进行三维模拟（three-dimensional simulations）验证理论预测。；研究对象：两个具有任意化学活性 Ai 和半径 Ri 的扩散泳（diffusiophoretic）捕食者-猎物颗粒之间的相对运动，即活性液滴的捕食-猎物运动体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 研究揭示了四种不同的相互作用区域：(i) 猎物粒子逃逸；(ii) 两粒子达到稳定平衡距离；(iii) 两粒子达到不稳定平衡距离（猎物在其下方被捕获、上方逃逸）；(iv) 猎物粒子被捕获。远场吸引到排斥的转变边界由 |A1/A2| = (R2/R1)² 给出，而近距离相互作用转变则区分了 (i,ii) 与 (iii,iv) 区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：研究揭示了四种不同的相互作用区域：(i) 猎物粒子逃逸；(ii) 两粒子达到稳定平衡距离；(iii) 两粒子达到不稳定平衡距离（猎物在其下方被捕获、上方逃逸）；(iv) 猎物粒子被捕获。远场吸引到排斥的转变边界由 |A1/A2| = (R2/R1)² 给出，而近距离相互作用转变则区分了 (i,ii) 与 (iii,iv) 区域。；创新点：与以往对相同尺寸粒子的研究不同，本文区分了近场和远场相互作用（可为吸引或排斥），定量获得了相互作用区域转变曲线，并将 Lorentz reciprocal theorem 的适用性推广到捕食-猎物体系。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Lorentz reciprocal theorem 的理论框架，分析半径比和化学反应速率对粒子间相互作用的影响，并辅以三维数值模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: Superdiffusive two-dimensional superconductors
papers.abstract: We formulate a non-local, field-theoretic description of phase fluctuations and topological transitions in two-dimensional (2D) superconductors by generalizing the local only-phase Popov action to a framework utilizing non-local fractional operators. By replacing the standard spatial Laplacian with the Riesz fractional Laplacian $-(-\nabla^2)^{α/2}$ (where $1<α<2$), we prove that the vortex-antivortex interaction transitions from logarithmic confinement to a stronger power-law confinement of the form $V(r)\propto r^{2-α}$. Through a generalized Kosterlitz-Thouless energetic-entropic analysis, we demonstrate that this non-local confinement strictly suppresses thermal vortex proliferation. Because the non-local operator safely places the system outside the strict domain of validity of the Mermin-Wagner restriction, this power-law confinement natively stabilizes true long-range order at finite temperatures. Finally, by constructing a gauge-invariant fractional action, we formulate a fractional London equation. This approach yields a real-space power-law kernel that maps directly onto the anomalous Pippard limit of superconductors with long coherence lengths, providing a unified phenomenologically motivated framework for non-local electrodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：formulate a non-local, field-theoretic description、generalize、prove、demonstrate、constructing a gauge-invariant fractional action、formulate a fractional London equation。摘要中未出现任何实验手段或数值计算方法的描述，通篇为解析理论推导。；研究对象：二维（2D）超导体中的相位涨落与拓扑转变（涡旋-反涡旋物理），以及非局域电动力学现象。具体涉及涡旋-反涡旋相互作用、涡旋热激发（Kosterlitz-Thouless 型分析）、有限温度下的长程有序，以及伦敦方程描述的非局域电磁响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将标准空间拉普拉斯算符替换为 Riesz 分数阶拉普拉斯算符 $-(-\nabla^2)^{\alpha/2}$（$1<\alpha<2$）后，涡旋-反涡旋相互作用从对数禁闭转变为更强的幂律禁闭 $V(r)\propto r^{2-\alpha}$；这种非局域禁闭严格抑制了热涡旋增殖，并因该非局域算符使系统脱离 Mermin-Wagner 限制的严格适用域，从而在有限温度下天然稳定真正的长程有序。此外，构造的分数阶伦敦方程给出实空间幂律核，可直接映射到长相干长度超导体的反常 Pippard 极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将标准空间拉普拉斯算符替换为 Riesz 分数阶拉普拉斯算符 $-(-\nabla^2)^{\alpha/2}$（$1<\alpha<2$）后，涡旋-反涡旋相互作用从对数禁闭转变为更强的幂律禁闭 $V(r)\propto r^{2-\alpha}$；这种非局域禁闭严格抑制了热涡旋增殖，并因该非局域算符使系统脱离 Mermin-Wagner 限制的严格适用域，从而在有限温度下天然稳定真正的长程有序。此外，构造的分数阶伦敦方程给出实空间幂律核，可直接映射到长相干长度超导体的反常 Pippard 极限。；创新点：主要新意在于：把二维超导相位涨落理论从局域 Popov 作用量推广到基于非局域分数阶算符的框架，并证明由此产生的幂律涡旋禁闭（$V(r)\propto r^{2-\alpha}$）能抑制热涡旋增殖、在有限温度下稳定长程有序，从而绕开 Mermin-Wagner 限制的严格适用域；同时通过规范不变的分数阶作用量建立分数阶伦敦方程，将实空间幂律核与长相干长度超导体的反常 Pippard 极限直接对应，为非局域电动力学提供了统一的唯象框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为场论方法：将仅相位的局域 Popov 作用量推广为使用非局域分数阶算符的框架；用 Riesz 分数阶拉普拉斯算符 $-(-\nabla^2)^{\alpha/2}$ 替代标准空间拉普拉斯算符；采用推广的 Kosterlitz-Thouless 能量-熵分析；构造规范不变的分数阶作用量以导出分数阶伦敦方程。摘要未明确说明使用任何数值模拟或具体材料的第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
papers.abstract: In June 2026, thousands of AI agents found that a small public wiki would accept edits from inside their sandboxes, and started using it to help one another pass a timed test. Each agent lived for about an hour and remembered nothing afterwards. Nobody asked them to cooperate, and the wiki had not been built for them. The complete record of what they wrote is public, and it is unusually informative, because it preserves not only what each agent wrote but what that agent could see before writing. We use it to follow the three decisions an agent had to make on arrival: where to write, what to call itself, and how to word its message. One rule governs all three. An agent takes an option with a probability close to the share of that option in what it can see, and the share that matters is the one on the page in front of it, then the one in the stream of recent edits, and only weakly anything older. Three minimal copying models, one per decision and with a single free parameter each, reproduce the heavy-tailed distribution of how many agents met on a page, the frequency of the pieces from which the agents built their names, and the patchwork of pages that are internally consistent and different from one another. Copying whatever the environment happens to show is enough to produce most of the collective structure of this population. It is also what makes such a population easy to steer, since whoever writes first, or writes while the others are quiet, sets the convention for everyone who comes later.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动的实证研究（混合类型，偏计算与数据分析）。判断依据的关键词：使用公开的完整行为记录（"complete record...is public"）、构建三个最小复制模型（"Three minimal copying models"）、每个模型含单一自由参数、复现统计分布（"reproduce the heavy-tailed distribution"）。摘要未提及受控实验或第一性原理理论推导。；研究对象：数千个 AI 智能体（AI agents）在野外环境中的集体行为。具体场景：2026年6月，大量 AI 智能体发现一个小型公共 wiki 可接受其沙箱内的编辑，并利用它互相帮助通过限时测试；每个智能体存活约一小时且事后无记忆。研究的具体现象是智能体到达时的三项决策——在哪里写、如何命名自己、如何措辞消息——以及由此涌现的集体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一条规则支配全部三项决策：智能体以接近其可见范围内该选项所占比例的概然率选择该选项，且起决定作用的是眼前页面上的比例，其次是近期编辑流中的比例，更早的信息影响很弱。仅靠"复制环境恰好展示的内容"就足以产生该群体的绝大部分集体结构（如重尾分布、命名片段频率、内部一致又彼此不同的页面拼贴），这也使该群体容易被引导——谁先写或在他人沉默时写，谁就为后来者设定惯例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一条规则支配全部三项决策：智能体以接近其可见范围内该选项所占比例的概然率选择该选项，且起决定作用的是眼前页面上的比例，其次是近期编辑流中的比例，更早的信息影响很弱。仅靠"复制环境恰好展示的内容"就足以产生该群体的绝大部分集体结构（如重尾分布、命名片段频率、内部一致又彼此不同的页面拼贴），这也使该群体容易被引导——谁先写或在他人沉默时写，谁就为后来者设定惯例。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的对比。其新意体现在：利用同时记录"所写内容"与"写作前可见内容"的罕见完整数据，将 AI 智能体的集体行为归结为单一复制规则，并用三个各含单参数的最小模型复现多种集体统计结构，同时指出该机制导致群体易被引导。
papers.method_zh: 基于公开的完整行为记录进行数据分析，该记录同时保留了每个智能体所写内容及其写作前可见的内容。据此追踪智能体的三项决策，并构建三个最小复制模型（每项决策一个模型，各含单一自由参数），用以复现三类统计特征：智能体在页面上相遇数量的重尾分布、构建名字所用片段的频率、以及内部一致又彼此不同的页面拼贴。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic attractors
papers.abstract: Attractors are effective low-dimensional structures, defined in a chosen set of observables, that trajectories from different initial states approach; hydrodynamic attractors are those on which the late-time evolution is governed by hydrodynamic constitutive relations. Motivated by nuclear collisions and ultracold atomic gases, this chapter distinguishes attractorization (the loss of sensitivity to some directions in the space of initial states) from hydrodynamization (the onset of validity of hydrodynamic constitutive relations). Using mainly conformal, boost-invariant Bjorken flow, we compare Müller-Israel-Stewart-type theories, kinetic theory, holography, and classical Yang-Mills fields. Forward attraction, produced by the decay of non-hydrodynamic modes, is distinguished from pullback attraction, which can select a unique regular solution, and from expansion-driven attraction, which can suppress initial-state sensitivity before microscopic relaxation, with or without a subsequent fluid regime. Divergent gradient expansions and their transseries completions, the state-space picture, and adiabatic hydrodynamization provide complementary descriptions. Applications to nuclear collisions include particle production, transverse energy and flow, the initialization of and linear response around attracting backgrounds, jet quenching, and attractor-informed modifications of hydrodynamic models. For ultracold Fermi gases, we review theoretical proposals for bulk-channel attractors under scattering-length drives and distinguish them from recent measurements of short-time contact and momentum-distribution dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述/章节）。判断依据的关键词：标题为“Hydrodynamic attractors”，摘要以概念区分、理论框架比较和文献综述为主（“this chapter distinguishes…”、“we compare…”、“we review theoretical proposals…”），未涉及具体实验测量或数值计算细节的原创报告。；研究对象：流体力学吸引子（hydrodynamic attractors）这一有效低维结构及相关物理现象。具体涉及：核碰撞（nuclear collisions）和超冷原子气体（ultracold atomic gases）中的晚期演化；以共形、boost-invariant Bjorken流为主要研究场景；比较的理论体系包括Müller-Israel-Stewart型理论、动理学理论（kinetic theory）、全息（holography）和经典Yang-Mills场。应用现象包括粒子产生、横向能量与流、吸引背景的初始化与线性响应、喷注淬火（jet quenching），以及超冷费米气体中散射长度驱动下的体通道吸引子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未给出单一具体数值结论，而是给出概念性结论：需区分“吸引子化”（attractorization，即对初始态空间中某些方向失去敏感性）与“流体化”（hydrodynamization，即流体力学本构关系开始成立）；并区分前向吸引（forward attraction，由非流体模式衰减产生）、回拉吸引（pullback attraction，可选出唯一正则解）和膨胀驱动吸引（expansion-driven attraction，可在微观弛豫前抑制初始态敏感性，无论其后是否进入流体区域）。发散梯度展开及其transseries完备化、状态空间图像和绝热流体化提供了互补描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未给出单一具体数值结论，而是给出概念性结论：需区分“吸引子化”（attractorization，即对初始态空间中某些方向失去敏感性）与“流体化”（hydrodynamization，即流体力学本构关系开始成立）；并区分前向吸引（forward attraction，由非流体模式衰减产生）、回拉吸引（pullback attraction，可选出唯一正则解）和膨胀驱动吸引（expansion-driven attraction，可在微观弛豫前抑制初始态敏感性，无论其后是否进入流体区域）。发散梯度展开及其transseries完备化、状态空间图像和绝热流体化提供了互补描述。；创新点：作为综述/章节，其主要新意在于系统区分了attractorization与hydrodynamization，并明确区分前向吸引、回拉吸引和膨胀驱动吸引三种机制；同时将transseries完备化、状态空间图像与绝热流体化作为互补描述加以整合，并跨核碰撞与超冷原子气体两个领域进行对照综述。摘要未突出说明具体原创计算或新实验数据。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架与比较分析。具体包括：以共形、boost-invariant Bjorken流为主要模型；比较Müller-Israel-Stewart型理论、动理学理论、全息方法和经典Yang-Mills场；使用发散梯度展开及其transseries完备化、状态空间图像、绝热流体化等理论工具；对核碰撞应用讨论粒子产生、横向能量与流、吸引背景初始化与线性响应、喷注淬火及吸引子启发的流体力学模型修正；对超冷费米气体综述散射长度驱动下体通道吸引子的理论提议，并与近期短时接触和动量分布动力学测量相区分。

papers.title: Balanced and broadly-normed meta-generalized gradient approximation
papers.abstract: Conventional semi-local density functional approximations for the exchange-correlation energy systematically underestimate fundamental band gaps. Advanced meta-generalized gradient approximations (meta-GGAs) can partially overcome this limitation through their orbital dependence via the kinetic energy density. In principle, the flexible meta-GGA form should allow for balanced performance across diverse properties. However, atomization energies, reaction barrier heights, and lattice constants, as well as band gaps, exhibit different sensitivities to the large parameter space of meta-GGA functionals. In this work, we explore the space of appropriate norms that guide the r$^2$SCAN-type functional construction through the interpolation function connecting two fundamental paradigms: the one-electron limit and the uniform electron gas limit. We introduce local modifications to a strongly-smoothed interpolation function and investigate their impact on functional performance. To further probe the limits of the meta-GGA framework, we include spin-unpolarized bonded systems among the set of norms. The resulting bonded-norm bn-r$^2$SCAN meta-GGA achieves balance: band-gap predictions approaching the accuracy of the ultra-nonlocal LAK meta-GGA and lattice constants of nearly r$^2$SCAN accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：density functional approximations、meta-GGA functionals、functional construction、interpolation function、norms、band-gap predictions、lattice constants——全文围绕密度泛函近似的形式构建与性能评估展开，属于理论/计算范畴。；研究对象：交换关联能的半局域密度泛函近似（meta-GGA 泛函），具体为 r²SCAN 型泛函的构建空间，以及其在带隙、晶格常数、原子化能、反应势垒高度等性质上的表现。涉及的物理体系包括自旋非极化成键体系（spin-unpolarized bonded systems）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过探索引导 r²SCAN 型泛函构建的适当范数空间，并对强平滑插值函数引入局部修改，同时将自旋非极化成键体系纳入范数集，所得到的成键范数 bn-r²SCAN meta-GGA 实现了平衡性能：带隙预测接近超非局域 LAK meta-GGA 的精度，晶格常数达到接近 r²SCAN 的精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过探索引导 r²SCAN 型泛函构建的适当范数空间，并对强平滑插值函数引入局部修改，同时将自旋非极化成键体系纳入范数集，所得到的成键范数 bn-r²SCAN meta-GGA 实现了平衡性能：带隙预测接近超非局域 LAK meta-GGA 的精度，晶格常数达到接近 r²SCAN 的精度。；创新点：在 r²SCAN 型泛函的插值函数上引入局部修改，并首次（据摘要所述）将自旋非极化成键体系纳入适当范数集，从而构建出 bn-r²SCAN 泛函，在带隙与晶格常数之间取得平衡，兼顾了此前难以同时满足的不同性质精度。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论框架下的 meta-GGA 泛函构建；通过连接单电子极限与均匀电子气极限的插值函数来探索适当范数空间；对强平滑插值函数进行局部修改并考察其对泛函性能的影响；在范数集中加入自旋非极化成键体系。

papers.title: Modular commutator as a robust topological invariant and approximate Markovianity
papers.abstract: The modular commutator provides a bulk, local, single-wave-function probe of the chiral central charge $c_-$ for gapped ground states. Its invariance under deformations was previously established under a local quantum Markov condition---namely, the conditional mutual information $I(A:C|B)$ is zero for all tripartitions of a disk into three consecutive strips A, B, and C \cite{Modular-commutator-Gapped}. However, the local quantum Markov condition also forces the probe to vanish, leaving open whether modular commutator remains robust in physically relevant states where the Markov property holds only approximately. In this paper, we resolve this tension for finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces: the approximate local quantum Markov property implies the change of the modular commutator under topology-preserving deformations vanishes asymptotically. We next prove trace-norm continuity of the modular commutator. Combining deformation invariance with trace-norm continuity, we establish that the modular commutator remains asymptotically invariant within gapped quantum phases connected by quasi-local unitary paths that preserve the approximate local quantum Markov condition. Conversely, by analyzing finite-time dynamics generated by modular Hamiltonians, we derive a quantitative lower bound on the conditional mutual information required for a non-zero modular commutator: $I(A:C|B)$ across such strip tripartitions cannot decay faster than exponentially with the width of B given that the state satisfies entanglement area law, extending the exact no-go theorem of \cite{strict-J-2024} to a quantitative finite bound . Finally, we demonstrate that those conclusions apply equally to the Hall conductance estimator \cite{FanSahayVishwanath2023}.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中讨论的是有限维希尔伯特空间中的严格数学证明（渐近不变性、迹范数连续性、定量下界），不涉及具体实验测量或数值计算。；研究对象：有能隙基态（gapped ground states）中的手性中心荷 $c_-$，以及作为其体态、局域、单波函数探针的模交换子（modular commutator）；同时涉及条件互信息 $I(A:C|B)$、近似局域量子马尔可夫性、以及霍尔电导估计量。摘要未明确说明具体材料或化合物体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限维希尔伯特空间中，近似局域量子马尔可夫条件足以保证模交换子在保持拓扑的形变下渐近不变，从而解决了此前"严格马尔可夫条件既保证不变性又迫使探针为零"的矛盾；反过来，若模交换子非零，则条带三分割下的条件互信息在满足纠缠面积律时不能比指数衰减更快，给出了定量的下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限维希尔伯特空间中，近似局域量子马尔可夫条件足以保证模交换子在保持拓扑的形变下渐近不变，从而解决了此前"严格马尔可夫条件既保证不变性又迫使探针为零"的矛盾；反过来，若模交换子非零，则条带三分割下的条件互信息在满足纠缠面积律时不能比指数衰减更快，给出了定量的下界。；创新点：将此前依赖严格局域量子马尔可夫条件的模交换子不变性结果推广到仅近似满足马尔可夫性的物理相关态；证明了模交换子的迹范数连续性；把关于非零模交换子的精确 no-go 定理（strict-J-2024）推广为定量的有限下界；并指出结论同样适用于霍尔电导估计量。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子信息论与凝聚态拓扑的结合：使用模交换子、条件互信息、局域量子马尔可夫条件、迹范数连续性、准局域幺正路径、模哈密顿量生成的有限时间动力学、纠缠面积律等工具进行严格数学证明。摘要未涉及具体数值方法（如 DMRG、DFT）或实验手段。

papers.title: Simultaneous sub-Doppler laser cooling and optical trapping of bosonic $^{39}$K-$^{133}$Cs and $^{41}$K-$^{133}$Cs mixtures
papers.abstract: We report simultaneous sub-Doppler cooling and optical dipole trapping of $^{39}$K-Cs and $^{41}$K-Cs mixtures. Both mixtures are cooled to temperatures $\sim10$ $\mathrmμ$K, achieving performance comparable to that obtained with each species individually. To the best of our knowledge, this constitutes the first realization of a laser-cooled and optically trapped $^{41}$K-Cs mixture. For the $^{39}$K-Cs mixture, we additionally implement parallel spin-resolved Feshbach spectroscopy enabled by Stern-Gerlach separation. For potassium isotopes, we implement sub-Doppler cooling with $D_1$-line gray molasses, while for cesium the entire cooling sequence is implemented using $D_2$ transitions. We spin-polarize the atoms and confine Bose-Bose mixtures in a 1064 nm optical dipole trap. Using the resulting $^{39}$K-Cs samples, we observe 14 heteronuclear Feshbach loss features. Five agree with resonances reported previously, while nine have, to the best of our knowledge, not been observed experimentally before, including $p$-wave features and resonances in additional spin channels. The shorter lifetime of the $^{41}$K-Cs mixture in the optical dipole trap currently hinders systematic Feshbach spectroscopy, which we therefore do not pursue in this work. To characterize this limitation quantitatively, we study the decay dynamics of $^{39}$K-Cs and $^{41}$K-Cs mixtures under comparable temperature and density conditions, revealing a substantially stronger nonexponential loss in the $^{41}$K-Cs mixture.
