The demonstrated preparation of ultracold $^{41}$K-Cs mixtures provides a starting point for Feshbach-resonance and photoassociation spectroscopy of this previously unexplored isotopologue. Such measurements are essential for identifying suitable pathways for magnetoassociation and coherent optical transfer, and ultimately for the production of ultracold ground-state $^{41}$KCs molecules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：论文摘要中出现“We report simultaneous sub-Doppler cooling and optical dipole trapping”“we implement”“we observe 14 heteronuclear Feshbach loss features”等表述，均为实验实现与实验观测的描述，未涉及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：玻色子 \(^{39}\)K-\(^{133}\)Cs 和 \(^{41}\)K-\(^{133}\)Cs 混合体系。具体研究内容包括：两种混合物的亚多普勒激光冷却与光偶极阱俘获、自旋极化后的玻色-玻色混合体系、\(^{39}\)K-Cs 的异核 Feshbach 损耗谱，以及两种混合物在光偶极阱中的衰减动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: (1) 同时实现了 \(^{39}\)K-Cs 和 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物的亚多普勒冷却与光偶极阱俘获，温度约 10 μK，性能与各单一组分单独冷却时相当；据作者所知，这是首次实现激光冷却并光阱俘获的 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物。(2) 在 \(^{39}\)K-Cs 样品中观测到 14 个异核 Feshbach 损耗特征，其中 5 个与先前报道的共振一致，9 个据作者所知为首次实验观测，包括 p 波特征和额外自旋通道中的共振。(3) \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物在光偶极阱中寿命较短，表现出明显更强的非指数损耗，目前阻碍了对其系统性的 Feshbach 光谱研究。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：(1) 同时实现了 \(^{39}\)K-Cs 和 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物的亚多普勒冷却与光偶极阱俘获，温度约 10 μK，性能与各单一组分单独冷却时相当；据作者所知，这是首次实现激光冷却并光阱俘获的 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物。(2) 在 \(^{39}\)K-Cs 样品中观测到 14 个异核 Feshbach 损耗特征，其中 5 个与先前报道的共振一致，9 个据作者所知为首次实验观测，包括 p 波特征和额外自旋通道中的共振。(3) \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物在光偶极阱中寿命较短，表现出明显更强的非指数损耗，目前阻碍了对其系统性的 Feshbach 光谱研究。；创新点：(1) 首次实现激光冷却并光偶极阱俘获的 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物。(2) 在 \(^{39}\)K-Cs 中通过并行自旋分辨 Feshbach 光谱观测到 14 个异核 Feshbach 损耗特征，其中 9 个为首次实验观测，包括 p 波特征和额外自旋通道中的共振。(3) 为此前未被探索的同位素体 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 的超冷制备提供了起点，可用于后续 Feshbach 共振和光缔合光谱研究，进而为磁缔合、相干光学转移以及最终制备超冷基态 \(^{41}\)KCs 分子奠定基础。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：对钾同位素使用 D\(_1\) 线灰色黏胶（gray molasses）实现亚多普勒冷却；对铯的整个冷却序列使用 D\(_2\) 跃迁；对原子进行自旋极化；使用 1064 nm 光偶极阱约束玻色-玻色混合物；通过 Stern-Gerlach 分离实现并行的自旋分辨 Feshbach 光谱；在可比温度和密度条件下研究 \(^{39}\)K-Cs 与 \(^{41}\)K-Cs 混合物的衰减动力学。

papers.title: The inverse problem of time-dependent density functional theory on the torus
papers.abstract: We prove that, for any given sufficiently regular one-particle density, there exists a unique external potential for which the solution to the many-body Schrödinger equation has this prescribed density. This implies in particular that one can exactly reproduce the time-dependent density of an interacting system using non-interacting electrons, which is at the heart of time-dependent density functional theory. Our result covers the Coulomb interaction and densities arising from extended nuclei.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确使用“We prove”（我们证明）、“there exists a unique external potential”等数学证明性表述，属于严格的理论推导工作，不涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：环面上的多体薛定谔方程体系，具体涉及含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）中的逆问题：给定一个足够规则的单粒子密度，研究是否存在唯一的外部势使得多体薛定谔方程的解具有该指定密度。摘要提及该结果覆盖库仑相互作用和由扩展核产生的密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于任意给定的足够规则的单粒子密度，存在唯一的外部势使得多体薛定谔方程的解具有该密度；这意味着可以用非相互作用电子精确重现相互作用体系的含时密度，从而为含时密度泛函理论提供了严格的数学基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于任意给定的足够规则的单粒子密度，存在唯一的外部势使得多体薛定谔方程的解具有该密度；这意味着可以用非相互作用电子精确重现相互作用体系的含时密度，从而为含时密度泛函理论提供了严格的数学基础。；创新点：在环面几何上严格证明了含时密度泛函理论逆问题的唯一性，且结果覆盖库仑相互作用和扩展核产生的密度。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 严格的数学证明方法，在环面（torus）几何上对含时多体薛定谔方程的逆问题进行论证。摘要未明确说明具体的数学工具或技术路线（如泛函分析、不动点定理等）。

papers.title: Restart and first detection in a lackadaisical quantum walk with flat-band localization
papers.abstract: We study stochastic and sharp restart in a one-dimensional lackadaisical discrete-time quantum walk with self-loop weight $\ell$. In the absence of restart, the dynamics has a flat band responsible for intrinsic localization and two dispersive bands supporting ballistic propagation. We compare two initially localized benchmark states: a flat-band-active state with finite flat-band overlap and a flat-band-dark state with zero flat-band overlap. For geometric stochastic restart with per-step restart probability $q$, the stationary mean-squared displacement scales as $q^{-2}$ as $q\to0$. In the same limit, the restart-site occupation probability approaches the restart-free intrinsic localized value for the flat-band-active state, whereas for the flat-band-dark state it vanishes as $q\ln(1/q)$. For power-law restart, where $p_m\propto m^{-s}$ is the probability that the waiting time to the next restart is $m$ steps, a normalized stationary site-occupation distribution exists only for $s>2$, while the stationary absolute spatial moment of order $p$ is finite only for $s>p+2$. In the regime $1<s\leq2$, at every fixed lattice site, the flat-band-active occupation converges to the intrinsic flat-band profile, while the flat-band-dark occupation tends to zero. We also consider monitored first detection with sharp restart, in which the walk is reinitialized after a fixed number $r$ of consecutive unsuccessful measurements. For fixed $r$, the mean first-detected-passage time of the flat-band-active state exhibits a minimum at an intermediate self-loop weight, whereas the flat-band-dark state approaches a ballistic detection limit as $\ell\to\infty$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：离散时间量子行走、平带局域化、随机重启与锐利重启、稳态占据分布、平均首次探测通过时间等，均为理论模型与解析/数值分析，摘要中未涉及实验或具体材料计算。；研究对象：一维“懒散型”（lackadaisical）离散时间量子行走，带自环权重 ℓ。研究其中由平带导致的本征局域化、两条色散带的弹道传播，以及两类初始局域态（平带活跃态与平带暗态）在随机重启、幂律重启和带锐利重启的监测首次探测下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于几何随机重启（每步重启概率 q），稳态均方位移在 q→0 时按 q^{-2} 标度；平带活跃态的重启位置占据概率趋于无重启时的本征局域值，而平带暗态则以 q ln(1/q) 趋于零。对于幂律重启（等待时间分布 p_m ∝ m^{-s}），归一化稳态占据分布仅当 s>2 时存在，p 阶绝对空间矩仅当 s>p+2 时有限；在 1<s≤2 时，平带活跃态在每个格点收敛到本征平带分布，平带暗态趋于零。在带锐利重启的监测首次探测中，固定重启间隔 r 时，平带活跃态的平均首次探测通过时间在中间自环权重处出现极小值，而平带暗态在 ℓ→∞ 时趋于弹道探测极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于几何随机重启（每步重启概率 q），稳态均方位移在 q→0 时按 q^{-2} 标度；平带活跃态的重启位置占据概率趋于无重启时的本征局域值，而平带暗态则以 q ln(1/q) 趋于零。对于幂律重启（等待时间分布 p_m ∝ m^{-s}），归一化稳态占据分布仅当 s>2 时存在，p 阶绝对空间矩仅当 s>p+2 时有限；在 1<s≤2 时，平带活跃态在每个格点收敛到本征平带分布，平带暗态趋于零。在带锐利重启的监测首次探测中，固定重启间隔 r 时，平带活跃态的平均首次探测通过时间在中间自环权重处出现极小值，而平带暗态在 ℓ→∞ 时趋于弹道探测极限。；创新点：将随机重启与锐利重启、监测首次探测引入带平带局域化的懒散型量子行走，区分平带活跃态与平带暗态，并给出重启下稳态标度、幂律重启的收敛条件以及首次探测时间随自环权重的非单调行为。摘要未突出说明与已有重启量子行走或平带局域化研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为带自环权重的一维懒散型离散时间量子行走；采用随机重启（几何分布）与幂律重启的随机过程分析，计算稳态均方位移、稳态位置占据分布与空间矩的标度行为；并对带锐利重启的监测首次探测过程计算平均首次探测通过时间。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值模拟或具体解析技巧。

papers.title: Dynamic Sensing via Photomodulated Gas Desorption in Plasmonic Nanoparticle Chemiresistors
papers.abstract: Quasi-static sensing, i.e., measurement of a sensor signal change induced by analyte presence with respect to a baseline signal observed in a reference gas beforehand, is the state of the art for qualitative and quantitative analyte identification in chemiresistive sensing. However, this approach is prone to baseline drift and, especially for inexpensive miniaturized point-of-care sensors, repeated calibration with reference gas is not feasible. To access reliable baseline information, active switching between analyte and reference gas would be required, causing a limitation for miniaturized implementation. Dynamic excitation of sensors offers an alternative: Via external stimuli the sensor is reversibly driven out of equilibrium in a controlled way, and the resulting transient sensor response, which is dependent on analytes present, is recorded and interpreted. Correlation of excitation and response signals can reduce effects of baseline drift and furthermore, dynamic features in sensor responses may contain valuable information. Especially light activation is a powerful and potentially miniaturizable approach to agitate sorption processes and therefore induce dynamics. In this work we report photothermal heating of hybrid, chemiresistive gold nanoparticle composites via LED excitation matching the plasmon resonance, to dynamically shift the analyte sorption equilibrium and induce dynamic sensor responses in a highly controlled way. We demonstrate that these sensor responses enable the detection of volatile organic compounds (VOC) via interpretation of differential signal components and that this approach improves the chemiresistors' baseline stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：report、demonstrate、LED excitation、photothermal heating、sensor responses 等，表明工作以实验演示为主。；研究对象：混合型化学电阻式金纳米颗粒复合材料（hybrid chemiresistive gold nanoparticle composites），以及其中通过等离激元共振匹配的 LED 光照引发的光热加热效应，用于动态调控分析物吸附平衡并产生动态传感器响应，检测挥发性有机化合物（VOC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过匹配等离激元共振的 LED 激发对金纳米颗粒复合化学电阻器进行光热加热，可动态移动分析物吸附平衡并以高度可控的方式诱导动态传感器响应；这些响应通过差分信号分量的解读可实现 VOC 检测，并改善化学电阻器的基线稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过匹配等离激元共振的 LED 激发对金纳米颗粒复合化学电阻器进行光热加热，可动态移动分析物吸附平衡并以高度可控的方式诱导动态传感器响应；这些响应通过差分信号分量的解读可实现 VOC 检测，并改善化学电阻器的基线稳定性。；创新点：相对于传统的准静态传感（依赖预先在参考气体中测量的基线信号，易受基线漂移影响且难以小型化重复校准），本工作提出利用光激活（等离激元共振匹配的 LED 光热加热）动态驱动传感器偏离平衡，通过瞬态响应和差分信号解读实现 VOC 检测，并提升基线稳定性，且该方法具有潜在的小型化优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：对混合化学电阻式金纳米颗粒复合材料施加与等离激元共振匹配的 LED 激发，利用光热加热动态调控吸附平衡，记录瞬态传感器响应，并通过激发信号与响应信号的相关性以及差分信号分量进行解读。摘要未明确说明具体的材料合成方法、表征手段或理论计算框架。

papers.title: From Local Context to Climate Science: Low-Cost Experimentation in the Initial Training of Physics Teachers
papers.abstract: Climate change poses a major scientific, environmental, and educational challenge, requiring approaches that connect physical concepts, empirical evidence, and socially relevant environmental issues. This study presents and analyzes a low-cost experimental investigation developed within the "Physics and the Environment" course of a Physics teacher training program at the State University of the Tocantina Region of Maranhão (UEMASUL), Brazil. The experiment involved constructing a simplified thermal simulator using accessible materials and comparing a confined system with an open control system, both exposed simultaneously to solar radiation. The results showed that the average temperature inside the simulator was $45.91^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, compared to $38.58^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ in the external control system, corresponding to a mean temperature difference of $7.33^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ (among other analyses). These results demonstrate that the experimental setup was capable of producing and measuring a significant thermal difference between the two systems. However, the observed temperature rise should not be interpreted as a direct measure of the atmospheric greenhouse effect, given that the experimental apparatus involves both radiative and non-radiative heat transfer mechanisms. The study emphasizes the educational potential of low-cost experimentation as a strategy to integrate electromagnetic radiation, energy balance, temperature, heat transfer, and climate science into the initial training of physics teachers. It also highlights the importance of explicitly discussing the limitations of experimental models and distinguishing local experimental evidence from conclusions regarding global climate processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（教育实验研究）。判断依据的关键词：low-cost experimental investigation、constructing a simplified thermal simulator、results showed、experimental setup、measured a significant thermal difference。；研究对象：巴西 UEMASUL 物理教师培训项目“物理与环境”课程中的低成本热学模拟实验装置：用易得材料搭建的简化热模拟器（封闭系统）与开放对照系统，两者同时暴露于太阳辐射下，研究其热行为差异。涉及物理现象包括电磁辐射、能量平衡、温度、热传递以及气候科学教育。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 封闭模拟器内部平均温度为 45.91°C，外部对照系统为 38.58°C，平均温差 7.33°C，表明该实验装置能够产生并测量两系统间显著的热差异；但作者强调该温升不应被直接解释为大气温室效应的直接测量，因为装置涉及辐射与非辐射两种热传递机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：封闭模拟器内部平均温度为 45.91°C，外部对照系统为 38.58°C，平均温差 7.33°C，表明该实验装置能够产生并测量两系统间显著的热差异；但作者强调该温升不应被直接解释为大气温室效应的直接测量，因为装置涉及辐射与非辐射两种热传递机制。；创新点：将低成本实验与气候科学教育结合，用于物理教师初始培训，强调在教学中显式讨论实验模型的局限性，并区分局部实验证据与全球气候过程结论；摘要未突出说明其在物理实验技术层面的新意，创新主要体现在教育实践与教学策略层面。
papers.method_zh: 低成本实验法：用可获取材料构建简化热模拟器，设置封闭系统与开放对照系统，同时置于太阳辐射下进行对比测量，分析温度差异；属于教师初始培训课程中的实验教学研究，未涉及 DFT、DMRG、ARPES 等计算或谱学手段。

papers.title: Structure-Informed Bayesian Inference of Anomalous Transport and Hidden Molecular Trapping in Amorphous Media
papers.abstract: Molecular diffusion in fluctuating amorphous and macromolecular media governs key transport processes across soft-matter physics, energy storage, and biological membranes. Extracting localized trapping states from single-particle tracking trajectories remains a fundamental challenge; because thermal structural breathing continuously reconfigures pore boundaries, conventional geometric algorithms suffer from severe systematic biases, erroneously merging distinct localized states during cyclic molecular returns. Here, we address this deadlock by shifting the paradigm from local geometric recurrence to a structure-informed Bayesian regularization. Leveraging discrete Morse theory, we extract the time-invariant topological skeleton of the fluctuating host matrix to construct robust, gas-specific physical priors that account for individual molecular dimensions. Trajectory steps are sequentially partitioned via a two-stage probabilistic refinement that dynamically adapts to the transport landscape. Benchmarked against a rigorous environment where synthetic particles explore the actual interconnected matrix graph, our approach eliminates systemic biases, restricting macroscopic trapping parameter deviations to just a few percent under optimal linear $O(N)$ computational scaling. Applied to hydrogen and methane transport within a type-I kerogen matrix, serving as a prototype for highly tortuous, flexible macromolecular networks, the method successfully decodes the hidden microscopic mechanisms of confined diffusion. To ensure immediate broad impact, the documented open-source code and data are made publicly available, offering an accessible strategy readily adaptable to a broad spectrum of tracking phenomena, from ion transport in battery polymers to protein trafficking within cellular environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（含方法开发与数值基准测试）。关键依据：摘要中出现“Bayesian regularization”“discrete Morse theory”“two-stage probabilistic refinement”“benchmarked against a rigorous environment where synthetic particles explore the actual interconnected matrix graph”“$O(N)$ computational scaling”“open-source code and data”等，表明工作以理论/计算方法构建与数值验证为主，而非实验测量。；研究对象：非晶及大分子介质中分子的异常输运与隐藏的局域捕获现象；具体应用体系为 type-I kerogen 基质中的氢气和甲烷输运，作为高度迂曲、柔性大分子网络的原型。核心物理问题是单粒子追踪轨迹中局域捕获态的提取，以及热结构呼吸导致孔边界持续重构时传统几何算法的系统性偏差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过从局部几何回归转向结构信息驱动的贝叶斯正则化，利用离散 Morse 理论提取涨落宿主基质的时间不变拓扑骨架来构建物理先验，可在合成粒子沿真实互连基质图扩散的严格基准中消除系统性偏差，使宏观捕获参数偏差在最优线性 $O(N)$ 计算标度下限制在百分之几；在 type-I kerogen 中的氢/甲烷输运中成功解析了受限扩散的隐藏微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过从局部几何回归转向结构信息驱动的贝叶斯正则化，利用离散 Morse 理论提取涨落宿主基质的时间不变拓扑骨架来构建物理先验，可在合成粒子沿真实互连基质图扩散的严格基准中消除系统性偏差，使宏观捕获参数偏差在最优线性 $O(N)$ 计算标度下限制在百分之几；在 type-I kerogen 中的氢/甲烷输运中成功解析了受限扩散的隐藏微观机制。；创新点：范式转变：从局部几何回归转向结构信息驱动的贝叶斯正则化；利用离散 Morse 理论提取涨落宿主基质的时间不变拓扑骨架，构建稳健且气体特异的物理先验以纳入分子尺寸；两阶段概率细化动态适应输运景观；在严格基准中消除系统性偏差并将宏观捕获参数偏差限制在百分之几，同时保持线性 $O(N)$ 计算标度；成功解码 type-I kerogen 中氢/甲烷受限扩散的隐藏微观机制；公开开源代码和数据，便于推广到电池聚合物中的离子输运、细胞环境中的蛋白质运输等广泛追踪现象。
papers.method_zh: 结构信息驱动的贝叶斯正则化；离散 Morse 理论提取涨落宿主基质的时间不变拓扑骨架；构建考虑单个分子尺寸的气体特异性物理先验；对轨迹步进行两阶段概率细化并动态适应输运景观；在合成粒子探索真实互连基质图的严格环境中进行基准测试；应用于 type-I kerogen 基质中氢气和甲烷输运；计算复杂度为线性 $O(N)$；提供开源代码和数据。

papers.title: Magic-free coexisting photonic and phononic moiré flat bands
papers.abstract: Moiré flat bands enhance localization and interactions through suppressed group velocity, but existing approaches largely target a single physical field because distinct excitations generally require different, finely tuned magic configurations. Here we introduce a flat-band mechanism based on strong diffractive hybridization among moiré-folded bands. Period-mismatched modulations open distinct coupling channels whose hybridization renormalizes the band dispersion. An effective Hamiltonian shows that increasing the diffractive coupling progressively suppresses the group velocity, driving the system toward a flat-band regime without field-specific magic configurations. This coupling-induced mechanism enables band flattening across distinct physical excitations. We demonstrate this mechanism in a single-layer moiré optomechanical crystal, where photonic and phononic flat bands are simultaneously realized, and their localized modes and optomechanical interaction are experimentally observed. Beyond photonic and phononic systems, this mechanism may extend to other wave and quasiparticle platforms, providing a general route to co-localizing and coupling distinct physical fields in moiré systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据关键词：提出机制并给出有效哈密顿量（理论），同时在单层莫尔光力晶体中实现并“experimentally observed”（实验）。；研究对象：单层莫尔光力晶体（moiré optomechanical crystal）中的光子与声子莫尔平带，以及其中局域模式和光力相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于莫尔折叠能带间强衍射杂化的平带机制：周期失配调制打开不同耦合通道，杂化重整化能带色散，随衍射耦合增强而逐步抑制群速度，从而无需特定场的“魔角”配置即可实现平带；并在单层莫尔光力晶体中同时实现光子与声子平带，实验观测到其局域模式和光力相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于莫尔折叠能带间强衍射杂化的平带机制：周期失配调制打开不同耦合通道，杂化重整化能带色散，随衍射耦合增强而逐步抑制群速度，从而无需特定场的“魔角”配置即可实现平带；并在单层莫尔光力晶体中同时实现光子与声子平带，实验观测到其局域模式和光力相互作用。；创新点：现有平带方法多针对单一物理场且需精细调节的“魔角”配置；本工作提出无需场特定魔角配置的耦合诱导平带机制，可跨不同物理激发实现能带平坦化，并在同一单层莫尔光力晶体中同时实现光子与声子平带及其局域模式和相互作用，且该机制可能推广到其他波与准粒子平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于莫尔折叠能带间衍射杂化的有效哈密顿量分析；实验手段：在单层莫尔光力晶体中实现并观测光子/声子平带、局域模式及光力相互作用（摘要未明确说明具体实验测量技术，如光谱、显微或泵浦-探测等）。

papers.title: MLIP Detective: Active Failure Mode Discovery Beyond Benchmark Scores for Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (u-MLIPs) aim to generalize across diverse configurations. Benchmarks enable reproducible evaluation but may not expose failures outside their predefined scope. Here, we show that physics-informed search can complement benchmark-based evaluation by uncovering hidden failure modes. We introduce MLIP Detective, an agentic framework for active failure mode discovery. Starting from benchmark evidence, MLIP Detective generates falsifiable, physics-informed failure hypotheses, screens them with inexpensive simulations, and escalates only the most suspicious cases to human experts together with proposed verification protocols. Without issue-specific prompting, MLIP Detective identified and characterized a systematic anomaly in MACE-MPA-0: the model predicted some relaxed adsorbate-surface systems involving O- or F-containing adsorbates to be higher in energy than their corresponding separated fragments. Using cross-model comparisons, MLIP Detective further inferred a likely training-data origin for the anomaly, consistent with recent reports.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、physics-informed search、simulations、cross-model comparisons、training-data origin。属于以计算方法/框架开发为主的研究，不涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：通用机器学习原子间势（u-MLIPs），具体以 MACE-MPA-0 模型为案例，研究其在吸附物-表面体系（含 O 或 F 的吸附物）中的失效模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MLIP Detective 在无需针对特定问题提示的情况下，发现并刻画了 MACE-MPA-0 的一个系统性异常：模型预测某些含 O 或 F 吸附物的弛豫吸附物-表面体系能量高于其对应分离碎片；并通过跨模型比较推断该异常可能源于训练数据，与近期报道一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MLIP Detective 在无需针对特定问题提示的情况下，发现并刻画了 MACE-MPA-0 的一个系统性异常：模型预测某些含 O 或 F 吸附物的弛豫吸附物-表面体系能量高于其对应分离碎片；并通过跨模型比较推断该异常可能源于训练数据，与近期报道一致。；创新点：提出了一种超越传统基准评分的主动失效模式发现框架，用物理信息驱动的搜索补充基准评估，能够揭示基准预设范围之外的隐藏失效模式；且无需针对具体问题的提示即可自动发现并刻画异常。
papers.method_zh: 提出 MLIP Detective 智能体框架，流程包括：从基准证据出发生成可证伪的、物理信息驱动的失效假设，用低成本模拟进行筛选，仅将最可疑的案例连同建议的验证协议提交给人类专家；并使用跨模型比较推断异常来源。

papers.title: Non-Markovian dynamics of a qubit on the zigzag edge of photonic graphene
papers.abstract: We present an analytical study of the dynamics of a qubit coupled to the zigzag edge of a photonic honeycomb lattice. Leveraging a resolvent operator approach and exact lattice Green's functions, we map the spectrum of qubit-photon bound states and complex poles to uncover the long-time scaling laws of the qubit population. Unlike a qubit coupled to the bulk of graphene, the presence of a zero-energy flat band connecting the Dirac points suppresses long-time branch-cut-induced tails, instead driving damped Rabi oscillations. Potential experimental platforms are briefly discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：analytical study、resolvent operator approach、exact lattice Green's functions、map the spectrum。；研究对象：耦合到光子蜂窝晶格（photonic graphene）锯齿型边缘（zigzag edge）的量子比特（qubit）的动力学行为，具体关注量子比特-光子束缚态谱及量子比特布居数的长时标度律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 与耦合到石墨烯体态的量子比特不同，锯齿型边缘存在连接狄拉克点的零能平带，该平带抑制了长时分支割（branch-cut）诱导的尾部衰减，转而驱动阻尼拉比振荡（damped Rabi oscillations）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：与耦合到石墨烯体态的量子比特不同，锯齿型边缘存在连接狄拉克点的零能平带，该平带抑制了长时分支割（branch-cut）诱导的尾部衰减，转而驱动阻尼拉比振荡（damped Rabi oscillations）。；创新点：揭示了光子石墨烯锯齿型边缘的零能平带对量子比特非马尔可夫动力学的独特影响——抑制分支割诱导的长时尾部并产生阻尼拉比振荡，这与体态耦合情形形成鲜明对比。摘要还简要讨论了潜在的实验平台，但未明确说明具体平台。
papers.method_zh: 解析方法：采用预解算子方法（resolvent operator approach）和精确晶格格林函数（exact lattice Green's functions），通过映射量子比特-光子束缚态谱和复极点来揭示量子比特布居数的长时标度律。

papers.title: Instantaneous-Frame Theory of Strongly Driven Parametric Gates
papers.abstract: Parametric two-qubit gates using tunable couplers are a promising approach to scalable superconducting quantum processors. However, conventional theories formulated in the idle eigenbasis break down in the large-amplitude regime required for fast gate operations. Here, we show that parametric gates are more naturally and accurately described as coherent rotations between instantaneous eigenstates rather than idle eigenstates. This approach may appear counterintuitive, since instantaneous eigenbases are usually associated with adiabatic dynamics. However, they also form a natural moving frame for driven dynamics, where the non-Abelian Berry connection governs transitions and provides a compact description of the exchange and effective $ZZ$ couplings. We show that this theory achieves quantitative agreement with exact numerical simulations across representative tunable-coupler architectures, including double-transmon, capacitively shunted double-transmon, and single-transmon couplers. The description remains accurate even in regimes where idle-frame descriptions fail, while substantially reducing the reliance on computationally demanding exact simulations. These results establish an instantaneous-frame theory of parametric gates beyond conventional idle-frame models and provide a new perspective on driven quantum dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：论文提出“instantaneous-frame theory”，以理论推导和与“exact numerical simulations”的对比验证为主，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：可调耦合器（tunable coupler）架构中的强驱动参数化两量子比特门（parametric two-qubit gates），具体包括 double-transmon、capacitively shunted double-transmon 和 single-transmon coupler 三类代表性架构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 参数化门在瞬时本征基（instantaneous eigenstates）下更自然、更准确地被描述为相干旋转，而非传统 idle 本征基下的描述；非阿贝尔 Berry 连接（non-Abelian Berry connection）主导跃迁，并给出交换耦合与有效 ZZ 耦合的紧凑描述。该理论在 idle-frame 描述失效的大振幅区域仍与精确数值模拟定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：参数化门在瞬时本征基（instantaneous eigenstates）下更自然、更准确地被描述为相干旋转，而非传统 idle 本征基下的描述；非阿贝尔 Berry 连接（non-Abelian Berry connection）主导跃迁，并给出交换耦合与有效 ZZ 耦合的紧凑描述。该理论在 idle-frame 描述失效的大振幅区域仍与精确数值模拟定量一致。；创新点：相对于传统在 idle 本征基下建立的理论，本文提出用瞬时本征基作为驱动动力学的自然移动框架，突破了传统理论在快速门操作所需大振幅区域的失效问题，同时显著减少对计算昂贵的精确模拟的依赖，为驱动量子动力学提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为瞬时帧（instantaneous-frame）理论，核心是瞬时本征基与非阿贝尔 Berry 连接；验证手段为与精确数值模拟进行定量对比，覆盖三种可调耦合器架构。

papers.title: Physics of Information Geometry - Part I: Principle of Least Action on the Probability Simplex
papers.abstract: We develop a least-action framework for describing how a probability distribution can evolve from an equilibrium state to a prescribed nonequilibrium state under constrained incremental changes. Taking a Gibbs distribution as the equilibrium reference, the framework gives a direct physical meaning to the geometry of the probability simplex: distance from equilibrium corresponds to nonequilibrium free energy, while changes between successive distributions carry an informational kinetic cost. The Pythagorean structure of relative entropy then provides the central insight of the work. It shows that intermediate distributions chosen via sequential information projections can reduce the kinetic cost of large transitions and establishes an energy-conservation-like relation between the kinetic expenditure along a path and the free energy accumulated in reaching the target distribution. Motivated by this geometry, we construct a greedy least-action path through successive information projections, obtain a closed-form characterization of each projection through the Lambert W function, and establish a finite-step performance guarantee. We further show that state-dependent costs can be incorporated naturally by reshaping the underlying Gibbs reference, providing a thermodynamic interpretation of path penalties as modifications of the effective energy landscape. Together, these results provide a unified view of distributional evolution through least action, information geometry, and nonequilibrium thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：develop a least-action framework、Pythagorean structure of relative entropy、closed-form characterization、Lambert W function、finite-step performance guarantee。摘要中未涉及任何实验或数值计算细节，属于纯理论/形式化推导工作。；研究对象：概率单纯形（probability simplex）上的概率分布演化。具体研究一个概率分布如何在受约束的增量变化下，从平衡态（以 Gibbs 分布为参考）演化到指定的非平衡态。这是一个统计物理/信息几何层面的抽象体系，而非具体材料或量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相对熵的 Pythagorean 结构表明，通过序贯信息投影选择的中间分布可以降低大转变的“动力学代价”，并在路径上的动力学消耗与到达目标分布所积累的自由能之间建立了一个类能量守恒关系。由此可构造一条贪心最小作用量路径，并给出有限步性能保证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相对熵的 Pythagorean 结构表明，通过序贯信息投影选择的中间分布可以降低大转变的“动力学代价”，并在路径上的动力学消耗与到达目标分布所积累的自由能之间建立了一个类能量守恒关系。由此可构造一条贪心最小作用量路径，并给出有限步性能保证。；创新点：将最小作用量原理、信息几何与非平衡热力学统一起来描述分布演化：赋予概率单纯形几何以直接物理意义（到平衡态的距离对应非平衡自由能，连续分布间的变化携带信息动力学代价）；利用相对熵的 Pythagorean 结构证明序贯信息投影可降低大转变的动力学代价，并建立类能量守恒关系；给出投影的 Lambert W 闭式解与有限步性能保证；并说明状态依赖代价可通过重塑 Gibbs 参考纳入，从而将路径惩罚解释为有效能垒的修改。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为最小作用量原理 + 信息几何（概率单纯形上的几何、相对熵的 Pythagorean 结构、信息投影）。技术手段包括：以 Gibbs 分布为平衡参考、序贯信息投影构造路径、用 Lambert W 函数给出每次投影的闭式刻画、通过重塑底层 Gibbs 参考来纳入状态依赖代价。

papers.title: Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. We provide a mechanistic explanation and experimental evidence for why wavelet encodings are well matched to the dual spatial-spectral structure of the FNO, enabling deterministic mode selection on both continuous-valued and binary-valued geometries within a single model, and for why prediction accuracy varies with geometric discontinuities. For metamaterial design, the resulting surrogate accelerates the simulation stage of the design cycle by three orders of magnitude relative to finite element analysis on a consumer-grade CPU, while preserving high fidelity. These results also carry broader implications for designing input encodings in other multi-mode PDE solvers based on spectral neural operators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（机器学习方法开发与数值验证）。关键依据：以神经网络算子（FNO）构建代理模型、与有限元分析对比、在CPU上加速仿真，摘要中未涉及实际样品制备或实验测量。；研究对象：弹性波方程的本征值/本征模式问题，具体为声波在任意超材料几何结构中传播的形变模式（本征模），涉及连续值与二值化两类几何构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与小波编码的PDE输入相结合，可在单一模型中学习并预测弹性波方程的多个本征模，并实现确定性的模式选择；小波编码与FNO的双重空间-谱结构相匹配，且预测精度随几何不连续性的变化而变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与小波编码的PDE输入相结合，可在单一模型中学习并预测弹性波方程的多个本征模，并实现确定性的模式选择；小波编码与FNO的双重空间-谱结构相匹配，且预测精度随几何不连续性的变化而变化。；创新点：针对标准算子学习假设唯一输入-输出映射、难以处理本征值问题（需同时求解本征参数与多个有效本征模之一）的困难，提出小波编码的FNO框架以在单一模型中学习多本征模并实现确定性模式选择；在超材料设计中将仿真阶段相对有限元分析加速三个数量级且保持高保真度；并对多模PDE谱神经算子的输入编码设计给出更广泛的启示。
papers.method_zh: Fourier Neural Operators（FNO）结合基于小波的PDE输入编码，用于求解弹性波方程的本征值问题；以有限元分析（FEA）作为对比基准，在消费级CPU上评估加速效果；并给出关于小波编码与FNO空间-谱结构匹配机理的解释及实验证据。

papers.title: Capacitance of Undoped Thin-Film Diodes
papers.abstract: The capacitance of thin-film diodes based on undoped semiconductors are dominated by injected charge carriers rather than doping-induced carriers. However, an analytical framework of the capacitance in these devices has remained elusive. Here, we derive an analytical description of the capacitance, fully accounting for injected charge carrier and electrode charge effects. Based on these findings, a method to extract the built-in voltage in these devices is presented. The theoretical framework is substantiated numerically by drift-diffusion simulations and experimentally on organic solar cells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型。判断依据的关键词：derive an analytical description（理论推导）、substantiated numerically by drift-diffusion simulations（数值模拟）、experimentally on organic solar cells（实验验证）。；研究对象：基于未掺杂半导体的薄膜二极管（thin-film diodes），具体实验体系为有机太阳能电池（organic solar cells）。研究的具体物理现象是这类器件的电容行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 未掺杂薄膜二极管的电容由注入的电荷载流子（而非掺杂诱导的载流子）主导；作者推导出了该电容的解析描述，该描述完整地考虑了注入电荷载流子和电极电荷效应，并基于此提出了提取内建电压（built-in voltage）的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：未掺杂薄膜二极管的电容由注入的电荷载流子（而非掺杂诱导的载流子）主导；作者推导出了该电容的解析描述，该描述完整地考虑了注入电荷载流子和电极电荷效应，并基于此提出了提取内建电压（built-in voltage）的方法。；创新点：此前这类器件电容的解析框架一直缺失（remained elusive），本文首次给出了完整考虑注入电荷载流子和电极电荷效应的电容解析描述，并据此提出了提取内建电压的方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（解析框架）＋漂移-扩散模拟（drift-diffusion simulations）进行数值验证＋在有机太阳能电池上进行实验验证。

papers.title: Transcription rate dynamics and RNA copy number noise: General relations and data-driven predictions
papers.abstract: Stochastic models of gene expression typically begin with a microscopic model of transcription and propagate its statistics to the RNA distribution. Here we develop a doubly stochastic framework in which RNA production is Poisson conditional on a time-varying transcription rate $λ(t)$. For RNA lifetimes drawn independently from an arbitrary finite-mean distribution, we derive the RNA Fano factor in terms of the lifetime survival function and the autocovariance of $λ(t)$. For a Poisson degradation process with rate $μ$, the survival kernel provides an exponential temporal filter, and the result depends only on the mean, variance, and normalized autocorrelation of $λ(t)$. These quantities may be calculated from an explicit rate model or, under ergodicity and adequate sampling, estimated from a sufficiently long rate trajectory. We validate the data-driven estimator using simulated transcription-rate trajectories, without supplying the known autocorrelation to the estimator. We also obtain exact analytical results for transcription-rate dynamics modeled by a discrete M/M/1 process and by drift-diffusion with reflecting, periodic, or first-passage-reset boundaries, and verify each result by direct simulation of the coupled transcription-rate and RNA copy-number processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算验证）。判断依据的关键词：stochastic models、doubly stochastic framework、derive the RNA Fano factor、exact analytical results、verify each result by direct simulation。摘要中未提及任何实验手段或实验数据，全部为解析推导与数值模拟验证。；研究对象：基因表达中的转录过程：以时变转录速率 λ(t) 产生 RNA 的随机模型，以及由此产生的 RNA 拷贝数噪声（以 RNA Fano factor 表征）。具体涵盖 RNA 寿命服从任意有限均值分布的一般情形、Poisson 降解过程（速率 μ），以及离散 M/M/1 转录速率动力学和带反射、周期、首达重置边界的漂移-扩散转录速率模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 RNA 产生对时变转录速率 λ(t) 条件为 Poisson 的双重随机框架下，RNA Fano factor 可由寿命生存函数与 λ(t) 的自协方差解析表达；当降解为速率 μ 的 Poisson 过程时，生存核给出指数时间滤波，结果仅依赖 λ(t) 的均值、方差和归一化自相关。此外，对 M/M/1 及三类边界条件的漂移-扩散速率模型给出了精确解析结果，并均通过直接模拟验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 RNA 产生对时变转录速率 λ(t) 条件为 Poisson 的双重随机框架下，RNA Fano factor 可由寿命生存函数与 λ(t) 的自协方差解析表达；当降解为速率 μ 的 Poisson 过程时，生存核给出指数时间滤波，结果仅依赖 λ(t) 的均值、方差和归一化自相关。此外，对 M/M/1 及三类边界条件的漂移-扩散速率模型给出了精确解析结果，并均通过直接模拟验证。；创新点：将 RNA 噪声（Fano factor）用寿命生存函数与转录速率自协方差的一般形式表达，而非局限于特定微观转录模型；指出在 Poisson 降解下结果只依赖 λ(t) 的前两阶矩与归一化自相关，从而允许在遍历性和充分采样条件下直接从足够长的速率轨迹估计这些量（数据驱动估计器），并在不提供已知自相关的情况下用模拟轨迹验证；同时给出 M/M/1 与多种边界条件漂移-扩散速率模型的精确解析结果。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为双重随机（doubly stochastic）模型：RNA 产生在给定 λ(t) 下服从 Poisson 分布，RNA 寿命独立地取自任意有限均值分布；通过寿命生存函数（survival function）与 λ(t) 自协方差推导 Fano factor，对 Poisson 降解引入指数时间滤波核。解析上求解了离散 M/M/1 过程与带反射、周期、首达重置边界的漂移-扩散模型的精确结果。数值上用模拟的转录速率轨迹检验数据驱动估计器（不向估计器提供已知自相关），并直接模拟耦合的转录速率与 RNA 拷贝数过程以验证各解析结果。

papers.title: Solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance search for axion-like dark matter with broadband SQUID magnetometry
papers.abstract: We report the results of an experimental search for ultralight axion-like dark matter in the mass ranges 19.5--20.5 and 21.5--22 neV. The Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment-electric probes the axion-nuclear electric dipole moment coupling. We perform solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance on $^{207}$Pb spin ensembles which reside in a polarized ferroelectric crystal. The background axion-like dark matter field induces an oscillating torque on the $^{207}$Pb spins via the electric dipole moment coupling $g_{d}$. The experiment is calibrated with pulsed magnetic resonance measurements covering two frequency bands (4.6--5.0 and 5.2--5.3 MHz) that correspond to the axion Compton frequencies associated with the identified axion mass ranges. By sweeping the leading magnetic field applied to the sample, we are able to detect the $^{207}$Pb nuclear magnetic resonance in these frequency ranges using a superconducting quantum interference device, inductively coupled to the sample with a broadband circuit. We establish the upper bounds $|g_{d}| < 4\times 10^{-4}$ GeV$^{-2}$ with 95% confidence in these frequency bands. Our results demonstrate the detection and small-tip angle calibration of low-field $^{207}$Pb nuclear magnetic resonance, allowing for sensitivity to axion-like dark matter in the nanoelectron-volt axion mass range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：标题含“search”“experimental search”，摘要明确说明“We report the results of an experimental search”“We perform solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance”“The experiment is calibrated with pulsed magnetic resonance measurements”等，属于实验测量与结果报道。；研究对象：超轻类轴子暗物质（axion-like dark matter），质量范围为 19.5–20.5 neV 和 21.5–22 neV；具体探测体系为极化铁电晶体中的 \(^{207}\)Pb 核自旋系综，通过轴子-核电偶极矩耦合 \(g_d\) 产生的振荡力矩进行探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 4.6–5.0 MHz 和 5.2–5.3 MHz 两个频段内，未探测到类轴子暗物质信号，并给出了 95% 置信度下的上限 \(|g_d| < 4\times 10^{-4}\) GeV\(^{-2}\)。同时，实验实现了低场 \(^{207}\)Pb 核磁共振的探测和小倾角校准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 4.6–5.0 MHz 和 5.2–5.3 MHz 两个频段内，未探测到类轴子暗物质信号，并给出了 95% 置信度下的上限 \(|g_d| < 4\times 10^{-4}\) GeV\(^{-2}\)。同时，实验实现了低场 \(^{207}\)Pb 核磁共振的探测和小倾角校准。；创新点：摘要中明确强调的是：实现了低场 \(^{207}\)Pb 核磁共振的探测和小倾角校准，并由此获得对纳电子伏特量级轴子质量范围内类轴子暗物质的灵敏度；同时给出了特定频段内 \(g_d\) 的实验上限。摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究更广泛或更具体的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment-electric probes（CASPEr-electric）方案；对极化铁电晶体中的 \(^{207}\)Pb 自旋系综进行固态核磁共振测量；用脉冲磁共振测量在两个频段（4.6–5.0 和 5.2–5.3 MHz）进行校准；通过扫描施加在样品上的主导磁场，并使用超导量子干涉仪（SQUID）经宽带电路与样品感应耦合，来探测这些频率范围内的 \(^{207}\)Pb 核磁共振。

papers.title: Truncated Polyakov bootstrap for BCFTs: Neumann-Dirichlet flow and Ising special transition
papers.abstract: We extend the recently proposed truncated Polyakov bootstrap to boundary conformal field theories (BCFTs). The formalism uses the analytic functional framework to find approximate solutions of BCFT crossing. We show that a generic nonperturbative solution can be identified by relating it to a family of deformations around generalized free fields (GFF) with a fixed boundary condition. We show this by tracking the flow of BCFT data from GFF with Neumann boundary condition to that with Dirichlet. The same method is then used for the 3d Ising special transition, using the perturbative Wilson-Fisher description as the deformation to identify it. The BCFT data obtained are in remarkable agreement with existing lattice results where available, and are otherwise new.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“formalism”“analytic functional framework”“approximate solutions”“perturbative Wilson-Fisher description”等理论推导与框架构建类关键词，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：边界共形场论（BCFTs），具体包括：从Neumann边界条件到Dirichlet边界条件的广义自由场（GFF）形变流，以及3d Ising模型的特殊相变（special transition）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将截断Polyakov bootstrap推广到BCFTs后，可通过与固定边界条件下广义自由场周围的形变族相联系，识别出一般的非微扰解；该方法得到的BCFT数据与已有格点结果高度一致，其余为新的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将截断Polyakov bootstrap推广到BCFTs后，可通过与固定边界条件下广义自由场周围的形变族相联系，识别出一般的非微扰解；该方法得到的BCFT数据与已有格点结果高度一致，其余为新的结果。；创新点：将截断Polyakov bootstrap从普通CFT推广到边界共形场论（BCFTs）；提出通过GFF形变流（Neumann-Dirichlet flow）识别非微扰BCFT解的方法；首次将该方法应用于3d Ising特殊相变，获得与格点结果一致及新的BCFT数据。
papers.method_zh: 截断Polyakov bootstrap，结合解析泛函框架（analytic functional framework）求解BCFT crossing方程的近似解；通过追踪从Neumann边界条件GFF到Dirichlet边界条件GFF的BCFT数据流来识别非微扰解；对3d Ising特殊相变，使用微扰Wilson-Fisher描述作为形变来识别解。

papers.title: Quantum-Geometric Meissner Effect in Magnetized Color Superconductors
papers.abstract: We find a quantum-geometric Meissner response in magnetized two-flavor color-superconducting (2SC) quark matter. Landau quantization quenches the transverse quasiparticle dispersion, suppressing the conventional Fermi-surface contribution and giving rise to a Meissner response governed by the quantum geometry of the Landau levels. In the strong-field regime, the response becomes dominated by the quantum metric of the lowest Landau level (LLL), and the leading scaling of the transverse Meissner mass is consequently set by the pairing gap, in contrast to the chemical potential scaling of conventional color superconductors. This unconventional scaling has a topological origin, as the LLL quantum metric is constrained by its Chern number. The reduced transverse Meissner mass provides potential implications for kHz quasi-periodic oscillations in magnetars.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要使用“We find a quantum-geometric Meissner response”“Landau quantization”“the response becomes dominated by the quantum metric”等理论推导与机制分析语言，未提及具体实验测量、样品制备或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：磁化双味色超导（2SC）夸克物质中的迈斯纳效应（Meissner response），具体关注横向迈斯纳质量在强磁场下的行为，以及朗道量子化对超导响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁化2SC夸克物质中，朗道量子化抑制了传统的费米面贡献，使迈斯纳响应由朗道能级的量子几何主导；在强场区，响应由最低朗道能级（LLL）的量子度规支配，横向迈斯纳质量的主导标度由配对能隙决定，而非传统色超导体的化学势标度。该非常规标度具有拓扑起源，因为LLL量子度规受其陈数约束。横向迈斯纳质量的降低可能对磁星的kHz准周期振荡有潜在意义。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁化2SC夸克物质中，朗道量子化抑制了传统的费米面贡献，使迈斯纳响应由朗道能级的量子几何主导；在强场区，响应由最低朗道能级（LLL）的量子度规支配，横向迈斯纳质量的主导标度由配对能隙决定，而非传统色超导体的化学势标度。该非常规标度具有拓扑起源，因为LLL量子度规受其陈数约束。横向迈斯纳质量的降低可能对磁星的kHz准周期振荡有潜在意义。；创新点：首次指出磁化色超导体中存在由量子几何主导的迈斯纳响应；揭示了强场下横向迈斯纳质量由配对能隙而非化学势标度的非常规行为，并指出其拓扑起源（LLL量子度规受陈数约束）；提出该效应对磁星kHz准周期振荡的潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法的细节，仅提及基于朗道量子化、量子几何（量子度规）、最低朗道能级（LLL）、陈数等概念进行理论分析。

papers.title: Restricted typicality in non-equilibrium quantum many-body systems
papers.abstract: Characterizing the time evolution of generic quantum many-body systems is a fundamental challenge, as representing the exact state requires exponentially scaling computational resources. While hydrodynamics and statistical mechanics successfully simplify this task by predicting the expectation values of local observables, these macroscopic frameworks provide no information about nonlinear characteristics of the quantum state. In this work, we demonstrate that for systems exhibiting a timescale separation, with dynamics governed by the transport of conserved charges, this lost information can be systematically recovered. By constraining the maximum-entropy Scrooge ensemble solely by the system's slow modes, we accurately reconstruct complex, nonlinear quantum properties of the global time-evolved state, including the half-chain entanglement entropy and the participation entropy in the computational basis. Our results generalize the paradigm of canonical typicality, revealing that a hydrodynamically bottlenecked system behaves as a typical pure state within a dynamically restricted submanifold of the Hilbert space - a phenomenon we term global restricted typicality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：最大熵 Scrooge 系综、正则典型性（canonical typicality）、半链纠缠熵、参与熵等，均为理论/概念框架层面的分析，摘要中未提及任何实验或具体数值计算平台。；研究对象：非平衡量子多体系统的时间演化，特别是存在时间尺度分离、动力学由守恒荷输运主导的系统；关注的物理量包括全局时间演化态的纠缠熵与计算基下的参与熵等非线性量子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于存在时间尺度分离、由守恒荷输运主导动力学的系统，仅用系统的慢模式约束最大熵 Scrooge 系综，即可准确重构全局时间演化态的非线性量子性质（如半链纠缠熵和计算基参与熵）；这表明受流体力学瓶颈限制的系统在希尔伯特空间的动力学受限子流形内表现为典型纯态，作者称之为“全局受限典型性”（global restricted typicality）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于存在时间尺度分离、由守恒荷输运主导动力学的系统，仅用系统的慢模式约束最大熵 Scrooge 系综，即可准确重构全局时间演化态的非线性量子性质（如半链纠缠熵和计算基参与熵）；这表明受流体力学瓶颈限制的系统在希尔伯特空间的动力学受限子流形内表现为典型纯态，作者称之为“全局受限典型性”（global restricted typicality）。；创新点：将正则典型性范式推广到非平衡情形，提出“全局受限典型性”概念：证明在流体力学瓶颈主导的系统里，仅靠慢模式约束的 Scrooge 系综就能恢复通常被宏观框架丢失的非线性量子信息（纠缠熵、参与熵等）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：最大熵 Scrooge 系综，仅以系统慢模式作为约束条件；结合流体力学与统计力学的宏观描述思路，对全局时间演化态的非线性性质进行重构。摘要未明确说明具体的数值方法或模型体系。

papers.title: Efficient computation of the asymptotics of extensive-rank HCIZ integrals
papers.abstract: We study the high-dimensional asymptotics of Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) integrals in the extensive-rank regime. The limit of these integrals is governed by a one-dimensional boundary-value hydrodynamical problem originally derived by Matytsin (1994) and rigorously proved by Guionnet and Zeitouni (2002). Despite its wide-ranging applications, explicit solutions to this problem are known only in a few specific cases. In this work, we introduce an efficient numerical scheme based on a particle discretization and prove its convergence to the continuous boundary-value problem for generic boundary densities. We validate our approach against known analytical solutions and apply it to generic densities, uncovering interesting dynamical phenomena. The high-dimensional limit of HCIZ integrals appears in various contexts, from the large deviations of random matrix spectra to the limiting free energy of disordered systems, high-dimensional statistics, and machine learning. As such, our contribution opens the way towards the numerical exploration of a wide range of high-dimensional models that were previously intractable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：introduce an efficient numerical scheme、prove its convergence、validate our approach against known analytical solutions、numerical exploration。；研究对象：Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) 积分在高维（extensive-rank）极限下的渐近行为，以及支配该极限的一维边界值流体动力学问题（由 Matytsin 1994 导出、Guionnet 和 Zeitouni 2002 严格证明）。摘要提到该极限出现在随机矩阵谱的大偏差、无序系统极限自由能、高维统计和机器学习等背景中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者提出了一个高效数值方案，并证明了该方案对一般边界密度收敛到连续边界值问题；通过与已知解析解对比验证了方法的正确性，并将其应用于一般密度，揭示了有趣的动力学现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者提出了一个高效数值方案，并证明了该方案对一般边界密度收敛到连续边界值问题；通过与已知解析解对比验证了方法的正确性，并将其应用于一般密度，揭示了有趣的动力学现象。；创新点：此前该边界值问题仅在少数特定情形下有显式解，本文首次给出对一般边界密度高效且收敛的数值求解方案，从而为数值探索此前难以处理的一大类高维模型（随机矩阵、无序系统、高维统计、机器学习等）开辟了道路。
papers.method_zh: 基于粒子离散化（particle discretization）的数值方案，用于求解 Matytsin 提出的一维边界值流体动力学问题，并证明其向连续边界值问题的收敛性；同时用已知解析解进行验证。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Cyclic Processes with Markov Samplers in Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract: The concept of Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) cycles, an analogy to cyclic processes in heat engines, is presented in order to examine Bayesian inference problems. In this effort, we develop adaptive ensemble schedulers that allow the tuning of external parameters of a Bayesian canonical ensemble during an MCMC run, realising the MCMC cycles in practice. We run these cycles on different statistical models. As a fundamental insight, we find (both theoretically and in practice) that such systems can produce a non-zero net work output if and only if the considered model is non-Gaussian. As such, they may serve as a measure of non-Gaussianity in Bayesian inference, which we test on an example from supernova cosmology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（含数值实验）。关键依据：提出 MCMC 循环概念、开发自适应 ensemble scheduler、在不同统计模型上运行循环，并同时给出理论推导与实际测试；摘要未涉及真实物理实验测量。；研究对象：贝叶斯推断问题中的统计模型与贝叶斯正则系综，具体涉及 MCMC 采样过程、模型的外部参数调节，以及作为示例的超新星宇宙学数据。摘要未明确说明具体材料或凝聚态物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 这类 MCMC 循环系统当且仅当所考虑的模型为非高斯时，才能产生非零的净功输出；因此该净功可作为贝叶斯推断中非高斯性的一种度量，并在超新星宇宙学示例上进行了检验。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：这类 MCMC 循环系统当且仅当所考虑的模型为非高斯时，才能产生非零的净功输出；因此该净功可作为贝叶斯推断中非高斯性的一种度量，并在超新星宇宙学示例上进行了检验。；创新点：首次提出 MCMC 循环与热机循环的类比，并实现可实际运行的自适应 ensemble scheduler 来调节贝叶斯正则系综外部参数；理论上和实践上均发现净功输出与模型非高斯性的充要关系，从而提供了一种新的非高斯性度量，并在超新星宇宙学中进行了测试。
papers.method_zh: 将热机循环过程类比到 MCMC，构建 Markov chain Monte Carlo 循环；开发自适应 ensemble schedulers，在 MCMC 运行过程中调节贝叶斯正则系综的外部参数；在不同统计模型上运行这些循环，并结合理论分析与实际数值测试，最后在超新星宇宙学示例上验证。

papers.title: Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery
papers.abstract: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does not necessarily reduce maximum regret, whereas Q90-UCB and expected improvement (EI) substantially reduce regret by directing evaluations toward regions that determine the optimizer's decisions. On MADE, controls receiving high-fidelity feedback after every episode require $6.36$--$7.23\times$ more oracle queries to match Online EI under two LLM orchestrators and $10.27\times$ more under the non-LLM Chemeleon+MLIP workflow. Online surrogate repair introduces a novel third feedback regime between fixed-surrogate operation and high-fidelity feedback after every episode, separating the frequency of high-fidelity evaluation from the duration of the agent's search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章（算法与基准测试）。关键依据：提出闭环算法 OSR，在“controlled synthetic environments”和“MADE”基准上做对比实验，涉及 LLM orchestrators 与 Chemeleon+MLIP 工作流，均为计算/仿真评估，未涉及真实湿实验。；研究对象：闭环 AI 科学发现（closed-loop discovery）中的反馈机制问题，即高保真反馈（湿实验合成、表征或高保真计算）与低成本代理模型搜索之间的不平衡。具体测试体系为合成环境和 MADE 基准任务，摘要未明确说明具体材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅提升代理模型的全局拟合精度并不必然降低最大 regret；而 Q90-UCB 和期望改进（EI）通过把高保真评估导向决定优化器决策的区域，能显著降低 regret。在 MADE 上，每轮都接收高保真反馈的对照组要达到 Online EI 的效果，需多出 6.36–7.23 倍（两种 LLM orchestrator）乃至 10.27 倍（非 LLM 的 Chemeleon+MLIP 工作流）的 oracle 查询。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅提升代理模型的全局拟合精度并不必然降低最大 regret；而 Q90-UCB 和期望改进（EI）通过把高保真评估导向决定优化器决策的区域，能显著降低 regret。在 MADE 上，每轮都接收高保真反馈的对照组要达到 Online EI 的效果，需多出 6.36–7.23 倍（两种 LLM orchestrator）乃至 10.27 倍（非 LLM 的 Chemeleon+MLIP 工作流）的 oracle 查询。；创新点：提出介于“固定代理模型运行”与“每轮都做高保真反馈”之间的第三种反馈范式，将高保真评估的频率与 agent 搜索的时长解耦；并指出优化 regret 的关键在于评估位置的选取而非全局代理拟合精度的提升。
papers.method_zh: 提出 online surrogate repair（OSR）闭环算法：主要用廉价代理反馈进行较长的 agent 搜索，同时用稀疏的高保真评估持续更新代理模型；采用采集规则（Q90-UCB、expected improvement）从 agent 累积的候选设计中挑选送交高保真评估的样本，并用所得标签更新后续 episode 的代理模型。评估手段为受控合成环境与 MADE 基准，对比对象包括 LLM orchestrators 和 Chemeleon+MLIP 工作流。

papers.title: Microwave-Free $^{13}$C Hyperpolarization of Diamond Particles Enabled by Magic Angle Spinning and NV Centers
papers.abstract: Nuclear hyperpolarization from optically pumped color centers in solids offers an alternative to conventional microwave-driven dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP). Diamond can host the nitrogen vacancy (NV) center, whose ground spin state can be readily polarized by light at room temperature, making diamond a candidate platform for nuclear hyperpolarization. We report $^{13}{\rm C}$ nuclear hyperpolarization in randomly oriented diamond particles with sizes ranging from 0.2 to 2 $μ$m, both at natural $^{13}{\rm C}$ abundance (1.1 %) and at 20 % isotopic enrichment, at magnetic fields of 7.1 T and 9.4 T. The protocol combines optical illumination with magic angle spinning (MAS) and does not require microwave irradiation. By investigating the nuclear polarization as a function of the MAS frequency between 0 and 6 kHz at the magnetic field of 7.1 T, we find maximum light-induced polarization enhancements of $280$-fold for the isotopically enriched sample and $411$-fold for the natural abundance sample. Under continuous illumination, steady-state absolute $^{13}{\rm C}$ polarization levels above 0.1 % are reached. A model involving optical pumping of NV centers and spin dynamics near level anticrossings (LACs) in three-spin clusters formed by NV, a substitutional nitrogen (P1) and $^{13}{\rm C}$ is used to describe these findings. The protocol strongly mitigates the effect of the anisotropy of the NV spin Hamiltonian, allowing more than $99.9\%$ of NV orientations to participate in the polarization transfer process. These results represent a first step toward transferring nuclear polarization from diamond particles to external nuclei, with potential applications in sensitive and high-resolution NMR at room temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模）。判断依据关键词：we report、we find、experimental protocol（optical illumination + MAS）、a model ... is used to describe these findings。；研究对象：随机取向的金刚石颗粒（尺寸0.2–2 μm）中的 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 核自旋超极化，涉及NV色心、替代氮（P1）与 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 构成的三自旋团簇中的自旋动力学与能级反交叉（LAC）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无需微波辐照的条件下，结合光照射与魔角旋转（MAS），可在7.1 T和9.4 T磁场下实现金刚石颗粒中 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 的核超极化；在7.1 T下，同位素富集样品最大光致极化增强为280倍，天然丰度样品为411倍，连续光照下稳态绝对 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 极化率超过0.1%。该方案大幅缓解了NV自旋哈密顿量各向异性的影响，使超过99.9%的NV取向都能参与极化转移过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无需微波辐照的条件下，结合光照射与魔角旋转（MAS），可在7.1 T和9.4 T磁场下实现金刚石颗粒中 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 的核超极化；在7.1 T下，同位素富集样品最大光致极化增强为280倍，天然丰度样品为411倍，连续光照下稳态绝对 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 极化率超过0.1%。该方案大幅缓解了NV自旋哈密顿量各向异性的影响，使超过99.9%的NV取向都能参与极化转移过程。；创新点：提出并验证了一种无需微波辐照的 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 核超极化协议，将光泵浦NV色心与魔角旋转相结合，适用于随机取向的金刚石颗粒，并显著抑制了NV自旋哈密顿量各向异性对极化转移的限制（>99.9% NV取向可参与）。摘要指出这是朝着将金刚石颗粒的核极化转移到外部核的第一步，潜在应用于室温下灵敏高分辨NMR。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光照射结合魔角旋转（MAS，转速0–6 kHz）的协议，在7.1 T和9.4 T磁场下对天然丰度（1.1%）及20%同位素富集的随机取向金刚石颗粒进行 \(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 核极化测量；理论上使用一个包含NV色心光泵浦以及NV–P1–\(^{13}\mathrm{C}\) 三自旋团簇中能级反交叉（LAC）附近自旋动力学的模型来解释实验结果。

papers.title: Exact spin form factors and correlations at a massive Kramers-Wannier interface
papers.abstract: We determine exact finite-volume spin form factors and two-point correlations for a massive Kramer--Wannier interface in the scaling Ising model, separating ordered and disordered phases. The interface admits two complementary lattice realizations: a self-dual inhomogeneous Ising chain whose continuum limit has a sign-changing Majorana mass profile, and, after exchanging Euclidean space and time, a mixed thermal average amenable to Toeplitz/Fredholm methods. Combining these descriptions, we obtain the exact Neveu-Schwarz-Ramond spin matrix elements and a factorized Fredholm determinant for the interface correlator. Defect TCSA and independent fermionic spin-chain calculations confirm the predicted spectrum and matrix elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“determine exact finite-volume spin form factors”“scaling Ising model”“continuum limit”“Toeplitz/Fredholm methods”“Defect TCSA”“fermionic spin-chain calculations”等，均为解析推导与数值验证相结合的理论研究，不涉及真实材料实验。；研究对象：标度极限下的 Ising 模型中的一个有质量（massive）Kramers–Wannier 界面，该界面将有序相与无序相分开。其两个互补的晶格实现为：一个自对偶非均匀 Ising 链（连续极限下具有变号的 Majorana 质量剖面），以及交换欧几里得空间与时间后的混合热平均体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者精确求得了该有质量 Kramers–Wannier 界面的有限体积自旋形状因子与两点关联函数，给出了精确的 Neveu–Schwarz–Ramond 自旋矩阵元以及界面关联函数的因子化 Fredholm 行列式；缺陷 TCSA 与独立的费米子自旋链计算证实了所预言的谱与矩阵元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者精确求得了该有质量 Kramers–Wannier 界面的有限体积自旋形状因子与两点关联函数，给出了精确的 Neveu–Schwarz–Ramond 自旋矩阵元以及界面关联函数的因子化 Fredholm 行列式；缺陷 TCSA 与独立的费米子自旋链计算证实了所预言的谱与矩阵元。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但从内容看，其新意在于将两种互补描述（变号 Majorana 质量剖面的连续极限与 Toeplitz/Fredholm 混合热平均）结合，首次精确给出该有质量 Kramers–Wannier 界面的自旋形状因子、NSR 自旋矩阵元及因子化 Fredholm 行列式形式的界面关联函数，并得到两种独立数值方法的验证。
papers.method_zh: 解析方法包括：标度 Ising 模型的精确求解、自对偶非均匀 Ising 链的连续极限分析（变号 Majorana 质量剖面）、交换欧几里得空间与时间后的 Toeplitz/Fredholm 方法；数值验证方法包括缺陷 TCSA（截断共形场空间）与独立的费米子自旋链计算。

papers.title: Topology Obstructs Pure Foundation Neural Quantum States
papers.abstract: Foundation models for ground states in spin-1/2 systems are a promising method for problems ranging from quantum chemistry to identifying new phase diagrams. Nearly all such models are currently pure-states that condition on the Hamiltonian's parameters, whose Monte Carlo samples give energy estimates according to the variational principle. In this contribution, we show that this representation is topologically obstructed. For any gapped Hamiltonian family whose ground-state bundle is non-trivial, every continuous normalized state-vector model has zero fidelity with the ground state at some parameter value in the Hamiltonian family. For that value, the energy is at least one spectral gap, $Δ$, with an $O(Δ)$ gap in an open-neighbourhood of that point. We show that this is a sufficient no-go also in the case of degenerate ground-state manifolds, time dynamics, and periodic systems with mixed space-time topology, demonstrating these obstructions on one- and two-qubit systems. We discuss how this causes a spike in the fidelity susceptibility, giving a numerical signature of a phase-transition where there is none. We then show that operator-valued models canonically avoid these obstructions and preserve topological information, implying a structural necessity in representation for foundation neural quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“we show that this representation is topologically obstructed”“sufficient no-go”“operator-valued models canonically avoid these obstructions”等理论论证与定理式表述，属于理论/形式化分析工作。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 系统的基态基础模型（foundation models for ground states in spin-1/2 systems），以及纯态神经量子态（pure-state neural quantum states）对含参数哈密顿量基态的表示能力；涉及有能隙哈密顿量族、简并基态流形、时间动力学、以及混合时空拓扑的周期系统，并在单量子比特和双量子比特系统上展示这些阻碍。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于基态丛非平凡的任意有能隙哈密顿量族，任何连续的归一化态矢量模型都会在某个参数值处与基态保真度为零，该处能量至少比基态高一个谱隙 Δ，且在该点附近的开邻域内存在 O(Δ) 的能隙；这种拓扑阻碍也会导致保真度磁化率出现尖峰，从而在没有相变的地方给出类似相变的数值信号。算符值模型（operator-valued models）可自然规避这些阻碍并保留拓扑信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于基态丛非平凡的任意有能隙哈密顿量族，任何连续的归一化态矢量模型都会在某个参数值处与基态保真度为零，该处能量至少比基态高一个谱隙 Δ，且在该点附近的开邻域内存在 O(Δ) 的能隙；这种拓扑阻碍也会导致保真度磁化率出现尖峰，从而在没有相变的地方给出类似相变的数值信号。算符值模型（operator-valued models）可自然规避这些阻碍并保留拓扑信息。；创新点：指出现有几乎全部纯态、以哈密顿量参数为条件的基础模型在表示上受到拓扑阻碍，并给出严格的 no-go 结论（包括简并基态流形、时间动力学和混合时空拓扑周期系统情形）；同时揭示该阻碍会在保真度磁化率中产生虚假相变尖峰，并提出算符值模型作为在表示结构上必要且能保留拓扑信息的替代方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与拓扑论证，基于基态丛的拓扑非平凡性、连续归一化态矢量模型、保真度（fidelity）与保真度磁化率、变分原理与蒙特卡洛采样给出的能量估计；并在单量子比特和双量子比特系统上进行演示。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值模拟方法（如 DMRG、神经网络训练细节等）。

papers.title: Geometry Dependence of Error Thresholds in Two-Dimensional Toric Codes
papers.abstract: We investigate how the lattice geometry influences the error thresholds of two-dimensional toric codes. In the presence of bit- or phase-flip errors, the toric code maps onto the two-dimensional random-bond Ising model (RBIM). We determine the critical behaviour of the RBIM using replica-exchange Monte Carlo simulations. While previous studies have explored thresholds for general lattice geometries under suboptimal decoders such as minimum-weight perfect matching, the rapid development of near-optimal decoders makes resolving the ultimate, maximum-likelihood code capacity relevant. We compute these optimal error thresholds on the Nishimori line for the square, honeycomb, triangular, dice, and kagome lattices. Owing to lattice duality, the phase-flip threshold on a given lattice is equivalent to the bit-flip threshold on its dual. We find that the optimal thresholds of dual-lattice pairs display a characteristic duality-driven splitting around the self-dual square-lattice, mirroring the qualitative behaviour observed for suboptimal decoders. While the average coordination number has the strongest impact on the error threshold, our results demonstrate that the detailed arrangement of vertices and plaquettes also plays a significant role in determining its precise value.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确使用“replica-exchange Monte Carlo simulations”进行计算，研究的是toric code的误差阈值，属于数值计算与理论分析结合的工作，无实验成分。；研究对象：二维toric code的误差阈值（error thresholds），具体研究格点几何（lattice geometry）对误差阈值的影响。涉及五种格点：square（正方）、honeycomb（蜂窝）、triangular（三角）、dice、kagome。物理现象为bit-flip或phase-flip误差下toric code映射到二维随机键Ising模型（RBIM）的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在对偶格点对上，最优误差阈值围绕自对偶的正方格点呈现由对偶性驱动的特征性分裂，这与次优解码器下观察到的定性行为一致；平均配位数对误差阈值影响最大，但顶点和面（plaquettes）的具体排列方式对阈值的精确值也有显著作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在对偶格点对上，最优误差阈值围绕自对偶的正方格点呈现由对偶性驱动的特征性分裂，这与次优解码器下观察到的定性行为一致；平均配位数对误差阈值影响最大，但顶点和面（plaquettes）的具体排列方式对阈值的精确值也有显著作用。；创新点：以往研究多针对一般格点几何在次优解码器（如最小权重完美匹配）下的阈值，而随着近最优解码器的快速发展，确定最终的最大似然码容量（maximum-likelihood code capacity）变得重要。本文计算了五种格点在Nishimori线上的最优误差阈值，并揭示了对偶格点对围绕自对偶正方格点的对偶性驱动分裂现象，以及顶点和面具体排列对阈值精确值的影响。
papers.method_zh: 将toric code在bit-flip或phase-flip误差下映射为二维随机键Ising模型（RBIM）；使用replica-exchange Monte Carlo模拟确定RBIM的临界行为；在Nishimori线上计算最大似然（maximum-likelihood）最优误差阈值；利用格点对偶性，将某格点的phase-flip阈值等同于其对偶格点的bit-flip阈值。

papers.title: Human mutation field reveals an equilibrium-like structure with irreversible circulation
papers.abstract: The evolution of DNA sequences can be viewed as stochastic dynamics on a high-dimensional discrete space, but it is unclear when empirical transition biases reduce to an effective energy landscape versus retain irreducible non-equilibrium circulation. Human context-dependent mutation probabilities offer a direct test: every single-nucleotide substitution in a local context has a reverse substitution, so the logarithm of the forward-to-reverse probability ratio defines an antisymmetric field-the human mutation field. We show this field has a dominant gradient component and a smaller but reproducible curl component. Using seven-base human germline substitution probabilities, we infer an effective mutational landscape with a Siamese neural network constrained to predict only energy differences. This model predicts forward-to-reverse log-ratios for held-out mutations with a correlation of about 0.93, close to both an unconstrained predictive reference (0.948) and the empirical reversible ceiling from Hodge projection (about 0.96). Although trained only on mutation probabilities, the inferred landscape largely recovers short-word genomic composition and Chargaff reverse-complement symmetry for sequences up to length four. Deviations from equilibrium structure reveal a small but detectable nonequilibrium component: a residual irreversible circulation violating the Kolmogorov cycle condition for detailed balance, reproducible across African, Asian, and European populations, and strongest in CpG-linked cycles and CpG-transition edges, consistent with methylcytosine deamination. These results give a thermodynamic decomposition of the human mutation field: most mutation bias is organized by a local equilibrium-like energy landscape aligned with genome composition, while the residual circulation points to specific directional mutational mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：使用七碱基人类生殖系替换概率数据、Siamese 神经网络建模、Hodge 投影分析、Kolmogorov 循环条件检验——属于基于经验数据的计算/数据分析研究，不涉及新实验测量或纯理论推导。；研究对象：人类 DNA 序列的上下文依赖突变概率（context-dependent mutation probabilities），具体为七碱基局部上下文中的单核苷酸替换概率，以及由此定义的人类突变场（human mutation field）——即正向与反向替换概率比值的对数所构成的反对称场。涉及基因组组成、Chargaff 反向互补对称性、CpG 相关突变循环等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 人类突变场具有主导的梯度分量和一个较小但可重复的旋度分量：大部分突变偏好可由一个与基因组组成一致的、类平衡的有效突变能量景观（有效势）来描述，但残余的不可逆循环（违反 Kolmogorov 细致平衡循环条件）可被检测到，且在 CpG 相关循环和 CpG 转换边上最强，与甲基胞嘧啶脱氨机制一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：人类突变场具有主导的梯度分量和一个较小但可重复的旋度分量：大部分突变偏好可由一个与基因组组成一致的、类平衡的有效突变能量景观（有效势）来描述，但残余的不可逆循环（违反 Kolmogorov 细致平衡循环条件）可被检测到，且在 CpG 相关循环和 CpG 转换边上最强，与甲基胞嘧啶脱氨机制一致。；创新点：首次对人类突变场进行了热力学分解，将其定量拆分为类平衡的梯度部分（有效能量景观）和不可逆的旋度部分（非平衡循环）；提出用仅预测能量差的受约束 Siamese 网络推断突变景观，并证明该景观虽仅从突变概率训练却能大幅恢复基因组组成和 Chargaff 对称性；识别出残余不可逆循环在 CpG 相关循环中最强，指向甲基胞嘧啶脱氨这一特定方向性突变机制，且在三个人群中可重复。
papers.method_zh: 使用七碱基人类生殖系替换概率数据；构建受约束的 Siamese 神经网络，仅预测能量差（而非直接预测概率），以推断有效突变景观；通过 Hodge 投影分解突变场为梯度分量与旋度分量，并计算经验可逆上限；检验 Kolmogorov 循环条件以量化非平衡循环；在非洲、亚洲、欧洲人群中检验循环分量的可重复性；将推断的景观与短词基因组组成及 Chargaff 反向互补对称性进行对比。

papers.title: Noninvasive Anisotropic Identification of Magnetic Properties in Toroidal Shaped Magnetic Steel
papers.abstract: This research proposes a model-free inverse approach for identifying the nonlinear anisotropic single-valued magnetic constitutive characteristics of soft magnetic materials from boundary measurements. Using the harmonic approximation, the internal magnetic flux density B and magnetic field strength H are independently reconstructed from the measured boundary data, thus avoiding the limitation of using a predefined parametric B--H mapping function. Subsequently, the reconstructed fields are spatially averaged along selected collection lines to recover the B--H characteristics of the principal directions. Numerical results demonstrate high reconstruction accuracy for unperturbed data and good robustness against Gaussian perturbations of the boundary measurements, with the overall mean error remaining below 5% for a 10% noise level. These results indicate that under the harmonic-field assumptions, the field-based reconstruction provides a simple and computationally efficient framework for non-invasive identification of nonlinear anisotropic magnetic constitutive characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：proposes a model-free inverse approach、Numerical results demonstrate、harmonic approximation、reconstructed fields——摘要中未提及任何实验测量，全部为数值重建与仿真验证。；研究对象：环形（toroidal）软磁钢材料中的非线性各向异性单值磁本构特性（B–H 关系），即从边界测量数据反推材料内部主方向上的磁化特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在谐波场近似下，可由边界测量独立重建内部磁通密度 B 与磁场强度 H，并沿选定采集线做空间平均以恢复主方向的 B–H 特性；数值结果表明无扰动数据下重建精度高，对边界测量的高斯扰动具有良好鲁棒性，10% 噪声水平下总体平均误差仍低于 5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在谐波场近似下，可由边界测量独立重建内部磁通密度 B 与磁场强度 H，并沿选定采集线做空间平均以恢复主方向的 B–H 特性；数值结果表明无扰动数据下重建精度高，对边界测量的高斯扰动具有良好鲁棒性，10% 噪声水平下总体平均误差仍低于 5%。；创新点：提出了一种无需预设参数化 B–H 映射函数的无模型逆方法，通过谐波近似独立重建 B 与 H 场，从而实现对非线性各向异性磁本构特性的非侵入式识别，框架简单且计算高效。
papers.method_zh: 无模型（model-free）逆问题方法：采用谐波近似（harmonic approximation），从边界测量数据独立重建内部 B 和 H 场，避免使用预定义的参数化 B–H 映射函数；随后沿选定采集线对重建场做空间平均，提取主方向的 B–H 特性；通过数值仿真验证精度与抗噪性（含高斯扰动测试）。

papers.title: Mixed quantum-classical evolution in open molecular systems
papers.abstract: We consider a mixed quantum-classical formulation for open nonequilibrium molecular systems. We employ the pseudoparticle nonequilibrium Green's function (PP-NEGF) method as a fully quantum description and a starting point for introducing classical nuclear dynamics for an open system. We use this formulation to derive a density-matrix equation of motion describing the quantum-classical evolution. We compare our results with previous formulations and highlight important differences related to the nonequilibrium and open character of the molecular system. We also analyze the approximations needed to reduce full quantum-classical dynamics to the fewest-switches surface hopping (FSSH) method and show that these approximations are unreasonable when adiabatic surfaces come close to each other.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：mixed quantum-classical formulation、pseudoparticle nonequilibrium Green's function (PP-NEGF) method、derive a density-matrix equation of motion、analyze the approximations。；研究对象：开放非平衡分子系统中的混合量子-经典演化，即开放分子体系中量子自由度与经典核运动的耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文基于 PP-NEGF 方法推导出描述开放体系量子-经典演化的密度矩阵运动方程，并指出其与先前表述的重要差异源于体系的非平衡与开放特征；同时证明将完整量子-经典动力学约化为 FSSH 方法所需的近似在绝热面相互接近时是不合理的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文基于 PP-NEGF 方法推导出描述开放体系量子-经典演化的密度矩阵运动方程，并指出其与先前表述的重要差异源于体系的非平衡与开放特征；同时证明将完整量子-经典动力学约化为 FSSH 方法所需的近似在绝热面相互接近时是不合理的。；创新点：将 PP-NEGF 全量子框架与经典核动力学结合，建立了面向开放非平衡分子体系的混合量子-经典密度矩阵演化方程，并明确揭示了该体系开放与非平衡特性所带来的与以往表述的关键区别，以及 FSSH 近似在绝热面接近时失效的问题。
papers.method_zh: 以赝粒子非平衡格林函数（PP-NEGF）方法作为全量子描述和出发点，引入经典核动力学，推导开放体系的密度矩阵运动方程；并与已有表述进行对比，分析约化到最少开关表面跳跃（FSSH）方法所需的近似条件。

papers.title: Electron beam driven collective self hybridized exciton polaritons
papers.abstract: Self-hybridized exciton polaritons in layered semiconductors emerge from the hybridization of excitonic resonances with confined photonic modes in films and provide a versatile platform for controlling light--matter interactions at the nanoscale. Yet, the nature of exciton--photon interactions and the collective and synchronous strong coupling of multiple excitons to the same photonic mode remain largely unexplored. Here, we use complementary momentum-resolved photoluminescence and cathodoluminescence spectroscopy to compare self-hybridized exciton polaritons in Ruddlesden--Popper perovskite flakes under optical and electron-beam excitation. We find that cathodoluminescence exhibits remarkably larger polaritonic level repulsion than photoluminescence, revealing an enhanced effective coupling strength under electron-beam excitation. We attribute this enhancement to the collective coherent excitation of multiple excitons by fast electrons, which couple to the same photonic mode and increase the interaction strength according to a $g_N=g_1\sqrt{N}$ scaling, with an effective number of up to $N\approx23$ coherently coupled excitonic oscillators. By reducing the electron kinetic energy, we further uncover a crossover to a partially incoherent excitation regime in which higher-order Fabry--Pérot exciton-polariton resonances disappear, leaving only the lowest polariton branches while coherent transition radiation persists. This transition arises because low-energy electrons excite excitons over extended spatial volumes, washing out the phase coherence required to sustain collective coupling and form polaritonic resonances. Our work shows that electron beams can actively modify collective light--matter coupling in layered semiconductors and establishes cathodoluminescence as a route to access excitation regimes beyond all-optical excitation schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确使用“momentum-resolved photoluminescence and cathodoluminescence spectroscopy”进行对比测量，属于以光谱实验为主的工作，未提及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：Ruddlesden–Popper 钙钛矿薄片中的自杂化激子极化激元（self-hybridized exciton polaritons），即层状半导体中激子共振与受限光子模式杂化形成的极化激元，以及其在光学激发与电子束激发下的差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 阴极发光（电子束激发）下极化激元能级排斥显著大于光致发光，表明电子束激发下有效耦合强度增强；这归因于快电子对多个激子的集体相干激发，它们耦合到同一光子模式，耦合强度按 \(g_N=g_1\sqrt{N}\) 标度增强，相干耦合的激子振子数可达 \(N\approx23\)。降低电子动能后，体系过渡到部分非相干激发区域：高阶 Fabry–Pérot 激子-极化激元共振消失，仅剩最低极化激元支，而相干跃迁辐射仍存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：阴极发光（电子束激发）下极化激元能级排斥显著大于光致发光，表明电子束激发下有效耦合强度增强；这归因于快电子对多个激子的集体相干激发，它们耦合到同一光子模式，耦合强度按 \(g_N=g_1\sqrt{N}\) 标度增强，相干耦合的激子振子数可达 \(N\approx23\)。降低电子动能后，体系过渡到部分非相干激发区域：高阶 Fabry–Pérot 激子-极化激元共振消失，仅剩最低极化激元支，而相干跃迁辐射仍存在。；创新点：首次对比了同一 Ruddlesden–Popper 钙钛矿薄片在光学激发与电子束激发下的自杂化激子极化激元，揭示电子束激发可实现比全光学激发更强的集体光-物质耦合（有效耦合激子数达约 23），并发现降低电子动能可驱动向部分非相干激发区域的 crossover；同时确立了阴极发光作为进入全光学方案之外激发 regime 的手段。
papers.method_zh: 动量分辨光致发光光谱（momentum-resolved photoluminescence）与动量分辨阴极发光光谱（momentum-resolved cathodoluminescence）的互补对比测量；通过改变电子束动能来调控激发 regime。

papers.title: Self-Organized Dynamic Reactors: Product-Condensate Feedback Accelerates Reactions
papers.abstract: Condensates can accelerate reactions by concentrating reactants, yet product accumulation can eliminate this advantage. We show that product-induced suppression of condensation generates rotating, deforming, and propagating condensate domains through spontaneous symmetry breaking. Their reorganization shifts reaction sites away from accumulated products while retaining reactant enrichment, yielding rates above those of static condensates and homogeneous states. Reaction flows can thus self-organize condensates into dynamic reactors, with implications for biological and synthetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We show that...”（我们证明/展示）、“spontaneous symmetry breaking”（自发对称破缺）等表述，属于理论建模与机制分析，未提及具体实验测量或数值计算细节。；研究对象：凝聚态中的凝聚体（condensate）与化学反应耦合体系，具体研究产物诱导的凝聚抑制如何驱动凝聚体结构（旋转、形变、传播的畴区）的自组织动力学，以及这种动态结构对反应速率的调控。属于非平衡态自组织与反应-凝聚耦合的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 产物对凝聚的抑制会通过自发对称破缺产生旋转、形变和传播的凝聚畴区；这些畴区的重组将反应位点从累积产物处移开，同时保持反应物富集，从而使反应速率超过静态凝聚体和均匀态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：产物对凝聚的抑制会通过自发对称破缺产生旋转、形变和传播的凝聚畴区；这些畴区的重组将反应位点从累积产物处移开，同时保持反应物富集，从而使反应速率超过静态凝聚体和均匀态。；创新点：揭示了产物-凝聚反馈可自发将凝聚体组织成动态反应器，通过畴区重组同时实现“移走产物”与“富集反应物”，从而突破静态凝聚体中产物积累导致反应优势丧失的限制。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段、计算方法或理论框架（如是否采用反应-扩散方程、相场模型、数值模拟等均未提及）。

papers.title: Formation of grain boundaries in ductile single crystals under plane-strain simple shear: a block-coordinate finite element method
papers.abstract: Large plastic deformation can drive an initially uniform single crystal to spontaneously subdivide into misoriented grains separated by thin dislocation walls -- a pattern-forming instability rooted in the loss of convexity of the crystal's elastic energy at large strain. We study this phenomenon for a ductile crystal in plane-strain simple shear within continuum dislocation theory, using a polyconvex (Ciarlet--Geymonat) elastic energy that guarantees existence of minimizers for the coupled deformation--slip problem. Minimizing over the plastic slip yields a condensed energy of double-well form whose non-quasiconvexity favours a lamellar microstructure; the gradient of the geometrically necessary dislocation density regularizes it, giving the grain boundaries a finite thickness and energy as functions of the misorientation angle. A block-coordinate finite element scheme -- alternating a convex non-smooth solve for the slip with a Levenberg-regularized Newton solve for the deformation -- resolves this microstructure numerically and detects its spontaneous onset, reproducing the lamellar grain structure in agreement with the closed-form analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（混合偏计算）。判断依据关键词：continuum dislocation theory、polyconvex elastic energy、block-coordinate finite element scheme、Levenberg-regularized Newton solve、closed-form analysis。摘要中无任何实验手段描述。；研究对象：韧性单晶在平面应变简单剪切下的大塑性变形行为，具体现象为：初始均匀单晶自发细分形成由薄位错壁隔开的取向错配晶粒（晶界形成），即一种源于大应变下弹性能凸性丧失的图案形成不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续位错理论框架下，采用多凸（Ciarlet–Geymonat）弹性能可保证耦合变形-滑移问题极小值的存在；对塑性滑移取极小后得到的凝聚能为双阱形式，其非拟凸性倾向于形成层状微结构，而几何必需位错密度梯度项起正则化作用，使晶界具有有限厚度和能量（均为取向错配角度的函数）；数值方法成功捕捉到该微结构的自发出现，重现了与解析分析一致的层状晶粒结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续位错理论框架下，采用多凸（Ciarlet–Geymonat）弹性能可保证耦合变形-滑移问题极小值的存在；对塑性滑移取极小后得到的凝聚能为双阱形式，其非拟凸性倾向于形成层状微结构，而几何必需位错密度梯度项起正则化作用，使晶界具有有限厚度和能量（均为取向错配角度的函数）；数值方法成功捕捉到该微结构的自发出现，重现了与解析分析一致的层状晶粒结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但可归纳为：将多凸弹性能与块坐标有限元数值方案结合，用于求解大塑性变形下晶界形成的耦合变形-滑移问题，并数值复现了与解析分析一致的层状晶粒结构。
papers.method_zh: 连续位错理论框架；采用多凸（Ciarlet–Geymonat）弹性能；对塑性滑移取极小化得到凝聚能；块坐标有限元方法（交替进行滑移的凸非光滑求解与变形的Levenberg正则化牛顿求解）；并与闭式解析分析对照验证。

papers.title: Core-Level Spectroscopy Decodes Bond-Alternation Dynamics of Cyclo[18]Carbon
papers.abstract: The advent of X-ray free-electron lasers and high-harmonic generation has made time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy a powerful tool for probing local atomic environments, yet whether localized core excitations can report on global collective distortions remains open. Cyclo[18]carbon (C$_{18}$), with its polyynic ground state (D$_\text{9h}$) and cumulenic transition state (D$_\text{18h}$), provides an ideal model to address this long-standing issue in bond-length alternation (BLA) dynamics. Mapping two-dimensional potential energy surfaces by first-principles simulations, we find that core ionization symmetrizes the ground-state double-well potential along the BLA coordinate. Our calculated X-ray spectra reveal remarkable sensitivity to bond-length variations: C1s ionization potentials vary by up to 2.4~eV across the BLA coordinate (1.1--1.4~Å), with a 0.9~eV variation for minima predicted by different functionals, while NEXAFS $π^*$ peaks shift by up to 4~eV across the same coordinate. These predicted signatures provide a quantitative spectroscopy--structure dictionary for decoding transient structures in future ultrafast X-ray experiments and monitoring bond-alternation dynamics in real time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles simulations、calculated X-ray spectra、predicted signatures。摘要中未提及任何实验测量，全部结果来自第一性原理计算。；研究对象：Cyclo[18]carbon（C₁₈）的键长交替（bond-length alternation, BLA）动力学，具体涉及其聚炔基态（D₉ₕ）与累积烯过渡态（D₁₈ₕ）之间的结构转变，以及C1s芯能级谱（X射线光电子谱与NEXAFS）对该BLA坐标的响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 芯电离会沿BLA坐标将基态双势阱对称化；计算的X射线谱对键长变化极为敏感——C1s电离能在BLA坐标（1.1–1.4 Å）范围内变化可达2.4 eV，NEXAFS π*峰在同一坐标范围内移动可达4 eV。这些谱学特征为超快X射线实验解码瞬态结构提供了定量的"谱学–结构"对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：芯电离会沿BLA坐标将基态双势阱对称化；计算的X射线谱对键长变化极为敏感——C1s电离能在BLA坐标（1.1–1.4 Å）范围内变化可达2.4 eV，NEXAFS π*峰在同一坐标范围内移动可达4 eV。这些谱学特征为超快X射线实验解码瞬态结构提供了定量的"谱学–结构"对应关系。；创新点：针对"局域芯激发能否报告全局集体畸变"这一长期未决问题，以C₁₈为模型体系，首次通过第一性原理计算证明芯能级谱对BLA动力学具有高度敏感性，并给出了定量的谱学–结构字典，为未来超快X射线实验实时监测键长交替动力学提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理模拟，包括：映射二维势能面（沿BLA坐标）、计算芯电离后的势能面变化、计算C1s电离能及NEXAFS谱。摘要提到使用了不同泛函（different functionals）进行对比，但未具体说明是哪种泛函或具体计算软件/方法（如DFT的具体泛函类型、是否含时DFT等）。

papers.title: Geometric Phases in Two-Level Mixing: From Neutral Mesons to Holonomic Qubits and Topological Majorana Modes
papers.abstract: We investigate the geometric structure of a Hermitian two-level mixing Hamiltonian motivated by neutral meson oscillations and its connections with qubit, fermionic, and topological descriptions. Mapping the Hamiltonian to an effective qubit representation, we analyze the geometric phase associated with cyclic parameter evolution on the Bloch sphere. Without identifying the complex mixing phase with a physical CP-violation observable, we interpret it as a CP-like geometric parameter controlling the azimuthal orientation of the Hamiltonian vector and its reversal under phase conjugation. Third-order Bargmann invariants constructed from the eigenstates yield an associated discrete phase whose dependence on the mixing parameters is examined alongside the continuous geometric construction. The cyclic evolution is also represented as a single-qubit $R_z$ phase operation and expressed through Majorana bilinears. Extending the construction to the momentum-dependent Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian of the Kitaev chain, we relate momentum-space winding to the topological regimes and the quantized Berry (Zak) phase in the real-parameter model, while the corresponding Bargmann construction approaches the global phase in the continuum limit. Together, these results provide a geometric perspective connecting phase structure, qubit operations, fermionic representations, and momentum-space topology within related two-level Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Hermitian two-level mixing Hamiltonian、mapping to effective qubit representation、Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian、Bargmann invariants、Berry (Zak) phase 等，均为理论构造与解析分析，摘要中未涉及任何实验测量。；研究对象：一个受中性介子振荡启发的厄米两能级混合哈密顿量，及其与量子比特、费米子和拓扑描述的联系；具体包括Bloch球面上的循环参数演化、Kitaev链的动量依赖Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量、拓扑区域与量子化Berry（Zak）相位，以及Majorana双线性表示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将哈密顿量映射为有效量子比特，复混合相位可被解释为控制哈密顿量矢量方位角取向及其在相位共轭下反转的类CP几何参数；由本征态构造的三阶Bargmann不变量给出一个离散相位，其依赖于混合参数；循环演化可表示为单量子比特R_z相位操作并用Majorana双线性表达；在Kitaev链中，动量空间缠绕与拓扑区域及实参数模型中的量子化Berry（Zak）相位相关联，而相应的Bargmann构造在连续极限下趋近全局相位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将哈密顿量映射为有效量子比特，复混合相位可被解释为控制哈密顿量矢量方位角取向及其在相位共轭下反转的类CP几何参数；由本征态构造的三阶Bargmann不变量给出一个离散相位，其依赖于混合参数；循环演化可表示为单量子比特R_z相位操作并用Majorana双线性表达；在Kitaev链中，动量空间缠绕与拓扑区域及实参数模型中的量子化Berry（Zak）相位相关联，而相应的Bargmann构造在连续极限下趋近全局相位。；创新点：将中性介子振荡启发的两能级混合哈密顿量与量子比特几何相位、Bargmann不变量、Majorana双线性及Kitaev链的动量空间拓扑统一在一个几何视角下；明确不将复混合相位等同于物理CP破坏可观测量，而是将其解释为类CP几何参数；并建立了Bargmann构造与连续极限下全局相位之间的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：厄米两能级混合哈密顿量的几何结构分析、映射到有效量子比特表示、Bloch球面上循环参数演化的几何相位分析、三阶Bargmann不变量的构造、单量子比特R_z相位操作表示、Majorana双线性表示，以及将构造推广到Kitaev链的动量依赖Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量，分析动量空间缠绕、拓扑区域与量子化Berry（Zak）相位。

papers.title: Fractional Bose-Einstein Condensate Dark Matter Cores: Numerical GPP Solutions and SPARC Rotation Curves
papers.abstract: We investigate a fractional Bose Einstein condensate dark matter scenario in which an ultralight bosonic component forms a self gravitating core embedded in a predominantly cold dark matter halo. The stationary GPP system solved numerically beyond the TF approximation leads to energetically bound equilibrium configurations and good phenomenological fits to the selected rotation curves from 30 SPARC galaxies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Numerical GPP Solutions、solved numerically、phenomenological fits，说明以数值求解和理论建模为主，属于计算与理论结合的工作。；研究对象：分数化玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚暗物质场景：一个超轻玻色子组分形成自引力核心，嵌入以冷暗物质为主的暗物质晕中。同时涉及30个SPARC星系的自转曲线。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超越Thomas-Fermi近似下数值求解定态GPP系统，可以得到能量上束缚的平衡构型，并且对所选30个SPARC星系的自转曲线给出良好的唯象拟合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超越Thomas-Fermi近似下数值求解定态GPP系统，可以得到能量上束缚的平衡构型，并且对所选30个SPARC星系的自转曲线给出良好的唯象拟合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要仅指出在超越TF近似下数值求解GPP系统并应用于SPARC星系自转曲线拟合，未明确说明相对于已有研究的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解定态GPP（Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson）系统，且计算超出Thomas-Fermi（TF）近似；随后将结果与30个SPARC星系的自转曲线进行唯象拟合。

papers.title: Efficient Representation of multicategorical local Hilbert spaces: nonlinear Restricted Boltzmann Machines to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract: Neural network quantum states (NQS) for representing spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ systems are typically built from Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with binary visible variables, in which the input spins are first combined through linear affine maps before more expressive nonlinear transformations are applied. The standard way for representing multi-categorical systems, namely spin-1 and spin-2, or the q-state quantum Potts systems with more than two local degrees of freedom, is a unary or one-hot encoded MLP architecture. Following a few similar studies, I observe that while the one-hot construction is the mathematically faithful encoding for systems with more than two local states such as spin-$S$ models with $S > 1/2$ or $q$-state Potts models, its parameter count grows with the number of local states, and the resulting optimization landscape can hinder convergence. I find numerically that allowing $\log Ψ$ to be a nonlinear function of the raw multi-valued spin variable is a natural categorical generalization: it preserves the labelling freedom of the local basis and reproduces the one-hot model with strictly fewer parameters, often with improved trainability. I first benchmark this idea on shallow Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), equipping them with several distinct nonlinear connections, for spin-1, 2, and 3 Heisenberg chains. I then turn to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), where each edge carries a learnable univariate nonlinearity, and show that they provide a strictly more expressive realization of the same principle. Finally, I demonstrate that this framework captures the critical behaviour of the quantum Potts Hamiltonian, recovering its phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：numerically、benchmark、Neural network quantum states (NQS)、Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs)、Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)、variational ansatz 的构建与数值验证。；研究对象：量子多体自旋系统的基态波函数表示，具体包括 spin-1、spin-2、spin-3 的海森堡链（Heisenberg chains），以及 q-state 量子 Potts 模型（多分量局域希尔伯特空间，local degrees of freedom 大于 2 的体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 允许 log Ψ 成为原始多值自旋变量的非线性函数，是对多分量局域希尔伯特空间的一种自然分类学推广：它保留了局域基的标号自由度，并能以严格更少的参数复现 one-hot 模型，且通常具有更好的可训练性；该框架还能捕捉量子 Potts 哈密顿量的临界行为并恢复其相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：允许 log Ψ 成为原始多值自旋变量的非线性函数，是对多分量局域希尔伯特空间的一种自然分类学推广：它保留了局域基的标号自由度，并能以严格更少的参数复现 one-hot 模型，且通常具有更好的可训练性；该框架还能捕捉量子 Potts 哈密顿量的临界行为并恢复其相变。；创新点：针对多分量（spin-1、spin-2、q-state Potts 等）体系，指出现有 one-hot（unary）编码 MLP 架构参数随局域态数增长且优化景观可能阻碍收敛；提出让 log Ψ 直接非线性依赖于原始多值自旋变量这一分类学推广，在保留局域基标号自由度的同时以更少参数复现 one-hot 模型并常改善可训练性，并进一步用 KAN 给出该原理更具表达力的实现。
papers.method_zh: 以神经网络量子态（NQS）为框架，将 log Ψ 构造为原始多值自旋变量的非线性函数；具体在浅层 Restricted Boltzmann Machines（RBMs）上引入若干不同的非线性连接进行基准测试（针对 spin-1、2、3 海森堡链），随后采用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KANs，每条边携带可学习的单变量非线性）作为同一原理的更具表达力的实现，并对量子 Potts 哈密顿量进行数值验证以恢复其相变。

papers.title: Entanglement Growth as Transport Across Schmidt Scales
papers.abstract: Quantum entanglement growth is commonly summarized by a single entropy, obscuring where correlations reside in the exponentially large Schmidt spectrum and how they form. Here, we introduce Schmidt-scale concentration and dominant Schmidt scale, two coordinates that locate the probability maximum across logarithmic windows in ordered Schmidt-rank space. Applied to quenches of a random-field spin chain, these coordinates distinguish rapid transport of the dominant scale to higher Schmidt rank at weak disorder from strongly suppressed transport despite continued logarithmic entropy growth at strong disorder.
