The disorder-averaged dynamics exhibit an ordered hierarchy: entropy production peaks first, spectral roughness and exact nonlocal magic peak next, and dominant-Schmidt-scale transport becomes typical only after a substantial delay. Moreover, a solvable head--tail model and controlled numerical experiments reveal the physical origin of this hierarchy: the spectral path determines the order of events, local dynamics on active exchange bonds set their early timing, and intra-subsystem many-body dressing further delays dominant-Schmidt-scale transport. These results establish the Schmidt-scale coordinates as powerful dynamical probes for uncovering fine-grained entanglement structures distinguishing entanglement production, entanglement-spectrum reorganization, and dominant-Schmidt-scale transport beyond entropy alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提到“solvable head–tail model”（可解头尾模型）和“controlled numerical experiments”（受控数值实验），研究对象为随机场自旋链的量子淬火，属于数值计算与理论分析结合的纯理论研究，无实验测量。；研究对象：量子纠缠生长的动力学过程，具体体系为随机场自旋链（random-field spin chain）的量子淬火。研究关注纠缠在Schmidt谱中的分布与输运，而非某具体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入“Schmidt尺度集中度”和“主导Schmidt尺度”两个坐标来定位Schmidt谱对数窗口中的概率最大值，发现弱无序下主导尺度快速向高Schmidt秩输运，而强无序下输运被强烈抑制但熵仍持续对数增长；无序平均动力学呈现有序层级：熵产生最先达峰，谱粗糙度和精确非局域magic次之，主导Schmidt尺度输运显著延迟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入“Schmidt尺度集中度”和“主导Schmidt尺度”两个坐标来定位Schmidt谱对数窗口中的概率最大值，发现弱无序下主导尺度快速向高Schmidt秩输运，而强无序下输运被强烈抑制但熵仍持续对数增长；无序平均动力学呈现有序层级：熵产生最先达峰，谱粗糙度和精确非局域magic次之，主导Schmidt尺度输运显著延迟。；创新点：超越单一熵描述，提出Schmidt尺度坐标作为动力学探针，能够区分纠缠产生、纠缠谱重组和主导Schmidt尺度输运三个不同过程，揭示了熵增长与谱输运可以解耦，并阐明了层级延迟的物理起源（谱路径决定事件顺序、活跃交换键上的局域动力学决定早期时序、子系统内多体修饰进一步延迟输运）。
papers.method_zh: 对随机场自旋链进行量子淬火数值模拟；引入Schmidt尺度集中度和主导Schmidt尺度两个序参量；构建可解的头尾模型（head–tail model）并结合受控数值实验分析层级起源。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Solution-phase fluorination of nanodiamond: near-surface NV$^-$ activation and spin relaxation
papers.abstract: Nanodiamonds hosting luminescent point defects, known as fluorescent nanodiamonds (FND), are a leading platform for quantum technology. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre is the most intensively studied of these; its negatively charged state (NV$^-$) can serve as a qubit at room temperature, and its stability is governed by surface functional groups. We present two solution-phase fluorination routes for stabilising NV$^-$: direct C-F bond formation by decarboxylation with xenon difluoride via a radical mechanism, and the Balz-Schiemann reaction, which replaces surface amino groups with fluorine. The two routes were compared by infrared, X-ray photoelectron, energy-dispersive X-ray, Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy. Both gave a high NV$^-$ fraction, up to $\sim$90% on average and approaching 100% in fluorine-rich regions, which to our knowledge is among the highest reported for surface-terminated nanodiamonds of this size and, in particular, for fluorine termination. Frequency-domain relaxometry shows that the fluorinated particles retain a long spin-lattice relaxation time, $733\pm56$ and $712\pm20$ $μ$s for the XeF$_2$ and Balz-Schiemann routes, several times the values reported for commercial HPHT nanodiamonds, although shorter than the $1173\pm123$ $μ$s of the as-received material. Charge-state stability and spin lifetime therefore do not improve together: fluorination activates near-surface NV$^-$ centres, which are the most exposed to surface noise but also the ones that dominate relaxometric sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中描述了两种溶液相氟化合成路线（XeF₂脱羧直接C-F键形成、Balz-Schiemann反应），并列举了多种表征手段（红外、X射线光电子能谱、能量色散X射线、拉曼、光致发光光谱）以及频域弛豫测量，属于典型的合成与表征实验工作。；研究对象：纳米金刚石中的氮-空位（NV）色心，特别是其带负电态（NV⁻）的表面稳定化与自旋弛豫性质。具体研究通过氟化表面终止来稳定NV⁻电荷态并考察其自旋-晶格弛豫时间。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种溶液相氟化路线均能显著提高NV⁻比例（平均可达约90%，富氟区域接近100%），但氟化后自旋-晶格弛豫时间（XeF₂路线733±56 μs，Balz-Schiemann路线712±20 μs）虽远优于商用HPHT纳米金刚石，却短于未处理原材料的1173±123 μs。即电荷态稳定性与自旋寿命不能同步提升：氟化激活了近表面NV⁻色心，这些色心最易受表面噪声影响，但也正是主导弛豫传感的信号来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种溶液相氟化路线均能显著提高NV⁻比例（平均可达约90%，富氟区域接近100%），但氟化后自旋-晶格弛豫时间（XeF₂路线733±56 μs，Balz-Schiemann路线712±20 μs）虽远优于商用HPHT纳米金刚石，却短于未处理原材料的1173±123 μs。即电荷态稳定性与自旋寿命不能同步提升：氟化激活了近表面NV⁻色心，这些色心最易受表面噪声影响，但也正是主导弛豫传感的信号来源。；创新点：首次提出并对比了两种溶液相氟化路线用于纳米金刚石NV⁻的表面稳定化，实现了迄今该尺寸表面终止纳米金刚石（尤其是氟终止）中报道的最高NV⁻比例之一（平均约90%，富氟区接近100%）；同时揭示了氟化虽提升电荷态稳定性但未同步改善自旋寿命这一矛盾关系。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：(1) 两种溶液相氟化路线——XeF₂经自由基机制脱羧直接形成C-F键，以及Balz-Schiemann反应将表面氨基替换为氟；(2) 表征手段：红外光谱、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）、能量色散X射线谱（EDX）、拉曼光谱、光致发光光谱；(3) 频域弛豫测量（frequency-domain relaxometry）用于测定自旋-晶格弛豫时间。

papers.title: Blind directions of physical learning networks: where to measure and what to measure
papers.abstract: A physical learning network is read at a few accessible nodes. Every task and learning rule that uses only the steady voltages and currents there, at a fixed operating point, acts through the boundary response map. Parameter changes in the kernel of its Jacobian are blind to first order. A walk along one fiber of that map had not terminated at a 600-step cap, one edge then at 15.2 times its start. A decomposition theorem splits the response Jacobian over the hidden components. The blind dimension adds over components whose surviving slots are disjoint. A boundary-to-boundary edge adds one parameter and deletes one slot. Exposing a hidden node changes only its component. For one hidden node the component's contribution counts the bipartite components of the non-adjacency graph of its neighbors. For a pocket of h hidden nodes a factor-analysis bound caps what outside electrodes can expose. It is attained when every pocket node meets every neighbor and no edge joins two of those neighbors, so past a threshold further electrodes outside such a pocket expose nothing. An electrode inside such a pocket, when its hidden nodes form a clique, is worth h-1 directions where one outside is worth none. Reading the accessible nodes as vector displacements rather than potentials left no deficit beyond counting in all 90 spring networks tested, each a pocket fully joined to five or more accessible nodes, and nothing blind at all in 88. What limits the reading is the quantity measured as much as the number of contacts. Maximum-weight spanning forests give a proved upper bound on the blind dimension. The matching equality is proved for one hidden node and conjectured beyond. The forest count matched the numerical blind dimension in 1,451 of 1,500 held-out networks, and no shortfall separates an incomplete search from a false equality. A self-learning circuit shows the split on hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值验证）。关键依据：摘要以定理（decomposition theorem）、上界证明（proved upper bound）、猜想（conjectured）、因子分析界（factor-analysis bound）等理论推导为主，同时用 90 个弹簧网络、1500 个留出网络的数值实验和自学习电路硬件进行验证，但核心贡献是理论框架。；研究对象：物理学习网络（physical learning networks）——即在少数可及节点（accessible nodes）上读取稳态电压和电流、在固定工作点下进行学习的物理网络，研究其边界响应映射（boundary response map）的雅可比矩阵的“盲方向”（blind directions），以及隐藏节点（hidden nodes）、隐藏节点团簇（pocket）与外部电极对可测量性的影响。摘要未明确说明具体材料平台，仅提到弹簧网络和自学习电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 边界响应映射雅可比矩阵的核内参数变化在一阶下对读取是盲的；盲维度可按隐藏分量分解并随分量叠加，且存在一个由最大权重生成森林给出的盲维度上界（在 1500 个留出网络中 1451 个与数值盲维度吻合）。测量什么量（如把可及节点读作矢量位移而非电势）与接触数目同样限制读取能力——在 90 个弹簧网络中后者未留下超出计数的亏缺，88 个完全无盲区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：边界响应映射雅可比矩阵的核内参数变化在一阶下对读取是盲的；盲维度可按隐藏分量分解并随分量叠加，且存在一个由最大权重生成森林给出的盲维度上界（在 1500 个留出网络中 1451 个与数值盲维度吻合）。测量什么量（如把可及节点读作矢量位移而非电势）与接触数目同样限制读取能力——在 90 个弹簧网络中后者未留下超出计数的亏缺，88 个完全无盲区。；创新点：将物理学习网络的“可测量性极限”形式化为边界响应映射雅可比的盲方向问题，给出盲维度按隐藏分量的可加分解、隐藏节点团簇的因子分析上界（超过阈值后外部电极无法暴露任何信息，而团簇内部电极在隐藏节点成团时价值 h-1 个方向），并提出最大权重生成森林作为盲维度的可证上界及匹配等式猜想；同时指出限制读取的是所测物理量本身而非仅接触数量。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：边界响应映射及其雅可比矩阵的核分析、响应雅可比的分解定理、非邻接图的双分图分量计数、因子分析界（factor-analysis bound）、最大权重生成森林（maximum-weight spanning forests）给出的盲维度上界证明与匹配等式（单隐藏节点已证、多节点为猜想）。数值上测试了 90 个弹簧网络和 1500 个留出网络，并用自学习电路在硬件上展示该分裂现象。

papers.title: Turbulence Decay Intensifies Clustering of Bubbles and Particles
papers.abstract: Our understanding of inertial particle dynamics in turbulence is mostly based on flows held in a statistically stationary state, a particular regime that differs from many natural flows where energy input can often be intermittent or cyclic, or may abruptly cease. Here we investigate inertial particle and bubble dynamics in freely decaying turbulence through complementary experiments and direct numerical simulations. While particle accelerations decay monotonically in time, we find evidence that the clustering can exhibit a non-monotonic evolution, intensifying sharply before subsequently weakening. We demonstrate that both the acceleration and clustering behaviors can be mapped onto their counterparts in stationary turbulence using a dynamic rescaling of the evolving length and time scales of the turbulence. Validity conditions for the dynamic rescaling, satisfied by both the experimental and numerical datasets, are derived. The proposed mappings remain applicable across a broad range of density ratios, from light to heavy particles, and particle sizes spanning two orders of magnitude in Stokes number.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算）。判断依据关键词：“complementary experiments and direct numerical simulations”。；研究对象：自由衰减湍流（freely decaying turbulence）中的惯性颗粒和气泡动力学，具体关注颗粒加速度与聚集（clustering）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自由衰减湍流中，颗粒加速度随时间单调衰减，但聚集行为却呈现非单调演化——先急剧增强，随后减弱。通过基于湍流演化长度和时间尺度的动态重标度，可将加速度和聚集行为映射到统计稳态湍流中的对应结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自由衰减湍流中，颗粒加速度随时间单调衰减，但聚集行为却呈现非单调演化——先急剧增强，随后减弱。通过基于湍流演化长度和时间尺度的动态重标度，可将加速度和聚集行为映射到统计稳态湍流中的对应结果。；创新点：以往对湍流中惯性颗粒动力学的研究多基于统计稳态湍流，而本文聚焦于自由衰减湍流这一更贴近自然流动的 regime，揭示了聚集行为的非单调演化，并提出了将非稳态结果映射到稳态湍流的动态重标度框架，且验证了该映射在广泛密度比和跨越两个数量级 Stokes 数的颗粒尺寸范围内均适用。
papers.method_zh: 互补的实验测量与直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulations, DNS），并结合动态重标度（dynamic rescaling）方法，将自由衰减湍流中的结果映射到稳态湍流框架。推导了动态重标度的有效性条件。

papers.title: Algorithmic Randomness and Physical Typicality
papers.abstract: Appeals to typicality are common in physics, but it is often unclear what it means for a physical state to be typical relative to a probability measure, and correspondingly unclear what a law that appeals to typicality asserts. Here we consider how one might characterize physical typicality using ideas from the theory of algorithmic randomness. As a concrete example, we show how taking a physical state to be typical relative to a computable measure when it is Martin-Löf random allows one to formulate the distribution postulate in Bohmian mechanics as a statistical constraining law of the theory. Using a toy model, we show how this constraint guarantees the standard Born statistics for computable experimental protocols. Algorithmic Bohmian mechanics (aBM) thus illustrates how algorithmic randomness may be used to provide precise content to a statistical law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中未涉及任何实验或数值计算，而是讨论如何用算法随机性理论刻画物理典型性，并以波姆力学为例进行概念性重构，属于理论/基础概念研究。；研究对象：物理状态的“典型性”（typicality）概念本身，具体以波姆力学（Bohmian mechanics）中的分布假设为案例，并借助一个玩具模型（toy model）来说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 若将物理状态相对于可计算测度（computable measure）的典型性定义为 Martin-Löf 随机，则可将波姆力学中的分布假设表述为一种统计约束定律；该约束可保证对可计算实验方案给出标准的 Born 统计。由此提出的“算法波姆力学”（aBM）表明算法随机性可为统计定律提供精确内容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：若将物理状态相对于可计算测度（computable measure）的典型性定义为 Martin-Löf 随机，则可将波姆力学中的分布假设表述为一种统计约束定律；该约束可保证对可计算实验方案给出标准的 Born 统计。由此提出的“算法波姆力学”（aBM）表明算法随机性可为统计定律提供精确内容。；创新点：将算法随机性理论引入物理典型性的刻画，把波姆力学中的分布假设重新表述为统计约束定律，并证明该约束对可计算实验方案恢复标准 Born 统计，从而为统计定律提供精确的数学内容。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：算法随机性理论（algorithmic randomness），特别是 Martin-Löf 随机性概念；结合可计算测度、波姆力学及统计约束定律的概念分析，并使用一个玩具模型进行论证。

papers.title: Effects of Trotter Error, Digitization Error, and Initial State Overlap on Tapered Quantum Phase Estimation for Minimum Eigenvalue Computation
papers.abstract: We numerically implement full quantum circuits of optimal tapered Quantum Phase Estimation (in the form of an implementable approximate bandwidth-limited DPSS taper) for the purpose of minimum eigenvalue computation, where the Hamiltonian time-evolution unitary is implemented using standard Trotterization, and the taper state is constructed using an optimized bandwidth-limited taper. We illustrate, on representative quantum Hamiltonians, with tractable exact classical numerical quantum circuit simulations, how tapered QPE performs with respect to optimal phase sampling rate, absolute error, Shannon entropy of the optimal phase distribution, when the tQPE algorithm parameters are changed. Those algorithm parameters are Trotter error, finite sampling, imperfect initial states, total evolution time, and digitization error (number of phase qubits). The reported numerical experiments include up to $\ell=10$ phase qubits of precision with $m=3$ additional phase-register error suppression qubits, on a $4$-qubit Heisenberg quantum magnet model Hamiltonian, using up to 12th-order Trotterization. We numerically show i) the steady-state optimal phase sampling rate is determined by the initial state overlap with the ground-state, ii) with respect to phase sampling probability, or overall eigenvalue sampling error rate, there is no strong evolution time dependence for tQPE unless there is high Trotter error, iii) the approximated time-evolution unitaries in tQPE, like in standard QPE, can result in substantial ringing, which leads to non-physical eigenvalue estimates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：numerically implement、exact classical numerical quantum circuit simulations、numerically show。；研究对象：量子相位估计（QPE）算法在最小本征值计算中的性能，具体针对 tapered QPE（使用可实现的近似带宽受限 DPSS taper），在代表性量子哈密顿量上进行研究，包括一个 4-qubit Heisenberg 量子磁体模型哈密顿量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: i) 稳态最优相位采样率由初始态与基态的overlap决定；ii) 除非 Trotter 误差很高，tQPE 的相位采样概率（或整体本征值采样误差率）没有强烈的演化时间依赖性；iii) tQPE 中近似的时间演化幺正（与标准 QPE 一样）会导致显著的振铃效应，从而产生非物理的本征值估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：i) 稳态最优相位采样率由初始态与基态的overlap决定；ii) 除非 Trotter 误差很高，tQPE 的相位采样概率（或整体本征值采样误差率）没有强烈的演化时间依赖性；iii) tQPE 中近似的时间演化幺正（与标准 QPE 一样）会导致显著的振铃效应，从而产生非物理的本征值估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的新意，但摘要中明确的工作特征是对 tapered QPE 完整量子电路进行精确经典模拟，并系统考察 Trotter 误差、数字化误差和初始态 overlap 等多个算法参数对 tQPE 性能（最优相位采样率、绝对误差、最优相位分布的 Shannon 熵）的影响。
papers.method_zh: 对 tapered QPE 的完整量子电路进行精确经典数值量子电路模拟；哈密顿量时间演化幺正用标准 Trotterization 实现；taper 态用优化的带宽受限 taper 构造。实验参数包括 Trotter 误差、有限采样、不完美初始态、总演化时间、数字化误差（相位量子比特数）。具体配置：最多 ℓ=10 个相位量子比特精度，m=3 个额外相位寄存器误差抑制量子比特，4-qubit Heisenberg 量子磁体模型哈密顿量，最高 12 阶 Trotterization。

papers.title: Wigner Time: a data-oriented approach to experimental timeline creation for quantum science and technology
papers.abstract: Precisely timed, multi-device control in atomic, molecular and optical physics is provided by specialized real-time systems, which impose their own terms on the description of the experiment: a program over a global clock, in which every stage boundary is an absolute time computed from everything preceding it. Such descriptions are tightly coupled -- changing one stage affects all later ones -- and are correspondingly hard to reuse, inspect, or move elsewhere. We introduce Wigner Time, a Python package in which the experimental procedure is instead represented as data: a table of timed updates, assembled by composing functions and referred to named points in the experiment rather than to absolute instants. Hardware enters only at a final conversion step, leaving the description readable and back-end agnostic. Wigner Time has run two cold-atom setups for more than two years, where replacing a hand-written real-time program improved the achievable temporal resolution five-fold; the design applies to any domain requiring precise multi-device timing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验技术/软件工具类文章（偏实验方法与仪器控制）。判断依据的关键词：real-time systems、multi-device control、cold-atom setups、Python package、experimental timeline creation、back-end agnostic。；研究对象：原子、分子与光学（AMO）物理实验中的多设备精确定时控制系统，具体应用于冷原子实验装置（cold-atom setups）的实验时序（timeline）描述与生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将实验流程表示为“数据”（定时更新表，通过函数组合并以命名时间点引用，而非绝对时刻），可使实验描述可读、可复用、与硬件后端无关；在兩台冷原子装置上运行两年多，替换手写实时程序后时间分辨率提升了五倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将实验流程表示为“数据”（定时更新表，通过函数组合并以命名时间点引用，而非绝对时刻），可使实验描述可读、可复用、与硬件后端无关；在兩台冷原子装置上运行两年多，替换手写实时程序后时间分辨率提升了五倍。；创新点：相对于传统基于全局时钟、以绝对时间计算每个阶段边界的紧耦合实时程序描述方式，本工作将实验流程解耦为可读、可复用、后端无关的数据表示，并在实际冷原子实验中验证了性能提升（时间分辨率提高五倍）。
papers.method_zh: 开发了名为 Wigner Time 的 Python 软件包，采用数据驱动的实验流程表示方法（定时更新表 + 函数组合 + 命名时间点引用），硬件仅在最终转换步骤介入。摘要未明确说明具体的实验测量手段或物理体系细节。

papers.title: Helicity-engineered nonlinear optical responses in photo-excited topological semimetals
papers.abstract: Topological materials provide a transformative arena for light-driven control of electronic motion; yet, direct manipulation of electron dynamics on sub-cycle timescale remains a significant challenge. We demonstrate that the strong-field-driven high-harmonic generation of a Weyl semimetal can be controlled and manipulated through bicircular pump-probe driving fields. While a lone probe pulse generates exclusively odd-order harmonics, the addition of a pump pulse triggers a series of sidebands arising from nonlinear frequency mixing of pump and probe photons. Our results reveal that the sideband intensities are highly sensitive to the relative helicity of the pulses and the orientation of the polarization plane. This sensitivity stems from the chiral nature of the Weyl nodes, which couples efficiently to the light's helicity only when the node-separation axis is perpendicular to the polarization plane. Furthermore, the significant suppression of sideband intensity with increasing pump-probe delay identifies these features as a potential clock for electron-hole decoherence. These findings establish frequency-mixed high-harmonic generation as a sensitive probe of chiral quantum dynamics and suggest a robust framework for manipulating topological currents via structured light, with implications for lightwave electronics and ultrafast quantum information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We demonstrate that...can be controlled and manipulated through bicircular pump-probe driving fields”“Our results reveal”“identifies these features as a potential clock”等表述，属于基于理论模型或数值模拟的强场动力学研究，未提及具体实验测量手段。；研究对象：外尔半金属（Weyl semimetal）在双圆偏振泵浦-探测强场驱动下的高次谐波产生及边带效应，以及其中手性外尔节点与光螺旋性的耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单独探测脉冲仅产生奇次谐波，加入泵浦脉冲后因泵浦与探测光子的非线性频率混合而产生一系列边带；边带强度对两脉冲的相对螺旋性和偏振面取向高度敏感，这种敏感性源于外尔节点的手性——仅当节点分离轴垂直于偏振面时手性才与光螺旋性高效耦合。此外，边带强度随泵浦-探测延迟增大而显著衰减，可作为电子-空穴退相干的潜在时钟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单独探测脉冲仅产生奇次谐波，加入泵浦脉冲后因泵浦与探测光子的非线性频率混合而产生一系列边带；边带强度对两脉冲的相对螺旋性和偏振面取向高度敏感，这种敏感性源于外尔节点的手性——仅当节点分离轴垂直于偏振面时手性才与光螺旋性高效耦合。此外，边带强度随泵浦-探测延迟增大而显著衰减，可作为电子-空穴退相干的潜在时钟。；创新点：提出通过双圆偏振泵浦-探测场对拓扑半金属高次谐波进行螺旋性工程调控，揭示了频率混合高次谐波产生可作为手性量子动力学的灵敏探针，并指出边带衰减可用于探测电子-空穴退相干，为利用结构光操控拓扑电流提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用双圆偏振泵浦-探测驱动场下的强场高次谐波产生理论框架/数值模拟，分析非线性频率混合产生的边带强度对螺旋性和偏振面取向的依赖关系。摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法（如TDDFT、半导体布洛赫方程等）。

papers.title: Unraveling-Dependent Metastability in Monitored Quantum Systems and Associative Memories
papers.abstract: Metastability in open quantum systems is usually inferred from spectral separation in the Liouvillian, which governs unconditional, ensemble-averaged dynamics. We show that this diagnosis is incomplete at the level of individual quantum trajectories: conditioned realizations of the same unconditional dynamics can bypass, transiently access, or operationally preserve a metastable memory, depending on the monitored channel and the observed record. We demonstrate these mechanisms in a driven-dissipative nonlinear oscillator realizing a quantum associative memory, by comparing spectra, target fidelities, and phase-space distributions. The non-Hermitian dynamics obtained by post-selecting on the absence of detected events supports metastable retrieval, but with a distinct long-time fate: normalization selects the least-decaying mode of the non-Hermitian spectrum rather than the addressed memory branch. In contrast, stochastic jump trajectories can preserve retrieval over extended times when the post-measurement update remains compatible with the coherent memory structure. Thus trajectory-level metastability is not determined by the averaged generator alone; it requires compatibility between the monitored channel, the measurement record, and the metastable manifold.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中出现“We show that this diagnosis is incomplete”“We demonstrate these mechanisms”“by comparing spectra, target fidelities, and phase-space distributions”，属于理论分析与数值模拟相结合的研究，未提及具体实验平台或实验测量。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的亚稳态（metastability），具体为受监测（monitored）量子系统以及量子联想记忆（quantum associative memory）。体系为一个驱动-耗散非线性振子（driven-dissipative nonlinear oscillator），用以实现量子联想记忆。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 亚稳态的传统诊断（基于Liouvillian的谱分离，即无条件系综平均动力学）在单条量子轨迹层面是不完备的：同一无条件动力学在不同监测通道和观测记录下，条件化实现可以绕过、短暂访问或操作性地保持亚稳态记忆。轨迹层面的亚稳态不由平均生成元单独决定，而要求监测通道、测量记录与亚稳态流形之间相互兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：亚稳态的传统诊断（基于Liouvillian的谱分离，即无条件系综平均动力学）在单条量子轨迹层面是不完备的：同一无条件动力学在不同监测通道和观测记录下，条件化实现可以绕过、短暂访问或操作性地保持亚稳态记忆。轨迹层面的亚稳态不由平均生成元单独决定，而要求监测通道、测量记录与亚稳态流形之间相互兼容。；创新点：已有研究通常从Liouvillian谱分离推断开放量子系统的亚稳态，本文指出这种基于系综平均的诊断在单条量子轨迹层面不完整，并揭示了条件化动力学可绕过、短暂访问或保持亚稳态记忆的机制。此外，本文发现对“无探测事件”后选择得到的非厄米动力学虽支持亚稳态检索，但长时间行为由归一化选出的非厄米谱中衰减最慢的模式决定，而非所寻址的记忆分支；而随机跳跃轨迹在测量后更新与相干记忆结构兼容时，可在延长时间内保持检索。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为开放量子系统的Liouvillian谱分析与量子轨迹（quantum trajectory）方法。具体手段包括：比较Liouvillian谱、目标保真度（target fidelities）和相空间分布（phase-space distributions）；分析通过对“未检测到事件”进行后选择（post-selection）得到的非厄米动力学；以及随机量子跳跃轨迹（stochastic jump trajectories）分析。

papers.title: Conservation of Normalized Energy Density in multi-layered media: a proof for the general multi-layer 2D SH problem
papers.abstract: The Normalized Energy Density (NED) was introduced in Goto et al.(2011) as a quantity that, unlike the conventional energy, is conserved across material interfaces in a layered elastic medium. Its conservation was proved analytically only for a two-layer structure; for three or more layers it was supported by Monte Carlo simulation. I supply the missing proof for a general multi-layer (n-layer) structure in the 2D SH problem. The key step is to stop treating the angular frequency as a single variable and instead lift the layer phases to independent coordinates on the n-torus. The obstruction identified in the original paper---that the ratio of travel-time combinations is generically irrational, so that the periodicity argument used for two layers fails and disappears, and the proof reduces to Weyl's equidistribution theorem combined with n repetitions of the same elementary integral used in the two-layer case. I prove conservation in two independent settings that together cover all cases of practical interest: travel times that are linearly independent over Q, and commensurable travel times, including the equal-travel-time (Goupillaud) discretization. I also show that an arbitrary layered structure can be subdivided by reflectionless interfaces into one whose travel times take only d distinct, Q-independent values, where d is the dimension of the Q-span of the original travel times; this places the two proved cases at the endpoints d=1 and d=n and isolates the remaining open case 1<d<n in a canonical form.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确说明是“supply the missing proof”（补充缺失的证明），核心工作为解析证明与数学推导（Weyl 等分布定理、n-环面坐标提升等），不涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：二维 SH（水平剪切）波在一般多层（n 层）弹性介质中的传播问题，以及归一化能量密度（Normalized Energy Density, NED）在层状介质界面处的守恒性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者证明了 NED 在一般 n 层结构的 2D SH 问题中守恒，覆盖两类情形：走时在 Q 上线性无关，以及走时可公度（含等走时的 Goupillaud 离散化）；并证明任意层状结构可通过无反射界面细分为走时仅取 d 个互不 Q 相关值的结构，从而将已证两种情形定位在 d=1 与 d=n 两个端点，把剩余开放情形 1<d<n 隔离为规范形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者证明了 NED 在一般 n 层结构的 2D SH 问题中守恒，覆盖两类情形：走时在 Q 上线性无关，以及走时可公度（含等走时的 Goupillaud 离散化）；并证明任意层状结构可通过无反射界面细分为走时仅取 d 个互不 Q 相关值的结构，从而将已证两种情形定位在 d=1 与 d=n 两个端点，把剩余开放情形 1<d<n 隔离为规范形式。；创新点：原论文仅对两层结构给出解析证明，三层及以上仅靠 Monte Carlo 模拟支持；本文补上了任意 n 层的严格证明，并指出原论文所遇障碍（走时组合之比一般无理，导致两层所用周期性论证失效）可通过环面坐标提升与 Weyl 等分布定理绕过。此外还给出通过无反射界面细分将一般结构约化为 d 个 Q-无关走时值的规范形式，明确了已证与未证情形的边界。
papers.method_zh: 理论/解析证明。关键步骤是将角频率不再视为单一变量，而把各层相位提升为 n-环面上的独立坐标；结合 Weyl 等分布定理，并重复使用两层情形中的同一初等积分 n 次。分别在走时 Q-线性无关与走时可公度两种独立设定下完成证明。

papers.title: Boundary-Cancelled Score-Hamiltonian Sampling
papers.abstract: Diffusion sampling can be viewed as imaginary-time annealing of probability densities. From a forward/backward Euclidean Schrödinger pair, we show that fixing the noising drift forces the reverse score term, and that the same logarithmic force is the one-sided imaginary-time counterdiabatic connection of a supersymmetric Score Hamiltonian. The correspondence turns score-learning error into a Hamiltonian perturbation and yields a schedule principle: if the first $r$ terminal derivatives vanish, Morita--Nishimori boundary cancellation suppresses the residual Hellinger error from $T^{-2}$ to $T^{-2r-2}$ until score or sampling floors are reached. Reverse-SDE benchmarks, including two-dimensional learned-score tests, confirm the predicted improvement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据的关键词：forward/backward Euclidean Schrödinger pair、supersymmetric Score Hamiltonian、counterdiabatic connection、schedule principle、Morita–Nishimori boundary cancellation，以及“Reverse-SDE benchmarks”数值验证。；研究对象：扩散采样（diffusion sampling）过程，将其视为概率密度的虚时间退火；具体涉及前向/后向欧几里得薛定谔对、噪声漂移、反向 score 项，以及超对称 Score Hamiltonian 框架下的采样误差与调度（schedule）问题。摘要未明确说明具体材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 固定噪声漂移会强制确定反向 score 项，且该对数力正是超对称 Score Hamiltonian 的单侧虚时间反绝热联络；由此可把 score 学习误差转化为哈密顿量微扰，并给出调度原则：若前 r 阶终端导数消失，Morita–Nishimori 边界消除可将残余 Hellinger 误差从 T^{-2} 抑制到 T^{-2r-2}，直至遇到 score 或采样下限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：固定噪声漂移会强制确定反向 score 项，且该对数力正是超对称 Score Hamiltonian 的单侧虚时间反绝热联络；由此可把 score 学习误差转化为哈密顿量微扰，并给出调度原则：若前 r 阶终端导数消失，Morita–Nishimori 边界消除可将残余 Hellinger 误差从 T^{-2} 抑制到 T^{-2r-2}，直至遇到 score 或采样下限。；创新点：将扩散采样中的 score 学习误差映射为哈密顿量微扰，建立 score 项与超对称 Score Hamiltonian 反绝热联络的对应关系，并提出通过终端导数消失条件与 Morita–Nishimori 边界消除来系统提升采样误差收敛阶的调度原则。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为前向/后向欧几里得薛定谔对、超对称 Score Hamiltonian、虚时间反绝热联络与 Morita–Nishimori 边界消除分析；并用反向随机微分方程（Reverse-SDE）基准测试（包括二维 learned-score 测试）进行数值验证。

papers.title: Fluidization in Growth-Induced Morphogenesis
papers.abstract: Elastic buckling has explained shape formation in growing tissues, yet the role of tissue fluidity remains elusive. We derive a minimal fluidized growth-elasticity model as a nonlinear analogue of Maxwell rheology. Analysis of a growing strip shows that fluidity promotes symmetry breaking under compression while regulating stress accumulation, so morphogenesis develops continuously before the elastic buckling threshold. Fluidity further controls the flow pattern, from smooth sinusoidal undulations to widened crests and localized indentations, with low fluidity favoring stronger localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derive a minimal model、nonlinear analogue of Maxwell rheology、Analysis of a growing strip——摘要中未出现实验手段或数值模拟方法，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：生长组织（growing tissues）中的形态发生（morphogenesis）现象，具体为生长条带（growing strip）在压缩下的形状形成与应力积累，关注组织流动性（fluidity）在其中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 流动性（fluidity）在压缩下促进对称性破缺并调控应力积累，使形态发生能在弹性屈曲阈值之前连续发展；流动性还控制流动模式，从平滑正弦起伏到加宽的波峰和局域化凹陷，低流动性倾向于更强的局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：流动性（fluidity）在压缩下促进对称性破缺并调控应力积累，使形态发生能在弹性屈曲阈值之前连续发展；流动性还控制流动模式，从平滑正弦起伏到加宽的波峰和局域化凹陷，低流动性倾向于更强的局域化。；创新点：已有研究用弹性屈曲解释生长组织中的形状形成，但组织流动性的作用尚不明确。本文通过建立流化生长-弹性模型，揭示了流动性在促进对称性破缺、调控应力积累以及控制流动图案方面的作用，表明形态发生可在弹性屈曲阈值之前连续发展。
papers.method_zh: 推导了一个最小化的流化生长-弹性模型（minimal fluidized growth-elasticity model），作为Maxwell流变学的非线性类比，并对生长条带进行了分析。

papers.title: Physical policy gradient theorem for in situ stochastic-adjoint training
papers.abstract: In situ adjoint training extracts parameter gradients directly from measurement, but has so far been limited to reciprocal or restricted systems. Here, we introduce the physical counterpart of the policy gradient theorem: a stochastic-adjoint gradient estimator that lifts these constraints by trading reciprocity for nondegenerate diffusion. As validation, we train a nonlinear resonator network, whose own dynamics supply the policy, against antagonistic temporal modulations with gradients from measured stochastic trajectories alone, without finite differences or a separate adjoint experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方法类文章（混合了数值验证）。关键依据：提出“policy gradient theorem 的物理对应物”、给出“stochastic-adjoint gradient estimator”，并以训练非线性谐振子网络作为验证（validation），属于理论框架构建加数值验证，而非纯实验。；研究对象：受限于互易性或受限系统的 in situ adjoint training（原位伴随训练）问题；具体验证体系为非线性谐振子网络（nonlinear resonator network），其自身动力学提供 policy，并面对对抗性时间调制（antagonistic temporal modulations）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了 policy gradient theorem 的物理对应版本——一种随机伴随梯度估计器，通过用非简并扩散（nondegenerate diffusion）替代互易性，解除了原位伴随训练此前对互易或受限系统的限制；并证明可仅凭测量的随机轨迹梯度训练非线性谐振子网络，无需有限差分或单独的伴随实验。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了 policy gradient theorem 的物理对应版本——一种随机伴随梯度估计器，通过用非简并扩散（nondegenerate diffusion）替代互易性，解除了原位伴随训练此前对互易或受限系统的限制；并证明可仅凭测量的随机轨迹梯度训练非线性谐振子网络，无需有限差分或单独的伴随实验。；创新点：将强化学习中的 policy gradient theorem 引入物理原位训练，提出 stochastic-adjoint 梯度估计器，用“非简并扩散”换取摆脱互易性约束，从而把原位伴随训练从互易/受限系统推广到更一般的系统；并展示无需有限差分或单独伴随实验即可从实测随机轨迹中获得梯度。

papers.title: Differentiable Solvation Shell Model for Rational Electrolyte Design
papers.abstract: Tailoring Li+ solvation structures has emerged as a promising design principle across multiple Li metal battery (LMB) electrolytes, with localized high concentration electrolytes (LHCE) emerging as a leading candidate. However, rational design of these electrolytes remains limited by a poor quantitative understanding of how molecular properties govern Li+ solvation shell composition. Here we introduce a mean field modeling framework, built on an Ising model, that predicts solvation shell composition from donor number (DN), acceptor number (AN), molar ratio, and molecular size. This framework is end-to-end differentiable, which enables parameterization directly from molecular dynamics (MD) solvation structures via gradient-based optimization. Focusing on LHCE, the model achieves 10.7% RMSE and R2=0.87 for shell composition, 2.3% RMSE on free solvent ratio, and further reproduces solvation trends in real LHCE electrolytes, at a fraction of MD's cost. Our model also shows good generalizability on other electrolyte systems in addition to LHCE. Analysis of its interaction terms shows that DN dominates Li+ solvation energetics, providing a thermodynamic basis for empirical DN-based design rules. We further demonstrate the model's design utility on the LiTFSI/tetraglyme (G4) system absent from training. The model identifies fluorobenzene (FB) as a promising diluent and predicts a salt-concentration window with anion-rich solvation shells and low free solvent, favorable for stable anion-derived SEIs and high oxidative stability, respectively. This prediction is validated by higher-fidelity MD. This work establishes an interpretable differentiable framework for predicting Li+ solvation shell composition, with potential to extend to other electrolyte classes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（混合计算与理论建模）。关键依据：摘要中提出“mean field modeling framework, built on an Ising model”，并强调“end-to-end differentiable”“parameterization directly from molecular dynamics (MD) solvation structures via gradient-based optimization”，最后用“higher-fidelity MD”验证预测。没有涉及实验合成或表征。；研究对象：锂金属电池（LMB）电解液中的Li+溶剂化壳层组成，尤其是局部高浓度电解液（LHCE）；具体体系包括LiTFSI/tetraglyme (G4)体系，以及氟苯（FB）作为稀释剂的设计。物理现象/对象是Li+溶剂化壳层的组成及其对电解液设计的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作提出了一个基于Ising模型的平均场、可端到端微分的框架，能够从供体数（DN）、受体数（AN）、摩尔比和分子尺寸预测Li+溶剂化壳层组成；在LHCE中达到壳层组成RMSE 10.7%、R²=0.87，自由溶剂比例RMSE 2.3%，并复现真实LHCE电解液中的溶剂化趋势。分析表明DN主导Li+溶剂化能量学，为基于DN的经验设计规则提供热力学基础。在未参与训练的LiTFSI/G4体系中，模型识别出FB为有前景的稀释剂，并预测出具有富阴离子溶剂化壳层和低自由溶剂的盐浓度窗口，该预测被更高保真度的MD验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作提出了一个基于Ising模型的平均场、可端到端微分的框架，能够从供体数（DN）、受体数（AN）、摩尔比和分子尺寸预测Li+溶剂化壳层组成；在LHCE中达到壳层组成RMSE 10.7%、R²=0.87，自由溶剂比例RMSE 2.3%，并复现真实LHCE电解液中的溶剂化趋势。分析表明DN主导Li+溶剂化能量学，为基于DN的经验设计规则提供热力学基础。在未参与训练的LiTFSI/G4体系中，模型识别出FB为有前景的稀释剂，并预测出具有富阴离子溶剂化壳层和低自由溶剂的盐浓度窗口，该预测被更高保真度的MD验证。；创新点：提出了一个可解释、端到端可微分的平均场模型，用于从分子性质定量预测Li+溶剂化壳层组成，并能直接由MD数据通过梯度优化参数化；相比MD大幅降低成本，同时保持对LHCE及其他电解液体系的预测能力；揭示了DN在Li+溶剂化能量学中的主导作用，为经验DN设计规则提供热力学依据；展示了在未训练体系LiTFSI/G4中预测FB为有前景稀释剂及盐浓度窗口的设计效用，并经更高保真度MD验证。

papers.title: The convergent laboratory: when AI reasoning, autonomous experiments, high performance and quantum computing reshape chemistry
papers.abstract: This Comment emerges from TPC26 (https://tpc26.org), a conference convening leaders from academia, national laboratories, and industry who are reshaping materials science discovery. The meeting explored how AI, autonomous agents, self-driving labs, higher performance and quantum computing converge to amplify their individual impact on materials science discovery. The perspectives here reflect the firsthand experiences of researchers at these frontiers and capture the essence of this global endeavor. As AI-driven reasoning, autonomous agentic frameworks, self-driving laboratories, and fault-tolerant quantum processors mature simultaneously, we offer this Comment as a reference at what we believe is a tipping point of transformative advances and productive disruption in the chemical sciences.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：这是一篇观点/评论（Comment）文章，而非传统意义上的实验、计算或理论文章。判断依据的关键词：标题中标注为“Comment”，摘要中说明其源自会议 TPC26，内容为“perspectives”“firsthand experiences”，旨在提供参考观点，而非报告具体研究数据或计算。；研究对象：研究对象是材料科学（尤其是化学科学）的发现过程与范式本身，即 AI 推理、自主智能体、自驱动实验室、高性能计算与量子计算等技术的融合如何重塑材料科学发现。摘要未明确说明针对某一具体材料、体系或物理现象。

papers.title: Hawking Radiation in non-Hermitian Microscopic Analogues
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian systems have recently emerged as a convenient platform to realize black-hole physics. Here, we propose a microscopic open quantum system, namely a fermionic tight-binding chain coupled to Markovian reservoirs, which emulates black-hole properties. The resulting quadratic Lindbladian admits an effective non-Hermitian limit that produces a gain and loss lattice model with a non-reciprocal next-nearest-neighbor hopping. The rapidity spectrum of the full Lindbladian forms tilted exceptional cones that define an effective Painlevé-Gullstrand geometry and separates into black-hole and white-hole sectors, while steady-state particle densities and currents retain clear signatures at the horizon positions. We then analyze the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian that arise from the microscopic quantum system. The biorthogonal flux identifies the outgoing exterior and interior channels. Finally, we introduce a fermionic Gaussian Nambu extension and formulate Hawking-pair witnesses through frequency-resolved scattering, nonlocal density-density correlations, and anomalous Hawking-partner amplitudes. The resulting correlations display analogue Hawking radiation signatures, while the frequency-resolved Hawking-partner correlations satisfy the fermionic covariance-positivity constraint. These results establish a connection between microscopic open-system dynamics, emergent non-Hermitian geometry, and fermionic many-body probes of analogue Hawking radiation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：propose a microscopic open quantum system、emulates、admits an effective non-Hermitian limit、formulate、establish a connection。摘要中未提及任何实验测量或数值计算细节，属于纯理论构建与解析分析。；研究对象：一个费米子紧束缚链耦合到马尔可夫库的微观开放量子系统，用以模拟黑洞物理（类比霍金辐射）。具体涉及：非厄米增益-损耗格点模型、非互易次近邻跃迁、倾斜例外锥、有效 Painlevé-Gullstrand 几何、黑洞与白洞分区、稳态粒子密度与电流、双正交流、以及费米子高斯 Nambu 扩展下的霍金配对探针。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该微观 Lindbladian 的 rapidity 谱形成倾斜例外锥，定义了有效 Painlevé-Gullstrand 几何并分离出黑洞与白洞区域，稳态粒子密度和电流在视界位置保留清晰特征；双正交流可识别出射的外部与内部通道；频率分辨的霍金伙伴关联呈现类比霍金辐射信号，并满足费米子协方差正性约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该微观 Lindbladian 的 rapidity 谱形成倾斜例外锥，定义了有效 Painlevé-Gullstrand 几何并分离出黑洞与白洞区域，稳态粒子密度和电流在视界位置保留清晰特征；双正交流可识别出射的外部与内部通道；频率分辨的霍金伙伴关联呈现类比霍金辐射信号，并满足费米子协方差正性约束。；创新点：将微观开放量子系统（费米子紧束缚链耦合马尔可夫库）与非厄米几何及类比黑洞物理联系起来，提出通过频率分辨散射、非局域密度-密度关联和反常霍金伙伴振幅来构造费米子霍金配对见证，并验证其满足费米子协方差正性约束，从而在微观开放系统动力学、涌现非厄米几何与费米子多体探针之间建立联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：开放量子系统的 Lindbladian 形式（二次型 Lindbladian）、非厄米有效哈密顿量极限、增益-损耗格点模型与非互易次近邻跃迁、rapidity 谱与例外锥分析、有效 Painlevé-Gullstrand 几何构造、双正交流（biorthogonal flux）分析、费米子高斯 Nambu 扩展、频率分辨散射、非局域密度-密度关联以及反常霍金伙伴振幅的计算。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值模拟或具体数值方法。

papers.title: Matrix Holography on an Optical Lattice
papers.abstract: We propose an analog quantum-simulation protocol based on a lattice of atomic ensembles and time-averaged Floquet dynamics to construct the four-body potentials that typically appear in bosonic BFSS-like matrix quantum mechanics. In contrast to gate-based digital implementations requiring deep circuits, our approach generates the target model through a fixed set of control stages per Floquet cycle, keeping the number of consecutive unitaries constant with respect to the matrix size $N$. The principal scaling cost in our construction is given by the frequency range required to control the growing lattice. We show that this cost grows at most as $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$, giving a polynomial scaling route to large$-N$, attractive to experimental implementation. Additionally, we demonstrate that the coupling parameter can be tuned beyond $\mathcal{O}(1)$, enabling the simulation of strong-coupling physics necessary for holographic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/方案提出型文章（混合类型中偏理论）。判断依据关键词：We propose an analog quantum-simulation protocol、construct、show that、demonstrate，摘要中未涉及实际实验实现或数值计算结果，属于提出模拟方案的理论工作。；研究对象：基于原子系综晶格与时间平均 Floquet 动力学构建的模拟量子模拟体系，目标是实现玻色型 BFSS-like 矩阵量子力学中出现的四体势（four-body potentials），即矩阵全息（matrix holography）相关的强耦合物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种通过固定控制阶段数（与矩阵大小 N 无关）的 Floquet 循环来生成目标四体势的模拟量子模拟方案；其主要标度成本来自控制增长晶格所需的频率范围，该成本最多按 O(N³) 增长，从而给出通向大 N 的多项式标度路径；此外耦合参数可调至超过 O(1)，可模拟全息相所需的强耦合物理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种通过固定控制阶段数（与矩阵大小 N 无关）的 Floquet 循环来生成目标四体势的模拟量子模拟方案；其主要标度成本来自控制增长晶格所需的频率范围，该成本最多按 O(N³) 增长，从而给出通向大 N 的多项式标度路径；此外耦合参数可调至超过 O(1)，可模拟全息相所需的强耦合物理。；创新点：相对于需要深电路的基于门的数字实现，该方案通过每个 Floquet 循环中固定的一组控制阶段生成目标模型，使连续幺正操作的数量相对于矩阵大小 N 保持常数；主要标度成本为控制晶格所需频率范围，最多按 O(N³) 增长，提供多项式标度的大 N 路径；并证明耦合参数可调至 O(1) 以上以模拟强耦合全息物理。
papers.method_zh: 基于原子系综晶格（lattice of atomic ensembles）的模拟量子模拟协议，结合时间平均 Floquet 动力学（time-averaged Floquet dynamics）来构造四体势；与需要深电路的基于门（gate-based）的数字实现相对比。摘要未明确说明具体的原子种类、实验参数或数值验证方法。

papers.title: Matrix Product Belief Propagation
papers.abstract: We introduce "matrix product belief propagation" (MP-BP) as a controlled method for the approximate contraction of two-dimensional tensor networks and graphical models, which generically leads to a quadratic reduction of errors relative to existing methods: at similar computational effort, the number of accurate digits is asymptotically doubled. For infinite systems, MP-BP can be understood as a practical implementation of Baxter's corner-transfer-matrix method; for reflection-symmetric networks, it further coincides with the boundary matrix-product-state and corner-transfer-matrix renormalization group algorithms as conventionally implemented. In the limit of unit matrix-product rank, MP-BP is equivalent to belief propagation, and more generally, can be understood as a generalization of BP in which the "messages" live on surfaces and are assumed to have a matrix-product factorization. We further extend the quadratic improvement to the computation of expectation values, and numerically demonstrate the qualitatively improved convergence for a variety of classical and quantum 2D tensor network problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键依据：论文提出一种新的近似收缩方法（MP-BP），讨论其与 Baxter 角转移矩阵法、边界矩阵乘积态、角转移矩阵重整化群以及信念传播的等价/推广关系，并给出数值演示；摘要未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：二维张量网络与图模型的近似收缩问题，以及无限体系、反射对称网络中的相关计算；并数值演示了多种经典与量子二维张量网络问题。摘要未明确说明具体材料、化合物或实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MP-BP 作为一种可控的二维张量网络/图模型近似收缩方法，相较于已有方法可普遍实现误差的二次降低：在相近计算代价下，精确位数渐近翻倍；该改进还可推广到期望值计算，并在多种经典与量子二维张量网络问题中表现出定性改善的收敛性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MP-BP 作为一种可控的二维张量网络/图模型近似收缩方法，相较于已有方法可普遍实现误差的二次降低：在相近计算代价下，精确位数渐近翻倍；该改进还可推广到期望值计算，并在多种经典与量子二维张量网络问题中表现出定性改善的收敛性。；创新点：主要新意在于提出 MP-BP 这一受控近似收缩框架，使误差相对现有方法出现二次降低（同等计算量下精确位数渐近翻倍），并将该二次改进扩展到期望值计算；同时统一/联系了 BP、Baxter 角转移矩阵法、边界矩阵乘积态和角转移矩阵重整化群等已有方法。
papers.method_zh: 提出“矩阵乘积信念传播”（MP-BP）方法，用于二维张量网络和图模型的近似收缩；将消息置于面上并假设其具有矩阵乘积分解，是信念传播（BP）的推广；在单位矩阵乘积秩极限下等价于 BP；对无限体系可理解为 Baxter 角转移矩阵法的实用实现；对反射对称网络，与传统实现的边界矩阵乘积态及角转移矩阵重整化群算法一致；并进行了数值演示。

papers.title: A Gauge Theory of Turbulence:
papers.abstract: We formalize the gauge structure of the Navier--Stokes equation for incompressible fluids, interpreting $\nabla\cdot\mathbf{v}=0$ as a gauge fixing analogous to the Coulomb gauge in electromagnetism. We construct the Martin--Siggia--Rose action and its full BRST symmetry, introducing BRST doublets for the Gribov parameter $γ$ and the monodromy phase $θ$. Through a Higgs mechanism, $γ$ acquires a vacuum expectation value $γ_{0}$, generating a mass scale for the vorticity and the ghosts; we compute the one-loop effective potential and analyze vacuum stability. Intermittency --- measured by the exponents $ζ_{n}$ --- is described by fluctuations of the Higgs field $σ$ around the condensate, via a Gribov-inspired log-Poisson hierarchy that satisfies exactly $ζ_{3}=1$ (Kolmogorov's four-fifths law). Fits to DNS data favor filamentary vorticity structures, with $D_{f}\approx1$ (one parameter) or $D_{f}\approx2.1$, $Δ\approx0.44$ (two parameters). The one-loop anomalous dimension in $d=3$, $Δ_σ\approx0.50$, supports the identification $D_{f}=2Δ_σ$. The formalism unifies classical hydrodynamics with gauge theory and spontaneous symmetry breaking, opening the study of turbulence and intermittency to quantum field theory methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：formalize、construct、BRST symmetry、Higgs mechanism、one-loop effective potential、gauge theory framework——全文为理论形式化构建，摘要未提及任何实验或数值模拟（DNS 数据仅用于拟合对比，非本文产生）。；研究对象：不可压缩流体的 Navier–Stokes 方程及其湍流/间歇性现象。具体包括：将 ∇·v=0 诠释为类库仑规范固定、涡量与鬼场的质量生成、以及由标度指数 ζ_n 度量的间歇性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将 Navier–Stokes 方程形式化为规范理论，通过 Higgs 机制使 Gribov 参数 γ 获得真空期望值 γ₀，为涡量和鬼场生成质量标度；间歇性可由 Higgs 场 σ 在凝聚体附近的涨落描述，其 log-Poisson 层级严格满足 ζ₃=1（Kolmogorov 五分之四律），且 d=3 下一圈反常维度 Δ_σ≈0.50 支持 D_f=2Δ_σ 的对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将 Navier–Stokes 方程形式化为规范理论，通过 Higgs 机制使 Gribov 参数 γ 获得真空期望值 γ₀，为涡量和鬼场生成质量标度；间歇性可由 Higgs 场 σ 在凝聚体附近的涨落描述，其 log-Poisson 层级严格满足 ζ₃=1（Kolmogorov 五分之四律），且 d=3 下一圈反常维度 Δ_σ≈0.50 支持 D_f=2Δ_σ 的对应关系。；创新点：首次将不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 方程纳入规范理论框架，把 ∇·v=0 视为类库仑规范固定，并引入 BRST 二重态与 Higgs 机制为涡量和鬼场生成质量；用 Gribov 启发的 log-Poisson 层级统一描述间歇性并严格满足 ζ₃=1；提出并验证 D_f=2Δ_σ 的关系，从而将湍流与间歇性研究开放给量子场论方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Martin–Siggia–Rose（MSR）作用量及其完整 BRST 对称性；为 Gribov 参数 γ 和单值化相位 θ 引入 BRST 二重态；Higgs 机制；一圈有效势计算与真空稳定性分析；Gribov 启发的 log-Poisson 层级用于间歇性指数；并与 DNS 数据进行拟合（单参数 D_f≈1 或双参数 D_f≈2.1、Δ≈0.44）。

papers.title: Quantum information spreading via higher-order operator correlators
papers.abstract: We provide a perspective into measuring the quantum information spreading by introducing N-operator correlators. Leveraging the idea from N-point correlation function from cosmology, we formulate a generalized Out-of-Time-Ordered Correlator (OTOC), called N-Operator Correlator (NOC). Such formulation can reduce the effect of restricted analysis associated with selecting only two operators for OTOC. NOC can take into account a larger set of measurement probes in measuring the degree of quantum information spreading. We demonstrate these concepts with two analytically tractable toy systems with computing thermal averages of operator time evolutions at a finite temperature: a single qubit in longitudinal field and XYZ two-qubit system. Our perspective serves as a basic introduction to generalized operator correlators in quantum mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：formulate、demonstrate with analytically tractable toy systems、basic introduction to generalized operator correlators。；研究对象：量子信息扩散（quantum information spreading）的度量问题，具体研究体系为两个可解析处理的玩具系统：纵向场中的单量子比特（single qubit in longitudinal field）和 XYZ 双量子比特系统（XYZ two-qubit system）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入 N-算符关联器（NOC）这一广义 OTOC 形式，可以在有限温度下纳入更多测量探针来度量量子信息扩散的程度，从而减少仅选取两个算符的 OTOC 所带来分析受限的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入 N-算符关联器（NOC）这一广义 OTOC 形式，可以在有限温度下纳入更多测量探针来度量量子信息扩散的程度，从而减少仅选取两个算符的 OTOC 所带来分析受限的影响。；创新点：将 OTOC 从两算符推广到 N 算符关联器（NOC），使其能纳入更大范围的测量探针来度量量子信息扩散，并作为量子力学中广义算符关联器的入门性介绍。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：借鉴宇宙学中 N 点关联函数的思想，构造广义的乱序关联器（OTOC），称为 N-算符关联器（NOC）；在两个可解析处理的玩具系统上计算算符时间演化的有限温度热平均。

papers.title: Lee-Yang zeros of modulated XY spin chains with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction: zero-contour topology and quantum phase-diagram reconstruction
papers.abstract: We investigate the Lee--Yang zeros (LYZ) of inhomogeneous anisotropic XY spin chains with Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya (DM) interactions in the complex transverse-field plane, focusing on their fundamental connection to quantum phase transitions. We systematically study uniform chains, period-2 and period-3 modulated chains, and Fibonacci quasiperiodic chains of lengths 5 and 8. As the DM coupling strength $D$ increases, the LYZ exhibit qualitatively distinct topological evolutions on the complex plane: the complex zeros of the uniform chain collapse toward the real axis; periodic chains feature either bifurcation of closed zero contours before all zeros become real or a single re-emergence of complex zeros; quasiperiodic chains exhibit repeated annihilation and revival of complex zeros. Analytical derivations demonstrate that this diverse behavior originates from DM-induced shifts of folded bands and the modulation of zero positions by anisotropic pairing at particle--hole band crossings. Our results establish a direct correspondence between LYZ topology and band deformation: isolated contact points of zeros with the real axis correspond to discrete quantum critical fields, while continuous real-zero intervals directly identify gapless chiral phases. Accordingly, beyond locating phase boundaries, LYZ can distinguish characteristic phases and serve as an intuitive probe for band folding and phase diagram restructuring.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：解析推导（analytical derivations）、理论模型（XY spin chains、DM interaction）、无实验测量手段描述。；研究对象：非均匀各向异性 XY 自旋链（含 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用）在复横向场平面中的 Lee-Yang 零点，具体包括均匀链、周期2与周期3调制链，以及长度为5和8的 Fibonacci 准周期链；关注其与量子相变的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着 DM 耦合强度 D 增大，Lee-Yang 零点在复平面上呈现定性不同的拓扑演化：均匀链的复零点向实轴坍缩；周期链表现为闭合零点轮廓的分叉（最终所有零点变为实数）或复零点的单次重现；准周期链表现为复零点的反复湮灭与复苏。零点拓扑与能带形变直接对应：零点与实轴的孤立接触点对应离散量子临界场，连续实零点区间直接标识无能隙手性相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着 DM 耦合强度 D 增大，Lee-Yang 零点在复平面上呈现定性不同的拓扑演化：均匀链的复零点向实轴坍缩；周期链表现为闭合零点轮廓的分叉（最终所有零点变为实数）或复零点的单次重现；准周期链表现为复零点的反复湮灭与复苏。零点拓扑与能带形变直接对应：零点与实轴的孤立接触点对应离散量子临界场，连续实零点区间直接标识无能隙手性相。；创新点：建立了 Lee-Yang 零点拓扑与能带形变之间的直接对应关系；表明 LYZ 不仅能定位相边界，还能区分特征相，并可作为能带折叠与相图重构的直观探针。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导与数值计算相结合：在复横向场平面中求解非均匀各向异性 XY 自旋链（含 DM 相互作用）的 Lee-Yang 零点，分析 DM 诱导的折叠能带移动以及粒子-空穴能带交叉处各向异性配对对零点位置的调制。

papers.title: Slow dynamics in concrete: Effects of temperature, strength variation, and microcracking damage
papers.abstract: In this study, we investigated the slow dynamic behavior of concrete with varying compressive strengths ($f'_c = 32\sim56$ MPa) and alkali-silica reaction (ASR) damage. Concrete prisms were conditioned by compressive loading and recovery was monitored by coda wave interferometry (CWI). A self-referencing temperature correction technique was used to minimize the effect of ambient temperature changes, demonstrating the importance of careful temperature control and correction. For intact specimens, both the recovery rate, $m_v$, and velocity drop magnitude, $|c|$, generally increased with compressive strength. Recovery times were calculated from the fit parameters, and higher strength specimens were found to recover faster (9.9 h for $f'_c = 32$ MPa, 6.6 h for $f'_c = 56$ MPa). When the same stress was applied, ASR-damaged specimens had increased softening and faster recovery rates, but longer recovery times (up to 458 h). These findings demonstrate the potential of slow dynamics in concrete characterization, through its ability to evaluate the strength of intact samples and its sensitivity to microcracking in damaged samples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：concrete prisms were conditioned by compressive loading、recovery was monitored by coda wave interferometry (CWI)、self-referencing temperature correction technique。；研究对象：混凝土（抗压强度 \(f'_c = 32\sim56\) MPa）的慢动力学行为，以及碱-硅反应（ASR）损伤对慢动力学的影响；具体监测的是混凝土棱柱在压缩加载后的恢复过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于完整试样，恢复速率 \(m_v\) 和速度降幅 \(|c|\) 通常随抗压强度增加而增大，且高强度试样恢复更快（32 MPa 为 9.9 h，56 MPa 为 6.6 h）；在相同应力下，ASR 损伤试样表现出更强的软化、更快的恢复速率，但恢复时间更长（可达 458 h）。这表明慢动力学可用于混凝土表征，既能评估完整样品的强度，也对损伤样品中的微裂纹敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于完整试样，恢复速率 \(m_v\) 和速度降幅 \(|c|\) 通常随抗压强度增加而增大，且高强度试样恢复更快（32 MPa 为 9.9 h，56 MPa 为 6.6 h）；在相同应力下，ASR 损伤试样表现出更强的软化、更快的恢复速率，但恢复时间更长（可达 458 h）。这表明慢动力学可用于混凝土表征，既能评估完整样品的强度，也对损伤样品中的微裂纹敏感。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对混凝土棱柱施加压缩加载进行 conditioning，使用尾波干涉法（CWI）监测恢复过程；采用自参考温度校正技术以最小化环境温度变化的影响。

papers.title: Kinematics of erosion-induced landslide mobility
papers.abstract: Erosion-induced landslide mobility is a prominent phenomenon in nature. However, this topic remains poorly understood, even though erosion greatly alters nearly every aspect of landslide mechanics, dynamics, run-out, mobility, deposition structure and the enormous destructive power carried by such catastrophic events. Here, I present a simple, elegant, and exact analytical model describing the kinematics of erosion-induced landslide mobility in terms of a newly constructed mobility controller containing essential forcing mechanisms in erosion. In contrast to the classical perspective, I formally prove that, irrespective of how large the erosion rate is, the erosion rate alone is not sufficient to determine enhanced or reduced mobility; mobility is also greatly regulated by the volume bulking rate, erosion drag or thrust, and flow depth. With this mechanical mobility controller, it is now possible to explain precisely when the mobility of an erodible landslide is enhanced or reduced. I demonstrate that, a mechanically valid, physically founded erosion model must be able to explain both the enhanced and reduced mobility of erosive landslides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中明确提到“present a simple, elegant, and exact analytical model”“formally prove”，属于纯理论/解析建模工作，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：侵蚀诱发的滑坡流动性（erosion-induced landslide mobility）这一自然现象，具体关注其运动学特征及控制机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文通过解析模型证明：无论侵蚀速率多大，侵蚀速率本身都不足以决定滑坡流动性是增强还是减弱；流动性还受到体积膨胀率（volume bulking rate）、侵蚀阻力或推力（erosion drag or thrust）以及流深（flow depth）的共同调控。一个力学上合理、物理上有根据的侵蚀模型必须能够同时解释侵蚀性滑坡流动性的增强和减弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文通过解析模型证明：无论侵蚀速率多大，侵蚀速率本身都不足以决定滑坡流动性是增强还是减弱；流动性还受到体积膨胀率（volume bulking rate）、侵蚀阻力或推力（erosion drag or thrust）以及流深（flow depth）的共同调控。一个力学上合理、物理上有根据的侵蚀模型必须能够同时解释侵蚀性滑坡流动性的增强和减弱。；创新点：与经典观点不同，该工作首次形式化地证明侵蚀速率单独不足以决定滑坡流动性的增强或减弱，并提出了包含体积膨胀率、侵蚀阻力/推力和流深等机制的“力学流动性控制器”，从而能够精确解释侵蚀性滑坡流动性何时增强、何时减弱。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个简单、优雅且精确的解析模型（exact analytical model），提出一个新的“流动性控制器”（mobility controller），其中包含侵蚀中的关键强迫机制，并据此进行形式化证明和运动学分析。

papers.title: Variable Charge State, Magnetic Excitations, and Kondo Effect of Sm/g/Ir(111)
papers.abstract: Using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy we investigate the charge state, magnetic excitations, and Kondo features of individual Sm adatoms on graphene/Ir(111). Depending on the number and distance of their neighbors, Sm atoms can be in two discrete charge states. At certain distances, a reversible transition between these two states is induced by the electric field of the STM tip leading to concentric charge rings in the images. Only atoms in one of the two charge states exhibit magnetic excitations in d$I$/d$V$ spectra. Two such excitations are located at 35~meV and 54~meV and related to transitions from the $J = 1/2$ ground state doublet to the first crystal field split $J = 3/2$ multiplet. Together with the intra-atomic exchange excitations at higher energy, these observations indicate that Sm transfers one $6s$ electron to the substrate while it retains its gas-phase $4f$ filling. New for lanthanide adatoms, we observe a Kondo resonance. The Zeeman splitting of the Kondo peak reveals that Sm retains its large gas-phase $g$-factor. Comparison of d$I$/d$V$ spectra to cotunneling theory yields the crystal field acting on the $4f$ shell and, consequently, on the $J = 3/2$ quadruplet, confirms Sm$^+$ as the ground state, and identifies Sm$^{2+}$ as being energetically close, thereby rationalizing our observation of variable charge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：使用低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）进行测量，观测 d$I$/d$V$ 谱、Kondo 共振、Zeeman 分裂等实验信号，并与 cotunneling 理论对比。；研究对象：石墨烯/Ir(111) 表面上单个 Sm 吸附原子的电荷态、磁激发和 Kondo 效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sm 原子可处于两种离散电荷态，仅其中一种表现出磁激发（35 meV 和 54 meV，对应 $J=1/2$ 基态双重态到第一晶体场分裂的 $J=3/2$ 多重态的跃迁）；Sm 将一个 $6s$ 电子转移给衬底而保留气相 $4f$ 填充，并首次在镧系吸附原子上观测到 Kondo 共振，其 Zeeman 分裂表明 Sm 保持大的气相 $g$ 因子。与 cotunneling 理论对比确认 Sm$^+$ 为基态，Sm$^{2+}$ 能量接近，从而解释了可变电荷态的观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sm 原子可处于两种离散电荷态，仅其中一种表现出磁激发（35 meV 和 54 meV，对应 $J=1/2$ 基态双重态到第一晶体场分裂的 $J=3/2$ 多重态的跃迁）；Sm 将一个 $6s$ 电子转移给衬底而保留气相 $4f$ 填充，并首次在镧系吸附原子上观测到 Kondo 共振，其 Zeeman 分裂表明 Sm 保持大的气相 $g$ 因子。与 cotunneling 理论对比确认 Sm$^+$ 为基态，Sm$^{2+}$ 能量接近，从而解释了可变电荷态的观测。；创新点：首次在镧系吸附原子上观测到 Kondo 共振；观测到由 STM 针尖电场诱导的两种电荷态之间的可逆转变（表现为同心电荷环）；通过 cotunneling 理论对比提取了作用于 $4f$ 壳层的晶体场参数，并确认 Sm$^+$ 为基态、Sm$^{2+}$ 能量接近。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）测量单个 Sm 吸附原子的 d$I$/d$V$ 谱；通过 STM 针尖电场诱导电荷态之间的可逆转变；将 d$I$/d$V$ 谱与 cotunneling 理论进行对比分析。

papers.title: From Electronic Structure to Environmental Remediation: Adsorption of Ionized Glyphosate on COOH-Modified Carbon Nanotube
papers.abstract: Glyphosate is a widely used herbicide whose persistence and toxicity in aquatic and terrestrial environments demand efficient removal strategies. Here we employ GFN2 xTB calculations with implicit ALPB aqueous solvation and automated docking to investigate the adsorption of all five pH dependent ionized forms of glyphosate (G1-G5) on (10,0) single walled carbon nanotubes covalently functionalized with carboxyl groups at 0-25% coverage. Adsorption energies reveal a clear charge dependent trend: the dianionic (G4) and trianionic (G5) species exhibit the most negative binding energies over the entire functionalization range, while the protonated and neutral forms (G1, G2) bind weakly, approaching reversible adsorption at high COOH contents. The deprotonated form G5 strengthens from -2.17 eV on pristine CNT to about -5.7 eV at 10% and 25% functionalization, with a local minimum near 15-20% COOH due to steric and electrostatic crowding of adjacent groups. Decomposition of the solvation free energy shows dominant electrostatic stabilization complemented by increasingly favorable hydrogen bond contributions as carboxyl density grows. All complexes display very small HOMO-LUMO gaps (0.02-0.22 eV), indicating high electronic sensitivity to adsorption and functionalization. Overall, CNT+COOH systems can operate in both strong capture and regenerable regimes depending on glyphosate ionization state, offering a tunable platform for pH responsive remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：GFN2 xTB calculations、implicit ALPB aqueous solvation、automated docking——均为计算方法，摘要中未出现任何实验手段。；研究对象：草甘膦（glyphosate）五种pH依赖的电离形态（G1–G5）在羧基（COOH）共价功能化的(10,0)单壁碳纳米管上的吸附体系，功能化覆盖率为0–25%。属于环境修复相关的分子吸附问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 吸附能呈现明显的电荷依赖趋势：双阴离子（G4）和三阴离子（G5）在整个功能化范围内结合能最负，而质子化和中性形态（G1、G2）结合较弱，在高COOH含量时接近可逆吸附。G5的吸附能从原始CNT上的-2.17 eV增强到10%和25%功能化时的约-5.7 eV，并在15–20% COOH附近因相邻基团的空间和静电拥挤出现局部极小值。所有复合物的HOMO-LUMO gap极小（0.02–0.22 eV）。CNT+COOH体系可根据草甘膦电离状态在强捕获和可再生两种模式间切换，为pH响应型修复提供可调平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：吸附能呈现明显的电荷依赖趋势：双阴离子（G4）和三阴离子（G5）在整个功能化范围内结合能最负，而质子化和中性形态（G1、G2）结合较弱，在高COOH含量时接近可逆吸附。G5的吸附能从原始CNT上的-2.17 eV增强到10%和25%功能化时的约-5.7 eV，并在15–20% COOH附近因相邻基团的空间和静电拥挤出现局部极小值。所有复合物的HOMO-LUMO gap极小（0.02–0.22 eV）。CNT+COOH体系可根据草甘膦电离状态在强捕获和可再生两种模式间切换，为pH响应型修复提供可调平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要中未明确将其结果与已有研究进行对比，也未明确指出相对于前人工作的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: GFN2 xTB半经验量子化学计算方法，结合隐式ALPB水溶剂化模型和自动对接（automated docking）；对溶剂化自由能进行了分解分析；计算了HOMO-LUMO gap。

papers.title: Non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: Exceptional points, Anomalous relaxation, Pseudo-equilibrium and Boundary refrigeration
papers.abstract: Non-reciprocal interactions are ubiquitous in active, biological, and disordered systems, generically driving them out of equilibrium. Here, we introduce a hierarchy of non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) models governed by a tunable non-reciprocity parameter $g$. At a special point $g=g^*$, the drift matrix becomes non-diagonalizable, realizing exceptional points (EP's) of different orders, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors simultaneously coalesce. The hierarchy encompasses non-reciprocally coupled dimers, their disordered counterparts, and a many-body chain exactly mapping onto the paradigmatic Hatano-Nelson model in the arena of non-Hermitian quantum systems. For the disordered model, we show that the distribution of the EP location $g^*$ across disorder realizations develops a universal edge singularity precisely at the clean-system EP, and is manifestly non-self-averaging. Across all models, we find that at the EP, the usual exponential relaxation of the autocorrelation and covariance functions is dressed by a polynomial-in-time prefactor whose degree is set by the order of the EP and whose detailed structure encodes the spatial architecture of the chain. At complete asymmetry, the many-body chain exhibits ``pseudo-equilibrium'': its steady-state distribution factorizes into equilibrium-like single-particle measures despite a nonzero steady-state current. Moreover, the $N$-particle interacting system decomposes into $N/2$ independent complex OU processes. Finally, using the Harada-Sasa relation, we obtain a closed-form expression for the total steady-state heat dissipation and uncover a boundary refrigeration effect, in which the boundary particles switch from acting as a hot to a cold reservoir as the non-reciprocity is tuned.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键判断依据：论文引入的是“hierarchy of non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) models”，并围绕漂移矩阵、例外点、稳态分布、Harada-Sasa 关系等展开解析与理论分析，摘要中未涉及具体实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非互易相互作用的 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 模型体系，包括非互易耦合二聚体、其无序版本，以及可精确映射到 Hatano-Nelson 模型的多体链；研究现象涉及例外点、异常弛豫、赝平衡和边界制冷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特殊非互易参数 \(g=g^*\) 处漂移矩阵不可对角化并出现不同阶数的例外点；在例外点处自相关和协方差函数的指数弛豫会乘以由例外点阶数决定的时间多项式前因子。完全不对称时，多体链呈现“赝平衡”：尽管存在非零稳态流，稳态分布仍分解为类平衡的单粒子测度；同时 \(N\) 粒子相互作用系统分解为 \(N/2\) 个独立复 OU 过程。利用 Harada-Sasa 关系还得到总稳态热耗散的闭式表达，并发现随非互易性调节，边界粒子会从热库转变为冷库，即边界制冷效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特殊非互易参数 \(g=g^*\) 处漂移矩阵不可对角化并出现不同阶数的例外点；在例外点处自相关和协方差函数的指数弛豫会乘以由例外点阶数决定的时间多项式前因子。完全不对称时，多体链呈现“赝平衡”：尽管存在非零稳态流，稳态分布仍分解为类平衡的单粒子测度；同时 \(N\) 粒子相互作用系统分解为 \(N/2\) 个独立复 OU 过程。利用 Harada-Sasa 关系还得到总稳态热耗散的闭式表达，并发现随非互易性调节，边界粒子会从热库转变为冷库，即边界制冷效应。；创新点：提出了可调非互易参数控制的一类 NROU 模型层级，并系统关联例外点、无序普适边缘奇异性、非自平均性、异常弛豫、赝平衡、独立复 OU 分解、稳态热耗散闭式表达和边界制冷效应。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为随机动力学中的 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程、非厄米物理中的例外点分析、非互易相互作用模型、Hatano-Nelson 模型映射、无序平均分析、稳态分布分解，以及 Harada-Sasa 关系用于热耗散计算。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值模拟或具体计算算法。

papers.title: Customized spin spirals in ferromagnetic thin films
papers.abstract: The advancement of spintronic nanoscale devices hinges on the ability to flexibly engineer magnetic spin structures in thin-film stacks with precision and control. Meeting this demand remains a challenge for stable non-collinear spin configurations and, more specifically, vertical spin spirals in thin films. Innovative methods are required for their fabrication, stabilization and control. Here, we use oblique-incidence deposition to design and stabilize vertical spin spirals at room temperature and without an external field in magnetic thin films. We induce two crossed uniaxial magnetic anisotropies at the thin film boundaries. These anisotropies are tunable in direction and strength, thus providing control over the angular range and depth profile of the resulting spin spiral. The combination of polarized neutron reflectometry and nuclear resonant scattering enables precise and direct determination of the depth-dependent spin configurations. Our results establish a single-film design approach, in which the surface anisotropies independently serve as controllable design parameters for tailoring the vertical spin-spiral profile. Potential applications include nanoscale energy-storage devices, magnetic sensors, and ferromagnetic-resonance filters, advancing all-spin-based device engineering in general.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：oblique-incidence deposition（斜入射沉积）、polarized neutron reflectometry（极化中子反射）、nuclear resonant scattering（核共振散射）——均为实验制备与表征手段。；研究对象：磁性薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋（vertical spin spirals in magnetic thin films），具体为铁磁薄膜体系中室温下稳定的非共线自旋结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过斜入射沉积在磁性薄膜边界引入两个交叉的单轴磁各向异性，可在室温和无外场条件下设计并稳定垂直自旋螺旋；这两个各向异性的方向和强度可调，从而实现对自旋螺旋角度范围和深度分布的控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过斜入射沉积在磁性薄膜边界引入两个交叉的单轴磁各向异性，可在室温和无外场条件下设计并稳定垂直自旋螺旋；这两个各向异性的方向和强度可调，从而实现对自旋螺旋角度范围和深度分布的控制。；创新点：提出了一种单层薄膜设计方法，利用表面各向异性作为独立可调的设计参数来定制垂直自旋螺旋的深度分布；实现了室温、无外场下垂直自旋螺旋的稳定，并可直接测定其深度依赖的自旋构型。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：斜入射沉积（制备）、极化中子反射术（polarized neutron reflectometry）与核共振散射（nuclear resonant scattering）相结合，用于精确、直接地确定深度依赖的自旋构型。

papers.title: Molecular interfacial rheology: Lipid membrane shear viscosity
papers.abstract: We develop a method to extract the shear viscosity of a lipid membrane from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. The method characterizes the rheology of general interfacial systems embedded in three-dimensional media; we term it molecular interfacial rheology. In our simulations the planar bilayer and surrounding water are confined between solid, parallel walls. Following Onsager's regression hypothesis, membrane and water fluctuations are assumed to relax according to the coupled continuum-mechanical equations governing the confined system---which predict that the membrane transverse velocity autocorrelation function (TVACF) decays exponentially, at a rate set by the membrane and water viscosities. The measured TVACF, however, exhibits damped oscillations followed by a slowly decaying tail. We reconcile these behaviors using the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, and extract the wavevector-dependent membrane viscosity from the time-integral of the TVACF. Results from theory and simulations agree over a decade of wavevectors, and extrapolating to long wavelengths yields shear viscosities ranging from 0.064 to 0.18 pN*us/nm across two representative single-component, fluid-phase bilayers. Our results are corroborated by nonequilibrium simulations where a spatially varying in-plane body force is applied to lipid molecules, thus validating the framework of molecular interfacial rheology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（结合理论建模）。关键依据：以平衡态分子动力学模拟（equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations）为主要手段，并配合 Mori–Zwanzig 形式理论和非平衡模拟验证，属于计算+理论混合但以计算为主。；研究对象：嵌入三维介质中的脂质双分子层（lipid membrane）的剪切粘度（shear viscosity），即受限在固体平行壁之间的平面双分子层及其周围水的界面流变学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 膜横向速度自相关函数（TVACF）并非如连续介质理论预测的简单指数衰减，而是表现为阻尼振荡加缓慢衰减尾部；通过 Mori–Zwanzig 形式从 TVACF 的时间积分中提取波矢依赖的膜粘度，理论模拟在跨越一个数量级的波矢范围内一致，外推到长波极限得到两种代表性单组分液相双分子层的剪切粘度为 0.064–0.18 pN·μs/nm。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：膜横向速度自相关函数（TVACF）并非如连续介质理论预测的简单指数衰减，而是表现为阻尼振荡加缓慢衰减尾部；通过 Mori–Zwanzig 形式从 TVACF 的时间积分中提取波矢依赖的膜粘度，理论模拟在跨越一个数量级的波矢范围内一致，外推到长波极限得到两种代表性单组分液相双分子层的剪切粘度为 0.064–0.18 pN·μs/nm。；创新点：提出了"分子界面流变学"（molecular interfacial rheology）方法，可从平衡态分子动力学模拟中提取一般界面体系的流变性质，特别是脂质膜的剪切粘度；并揭示了 TVACF 的阻尼振荡与慢衰减尾部行为，用 Mori–Zwanzig 形式加以解释，从而从 TVACF 时间积分中提取波矢依赖的膜粘度。
papers.method_zh: 平衡态分子动力学模拟（平面双分子层与水受限在固体平行壁之间）；基于 Onsager 回归假设的耦合连续介质力学方程；Mori–Zwanzig 形式理论用于调和 TVACF 的振荡与慢衰减行为；并通过施加空间变化的面内体积力的非平衡模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Remote epitaxy beyond polarity
papers.abstract: Remote epitaxy through a monolayer two-dimensional material-covered substrate establishes a crystallographic registry across the van der Waals (vdW) surface that enables the epitaxial growth, lift-off and transfer of single-crystalline films. A central belief in remote epitaxy is that the substrate facilitating the phenomenon must be a material with strong ionicity, as the interatomic electrostatic potential fluctuation in covalent and metallic materials is substantially attenuated by two-dimensional materials. Here, we show remote epitaxy is possible when the substrate is a metallic or covalently bonded material and experimentally demonstrate non-polar remote homo- and heteroepitaxy across a wide range of material systems, including both metals and semiconductors. The achieved non-polar remote interactions are designed and engineered by harnessing substrate conductivity and vicinal surface step-edge density. These findings indicate that remote epitaxy is universal and applicable to ionic, metallic, and covalent materials, expanding its capabilities and stimulating a plethora of new fundamental scientific questions about the mechanism of remote epitaxy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中明确使用“experimentally demonstrate”（实验证明）、“designed and engineered”（设计与调控）等表述，且涉及具体材料体系的实验实现。；研究对象：远程外延（remote epitaxy）这一外延生长现象，具体研究在金属性或共价键合衬底上、通过单层二维材料覆盖衬底实现的非极性远程同质外延和异质外延，涵盖金属和半导体等多种材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 远程外延并不局限于强离子性衬底，在金属性或共价键合衬底上同样可以实现；通过调控衬底导电性和邻晶表面台阶边缘密度，可以设计并实现非极性远程相互作用。这表明远程外延具有普适性，适用于离子性、金属性和共价性材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：远程外延并不局限于强离子性衬底，在金属性或共价键合衬底上同样可以实现；通过调控衬底导电性和邻晶表面台阶边缘密度，可以设计并实现非极性远程相互作用。这表明远程外延具有普适性，适用于离子性、金属性和共价性材料。；创新点：挑战了远程外延必须依赖强离子性衬底这一核心传统认知，首次实验证明在金属性和共价键合衬底上也能实现远程外延，并展示了非极性远程同质和异质外延，将远程外延的适用范围从离子性材料拓展到金属性和共价性材料，提出远程外延具有普适性。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段（如分子束外延、ARPES 等）或计算方法，仅提及通过调控衬底导电性和邻晶表面台阶边缘密度来设计非极性远程相互作用，并在多种金属和半导体材料体系中进行了实验验证。

papers.title: How dipolar interactions structure molecular droplets
papers.abstract: We investigate how dipolar interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules structure the self-bound droplets formed under variation of the interaction strength. We identify the transition from droplets to crystals as a finite-size first order transition. With droplet-ring states and transitional supersolid states we predict additional structure in the crystal and droplet phases, respectively. To describe this strongly correlated regime, and in particular the reconfiguration of quantum ground states, we design a variational Monte Carlo framework based on neural quantum states. It is especially suitable to describe ground states and almost degenerate states with very different configurations. Moreover, one can easily determine the superfluid fraction. Our results reveal the sequence of finite-size structures through which dipolar interactions reorganize molecular droplets into crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：设计变分蒙特卡洛框架（variational Monte Carlo framework）、基于神经量子态（neural quantum states）、预测（predict）、确定超流分数（determine the superfluid fraction）。摘要中未提及任何实验手段或实验数据。；研究对象：微波屏蔽极性分子（microwave-shielded polar molecules）之间的偶极相互作用如何构造自束缚液滴（self-bound droplets）的结构，以及液滴到晶体的转变、液滴-环态（droplet-ring states）和过渡超固态（transitional supersolid states）等强关联量子基态与近简并态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偶极相互作用驱动的液滴到晶体转变是一个有限尺寸的一阶相变；在晶体相和液滴相中分别存在额外的结构——液滴-环态和过渡超固态；偶极相互作用通过一系列有限尺寸结构将分子液滴重组为晶体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偶极相互作用驱动的液滴到晶体转变是一个有限尺寸的一阶相变；在晶体相和液滴相中分别存在额外的结构——液滴-环态和过渡超固态；偶极相互作用通过一系列有限尺寸结构将分子液滴重组为晶体。；创新点：提出了基于神经量子态的变分蒙特卡洛框架，特别适合描述构型非常不同的基态和近简并态，且能容易地确定超流分数；并据此预测了液滴相和晶体相中的额外结构（液滴-环态、过渡超固态）以及液滴到晶体的有限尺寸一阶转变。
papers.method_zh: 设计了基于神经量子态（neural quantum states）的变分蒙特卡洛（variational Monte Carlo）框架，用于描述强关联区域中构型差异很大的基态和近简并态，并可方便地确定超流分数。

papers.title: Breakdown of Anomalous Hall Scaling in Dilute Kondo System
papers.abstract: The confluence of strong electronic correlations and Berry curvature-driven transport constitutes a largely underexplored frontier in quantum materials research, particularly in systems where electronic correlations arise from flat-band physics rather than conventional $f$-electron states. Here, we report an intrinsic Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall transport in the dilute Kondo system Ru$_2$Mn$_{0.5}$Ti$_{0.5}$Ge, a non-$f$-electron Heusler alloy hosting flat bands with van Hove singularity proximate to the Fermi level. The anomalous Hall response is strikingly non-monotonic, violating the Fermi-liquid scaling relation near the magnetic transition and is restored only at low temperature, coincident with the onset of Kondo coherence. \textit{Ab initio} calculations strongly establish that the Berry curvature originates from the Kondo hybridization induced interplay of flat bands and spin-orbit coupling mediated anticrossings at the Fermi level. Our findings demonstrate that Kondo coherence of flat bands bears a profound impact on Berry curvature associated ferroic responses, mandating a rigorous theoretical understanding of anomalous transport in the regime where reciprocal space topology and strong correlations are intrinsically intertwined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算）。判断依据关键词：论文报道了“intrinsic Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall transport”的实验观测（“we report”），同时结合了“Ab initio calculations”来建立微观机制。；研究对象：稀磁 Kondo 体系 Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge，一种非 f 电子 Heusler 合金，其平带及 van Hove 奇点靠近费米能级。研究的具体物理现象是该体系中的内禀 Berry 曲率驱动的反常霍尔输运及其标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该稀磁 Kondo 体系中的反常霍尔响应呈现显著的非单调行为，在磁转变附近违反费米液体标度关系，仅在低温下、与 Kondo 相干性出现同步时才恢复。Ab initio 计算表明，Berry 曲率来源于 Kondo 杂化诱导的平带与自旋轨道耦合在费米能级处反交叉的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该稀磁 Kondo 体系中的反常霍尔响应呈现显著的非单调行为，在磁转变附近违反费米液体标度关系，仅在低温下、与 Kondo 相干性出现同步时才恢复。Ab initio 计算表明，Berry 曲率来源于 Kondo 杂化诱导的平带与自旋轨道耦合在费米能级处反交叉的相互作用。；创新点：首次在非 f 电子稀磁 Kondo 体系（平带驱动关联效应）中报道了内禀 Berry 曲率驱动的反常霍尔输运，并揭示了 Kondo 相干性对平带 Berry 曲率相关铁性响应的深刻影响，突破了此前该领域主要关注 f 电子体系的局限，强调了倒空间拓扑与强关联内在交织时反常输运需要新的理论理解。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：测量了反常霍尔输运（具体实验手段摘要未明确说明，如是否为输运测量、ARPES 等未详细给出）。计算方面：使用了 Ab initio 计算（具体是否为 DFT+U 等细节摘要未明确说明）来确立 Berry 曲率的微观起源。

papers.title: Fluctuations of a Photon Bose-Einstein Condensate Coupled to a Reservoir: Describing Coherence Properties in a Free-Energy Model
papers.abstract: Photons are mutually nearly noninteracting particles, so thermalized photon ensembles are commonly obtained not from direct particle-particle-interactions but rather from contact with matter, which can constitute a reservoir for the photon gas. We develop a theory model for photons in a material-filled (e.g. liquid dye) optical microcavity, with the aim to study the fluctuation properties using a free-energy description for noninteracting photons coupled to a reservoir of material electronic excitations. To begin with, we use a single mode description for the condensate. For a small relative size of the material reservoir, corresponding to the canonical regime, condensate number fluctuations are small, and the derived free energy landscape takes the usual Mexican-hat shaped form such that spontaneous symmetry breaking occurs. In contrast, for a large relative size of the reservoir, corresponding to the grand canonical regime, fluctuations become as large as the average particle number. We show that the resulting free energy landscape acquires a bowl-shaped form, with a single minimum at the origin. Thus, a macroscopic occupation of the ground state (i.e., Bose-Einstein condensation) in the absence of spontaneous symmetry breaking is expected. We also provide a model for the treatment of a photon gas trapped in a box-shaped potential with spatially distributed coupling to a reservoir. The model predicts, for example, a statistically fluctuating pattern of islands with long-range coherence, resembling transient microcondensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：develop a theory model、free-energy description、we also provide a model、the model predicts。；研究对象：填充材料（如液体染料）的光学微腔中的光子气体，以及其与材料电子激发库耦合形成的光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，重点研究其相干性与涨落性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当材料库相对尺寸较小（正则系综区域）时，凝聚体粒子数涨落小，自由能呈墨西哥帽形，发生自发对称破缺；当材料库相对尺寸较大（巨正则系综区域）时，涨落与平均粒子数相当，自由能变为碗形、原点处单一极小，此时可在无自发对称破缺的情况下实现基态宏观占据（即玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）。此外，对于盒形势阱中空间分布耦合的光子气体，模型预测会出现具有长程相干性的统计涨落“岛”图案，类似瞬态微凝聚体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当材料库相对尺寸较小（正则系综区域）时，凝聚体粒子数涨落小，自由能呈墨西哥帽形，发生自发对称破缺；当材料库相对尺寸较大（巨正则系综区域）时，涨落与平均粒子数相当，自由能变为碗形、原点处单一极小，此时可在无自发对称破缺的情况下实现基态宏观占据（即玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）。此外，对于盒形势阱中空间分布耦合的光子气体，模型预测会出现具有长程相干性的统计涨落“岛”图案，类似瞬态微凝聚体。；创新点：将光子BEC的相干性与涨落性质放在自由能模型中处理，揭示了材料库相对尺寸（即正则与巨正则区域）如何决定自由能景观形状以及是否发生自发对称破缺，并指出在巨正则区域可在无自发对称破缺下实现BEC；同时提出盒形势阱中空间分布耦合的模型，预测长程相干“岛”状瞬态微凝聚体。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：针对无相互作用光子与材料电子激发库耦合体系，采用自由能描述；首先使用单模描述处理凝聚体，并区分正则系综与巨正则系综两种极限；另外建立了盒形势阱中光子气体与库空间分布耦合的模型。

papers.title: Connecting heterogeneous dynamics with local entropy
papers.abstract: Establishing a robust and physically interpretable link between static structure and heterogeneous relaxation dynamics remains a fundamental challenge in glass physics. Here, we introduce a weighted pair-entropy descriptor based on the conventional two-body excess entropy. For this, we multiply the integrand used to calculate the excess entropy by a weight function that is directly related to the length scale of the pair correlation function. This multiplication does not affect the contribution of the short range order to the local excess entropy, but allows to take into account the structure present on intermediate distances, i.e., the medium-range order. For a canonical two-dimensional Lennard-Jones glass former, the resulting descriptor exhibits a strong correlation with particle-level dynamical propensity at long times (multiples of the alpha-relaxation time), with a maximum structure--dynamics correlation reaching about 0.9, substantially outperforming the predictive power of the conventional local pair excess entropy. These results demonstrate that incorporating a physically motivated structural length scale into entropy-based descriptors markedly enhances their predictive power while preserving physical interpretability. Our findings provide a simple and general framework for investigating structure--dynamics correlations in glass-forming systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：canonical two-dimensional Lennard-Jones glass former、descriptor、correlation，表明是在模型体系上进行数值计算/模拟的研究。；研究对象：二维 Lennard-Jones 玻璃形成体（glass former）中的结构—动力学关联，具体关注粒子层次的异质弛豫动力学（heterogeneous relaxation dynamics）与局部熵之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入的加权对熵描述符（weighted pair-entropy descriptor）在长时间尺度（α弛豫时间的倍数）上与粒子级动力学倾向（dynamical propensity）表现出强关联，结构—动力学关联最大值可达约 0.9，显著优于传统的局部对过剩熵。这表明在熵基描述符中引入具有物理意义的结构长度尺度，可在保持物理可解释性的同时大幅提升其预测能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入的加权对熵描述符（weighted pair-entropy descriptor）在长时间尺度（α弛豫时间的倍数）上与粒子级动力学倾向（dynamical propensity）表现出强关联，结构—动力学关联最大值可达约 0.9，显著优于传统的局部对过剩熵。这表明在熵基描述符中引入具有物理意义的结构长度尺度，可在保持物理可解释性的同时大幅提升其预测能力。；创新点：在传统局部对过剩熵的基础上乘以与对关联函数长度尺度相关的权重函数，从而在不影响短程有序贡献的前提下纳入中程有序（medium-range order）的结构信息，显著提升了对动力学异质性的预测能力，同时保持了物理可解释性，提供了一个简单且通用的研究玻璃形成体系中结构—动力学关联的框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于传统两体过剩熵（two-body excess entropy），将其积分被积函数乘以一个与对关联函数长度尺度直接相关的权重函数，构建加权对熵描述符；在二维 Lennard-Jones 玻璃形成体上进行计算，并测量该描述符与粒子级动力学倾向之间的关联。

papers.title: Diffusion under competing bulk and surface stopping mechanisms
papers.abstract: We investigate reflected diffusion in a bounded domain subject to two independent, competing stopping mechanisms: an exponentially distributed bulk lifetime of rate $p$ and a surface reaction triggered when the boundary local time exceeds an independent exponential threshold of rate $q$. Denoting by $T$ the stopping time and by $L$ the acquired boundary local time at stopping, we derive their marginal distributions, joint Laplace transform, and complete hierarchy of mixed moments. These statistics are determined by the splitting probability $φ$ that surface reaction occurs before bulk decay. In particular, we establish the identity $p\expect{T}+q\expect{L}=1$ and show that the cumulative risk $pT+qL$ is exponentially distributed with unit rate. We further obtain equivalent representations of $φ$ in terms of the Robin-Laplacian and the generalized Steklov spectra. Explicit results for a three-dimensional ball reveal how competing rates $p,q$ control $φ$ and the $(T,L)$ statistics. Monte Carlo simulations test the universal cumulative-risk law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中未提及任何实验测量或数值模拟作为主要手段，而是以推导随机过程的统计量（边际分布、联合拉普拉斯变换、混合矩）为主，辅以蒙特卡洛模拟验证理论结果。；研究对象：有界区域中的反射扩散过程，受两种独立竞争的停止机制控制：一是速率 $p$ 的指数分布体寿命（体衰减），二是当边界局部时超过独立指数阈值（速率 $q$）时触发的表面反应。具体物理现象是扩散粒子在体相衰减与表面反应之间的竞争停止行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了停止时间 $T$ 与停止时获得的边界局部时 $L$ 的完整统计描述，这些统计量由表面反应先于体衰减发生的分裂概率 $\phi$ 决定；证明了恒等式 $p\langle T\rangle + q\langle L\rangle = 1$，并证明累积风险 $pT + qL$ 服从单位速率的指数分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了停止时间 $T$ 与停止时获得的边界局部时 $L$ 的完整统计描述，这些统计量由表面反应先于体衰减发生的分裂概率 $\phi$ 决定；证明了恒等式 $p\langle T\rangle + q\langle L\rangle = 1$，并证明累积风险 $pT + qL$ 服从单位速率的指数分布。；创新点：揭示了体相与表面竞争停止机制下停止时间与边界局部时的联合统计规律，特别是发现了累积风险 $pT + qL$ 的普适指数分布律（$p\langle T\rangle + q\langle L\rangle = 1$），并将分裂概率与 Robin-Laplacian 及广义 Steklov 谱联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 随机过程理论框架：推导边际分布、联合拉普拉斯变换和混合矩的解析表达式；利用 Robin-Laplacian 和广义 Steklov 谱给出分裂概率 $\phi$ 的等价表示；对三维球体给出显式结果；用蒙特卡洛模拟检验累积风险定律的普适性。

papers.title: Robustness of RKKY interactions across a Weyl node-annihilation transition
authors: Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
papers.abstract: Weyl semimetals (WSMs), with their unique topological properties and distinct electronic structure, exhibit intriguing properties when either time-reversal or inversion symmetries are broken. In this work, we consider the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction between magnetic impurities in time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSMs. We derive analytical expressions for the full RKKY exchange tensor in arbitrary two-band spinful lattice systems. Our approach reveals both Heisenberg, anisotropic Ising and Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya terms, which can be calculated by energy-integrating real-space Green's functions across the entire Brillouin zone, with the band edge acting as a natural energy cutoff. We apply this framework to study a two-band tight-binding model for a time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSM that interpolates between a Weyl phase with well-separated chiral nodes and a quadratic band-touching semimetal phase. Remarkably, the spatial profile, magnitude, and anisotropic tensor structure of the exchange couplings remain persistent across the node-annihilation transition. This topological robustness reveals that short- and intermediate-range RKKY interactions are mediated by the global, Brillouin-zone-integrated quantum metric of the full valence band rather than being strictly dictated by local low-energy Berry curvature monopoles. These findings demonstrate the necessity of full-band tight-binding formulations when predicting real-space magnetic interactions, providing key insights for electric-field tuning of magnetic anisotropy and constructing realistic models of heavy-fermion and Weyl-Kondo semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derive analytical expressions、two-band tight-binding model、energy-integrating real-space Green's functions，均为解析推导与模型计算，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：时间反演对称性破缺的Weyl半金属中磁性杂质之间的RKKY相互作用，具体研究一个两带紧束缚模型，该模型可在具有分离手性节点的Weyl相与二次能带接触半金属相之间插值，并跨越Weyl节点湮灭相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在节点湮灭相变前后保持持续不变（拓扑鲁棒性）；这表明短程和中程RKKY相互作用由整个价带的全局布里渊区积分量子度规所主导，而非严格由低能局域Berry曲率单极子决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在节点湮灭相变前后保持持续不变（拓扑鲁棒性）；这表明短程和中程RKKY相互作用由整个价带的全局布里渊区积分量子度规所主导，而非严格由低能局域Berry曲率单极子决定。；创新点：首次给出了任意两带含自旋晶格系统中完整RKKY交换张量的解析表达式；揭示了RKKY相互作用在Weyl节点湮灭相变前后的拓扑鲁棒性，并指出其由全价带的全局量子度规而非局域低能Berry曲率单极子主导；强调了预测实空间磁相互作用时采用全能带紧束缚形式的必要性，为电场调控磁各向异性以及构建重费米子和Weyl-Kondo半金属的现实模型提供了关键见解。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导了任意两带含自旋晶格系统中完整RKKY交换张量的表达式，包含Heisenberg项、各向异性Ising项和Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya项；通过对实空间格林函数在整个布里渊区进行能量积分来计算，以能带边缘作为自然能量截断；并将该框架应用于一个两带紧束缚模型。

papers.title: Coarse-graining far-from-equilibrium dynamics using oblique projectors
papers.abstract: We generalize the Mori-Zwanzig projection operator formalism by introducing an oblique projector using biorthogonal variables to coarse-grain the dynamics of systems far from equilibrium, such as active or living matter. Improving on previously used orthogonal projectors, the oblique projector correctly decomposes the emergent interactions of the coarse-grained particles into systematic and stochastic contributions. We show that the formalism directly connects to established results in non-equilibrium linear response theory and adiabatic perturbation theory. Based on this formalism, we develop a coarse-graining algorithm which we apply to extract the emergent non-equilibrium chiral dynamics of a passive tracer in a chiral active bath. Our theory correctly predicts the odd transport properties and a confinement-induced shift of the chiral frequency of the tracer.
