Together, these results establish spin--charge subordination as a kinematic mechanism for anomalously slow internal-state transport in one-dimensional impenetrable quantum gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“obtain the exact full counting statistics”“exact relation”“universal non-Gaussian M-Wright law”等表述，属于解析推导与严格结果，未涉及实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：一维无限-U SU(N) Hubbard 模型（一维不可穿透量子气体）中的电荷输运与味（flavor）输运，以及自旋-电荷从属（spin-charge subordination）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无通过约束（no-passing constraint）使有序味序列冻结，而粒子坐标像自由无自旋费米子一样演化；因此电荷转移由自由费米子行列式描述，味转移则严格从属于穿过观测切面的粒子数。对任意无迹 Cartan 生成元，电荷与味累积量之间存在精确关系，且完整的渐近味分布服从普适的非高斯 M-Wright 律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无通过约束（no-passing constraint）使有序味序列冻结，而粒子坐标像自由无自旋费米子一样演化；因此电荷转移由自由费米子行列式描述，味转移则严格从属于穿过观测切面的粒子数。对任意无迹 Cartan 生成元，电荷与味累积量之间存在精确关系，且完整的渐近味分布服从普适的非高斯 M-Wright 律。；创新点：首次在无限-U SU(N) Hubbard 链中建立电荷与味输运的精确全计数统计，揭示味转移严格从属于电荷转移的机制，并给出电荷-味累积量的精确关系及普适非高斯 M-Wright 渐近分布；将自旋-电荷从属确立为一维不可穿透量子气体中内部态输运异常缓慢的动力学机制。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：基于一维无限-U SU(N) Hubbard 模型，利用无通过约束导致的味序列冻结与粒子坐标自由费米子化，计算电荷与味输运的精确全计数统计（full counting statistics），并推导电荷与味累积量之间的精确关系及渐近味分布。

papers.title: Challenges in orbital current-driven domain wall motion in light metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures
papers.abstract: Recent advances in spintronics suggest that orbital Hall currents generated by charge injection in light metals can provide nonequilibrium angular momentum without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here, we examine whether such orbital currents can drive domain wall (DW) motion in an amorphous ferrimagnetic alloy, Gd$_{25}$(Fe$_{9}$Co$_{1}$)$_{75}$ (GFC), where the rare-earth sublattice offers strong SOC for orbital-to-spin conversion. We compare three representative heterostructures: Pt/GFC as a spin Hall reference, light-metal (Mn or Ti)/GFC for direct orbital-current injection, and light-metal/Pt/GFC incorporating an ultrathin Pt layer for orbital-to-spin conversion. Whereas Pt/GFC exhibits robust and reproducible spin-orbit-torque-driven DW motion, no current-driven DW motion is detected in Mn/GFC or Ti/GFC. Second-harmonic Hall measurements nevertheless reveal finite damping-like torques in both Mn/GFC and Ti/GFC, demonstrating that angular-momentum transfer into GFC does occur but is far weaker than in Pt/GFC. Inserting a 1-nm-thick Pt conversion layer strongly enhances the damping-like torque and restores DW motion. Thickness-dependent analysis further shows that DW mobility and depinning thresholds correlate with the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and domain-wall width, highlighting weak torque conversion and insufficient interfacial stabilization of chiral DWs as key challenges for orbital-driven DW motion in light-metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：论文使用“second-harmonic Hall measurements”“thickness-dependent analysis”等实验测量手段，并在实际异质结样品中观测畴壁运动，属于实验研究。；研究对象：轻金属/亚铁磁异质结中的轨道电流驱动畴壁运动。具体体系为非晶亚铁磁合金 Gd₂₅(Fe₉Co₁)₇₅（GFC），以及三种异质结构：Pt/GFC（自旋霍尔参考样品）、轻金属（Mn 或 Ti）/GFC（直接轨道电流注入）、轻金属/Pt/GFC（插入超薄 Pt 层进行轨道-自旋转换）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Mn/GFC 和 Ti/GFC 中未检测到电流驱动的畴壁运动，尽管二次谐波霍尔测量表明两者均存在有限的类阻尼力矩，说明角动量确实转移到了 GFC 中但远弱于 Pt/GFC；插入 1 nm 厚 Pt 转换层可显著增强类阻尼力矩并恢复畴壁运动。畴壁迁移率和去钉扎阈值与界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用及畴壁宽度相关，表明弱力矩转换和手性畴壁界面稳定不足是轻金属/亚铁磁体系中轨道驱动畴壁运动的关键挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Mn/GFC 和 Ti/GFC 中未检测到电流驱动的畴壁运动，尽管二次谐波霍尔测量表明两者均存在有限的类阻尼力矩，说明角动量确实转移到了 GFC 中但远弱于 Pt/GFC；插入 1 nm 厚 Pt 转换层可显著增强类阻尼力矩并恢复畴壁运动。畴壁迁移率和去钉扎阈值与界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用及畴壁宽度相关，表明弱力矩转换和手性畴壁界面稳定不足是轻金属/亚铁磁体系中轨道驱动畴壁运动的关键挑战。；创新点：系统比较了 Pt/GFC（自旋霍尔参考）、轻金属（Mn、Ti）/GFC（直接轨道电流注入）和轻金属/Pt/GFC（插入超薄 Pt 转换层）三类异质结中的电流驱动畴壁运动，实验上揭示了轻金属产生的轨道电流虽能向亚铁磁体转移角动量，但力矩转换效率远低于 Pt 的自旋霍尔效应，并指出弱力矩转换与手性畴壁界面稳定不足是轨道驱动畴壁运动的主要瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：电流驱动畴壁运动的测量、二次谐波霍尔测量（用于表征类阻尼力矩）、厚度依赖分析（关联畴壁迁移率、去钉扎阈值与界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用及畴壁宽度）。摘要未明确说明具体的薄膜生长方法（如磁控溅射、分子束外延等）及结构表征手段。

papers.title: Field-Driven Coupled Magnon--Phonon--Electron Relaxation in Magnetite Using Steepest-Entropy-Ascent Quantum Thermodynamic Formalism
papers.abstract: A field-driven steepest-entropy-ascent quantum thermodynamic (SEAQT) formulation is developed for longitudinal nonequilibrium relaxation in magnetite (Fe$_3$O$_4$) with coupled electron, phonon, and magnon populations. Material-specific excitation spectra define the thermodynamic state space, while one relaxation parameter for each population sets its kinetic scale. A longitudinal magnetic field shifts the dressed magnon eigenenergies while the occupation basis remains fixed; irreversible redistribution conserves instantaneous energy and electron number while allowing the magnon population to vary. The formulation yields nonequilibrium subsystem temperatures, entropy production, magnetic-work identities, and a coupled small-signal susceptibility incorporating energy-conservation feedback among all three populations; the one-pole Debye response appears only as a limiting case. Numerical results under sinusoidal driving show a transition from nearly quasistatic behavior to frequency-dependent lag, finite-amplitude departure from the linear-response ellipse, and increasing higher-harmonic content. Relaxational work per cycle increases strongly with field amplitude and frequency, while the complex susceptibility is broader and shifted relative to a Debye reference. Entropy production remains positive, and the electron, phonon, and magnon temperatures show distinct excursions followed by secular heating when positive magnetic work is retained without heat rejection. The calculated work represents longitudinal magnon quasiparticle relaxation in a homogeneous single-domain model, not the total core loss of a finite ferrite specimen.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：develops a formulation、formalism、numerical results、model（摘要中明确构建了 SEAQT 理论框架并进行了数值计算，未涉及实验测量）。；研究对象：磁铁矿（Fe₃O₄）中电子、声子、磁振子三个子系统耦合的纵向非平衡弛豫现象，具体为纵向磁场驱动下的磁振子准粒子弛豫及相关的磁化响应、熵产生和子系统温度演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该 SEAQT 形式化方法能够给出耦合电子-声子-磁振子系统的非平衡子系统温度、熵产生、磁功恒等式及耦合小信号磁化率；在正弦驱动下，系统从近准静态行为过渡到频率依赖的滞后响应，出现非线性偏离和高次谐波，且复磁化率比 Debye 参考更宽且有偏移；当正磁功未被热耗散时，三个子系统温度先出现各自不同的偏移，随后发生持续加热。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该 SEAQT 形式化方法能够给出耦合电子-声子-磁振子系统的非平衡子系统温度、熵产生、磁功恒等式及耦合小信号磁化率；在正弦驱动下，系统从近准静态行为过渡到频率依赖的滞后响应，出现非线性偏离和高次谐波，且复磁化率比 Debye 参考更宽且有偏移；当正磁功未被热耗散时，三个子系统温度先出现各自不同的偏移，随后发生持续加热。；创新点：发展了场驱动的 SEAQT 形式化方法用于磁铁矿中电子-声子-磁振子耦合的纵向非平衡弛豫，给出了包含三粒子群间能量守恒反馈的耦合小信号磁化率（单极点 Debye 响应仅作为极限情形），并揭示了正弦驱动下的非线性谐波产生及子系统温度的差异化演化与持续加热行为。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于最陡熵增量子热力学（SEAQT）形式化框架，针对磁铁矿建立纵向非平衡弛豫模型；用材料特定的激发谱定义热力学状态空间，每个粒子群用一个弛豫参数设定动力学尺度；纵向磁场移动缀饰磁振子本征能量而保持占据基不变；在瞬时能量和电子数守恒条件下进行不可逆重分布；数值上采用正弦驱动进行模拟。

papers.title: Orientation selection and superconducting properties of epitaxial Al on ferromagnetic semiconductor (In,Fe)As
papers.abstract: Superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures provide a versatile platform for exploring spin-dependent superconducting phenomena arising from interfacial proximity effects. In this article, we investigate the structural and superconducting properties of Al thin films grown in situ by molecular beam epitaxy on strained Fe-doped ferromagnetic semiconductor (FMS) (In,Fe)As layers. X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal the epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al layers, with the growth orientation changing from (110) to (111) as the in-plane lattice constant of (In,Fe)As increases. The superconducting critical temperature of Al varies systematically with the film surface morphology and grain size. In addition, the critical magnetic field of Al exhibits an anomalous decrease below 0.5 K, possibly reflecting magnetic coupling to the underlying FMS (In,Fe)As layer. These findings provide a guideline for material design of epitaxial Al/(In,Fe)As heterostructures, which may serve as a promising platform for investigating proximity-induced superconducting and magnetic phenomena in semiconductor-based hybrid quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“grown in situ by molecular beam epitaxy”“X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal”等实验制备与表征手段，属于实验研究。；研究对象：分子束外延原位生长的Al薄膜与铁磁半导体(In,Fe)As层构成的超导体/铁磁体异质结，具体研究Al薄膜的晶体取向选择、超导临界温度、临界磁场以及可能的界面磁耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Al在(In,Fe)As上实现单晶外延生长，其生长取向随(In,Fe)As面内晶格常数增大从(110)转变为(111)；Al的超导临界温度随薄膜表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统性变化，且临界磁场在0.5 K以下出现反常下降，可能源于与底层铁磁半导体(In,Fe)As的磁耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Al在(In,Fe)As上实现单晶外延生长，其生长取向随(In,Fe)As面内晶格常数增大从(110)转变为(111)；Al的超导临界温度随薄膜表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统性变化，且临界磁场在0.5 K以下出现反常下降，可能源于与底层铁磁半导体(In,Fe)As的磁耦合。；创新点：揭示了Al在铁磁半导体(In,Fe)As上的外延取向可由衬底面内晶格常数调控（(110)→(111)），并观察到Al临界磁场在0.5 K以下的反常下降，为外延Al/(In,Fe)As异质结的材料设计提供了指导，并提示其可作为研究近邻诱导超导与磁现象的平台。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）原位生长Al/(In,Fe)As异质结；X射线衍射（XRD）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）表征晶体结构与外延取向；测量超导临界温度和临界磁场。

papers.title: Thermodynamic learning
papers.abstract: We discuss the possibility to train a thermodynamic system, whose micro-variables are fully determined through the Hamiltonian by the usual statistical mechanical rules, to perform tasks such as memorization and generalization. Training is achieved by the application of suitable external fields, playing the role of {\it data}. At variance with conventional machine learning, no other logical or algorithmic rules are introduced. The system is amenable, in principle, to exact analytical calculations. We specialize this general approach to a prototypical Ising system with annealed dichotomous couplings and study its learning ability. Results indicate excellent memorization and good generalization capacity already for small systems, and a tendency to improve with system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：讨论可能性、可进行精确解析计算、将一般方法专门化到原型 Ising 系统进行研究，摘要中未涉及实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：一个热力学系统，其微观变量完全由哈密顿量通过通常的统计力学规则决定；具体专门化到具有退火双色耦合（annealed dichotomous couplings）的原型 Ising 系统，研究其记忆与泛化等学习任务的能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结果表明，即使是小系统也已具备出色的记忆能力和良好的泛化能力，并且这种学习能力有随系统尺寸增大而提升的趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结果表明，即使是小系统也已具备出色的记忆能力和良好的泛化能力，并且这种学习能力有随系统尺寸增大而提升的趋势。；创新点：与常规机器学习不同，该方法不引入任何其他逻辑或算法规则，而是通过外部场训练一个微观变量完全由哈密顿量和统计力学规则决定的热力学系统来完成记忆和泛化任务，且该体系原则上可精确解析计算。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为统计力学方法：通过施加合适的外部场（充当数据）来训练热力学系统，不引入其他逻辑或算法规则；该体系原则上可进行精确解析计算。具体专门化到退火双色耦合的 Ising 系统进行分析。

papers.title: Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
papers.abstract: Identifying the origin of the superfluid stiffness of electron-electron and electron-hole pair condensates is an important issue in flat-band physics. Here, we study the stiffness of bilayer exciton condensates using exact diagonalization and realistic Coulomb interactions across a wide variety of flat Chern band systems, including Landau levels, mixed Landau levels, and moiré bands. We find that stiffness is non-monotonic in the trace of the quantum metric and that it develops peaks when the band wavefunctions are engineered to be similar to those of Landau levels. The stiffness predicted by mean-field theory agrees quantitatively with exact diagonalization in these optimal cases, but systematically overestimates it otherwise. Flat bands with identical quantum geometry tensors can exhibit substantial differences in stiffness. The stiffness of condensates formed between moiré flat bands, which typically have strong variations in Berry curvature and quantum metric across their Brillouin zones, tends to be larger when the bands have non-zero Chern numbers and can be larger than that of Landau levels. Our results reveal a behavior that is richer than that suggested by simple geometric bounds and provide new guiding principles for the design of robust flat-band condensates with large superfluid stiffness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：exact diagonalization、realistic Coulomb interactions、mean-field theory。；研究对象：双层激子凝聚体（bilayer exciton condensates）的超流刚度，研究体系涵盖多种平带Chern band系统，包括朗道能级（Landau levels）、混合朗道能级（mixed Landau levels）和莫尔带（moiré bands）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子凝聚体的刚度对量子度规的迹（trace of the quantum metric）呈非单调依赖关系，当能带波函数被设计为类似朗道能级时刚度出现峰值；具有相同量子几何张量的平带可以表现出显著不同的刚度；莫尔平带间形成的凝聚体刚度在能带具有非零Chern数时趋于更大，甚至可超过朗道能级的刚度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子凝聚体的刚度对量子度规的迹（trace of the quantum metric）呈非单调依赖关系，当能带波函数被设计为类似朗道能级时刚度出现峰值；具有相同量子几何张量的平带可以表现出显著不同的刚度；莫尔平带间形成的凝聚体刚度在能带具有非零Chern数时趋于更大，甚至可超过朗道能级的刚度。；创新点：揭示了刚度对量子度规的非单调行为，超越了简单几何界所预期的图景；发现相同量子几何张量的平带刚度可以差异显著；指出莫尔平带凝聚体刚度在非零Chern数时可超过朗道能级，为设计具有大超流刚度的稳健平带凝聚体提供了新的指导原则。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）方法，结合真实库仑相互作用（realistic Coulomb interactions），并在最优情况下与平均场理论（mean-field theory）的预测进行定量对比。

papers.title: Scaling laws and energy dissipation in the dynamics of SLE curve as a 1D turbulence model
papers.abstract: In this study, we demonstrate the characteristics of the stochastic Loewner evolution (SLE) as a one-dimensional (1D) turbulence model. First, we show that the diffusion process $x(t)$ obtained by the time coordinate change in the SLE becomes the time dependent diffusion process that satisfies Richardson's law of turbulence.Subsequently, we derive the condition on the diffusivity parameter $κ$ such that the diffusion process $x(t)$ satisfies Kolmogorov's 4/5th law, which determines the relation between the mean energy dissipation and velocity in the particles of turbulence. Further mathematical analysis showed that this condition is seen as the condition on Loewner entropy $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$, which includes the white Gaussian noise term $W_{s}$ in the Loewner driving function of the present model. In addition, the numerical simulations were performed to verify the scaling relations of this 1D turbulence model. These results suggest that the standard SLE becomes a beneficial model of 1D turbulence by introducing an appropriate time coordinate change and imposing the conditions on $κ$ and $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值验证）。判断依据关键词：mathematical analysis、derive the condition、numerical simulations were performed to verify——以解析推导为主、数值模拟为辅，无实验成分。；研究对象：随机Loewner演化（SLE）作为一维湍流模型；具体研究SLE经时间坐标变换后得到的扩散过程 x(t)，以及其与湍流标度律（Richardson定律、Kolmogorov 4/5律）的对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SLE经适当时间坐标变换后得到的扩散过程 x(t) 满足湍流的Richardson定律；并推导出扩散率参数 κ 需满足的条件，使 x(t) 满足Kolmogorov 4/5律，该条件可表述为对Loewner熵 S_Loew 的条件（涉及Loewner驱动函数中的白高斯噪声项 W_s）。数值模拟验证了该一维湍流模型的标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SLE经适当时间坐标变换后得到的扩散过程 x(t) 满足湍流的Richardson定律；并推导出扩散率参数 κ 需满足的条件，使 x(t) 满足Kolmogorov 4/5律，该条件可表述为对Loewner熵 S_Loew 的条件（涉及Loewner驱动函数中的白高斯噪声项 W_s）。数值模拟验证了该一维湍流模型的标度关系。；创新点：将SLE作为一维湍流模型，建立了其与Richardson定律和Kolmogorov 4/5律的联系，并给出以 κ 和 Loewner熵 S_Loew 表述的条件，表明标准SLE通过引入适当时间坐标变换并施加对 κ 和 S_Loew 的条件后可成为有效的一维湍流模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为随机Loewner演化（SLE）与Loewner驱动函数、Loewner熵分析；数学解析推导（时间坐标变换、扩散率参数 κ 条件推导）；辅以数值模拟验证标度关系。

papers.title: Mean-field theory for quantum spin chains
papers.abstract: Mean-field theory is a widely used approximation for describing phase transitions, particularly effective above the upper critical dimension. Its origins can be traced back to the van der Waals theory of the liquid-gas transition and Weiss's molecular field theory of the paramagnetic-ferromagnetic transition. However, it was Lev D. Landau who provided a unifying and general framework applicable to a broad class of physical systems. The mean-field approach typically involves neglecting thermal fluctuations, which is a reasonable assumption in many classical contexts. However, its application to quantum phase transitions at zero temperature is less common. The aim of this short pedagogical paper is to explore and clarify the use of the mean-field approach in the less familiar domain of quantum phase transitions. We specifically consider the Ising model and the Blume-Capel model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Mean-field theory、pedagogical paper、explore and clarify the use of the mean-field approach、specifically consider the Ising model and the Blume-Capel model。；研究对象：量子自旋链中的量子相变，具体考虑 Ising 模型和 Blume-Capel 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。摘要仅指出该文旨在探索和澄清平均场方法在量子相变这一不太熟悉的领域中的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。摘要仅指出该文旨在探索和澄清平均场方法在量子相变这一不太熟悉的领域中的应用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该文定位为简短的教学性论文（short pedagogical paper），目的是在量子相变领域探索和澄清平均场方法的使用，而非报告新的物理发现。
papers.method_zh: 平均场理论（mean-field approach），应用于 Ising 模型和 Blume-Capel 模型的量子相变问题。

papers.title: Breakdown of the Overdamped Approximation in Fluctuating Environments
papers.abstract: The overdamped approximation is widely used to describe Brownian motion in complex environments, but its validity becomes nontrivial when the friction coefficient itself fluctuates in time. We investigate this problem by comparing underdamped and overdamped Langevin dynamics subject to the same fluctuating friction and satisfying the fluctuation--dissipation relation at a common temperature. We show that environmental averaging and inertial elimination generally lead to different long-time transport when environmental fluctuations are fast compared with velocity relaxation. For rapidly fluctuating friction, the underdamped dynamics is governed by the arithmetic mean friction and yields $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langleγ\rangle$, whereas the overdamped dynamics gives $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langleγ^{-1}\rangle$. For a two-state Markov friction, we derive the finite-time effective diffusion coefficient exactly and identify the full crossover between these two regimes, controlled by the competition between velocity relaxation and environmental switching. We further establish the fast-fluctuation result for general stationary friction processes and verify it for a continuous log-Ornstein--Uhlenbeck environment, for which the characteristic crossover time can also be determined independently. Our results reveal a noncommutativity between environmental averaging and inertial elimination, establish a timescale-dependent criterion for the validity of overdamped dynamics in temporally heterogeneous environments, and show that rapid environmental fluctuations can enhance, rather than suppress, the consequences of inertia.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Langevin dynamics、fluctuation–dissipation relation、two-state Markov friction、log-Ornstein–Uhlenbeck environment、解析推导有效扩散系数与交叉时间。摘要中未出现实验测量或第一性原理计算相关内容。；研究对象：复杂环境中受涨落摩擦系数影响的布朗运动，具体比较过阻尼与欠阻尼朗之万动力学在相同涨落摩擦和同一温度（满足涨落耗散关系）下的长时间输运行为；并以两态马尔可夫摩擦和连续对数Ornstein–Uhlenbeck环境为具体模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境平均与惯性消除一般不可交换：当环境涨落快于速度弛豫时，欠阻尼动力学由摩擦的算术平均支配，给出 \(D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langle\gamma\rangle\)，而过阻尼动力学给出 \(D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langle\gamma^{-1}\rangle\)，两者长时间输运不同；快速环境涨落可以增强而非抑制惯性的后果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境平均与惯性消除一般不可交换：当环境涨落快于速度弛豫时，欠阻尼动力学由摩擦的算术平均支配，给出 \(D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langle\gamma\rangle\)，而过阻尼动力学给出 \(D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langle\gamma^{-1}\rangle\)，两者长时间输运不同；快速环境涨落可以增强而非抑制惯性的后果。；创新点：揭示了环境平均与惯性消除之间的非对易性；建立了时间尺度依赖的判据，用于判断时间非均匀环境中过阻尼动力学的有效性；指出快速环境涨落可增强惯性效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为过阻尼与欠阻尼朗之万动力学，在共同温度下满足涨落耗散关系；对两态马尔可夫摩擦精确推导有限时间有效扩散系数并确定两种 regime 之间的完整交叉；进一步对一般平稳摩擦过程建立快涨落结果，并在连续对数Ornstein–Uhlenbeck环境中验证，同时独立确定特征交叉时间。

papers.title: 4 MV/cm (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Heterojunction Diodes Realized by Low-Damage e-Beam NiO$_x$ Interlayers
papers.abstract: We report on the utilization of a low-damage e-beam NiO$_x$ deposition process to realize field-plated heterojunction diodes (FP-HJDs) on (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ films with high critical breakdown field strengths beyond 4 MV/cm and power figure of merits (PFOM) of >1 GW/cm$^2$. Diodes were fabricated on a 2.67 $\times$ 10$^{16}$ cm$^{-3}$ intentionally doped 6.2 $μ$m thick epitaxial layer grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) on a conductive Sn-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ (010) substrate using TMGa, O$_2$, Ar carrier gas, and SiH$_4$ as the silicon dopant source. The mesa etched FP-HJD devices utilized a thin 7 nm e-beam NiO$_x$ interlayer before the sputtered NiO$_x$ layers to eliminate the effects of sputter-induced ion damage on the (010) epilayers. Current-Voltage measurements resulted in a forward current density of 700 A/cm$^2$ at 4 V, HJD ideality factor of 1.29, a V$_{bi}$ of 2 V, rectification ratio of 10$^{11}$, and a differential specific on resistance (R$_{on,sp}$) value of 2.36 m$Ω$ $\times$ cm$^2$. Breakdown of the (010) FP-HJDs was 1.64 kV, leading to a parallel plane electric field at breakdown (E$_{||,max}$) of 4.02 MV/cm and a PFOM of 1.14 GW/cm$^2$, which is a state-of-the-art result for diodes on MOCVD-grown (010) drift layers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：论文描述了器件制备工艺（e-beam 沉积、溅射、MOCVD 外延生长）、电学测量（Current-Voltage 测量、击穿测试）等具体实验手段，并报告了实验测得的器件性能参数。；研究对象：在 (010) β-Ga₂O₃ 薄膜上制备的场板异质结二极管（FP-HJDs），具体为 NiOₓ/β-Ga₂O₃ 异质结二极管。外延层由 MOCVD 在导电 Sn 掺杂 β-Ga₂O₃ (010) 衬底上生长，掺杂浓度 2.67 × 10¹⁶ cm⁻³，厚度 6.2 μm。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用低损伤电子束沉积 NiOₓ 中间层（7 nm）的场板异质结二极管实现了超过 4 MV/cm 的临界击穿场强（平行平面电场 E∥,max = 4.02 MV/cm）和 1.14 GW/cm² 的功率优值（PFOM），击穿电压为 1.64 kV，这是 MOCVD 生长 (010) 漂移层二极管的最先进结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用低损伤电子束沉积 NiOₓ 中间层（7 nm）的场板异质结二极管实现了超过 4 MV/cm 的临界击穿场强（平行平面电场 E∥,max = 4.02 MV/cm）和 1.14 GW/cm² 的功率优值（PFOM），击穿电压为 1.64 kV，这是 MOCVD 生长 (010) 漂移层二极管的最先进结果。；创新点：主要新意在于使用低损伤电子束 NiOₓ 沉积工艺作为溅射 NiOₓ 之前的薄中间层（7 nm），以消除溅射诱导的离子损伤对 (010) 外延层的影响，从而在 MOCVD 生长的 (010) β-Ga₂O₃ 漂移层上实现了最先进的击穿场强（>4 MV/cm）和功率优值（>1 GW/cm²）。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：(1) 用 MOCVD 在导电 Sn 掺杂 β-Ga₂O₃ (010) 衬底上生长 Si 掺杂外延层，前驱体为 TMGa、O₂、Ar 载气和 SiH₄ 掺杂源；(2) 台面刻蚀制备 FP-HJD 器件；(3) 在溅射 NiOₓ 层之前先沉积 7 nm 电子束 NiOₓ 中间层以消除溅射诱导的离子损伤；(4) 电流-电压测量获得正向电流密度、理想因子、内建电势、整流比和微分比导通电阻等参数；(5) 击穿测试。

papers.title: Evidence of Crystal-Field-Mediated Anisotropic Orbital Rashba Effect in Epitaxial Ru/FM Heterostructure
papers.abstract: Electrical generation of orbital angular momentum provides a promising route to current-induced torques, yet effective control of orbital Rashba textures still remains challenging, particularly because the role of the interfacial crystal field remains largely unexplored. Here, we report experimental evidence for a crystal-field-mediated interfacial anisotropic orbital Rashba effect (AORE) in epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures. Total orbital torque was disentangled into an isotropic bulk contribution and an in-plane anisotropic interfacial contribution. The latter was strongly suppressed by degrading the crystallinity of either constituent and by inserting a Cu spacer, highlighting the essential roles of coherent interfacial orbital hybridization and direct Ru/ferromagnet contact. These results identify interfacial crystal-field coherency as a key ingredient in manipulating orbital Rashba textures and establish a route toward engineering the symmetry and directionality of orbital torques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：experimental evidence、epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures、disentangled（实验分离）、inserting a Cu spacer、degrading the crystallinity（实验操控手段）。；研究对象：外延生长的 Ru/铁磁体（Ru/FM）异质结中的界面各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应（AORE），以及与之相关的轨道力矩（orbital torque）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该外延 Ru/FM 异质结中观测到由界面晶场介导的各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应；总轨道力矩可分解为各向同性的体贡献与面内各向异性的界面贡献，后者依赖于界面轨道杂化的相干性和 Ru/FM 的直接接触。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该外延 Ru/FM 异质结中观测到由界面晶场介导的各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应；总轨道力矩可分解为各向同性的体贡献与面内各向异性的界面贡献，后者依赖于界面轨道杂化的相干性和 Ru/FM 的直接接触。；创新点：首次提供实验证据表明界面晶场相干性是调控轨道 Rashba 织构的关键因素，并建立了通过界面晶场工程来调控轨道力矩对称性与方向性的途径；此前界面晶场在轨道 Rashba 效应中的作用在很大程度上未被探索。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段（如生长方法、测量技术等），仅提及通过降低任一组元的结晶质量以及插入 Cu 隔离层来进行对照实验，以验证界面贡献的来源。

papers.title: Enhanced Multifractality Induced by Non-Hermitian Disorder in Quantum Percolation
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between geometric dilution and non-Hermitian disorder in the two-dimensional quantum site-percolation model. Non-Hermiticity is introduced through random imaginary on-site potentials, representing spatially uncorrelated gain and loss, while the hopping amplitudes remain reciprocal. By combining complex level-spacing statistics, participation entropy, and multifractal analysis, we characterize the localization properties of the eigenstates as functions of the disorder and the non-Hermiticity strength. Our finite-size scaling results show that non-Hermitian disorder shifts the quantum percolation threshold ($p_q$) toward larger occupation probabilities. Consequently, the fully delocalized phase is progressively suppressed and disappears at sufficiently strong disorder. This suppression is not a simple consequence of adding on-site disorder of a given strength, but is specifically enhanced by its imaginary character, as an equally strong real (Hermitian) on-site potential produces a weaker shift of $p_q$. Nevertheless, the intermediate region between the classical ($p_c$) and quantum percolation thresholds presents a genuine multifractal critical phase, while the localization-length exponent $ν$ remains the same, relative to its Hermitian value. Altogether, our results demonstrate that random gain and loss enhance the multifractal regime while preserving the universality class of the quantum percolation transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：finite-size scaling、complex level-spacing statistics、participation entropy、multifractal analysis，均为数值计算与理论分析手段，摘要未提及任何实验测量。；研究对象：二维量子格点渗流模型（two-dimensional quantum site-percolation model），研究其中几何稀释（geometric dilution）与非厄米无序（random imaginary on-site potentials，即空间无关联的增益与损耗）之间的相互作用，以及本征态的局域化性质与量子渗流相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米无序（随机虚位势）会将量子渗流阈值 $p_q$ 推向更大的占据概率，从而逐步压制完全退局域相并在足够强的无序下使其消失；这种压制并非单纯来自位势无序的强度，而是由其虚数（非厄米）特性所增强——同等强度的实（厄米）位势只产生较弱的 $p_q$ 移动。同时，经典渗流阈值 $p_c$ 与 $p_q$ 之间的中间区域呈现真正的多重分形临界相，而局域化长度指数 $\nu$ 与厄米情形保持相同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米无序（随机虚位势）会将量子渗流阈值 $p_q$ 推向更大的占据概率，从而逐步压制完全退局域相并在足够强的无序下使其消失；这种压制并非单纯来自位势无序的强度，而是由其虚数（非厄米）特性所增强——同等强度的实（厄米）位势只产生较弱的 $p_q$ 移动。同时，经典渗流阈值 $p_c$ 与 $p_q$ 之间的中间区域呈现真正的多重分形临界相，而局域化长度指数 $\nu$ 与厄米情形保持相同。；创新点：揭示了非厄米无序（随机增益与损耗）能够增强多重分形区域，同时保持量子渗流相变的普适类不变；并明确指出这种效应对 $p_q$ 的移动源于位势的虚数特性，而非普通无序强度的简单效果（通过与同等强度实位势的对比加以区分）。
papers.method_zh: 对二维量子格点渗流模型进行数值计算，引入随机虚位势（保持跃迁振幅互易）实现非厄米性；结合复能级间距统计（complex level-spacing statistics）、参与熵（participation entropy）和多重分形分析来表征本征态局域化性质，并通过有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）确定渗流阈值与临界指数。

papers.title: Hydrogen Storage on Transition-Metal-Decorated Nitrogen-Modified Carbon Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Recently synthesized carbon nanoribbons (CNRs) were investigated for hydrogen (H2) storage using first-principles density functional theory calculations. Pristine CNRs exhibited weak H2 adsorption; therefore, the host structure was modified by substituting carbon atoms at the C-H edges with 12 nitrogen atoms, followed by Mn and Y doping to enhance H2 binding. A maximum of five metal atoms could be accommodated on the 12N-CNRs. Electronic structure analysis revealed strong orbital hybridization between the metal atoms and the CNRs, while binding energy calculations confirmed the structural stability of the doped systems. Bader charge analysis further quantified the charge transfer between the metal atoms and the host structure. The average H2 adsorption energies were calculated to be -0.40 eV/H2 for the Mn-doped system and -0.25 eV/H2 for the Y-doped system, which are within the desirable range for reversible hydrogen storage. The maximum theoretical gravimetric storage capacities at 0 K reached 7.48 wt% for the Mn-doped system and 6.55 wt% for the Y-doped system. Under practical conditions of 30 atm and 298.15 K, the storage capacity of the Y-doped system decreased to 6.04 wt%, whereas the Mn-doped system maintained its full capacity of 7.48 wt%. Thermodynamic analysis indicated that H2 adsorption is favored at low temperatures and high pressures, while desorption becomes feasible at elevated temperatures and lower pressures. These results demonstrate that Mn- and Y-doped CNRs satisfy key U.S. Department of Energy requirements for reversible H2 storage and show promise as potential hydrogen storage materials under near-ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles density functional theory calculations（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：近期合成的碳纳米带（CNRs）及其氮修饰和过渡金属（Mn、Y）掺杂后的体系，用于氢气（H₂）存储。具体包括：原始CNRs、12个氮原子取代C-H边缘碳原子的12N-CNRs、以及Mn掺杂和Y掺杂的12N-CNRs。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn掺杂体系的平均H₂吸附能为-0.40 eV/H₂，Y掺杂体系为-0.25 eV/H₂，均处于可逆储氢的理想范围内；在0 K下最大理论重量储氢容量分别达到7.48 wt%（Mn掺杂）和6.55 wt%（Y掺杂）。在30 atm、298.15 K的实际条件下，Y掺杂体系容量降至6.04 wt%，而Mn掺杂体系仍保持7.48 wt%的满容量。Mn和Y掺杂的CNRs满足美国能源部可逆储氢的关键要求，有望成为近环境条件下的潜在储氢材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn掺杂体系的平均H₂吸附能为-0.40 eV/H₂，Y掺杂体系为-0.25 eV/H₂，均处于可逆储氢的理想范围内；在0 K下最大理论重量储氢容量分别达到7.48 wt%（Mn掺杂）和6.55 wt%（Y掺杂）。在30 atm、298.15 K的实际条件下，Y掺杂体系容量降至6.04 wt%，而Mn掺杂体系仍保持7.48 wt%的满容量。Mn和Y掺杂的CNRs满足美国能源部可逆储氢的关键要求，有望成为近环境条件下的潜在储氢材料。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但摘要指出原始CNRs的H₂吸附较弱，通过氮原子取代边缘碳原子并进一步进行Mn和Y掺杂来增强H₂结合，系统比较了两种金属掺杂体系的储氢性能（包括实际条件下的容量保持差异），这些结果展示了Mn和Y掺杂CNRs作为近环境条件储氢材料的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。具体包括：电子结构分析（轨道杂化）、结合能计算（验证掺杂体系结构稳定性）、Bader电荷分析（量化金属原子与主体结构间的电荷转移）、平均H₂吸附能计算、重量储氢容量计算，以及热力学分析。

papers.title: Light alkali metal functionalized two-dimensional C5N monolayers for enhanced hydrogen storage
papers.abstract: This work presents a density functional theory (DFT) investigation of a two-dimensional (2D) C5N monolayer functionalized with Li, Na, and K for hydrogen storage. Pristine C5N exhibits weak H2 adsorption, while alkali-metal functionalization significantly enhances its storage capability. The C5N monolayer can stably accommodate up to six metal dopants, with binding energies stronger than the corresponding cohesive energies, indicating resistance to metal aggregation. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further confirm the thermal stability of the functionalized systems at 300 K. Charge transfer from the metal dopants to C5N enhances polarization and strengthens H2 adsorption. Each dopant can adsorb up to eight H2 molecules, yielding a maximum of 48 H2 molecules per unit cell and gravimetric storage capacities of 9.42, 8.61, and 7.93 wt% for Li-, Na-, and K-functionalized C5N, respectively. The average H2 adsorption energies of -0.16 to -0.17 eV/H2 indicate moderate interactions suitable for reversible storage. Thermodynamic analysis further demonstrates favourable H2 adsorption/desorption under practical operating conditions, while desorption-temperature, recovery-time, and volumetric analyses support the potential reversibility and storage performance of these systems. Overall, alkali-metal-functionalized C5N emerges as a promising 2D material for efficient and reversible H2 storage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：density functional theory (DFT) investigation、ab initio molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：二维 C5N 单层材料，经 Li、Na、K 碱金属功能化后用于储氢的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碱金属功能化显著增强了 C5N 单层的 H2 吸附能力；每个金属掺杂剂最多可吸附 8 个 H2 分子，Li、Na、K 功能化的 C5N 分别达到 9.42、8.61、7.93 wt% 的最大重量储氢容量，平均 H2 吸附能为 -0.16 至 -0.17 eV/H2，适合可逆储氢。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碱金属功能化显著增强了 C5N 单层的 H2 吸附能力；每个金属掺杂剂最多可吸附 8 个 H2 分子，Li、Na、K 功能化的 C5N 分别达到 9.42、8.61、7.93 wt% 的最大重量储氢容量，平均 H2 吸附能为 -0.16 至 -0.17 eV/H2，适合可逆储氢。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但展示了碱金属功能化 C5N 单层在储氢容量和可逆性方面的综合性能。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟（用于验证 300 K 下的热稳定性）；电荷转移分析；热力学分析（包括脱附温度、恢复时间和体积分析）。

papers.title: Demonstration of room-temperature, magnetic-field-free, and ultralow-power spin-orbit torque logic device based on composition-uniform van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2
papers.abstract: Van der Waals magnets have received blooming interest in material science and spintronics for the advantages of low magnetization, flexible stacking, strong tunability, and dangling-bond-free interfaces. However, there has been no report of room-temperature magnetic-field-free spin logic device based on a van der Waals magnet. Here, we demonstrate a room-temperature, field-free, low-power, scalable spin-orbit torque in-memory computing logic device utilizing a van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2 bit with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and a Pt channel with strong spin Hall effect, high electrical conductivity, and electric asymmetries. Current pulse width-dependent switching measurement reveals a low intrinsic critical magnetic-field-free switching current of 1.8e7 A cm-2, a high thermal stability factor of 50, and the potential of an ultralow write power of 1.5 fJ per bit at 1 ns pulse width for a typical industrial-level device dimensions (40 times lower than the industrially optimized W/FeCoB device). These results suggest a great potential of van der Waals magnets in dense, ultralow-power, scalable in-memory computing technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“measurement reveals”“device”等表述，说明工作以器件制备与测量为主。；研究对象：基于范德瓦尔斯磁体 Fe3GaTe2 的自旋轨道力矩（SOT）逻辑器件，具体为 Fe3GaTe2 比特层（具有强垂直磁各向异性）与 Pt 沟道（具有强自旋霍尔效应、高电导率和电学不对称性）构成的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实现了基于范德瓦尔斯磁体的室温、无外磁场、低功耗、可扩展的自旋轨道力矩存内计算逻辑器件；测得本征无磁场临界翻转电流密度为 1.8e7 A cm-2，热稳定性因子为 50，在 1 ns 脉冲宽度下典型工业级器件尺寸的写入功耗可低至 1.5 fJ/bit（比工业优化的 W/FeCoB 器件低 40 倍）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实现了基于范德瓦尔斯磁体的室温、无外磁场、低功耗、可扩展的自旋轨道力矩存内计算逻辑器件；测得本征无磁场临界翻转电流密度为 1.8e7 A cm-2，热稳定性因子为 50，在 1 ns 脉冲宽度下典型工业级器件尺寸的写入功耗可低至 1.5 fJ/bit（比工业优化的 W/FeCoB 器件低 40 倍）。；创新点：首次报道了基于范德瓦尔斯磁体的室温、无外磁场自旋逻辑器件，并结合强垂直磁各向异性的 Fe3GaTe2 与强自旋霍尔效应的 Pt 沟道，展示了超低写入功耗和可扩展性，优于工业优化的 W/FeCoB 器件。
papers.method_zh: 制备了 Fe3GaTe2/Pt 自旋轨道力矩器件，并进行了电流脉冲宽度依赖的翻转测量（current pulse width-dependent switching measurement）。摘要未明确说明具体的薄膜生长手段、表征设备或理论计算框架。

papers.title: Initialization-free ultralow-power programmable spin-orbit torque logic devices enabled by chirally asymmetric switching
papers.abstract: Spin logic is of great interest for the development of high-performance, non-Von Neumann artificial intelligence chips. Of particular advantage is the programmable spin-orbit torque logic that can achieve the complete set of the 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device in an initialization-free, low-power, and scalable manner, which is, however, a challenge despite remarkable efforts over more than two decades. Here, utilizing chirally asymmetric switching, we demonstrate an initialization-free, low-power, programmable spin-orbit torque logic device that is capable of the complete set of 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device with only three inputs and ultralow power of < 1 fJ/bit. We also propose the first initialization-free, all-electrical spin-based cascading computing devices, including a half adder, a three-level full adder, a two-level full adder, and a Transfer/NOT selector. These compact and scalable computing devices are enabled by the chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching of a Ta/FeCoB bilayer with a significant perpendicular Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction field. These results pave an intriguing way for the development of next-generation high-performance large-scale in-memory computing chips based on chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：demonstrate、utilizing、we propose、Ta/FeCoB bilayer、perpendicular Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction field 等，表明工作以实验器件制备与测量为主。；研究对象：基于手性非对称自旋轨道矩（chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque）开关的编程自旋轨道矩逻辑器件；具体材料体系为具有显著垂直 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用场的 Ta/FeCoB 双层薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用手性非对称开关，实现了无需初始化、低功耗、可编程的自旋轨道矩逻辑器件，可在单个器件中仅用三个输入完成全部16种布尔逻辑操作，功耗低于1 fJ/bit；并提出了首个无需初始化的全电学自旋级联计算器件，包括半加器、三级全加器、二级全加器以及 Transfer/NOT 选择器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用手性非对称开关，实现了无需初始化、低功耗、可编程的自旋轨道矩逻辑器件，可在单个器件中仅用三个输入完成全部16种布尔逻辑操作，功耗低于1 fJ/bit；并提出了首个无需初始化的全电学自旋级联计算器件，包括半加器、三级全加器、二级全加器以及 Transfer/NOT 选择器。；创新点：首次实现了无需初始化、低功耗、可编程的自旋轨道矩逻辑器件，在单个器件中仅用三个输入即可完成全部16种布尔逻辑操作，功耗低于1 fJ/bit；并首次提出无需初始化的全电学自旋级联计算器件（半加器、三级全加器、二级全加器、Transfer/NOT 选择器），且器件紧凑、可扩展。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段或理论框架（如薄膜沉积方法、电学测量方案、微磁模拟等均未提及），仅提及基于 Ta/FeCoB 双层的垂直 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用场实现手性非对称自旋轨道矩开关。

papers.title: Metallic Organometallic and Semiconducting Covalent Phases of Free-Standing $γ$-Graphdiyne Molecular Wires
papers.abstract: One-dimensional carbon allotropes combining sp and sp2 hybridizations provide a versatile platform for atomically precise quantum wires with tunable electronic, vibrational, and mechanical responses. Recent on-surface synthesis has realized the $γ$-graphdiyne molecular wire on Au(100) in two interconvertible phases sharing an identical aromatic backbone but distinct linkage chemistry: an organometallic intermediate with C-Au-C bridges and a fully covalent product with diacetylenic linkages. While experimental techniques characterize the on-surface periodicity and C$\equiv$C Raman signatures, the intrinsic properties of the free-standing wires remain inaccessible. Here, we address this gap using hybrid-functional first-principles calculations. The covalent phase is a semiconductor with a direct band gap of 2.02 eV, a polyynic bond-length alternation of 0.117 Å, and a chain periodicity reproducing experiment within -0.5%. Conversely, the organometallic phase exhibits partial cumulenization and 1D metallic behavior, with spin channels crossing the Fermi level. Both isolated polymers demonstrate dynamic stability with Young's moduli of 995 nN and 861 nN, respectively, where the C-Au-C bridge acts as a soft link absorbing 9.2% of axial deformation at +6% macroscopic strain. Species-resolved vibrational analysis identifies an effective-conjugation-coordinate band at 1408 cm$^{-1}$ for the covalent phase and Au-projected modes below 400 cm$^{-1}$ for the intermediate, offering diagnostic fingerprints for phase discrimination during thermal or chemical conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：hybrid-functional first-principles calculations（杂化泛函第一性原理计算），摘要明确说明实验已实现该体系而本文用计算方法研究自由站立（free-standing）线的本征性质。；研究对象：自由站立的γ-石墨二炔（γ-graphdiyne）分子线，包括两种可相互转化的相：具有C-Au-C桥连的有机金属中间相，以及具有二乙炔键连的全共价产物相。研究其电子结构、力学性质和振动性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共价相是直接带隙为2.02 eV的半导体，具有0.117 Å的聚炔键长交替，链周期性再现实验误差在-0.5%以内；有机金属相则表现出部分累积烯化和一维金属行为，自旋通道穿过费米能级。两相均具有动力学稳定性，杨氏模量分别为995 nN和861 nN，其中C-Au-C桥作为软连接在+6%宏观应变下吸收9.2%的轴向形变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共价相是直接带隙为2.02 eV的半导体，具有0.117 Å的聚炔键长交替，链周期性再现实验误差在-0.5%以内；有机金属相则表现出部分累积烯化和一维金属行为，自旋通道穿过费米能级。两相均具有动力学稳定性，杨氏模量分别为995 nN和861 nN，其中C-Au-C桥作为软连接在+6%宏观应变下吸收9.2%的轴向形变。；创新点：实验上已通过表面合成在Au(100)上实现该分子线并表征了其表面周期性和C≡C拉曼信号，但自由站立线的本征性质此前无法获取。本文通过第一性原理计算填补了这一空白，首次给出了自由站立两相的本征电子、力学和振动性质，并识别出可用于相鉴别的振动指纹（共价相1408 cm⁻¹的有效共轭坐标带，中间相400 cm⁻¹以下的Au投影模式）。
papers.method_zh: 杂化泛函第一性原理计算（hybrid-functional first-principles calculations），包括电子结构计算（带隙、能带）、键长分析、声子/动力学稳定性计算、杨氏模量计算、应变响应分析，以及按物种分辨的振动分析（species-resolved vibrational analysis）。

papers.title: A discrete crack-tip theory for nonlinear lattice networks
papers.abstract: Crack-tip fields govern deformation localization and failure initiation. Classical continuum fracture mechanics describes these fields through theories such as the Hutchinson-Rice-Rosengren (HRR) field for nonlinear power-law solids. However, continuum descriptions break down near cracks in soft and architected materials, where load is transmitted through discrete chains, fibers, or struts. Here, we develop a discrete crack-tip theory for lattice networks with nonlinear chains. The theory has two central components. First, at large deformation, the strain of a representative chain in layer $i$ depends approximately linearly on the applied macroscopic strain, $\varepsilon_i\approx k_i(λ-1)$, defining a layer-dependent strain-amplification factor $k_i$. Second, along topology-selected chain directions, termed discrete HRR lines, the layer-to-layer ratios of $k_i$ follow a two-regime scaling law. Together, for a power-law chain force-strain relation with exponent $p$, the inner discrete regime predicts $\varepsilon_i\sim i^{-1/p}$ and $f_i\sim i^{-1}$, which differs from the classical continuum HRR prediction. The theory also explains why the intrinsic fracture energy approaches a size-independent limit as the network size increases. Photoelastic hydrogel experiments further validate our theory. These results reveal a two-regime crack-tip scaling law in nonlinear lattice networks and provide a framework for predicting chain deformation and intrinsic fracture energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章为主，结合实验验证。判断依据关键词：develop a discrete crack-tip theory、theory has two central components、Photoelastic hydrogel experiments further validate our theory。摘要以理论推导为核心，实验用于验证理论。；研究对象：非线性链构成的晶格网络（lattice networks with nonlinear chains）中的裂纹尖端场，具体涉及软材料和架构材料中通过离散链、纤维或支柱传递载荷的体系。物理现象为裂纹尖端的变形局域化和失效起始。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于幂律链力-应变关系（指数为p），内部离散区域预测应变按 ε_i ∼ i^{-1/p} 标度、力按 f_i ∼ i^{-1} 标度，这与经典连续介质HRR预测不同；理论还解释了为什么本征断裂能随网络尺寸增大趋近于尺寸无关的极限。实验验证了该理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于幂律链力-应变关系（指数为p），内部离散区域预测应变按 ε_i ∼ i^{-1/p} 标度、力按 f_i ∼ i^{-1} 标度，这与经典连续介质HRR预测不同；理论还解释了为什么本征断裂能随网络尺寸增大趋近于尺寸无关的极限。实验验证了该理论。；创新点：经典连续介质断裂力学（如HRR场）在软材料和架构材料的裂纹附近失效，因为载荷通过离散链/纤维/支柱传递。本文提出了针对非线性链晶格网络的离散裂纹尖端理论，揭示了与经典连续HRR预测不同的两区间裂纹尖端标度律，并解释了本征断裂能的尺寸无关极限行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 大变形下第i层代表性链的应变近似线性依赖于宏观应变，ε_i ≈ k_i(λ-1)，定义层依赖的应变放大因子k_i；(2) 沿拓扑选择的链方向（称为离散HRR线），k_i的逐层比值遵循两区间标度律。实验手段为光弹性水凝胶（photoelastic hydrogel）实验验证。

papers.title: Structural tuning of reduced exciton mass in layered HOIP compounds: Causation vs. correlation
papers.abstract: Reduced exciton mass ($μ$) was recently reported to correlate strongly with a framework distortion in a series of nine single-layer (2D) metal-halide perovskite (HOIP) compounds. Specifically, $μ$ was observed to increase in tandem with an alternating PbI4 octahedral tilt about an in-plane axis. In this work, we use group representation theory to decompose the observed framework distortions into displacive symmetry modes of a common high-symmetry parent framework. We find that all nine distorted frameworks involve linear combinations of the same six symmetry modes, which have been reported to contribute to the framework distortions of a wide range of HOIP compounds. We show that these modes have highly correlated impacts on the band structure. To differentiate causation from correlation, we vary the amplitude of each mode independently and use density-functional theory to determine the resulting electronic band structures, from which $μ$ is extracted. We find that bond-transverse displacements of the equatorial halide atoms increase $μ$, while bond-transverse displacements of the apical halide atoms decrease it. Bond-axis displacements appear to have little or no effect on $μ$. Our results demonstrate three new structure-property relationships, revealing a promising new avenue for exciton engineering in layered perovskite materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：group representation theory、density-functional theory、vary the amplitude of each mode independently、extract μ from calculated band structures。摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：九种单层（2D）金属卤化物钙钛矿（HOIP）化合物中的激子约化质量（μ）与框架畸变之间的关系，具体涉及PbI₄八面体绕面内轴的交替倾斜，以及赤道/顶点卤素原子的键横向位移和键轴向位移对μ的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 九种畸变框架均可由同一高对称母框架的六个对称模式的线性组合描述；这些模式对能带结构的影响高度关联。通过独立改变各模式振幅并计算μ，发现赤道卤素原子的键横向位移增大μ，顶点卤素原子的键横向位移减小μ，而键轴向位移对μ几乎无影响。由此揭示了三个新的结构-性质关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：九种畸变框架均可由同一高对称母框架的六个对称模式的线性组合描述；这些模式对能带结构的影响高度关联。通过独立改变各模式振幅并计算μ，发现赤道卤素原子的键横向位移增大μ，顶点卤素原子的键横向位移减小μ，而键轴向位移对μ几乎无影响。由此揭示了三个新的结构-性质关系。；创新点：此前仅观察到μ与框架畸变之间的强关联，本文通过群表示论分解畸变模式并结合DFT独立调控各模式振幅，将因果关系与关联区分开来，明确了不同对称模式对μ的独立贡献方向，揭示了三个新的结构-性质关系，为层状钙钛矿材料的激子工程提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 群表示论（将框架畸变分解为高对称母框架的位移对称模式）+ 密度泛函理论（DFT，独立改变各对称模式振幅后计算电子能带结构并提取激子约化质量μ）。

papers.title: From Single-Chain Dynamics to Structure Formation: Dynamic Self-Consistent Field Theory and Molecular Dynamics of (Co)polymer Melts across Entanglement Regimes
papers.abstract: Dynamic self-consistent field theory (DSCFT) provides an efficient continuum framework for studying structure formation in inhomogeneous polymer systems, but its predictive accuracy depends on the choice of the nonlocal mobilities. Here, we construct mobility functions for moderately and strongly entangled homopolymer and diblock copolymer systems from the relaxation dynamics of single-chain structure factors, based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the Kremer-Grest model and analytical reptation theory. Single- chain mobilities are combined such that the resulting DSCFT accounts for the dependence of fluxes on local chain densities. The theory is then applied to the spinodal decomposition of symmetric homopolymer blends and diblock copolymer melts following a quench into the (micro)phase-separation regime. Predictions of DSCFT are systematically compared with MD simulations. Mobility functions derived from single-chain dynamics are found to reproduce the kinetics of structure formation more accurately than conventional Debye-type mobilities. We additionally investigate the influence of adding stochastic currents (noise) that are correlated according to the fluctuation-dissipation relation. At low noise levels, they enable the generation of equilibrium initial states and facilitate defect annealing. At high noise levels, however, nonolinear effects lead to discrepancies between DSCFT and MD simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。关键依据：摘要中同时出现“molecular dynamics (MD) simulations”“analytical reptation theory”“dynamic self-consistent field theory (DSCFT)”等计算与理论方法关键词，且以理论构建和模拟对比为主。；研究对象：中等和强缠结条件下的均聚物与二嵌段共聚物熔体，以及对称均聚物共混物和二嵌段共聚物熔体淬火进入（微）相分离后的结构形成动力学（旋节分解）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从单链结构因子弛豫动力学构建的迁移率函数，比传统 Debye 型迁移率能更准确地再现结构形成动力学；加入按涨落-耗散关系关联的随机流（噪声）在低噪声水平下可生成平衡初始态并促进缺陷退火，但高噪声水平下非线性效应会导致 DSCFT 与 MD 模拟之间出现偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从单链结构因子弛豫动力学构建的迁移率函数，比传统 Debye 型迁移率能更准确地再现结构形成动力学；加入按涨落-耗散关系关联的随机流（噪声）在低噪声水平下可生成平衡初始态并促进缺陷退火，但高噪声水平下非线性效应会导致 DSCFT 与 MD 模拟之间出现偏差。；创新点：主要新意在于从单链结构因子弛豫动力学出发构建非局域迁移率函数，并将其组合为能反映通量对局部链密度依赖的 DSCFT，从而在中等和强缠结区域改进对结构形成动力学的预测精度，优于传统 Debye 型迁移率；同时系统考察了关联随机流在不同噪声水平下的作用与局限。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Kremer-Grest 模型的分子动力学模拟和解析 reptation 理论，构建单链迁移率函数；将其组合使 DSCFT 能考虑通量对局部链密度的依赖；随后将理论应用于对称均聚物共混物和二嵌段共聚物熔体的旋节分解，并与 MD 模拟进行系统对比；还考察了按涨落-耗散关系关联的随机流（噪声）的影响。

papers.title: Layer Architecture Shapes Electronic, Magnetic, and Lattice Interactions in Ruddlesden-Popper Nickelates
papers.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates has raised a central question: how does layer architecture shape the electronic, magnetic, and lattice interactions relevant to pairing? Here, we report a detailed comparative study of the two polymorphs of La3Ni2O7--the alternating monolayer-trilayer (LNO-1313) and bilayer (LNO-2222) structures--and the related trilayer compound La4Ni3O10, using both Ni L3- and O K-edge RIXS. We find that LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 share strikingly similar electronic, magnetic, and lattice excitations, whereas bilayer LNO-2222 exhibits distinct features. Compared to LNO-2222, LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 have weaker orbital polarization, enhanced 3d8L character, a reduced out-of-plane magnetic-exchange scale, and stronger EPC. Within an effective local-moment framework, an entangled-dimer scenario provides a natural description of the spin excitations generated by strong antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling. Its advantage over conventional spin-wave theory is clearest in bilayer LNO-2222, where the interlayer coupling dominates the intralayer interactions. These findings provide critical experimental constraints for future theoretical models for the low-energy physics relevant to superconductivity in these layered nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：RIXS（共振非弹性X射线散射）、Ni L3-edge 和 O K-edge 测量、对比研究不同多晶型样品。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐体系，具体包括 La3Ni2O7 的两种多晶型——交替单层-三层结构（LNO-1313）和双层结构（LNO-2222），以及相关的三层化合物 La4Ni3O10。研究关注的是层结构如何影响与超导配对相关的电子、磁性和晶格相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LNO-1313 和 La4Ni3O10 具有高度相似的电子、磁性和晶格激发特征，而双层 LNO-2222 表现出明显不同的行为：相比 LNO-2222，LNO-1313 和 La4Ni3O10 具有更弱的轨道极化、增强的 3d8L 特征、更小的面外磁交换尺度以及更强的电子-声子耦合。此外，纠缠二聚体图像能自然描述由强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发，且在层间耦合主导层内相互作用的双层 LNO-2222 中优势最为明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LNO-1313 和 La4Ni3O10 具有高度相似的电子、磁性和晶格激发特征，而双层 LNO-2222 表现出明显不同的行为：相比 LNO-2222，LNO-1313 和 La4Ni3O10 具有更弱的轨道极化、增强的 3d8L 特征、更小的面外磁交换尺度以及更强的电子-声子耦合。此外，纠缠二聚体图像能自然描述由强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发，且在层间耦合主导层内相互作用的双层 LNO-2222 中优势最为明显。；创新点：首次通过 Ni L3-edge 和 O K-edge RIXS 对 La3Ni2O7 的两种多晶型及相关三层化合物 La4Ni3O10 进行系统对比，揭示了层结构（单层-三层交替 vs. 双层）对轨道极化、3d8L 特征、面外磁交换和电子-声子耦合的调控规律；并提出纠缠二聚体图像作为描述强层间反铁磁耦合下自旋激发的有效框架，为未来镍酸盐超导低能物理的理论模型提供了关键实验约束。
papers.method_zh: 使用 Ni L3-edge 和 O K-edge 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）对 La3Ni2O7 的两种多晶型（LNO-1313 和 LNO-2222）及 La4Ni3O10 进行详细的对比实验研究。理论分析方面，在有效局域矩框架内采用纠缠二聚体（entangled-dimer）图像描述自旋激发，并与传统自旋波理论进行对比。

papers.title: Calculation of DFT Spin-Orbit Spillage with Quantum ESPRESSO
papers.abstract: This work describes the calculation of spin-orbit spillage from a crystal structure. Spin-orbit spillage provides a measure of the likelihood that a material has topological character. The spillage also provides the reference quantity for the machine-learning classifier of Choudhary et al., which predicts whether the spillage exceeds a specified threshold rather than the calculation of its numerical value directly. The complete computation workflow was applied to the insulating compound BaMg2Bi2, yielding a spillage of 2.094 compared with the published VASP spillage of 2.075, corresponding to a difference of 0.9%. The calculation is described in terms of two Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) calculations of spillage performed with and without spin-orbit coupling, the role of relativistic pseudopotentials, and the subsequent wavefunction-overlap analysis. The limitations of the same calculation procedure for semimetals are also examined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：Calculation、DFT、Quantum ESPRESSO、workflow、wavefunction-overlap analysis。；研究对象：晶体结构中的自旋-轨道 spillage（spin-orbit spillage），以及绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2。Spillage 用于衡量材料具有拓扑特性的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2 完成完整计算流程后，得到的 spillage 为 2.094，与已发表的 VASP 结果 2.075 相比差异为 0.9%，表明该 Quantum ESPRESSO 计算流程与 VASP 结果高度一致。摘要还指出该计算流程用于半金属时存在局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2 完成完整计算流程后，得到的 spillage 为 2.094，与已发表的 VASP 结果 2.075 相比差异为 0.9%，表明该 Quantum ESPRESSO 计算流程与 VASP 结果高度一致。摘要还指出该计算流程用于半金属时存在局限性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要主要描述了在 Quantum ESPRESSO 中实现自旋-轨道 spillage 计算的完整工作流程，并将其结果与已发表的 VASP 结果进行对比验证，同时考察了该方法用于半金属时的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT），使用 Quantum ESPRESSO（QE）进行两次 spillage 计算（分别包含和不包含自旋-轨道耦合），涉及相对论赝势的作用以及随后的波函数重叠分析。

papers.title: Triboelectrification of a dense metal-organic framework for resilient mechanical energy harvesters
papers.abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) incorporating metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have largely been designed around porous architectures, based on the assumption that high internal surface area is the primary driver for triboelectric enhancement. Herein, we demonstrate that a dense, nominally nonporous MOF called ZIF-zni can instead function as an effective high-loading filler within a tribopositive polyurethane (PU) matrix, offering a design strategy for harnessing interfacial electromechanical effects. A 20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU composite delivers an output voltage of 470+/-15 V and a peak power density of 1.31+/-0.03 W m-2 against polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The device exhibits stable performance over ~94,000 cycles under a contact force of ~100 N, and it remains operational under higher impact beyond 500 N. This concept enables the demonstration of a proof-of-concept triboelectric floor tile. Combined experimental and theoretical studies indicate that the performance enhancement arises from favourable interfacial polarization, reduced dielectric screening, and surface accessible ZIF-zni rich domains, rather than porosity alone. These features are accompanied by reduced work of adhesion and modified surface roughness, hence improving contact electrification. These findings establish dense MOFs as an effective triboelectric filler and identify interfacial electronic structure and polarization as key design parameters for engineering mechanical energy harvesters and self-powered sensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论计算相结合的混合型文章。判断依据关键词：combined experimental and theoretical studies、demonstrate、proof-of-concept triboelectric floor tile。；研究对象：一种致密、名义上无孔的金属-有机框架（MOF）材料 ZIF-zni，作为高负载填料嵌入摩擦正电性聚氨酯（PU）基体中，构成 ZIF-zni@PU 复合摩擦电材料，并与聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）配对构成摩擦纳米发电机（TENG），用于机械能收集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 致密无孔 MOF（ZIF-zni）同样可作为有效的摩擦电填料，20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU 复合材料对 PDMS 输出 470±15 V 电压和 1.31±0.03 W m⁻² 峰值功率密度；性能提升源于有利的界面极化、减弱的介电屏蔽以及表面可及的 ZIF-zni 富集区域，而非单纯依赖孔隙率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：致密无孔 MOF（ZIF-zni）同样可作为有效的摩擦电填料，20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU 复合材料对 PDMS 输出 470±15 V 电压和 1.31±0.03 W m⁻² 峰值功率密度；性能提升源于有利的界面极化、减弱的介电屏蔽以及表面可及的 ZIF-zni 富集区域，而非单纯依赖孔隙率。；创新点：突破了以往 MOF 基 TENG 普遍基于多孔结构、以高内比表面积为摩擦电增强主要驱动力的设计假设，首次提出并验证以致密、名义无孔 MOF 作为高负载填料的设计策略，将界面电子结构与极化（而非孔隙率）确立为机械能收集器与自供电传感器的关键设计参数。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：制备 ZIF-zni@PU 复合材料并构建 TENG 器件，测量输出电压、峰值功率密度，进行约 94,000 次循环（接触力约 100 N）的稳定性测试及超过 500 N 的高冲击测试，并演示了摩擦电地砖原型；同时测量了粘附功和表面粗糙度。理论方面：摘要仅提及“combined experimental and theoretical studies”，未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架。

papers.title: Composition-dependent nonlinear viscoelastic-viscoplastic behavior and constitutive framework for digitally mixed polymers spanning the glass transition
papers.abstract: Multi-material PolyJet printing produces voxel-scale digital mixtures of an elastomeric photopolymer (Agilus) and a glassy photopolymer (Vero), giving a material family whose room-temperature response ranges from elastomeric to glassy; a unified description spanning the family has remained challenging. Large-deformation uniaxial compression over nearly three orders of magnitude in strain rate reveals a nonlinear, rate-dependent load-unload response that evolves continuously with composition, from recoverable elastomeric hysteresis to glassy yield with post-yield softening, hardening, and substantial residual strain. Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) shows that each mixture has a single glass transition temperature ($T_g$) that shifts to higher temperature with both Vero fraction and frequency, so composition acts much as temperature or loading rate does. This time-composition equivalence motivates one constitutive structure for the whole family rather than a separate property set per mixture: an equilibrium hyperelastic network with three non-equilibrium, rate-dependent branches carrying reptational, intermolecular, and glassy resistance. Its properties are anchored at the two endpoints and interpolated by smooth composition scaling laws. The model captures the compression response of all seven calibrated compositions and predicts a withheld mixture from the scaling laws alone. Resolving the predicted stress into its branches shows the load passing from the elastomeric to the glassy mechanism, and the work from elastic storage to dissipation, as Vero content and rate rise. The glass transition that DMA maps at small strain therefore governs the large-strain deformation mechanisms. The framework gives a compact, physically based description of digitally mixed polymers and a predictive basis for designing functionally graded, architected multi-material structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论/本构建模）。关键依据：摘要中既有实验手段（大变形单轴压缩、DMA），又有本构框架的构建与预测验证（constitutive framework、scaling laws、model captures/predicts）。；研究对象：多材料PolyJet打印制备的数字化混合光聚合物体系，由弹性体光聚合物（Agilus）与玻璃态光聚合物（Vero）按体素尺度混合而成，室温力学响应随组分从弹性体到玻璃态连续变化，跨越玻璃转变。研究现象为大变形下的非线性黏弹-黏塑性力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 每种混合物具有单一的玻璃转变温度，且随Vero含量和频率升高而升高，表明组分的作用类似于温度或加载速率（时间-组分等效）；DMA在小应变下测得的玻璃转变同样支配大应变变形机制。作者提出一个统一本构结构（平衡超弹网络+三个非平衡速率相关分支，分别对应爬行、分子间和玻璃态阻力），可描述全部七种标定组分并仅凭标度律预测未参与标定的混合物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：每种混合物具有单一的玻璃转变温度，且随Vero含量和频率升高而升高，表明组分的作用类似于温度或加载速率（时间-组分等效）；DMA在小应变下测得的玻璃转变同样支配大应变变形机制。作者提出一个统一本构结构（平衡超弹网络+三个非平衡速率相关分支，分别对应爬行、分子间和玻璃态阻力），可描述全部七种标定组分并仅凭标度律预测未参与标定的混合物。；创新点：提出用单一本构结构（而非每种混合物单独一套参数）统一描述整个数字化混合聚合物家族，通过时间-组分等效与组分标度律实现跨组分预测，并成功预测未标定混合物；同时揭示小应变DMA测得的玻璃转变支配大应变变形机制，为功能梯度、架构化多材料结构设计提供预测基础。
papers.method_zh: 实验：近三个数量级应变率范围内的大变形单轴压缩（加载-卸载）、动态机械分析（DMA）测玻璃转变温度。理论/建模：构建统一本构框架，包含一个平衡超弹网络与三个非平衡速率相关分支（reptational、intermolecular、glassy），端点性质锚定并用平滑组分标度律插值；将预测应力分解到各分支以分析机制转变。

papers.title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
papers.abstract: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced acceleration method groups blocks of equal shape and dispatches them to optimized dense kernels. In the reported benchmarks, VBCSR outperforms the tested Python-accessible reference implementations for several block-sparse benchmarks. We further demonstrate VBCSR in an InP nanoparticle application containing more than \(10^6\) atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：atomistic simulations、sparse matrix library、linear algebra、benchmarks、dense kernels、Python-accessible reference implementations。；研究对象：大规模原子模拟中的稀疏块矩阵运算，具体应用体系为包含超过 \(10^6\) 个原子的 InP 纳米颗粒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VBCSR 库通过保留可变大小原子块并采用分组加速方法，在多个块稀疏基准测试中优于所测试的 Python 可访问参考实现，并成功应用于超过 \(10^6\) 原子的 InP 纳米颗粒模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VBCSR 库通过保留可变大小原子块并采用分组加速方法，在多个块稀疏基准测试中优于所测试的 Python 可访问参考实现，并成功应用于超过 \(10^6\) 原子的 InP 纳米颗粒模拟。；创新点：提出了保留可变大小原子块的 VBCSR 格式及统一接口，能够自动映射不同算子类型到合适的稀疏格式，并通过按块形状分组调度到优化稠密内核实现加速，克服了传统标量稀疏格式遮蔽局部块结构、限制块算法使用的问题。
papers.method_zh: 开发了分布式稀疏矩阵库 VBCSR，支持将标量、均匀基组和多物种算符自动映射到 CSR、BSR 或 VBCSR 格式；采用将相同形状块分组并调度到优化稠密内核的加速方法；在块稀疏基准测试和 InP 纳米颗粒应用中进行验证。

papers.title: Speed-quality tradeoff in a physical model of molecular sorting
papers.abstract: Eukaryotic cells rely on membrane-mediated processes to compartmentalize biomolecules, counteracting diffusion-driven homogenization. These processes involve the selective sorting and packing of molecules into lipid vesicles, which are then dispatched to appropriate intracellular destinations. Previous works introduced an abstract statistical physics framework for studying this molecular distillation process, where the membrane was treated as static and the focus was on molecular aggregation and extraction. Here, we extend this framework to explicitly incorporate dynamic membrane behavior, including bending, curvature generation, and changes in membrane size due to vesicle fusion and fission events. Sorting domains drive membrane curvature, leading to vesicle formation, detachment, and a molecular distillation process that alters membrane size. Using mesoscopic modeling and numerical tools, we investigate the resulting interplay between membrane mechanics and molecular sorting. We determine a well-defined parameter region where vesicle fission and efficient molecular sorting occur, controlled by membrane rigidity, spontaneous curvature, and pressure difference across the membrane. We further identify a trade-off between speed and quality of molecular distillation: parameters that accelerate vesicle formation tend to reduce the quality of distillation, and vice versa. We propose maximization of the rate of negative entropy production as a natural criterion to optimally balance these competing effects. In this context, optimal parameters emerge naturally from the coupled dynamics of molecular aggregation and membrane mechanics, suggesting a possible strategy for cellular sorting systems to strike an efficient balance between rapid vesicle formation and high sorting quality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：mesoscopic modeling、numerical tools、abstract statistical physics framework、extend this framework。摘要中未提及具体实验手段，属于在已有理论框架基础上进行介观建模与数值计算的研究。；研究对象：真核细胞中膜介导的分子分选（molecular sorting）过程，即分子被选择性分选并包装进脂质囊泡、随后被运送到细胞内目的地的过程。具体研究体系为动态膜（包括弯曲、曲率生成、以及囊泡融合/裂变导致的膜尺寸变化）与分子聚集、分选之间的耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分选结构域驱动膜弯曲，进而导致囊泡形成、脱离，并引发改变膜尺寸的分子蒸馏过程；存在一个由膜刚性、自发曲率和跨膜压差控制的明确参数区域，在该区域内发生囊泡裂变和高效分子分选。此外，分子蒸馏的速度与质量之间存在权衡：加速囊泡形成的参数往往降低蒸馏质量，反之亦然。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分选结构域驱动膜弯曲，进而导致囊泡形成、脱离，并引发改变膜尺寸的分子蒸馏过程；存在一个由膜刚性、自发曲率和跨膜压差控制的明确参数区域，在该区域内发生囊泡裂变和高效分子分选。此外，分子蒸馏的速度与质量之间存在权衡：加速囊泡形成的参数往往降低蒸馏质量，反之亦然。；创新点：相对于此前将膜视为静态、只关注分子聚集与提取的工作，本文显式地将动态膜行为（弯曲、曲率生成、膜尺寸变化）纳入框架，揭示了膜力学与分子分选之间的耦合，确定了囊泡裂变与高效分选发生的参数区域，识别出分子蒸馏速度与质量之间的权衡关系，并提出以负熵产生率最大化作为最优平衡这些竞争效应的自然判据。
papers.method_zh: 在先前静态膜的抽象统计物理框架基础上，扩展引入动态膜行为（弯曲、曲率生成、囊泡融合与裂变引起的膜尺寸变化），采用介观建模（mesoscopic modeling）和数值工具进行研究。摘要未明确说明具体的数值算法或软件。

papers.title: Fukui-Kawakami chains: spectrum and hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry
papers.abstract: Fukui and Kawakami showed that the trigonometric Haldane--Shastry (HS) spin chain can be deformed by introducing twisted boundary conditions. In this work we revisit the resulting twisted HS chains, which we call Fukui--Kawakami (FK) chains. We analyse their spectra in dependence of the twist parameter, utilising a direct connection with the (untwisted) HS chain. This allows us to explain why part of the spectrum can be described by Fukui and Kawakami's twisted Bethe equations, and can be constructed from Yangian highest weight states. These states can be labelled by combinatorial data called `motifs', as in the HS chain, which cover some of the (deformed) descendants. We furthermore show that there are other descendants which do not follow from these Bethe equations, but whose energy can be described as a sum of two single-particle energies, suggesting additional hidden symmetries. We then focus on the special case of antiperiodic boundary conditions, and show that this chain coincides with the `minimally polarised' long-range model recently introduced by Basu-Mallick, Finkel, and González-López. Remarkably, this connection implies that the antiperiodic chain has a hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry, which we use to relate the HS motifs to their `supersymmetric' $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ counterparts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectrum、Bethe equations、Yangian highest weight states、hidden symmetry、motifs——均为解析/代数理论分析，摘要中未提及任何实验或数值计算。；研究对象：Fukui–Kawakami（FK）链，即引入扭曲边界条件（twisted boundary conditions）后的三角函数型 Haldane–Shastry（HS）自旋链；重点研究其能谱随扭曲参数的变化，以及反周期边界条件下的特殊情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FK 链的部分能谱可由 Fukui–Kawakami 的扭曲 Bethe 方程描述，并可由 Yangian 最高权态构造；但还存在不遵循这些 Bethe 方程的其余后代态，其能量可写成两个单粒子能量之和，暗示存在额外的隐藏对称性。在反周期边界条件下，该链与 Basu-Mallick、Finkel、González-López 最近引入的“最小极化”长程模型一致，从而具有隐藏的 $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 超对称，并可将 HS 的 motifs 与其“超对称”对应物联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FK 链的部分能谱可由 Fukui–Kawakami 的扭曲 Bethe 方程描述，并可由 Yangian 最高权态构造；但还存在不遵循这些 Bethe 方程的其余后代态，其能量可写成两个单粒子能量之和，暗示存在额外的隐藏对称性。在反周期边界条件下，该链与 Basu-Mallick、Finkel、González-López 最近引入的“最小极化”长程模型一致，从而具有隐藏的 $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 超对称，并可将 HS 的 motifs 与其“超对称”对应物联系起来。；创新点：揭示了 FK 链中除扭曲 Bethe 方程可描述部分之外还存在额外后代态及其隐藏对称性；特别地，证明了反周期 FK 链与近期提出的“最小极化”长程模型的等价性，并由此建立其隐藏 $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 对称性，进而将 HS motifs 与超对称 $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 对应物相关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：利用 FK 链与未扭曲 HS 链之间的直接联系来分析能谱随扭曲参数的依赖关系；使用扭曲 Bethe 方程、Yangian 最高权态表示、组合数据“motifs”标记态，以及 $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 超对称代数框架。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值计算或具体模型参数。

papers.title: Dual Charge-Density-Waves in Two-dimensional DyTe3 and Their Distinct Impacts on Magneto-Transport Properties
papers.abstract: Charge-density-waves (CDWs) are macroscopic quantum states defined by periodic modulations in electronic charge density coupled with lattice distortions. Despite significant research efforts, the evolution of electromagnetic transport properties in the presence of CDWs remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the effects of two orthogonal CDWs (CDW1 and CDW2) coexisting at low-temperature in DyTe3 on its electronic transport properties. Importantly, we find that while no clear magnetotransport anomaly is resolved across CDW1 transition under the present experimental conditions, the emergence of CDW2 drives a drastic enhancement in magnetoresistance and a multiband-governed nonlinear Hall response. These results demonstrate that CDW1 and CDW2 in DyTe3 are fundamentally different and impact its electronic transport in qualitatively distinct ways, establishing DyTe3 as a model system for understanding the transport consequences of multiple CDWs in quasi-two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：report、find、experimental conditions、magnetotransport anomaly is resolved、magnetoresistance enhancement、nonlinear Hall response 等，表明是基于实验测量（输运测量）的研究。；研究对象：二维材料 DyTe3 中低温下共存的两个正交电荷密度波（CDW1 和 CDW2），以及它们对电子输运性质（磁输运）的不同影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 DyTe3 中，CDW1 转变在当前实验条件下未表现出明显的磁输运异常，而 CDW2 的出现则导致磁阻急剧增强，并引发由多带主导的非线性霍尔响应；这表明 CDW1 和 CDW2 在本质上是不同的，对电子输运的影响在定性上截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 DyTe3 中，CDW1 转变在当前实验条件下未表现出明显的磁输运异常，而 CDW2 的出现则导致磁阻急剧增强，并引发由多带主导的非线性霍尔响应；这表明 CDW1 和 CDW2 在本质上是不同的，对电子输运的影响在定性上截然不同。；创新点：首次报道了 DyTe3 中两个正交 CDW 共存对电子输运性质的不同影响，揭示了 CDW1 和 CDW2 在磁输运行为上的定性差异，并将 DyTe3 确立为研究准二维材料中多重 CDW 输运效应的模型体系。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段（如是否使用 ARPES、输运测量装置、具体温度/磁场条件等），仅提及在低温下观测两个正交 CDW 对电子输运性质的影响，涉及磁阻和霍尔响应的测量。

papers.title: Quantum oscillations of helical edge states of periodically deformed 2D topological insulator in magnetic field
papers.abstract: We study edge-state transport in a two-dimensional topological insulator with a periodically deformed edge subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Zeeman coupling breaks time-reversal symmetry and enables elastic backscattering, producing oscillations of the forbidden-band widths. In the strong-field regime, the gaps can close completely at discrete field values. In the weak-field regime, we identify an important class of periodic deformations for which the dominant semiclassical scattering is controlled by complex infinity rather than by the nearest turning points. We develop a semiclassical treatment of this process and establish its agreement with perturbation theory and direct numerical calculations. The gap modulation should produce observable oscillations of the edge conductance. Unlike conventional magnetic quantum oscillations, which are periodic in inverse field, the predicted oscillations are periodic in the magnetic field itself, with a period determined by the Fermi velocity and effective g-factor
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：semiclassical treatment、perturbation theory、direct numerical calculations，摘要中未提及任何实验测量。；研究对象：具有周期性形变边缘的二维拓扑绝缘体，在均匀磁场下的螺旋边缘态输运现象，具体关注边缘态能隙的量子振荡及边缘电导振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zeeman耦合破坏时间反演对称性，使弹性背散射成为可能，导致禁带宽度发生振荡；强场下能隙在离散磁场值处完全闭合；弱场下存在一类周期性形变，其主导半经典散射由复无穷远点而非最近转向点控制；预测的边缘电导振荡以磁场本身为周期（而非通常的倒数磁场周期），周期由费米速度和有效g因子决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zeeman耦合破坏时间反演对称性，使弹性背散射成为可能，导致禁带宽度发生振荡；强场下能隙在离散磁场值处完全闭合；弱场下存在一类周期性形变，其主导半经典散射由复无穷远点而非最近转向点控制；预测的边缘电导振荡以磁场本身为周期（而非通常的倒数磁场周期），周期由费米速度和有效g因子决定。；创新点：预测了一种非常规的磁量子振荡：与传统的以倒数磁场为周期的磁振荡不同，该振荡以磁场本身为周期；同时识别出弱场下一类周期性形变中由复无穷远点主导的半经典散射机制，并建立了相应的半经典处理方法。
papers.method_zh: 半经典理论处理（针对复无穷远点控制的散射过程），并辅以微扰论和直接数值计算进行验证和对比。

papers.title: The influence of quantum geometry on the phase boundary and collective excitations of electron liquids and crystals
papers.abstract: Recent experiments on multilayer graphene systems have reinvigorated the study of electron crystallization, now with the inclusion of quantum geometry. In this work, we apply time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) to the $λ$-jellium model to analyze the impact that quantum geometry has on the electronic liquid--crystal phase diagram and how it modifies the collective modes and responses of the liquid and crystal phases. In agreement with recent results utilizing neural quantum states, we find that quantum geometry favours electron crystallization, shifting the transition to higher densities. We also study the instabilities revealed by TDHF in the Fermi liquid ground state at low densities, providing insight into the fluctuations driving the crystallization transition. We further find that quantum geometry reduces the dispersion of the plasmon mode and suppresses Friedel oscillations deep in the liquid phase. Resolving the density response in terms of individual orbitals, we find that this suppression is caused by spectral weight transfer to an out-of-phase inter-orbital mode. Finally, we show that an analogous mode that emerges in the crystal phase corresponds to the breathing mode of an emergent real-space pseudospin skyrmion lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键依据：摘要中使用“apply time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) to the λ-jellium model”进行理论分析，并与“neural quantum states”的已有结果进行对比，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：λ-jellium 模型中的电子液体与电子晶体相，具体研究量子几何对电子液–晶相图、集体激发模式及响应的影响，以及低密度下费米液体基态的不稳定性。摘要提及多层石墨烯系统的实验背景，但实际研究对象为 λ-jellium 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子几何倾向于促进电子结晶，将液–晶相变推向更高密度；量子几何减小等离激元模式的色散，并抑制液相深处的 Friedel 振荡，这种抑制源于谱权重转移到一个反相的轨道间模式；晶体相中出现的一种类似模式对应于涌现实空间赝自旋斯格明子晶格的呼吸模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子几何倾向于促进电子结晶，将液–晶相变推向更高密度；量子几何减小等离激元模式的色散，并抑制液相深处的 Friedel 振荡，这种抑制源于谱权重转移到一个反相的轨道间模式；晶体相中出现的一种类似模式对应于涌现实空间赝自旋斯格明子晶格的呼吸模式。；创新点：将量子几何纳入 λ-jellium 模型的 TDHF 分析，系统揭示了量子几何对电子液–晶相边界、等离激元色散、Friedel 振荡抑制机制（轨道间反相模式的谱权重转移）以及晶体相中赝自旋斯格明子晶格呼吸模式的影响。
papers.method_zh: 含时 Hartree-Fock（TDHF）方法，应用于 λ-jellium 模型；通过分解密度响应到各个轨道来分析谱权重转移；并与近期使用神经量子态（neural quantum states）的结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Exact quantum spin liquids with topological order on maple-leaf and trellis lattices
papers.abstract: We construct spin models with bond-dependent anisotropic interactions on the penta-coordinated maple-leaf and trellis lattices, which yield exact $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quantum spin liquids akin to the Kitaev honeycomb model. We characterize the resulting ground states by their flux sectors, Chern numbers, and topological excitations. Using replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that the gauge fluxes are ordered at sufficiently low temperatures such that every unit triangle has $\pm π/2$-flux, where the sign is uniform across the system, and every unit hexagon (square) has $0$-flux ($π$-flux) within the parameter space of interest. We map out the topological phase diagram for each model, which reveals parameter regimes hosting $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and Ising topological orders, and we derive an analytical expression for the mass term of the Majorana fermions, the vanishing of which indicates a transition between these phases. We further establish the correspondence between individual vortices (i.e., flux excitations) and two species of anyons in the dimer limit, overcoming the obstacle faced by degenerate perturbation theory in treating odd-length elementary plaquettes. Interestingly, we find that two dimer limits of the maple-leaf model with distinct assignments of anyon species can be smoothly connected to each other in the vortex-free sector, but they are separated by fermion-gap-closing transitions in certain two-vortex sectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：论文以“构造自旋模型”（construct spin models）、“精确求解”（exact quantum spin liquids）、“推导解析表达式”（derive an analytical expression）为主，辅以量子蒙特卡洛数值模拟验证，属于以理论构造和解析推导为核心、数值计算为辅助的理论工作。；研究对象：五配位的枫叶（maple-leaf）晶格和网格（trellis）晶格上的键依赖各向异性自旋模型，以及其中涌现的精确 Z₂ 量子自旋液体（类 Kitaev 蜂窝模型）、其拓扑序、规范通量、Chern 数、拓扑激发和任意子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在这两种晶格上构造的键依赖各向异性自旋模型可产生精确的 Z₂ 量子自旋液体；低温下规范通量有序（每个单位三角形为 ±π/2 通量且符号全系统一致，每个单位六边形/正方形分别为 0 通量/π 通量）；模型相图中存在 Z₂ 和 Ising 两种拓扑序，二者之间的转变由 Majorana 费米子质量项消失标志；在二聚体极限下建立了单个涡旋（通量激发）与两类任意子的对应关系；枫叶模型的两个具有不同任意子种类分配的二聚体极限在无涡旋扇区可光滑连接，但在某些双涡旋扇区被费米子能隙闭合转变分隔。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在这两种晶格上构造的键依赖各向异性自旋模型可产生精确的 Z₂ 量子自旋液体；低温下规范通量有序（每个单位三角形为 ±π/2 通量且符号全系统一致，每个单位六边形/正方形分别为 0 通量/π 通量）；模型相图中存在 Z₂ 和 Ising 两种拓扑序，二者之间的转变由 Majorana 费米子质量项消失标志；在二聚体极限下建立了单个涡旋（通量激发）与两类任意子的对应关系；枫叶模型的两个具有不同任意子种类分配的二聚体极限在无涡旋扇区可光滑连接，但在某些双涡旋扇区被费米子能隙闭合转变分隔。；创新点：首次在五配位的枫叶晶格和网格晶格上构造出可精确求解的 Z₂ 量子自旋液体模型，扩展了类 Kitaev 精确可解模型到新的晶格几何；给出了 Majorana 质量项的解析表达式以刻画 Z₂ 与 Ising 拓扑序之间的转变；在二聚体极限下克服简并微扰论对奇数长度格胞的困难，建立了涡旋与两类任意子的对应；揭示了枫叶模型两个二聚体极限在无涡旋扇区可光滑连接、但在双涡旋扇区被能隙闭合转变分隔的新奇现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造键依赖各向异性自旋模型并解析求解；用复制交换量子蒙特卡洛（replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo）模拟确定通量序和绘制拓扑相图；推导 Majorana 费米子质量项的解析表达式；在二聚体极限下建立涡旋与任意子的对应关系（克服了简并微扰论处理奇数长度基本格胞的困难）。

papers.title: Reproducible capillary fluctuation analysis of solid-liquid interfaces for stiffness and anisotropy calculations
papers.abstract: The capillary fluctuation method (CFM) is widely used to compute solid--liquid interfacial properties from atomistic simulations, but its accuracy depends on choices in interface construction, wave-vector selection, sampling, and simulation geometry. Here, we develop a diagnostics-driven workflow for reproducible CFM calculations using pure Al as a representative system. Employing both ribbon models and thick two-dimensional references, we show that apparent linearity of the fluctuation spectrum alone does not ensure reliable stiffness or anisotropy estimates. Instead, a reliable CFM analysis requires a fitting window consistent with both temporal sampling and continuum capillary-wave assumptions, systematic sensitivity tests of the interface identification procedure, explicit propagation of replica variability, and independent verification of model-thickness convergence. We further propose a practical thickness-selection rule based on coexistence-temperature consistency, which enables finite-size effects to be controlled while retaining the substantial computational efficiency of ribbon geometries. By making the main sources of uncertainty explicit and diagnosable, the proposed workflow improves the reliability of the CFM as a quantitative tool and provides a foundation for its broader application to complex solid--liquid interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“atomistic simulations”（原子尺度模拟）、“ribbon models and thick two-dimensional references”（带状模型与厚二维参考体系）、“replica variability”（副本变异性）等，属于基于原子模拟的计算方法学研究，不涉及实验测量。；研究对象：纯铝（pure Al）的固-液界面，具体关注其界面刚度（stiffness）与各向异性（anisotropy）的计算，以及毛细波动方法（CFM）在该体系中的可靠性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭波动谱的表观线性并不能保证得到可靠的刚度或各向异性估计；可靠的CFM分析需要拟合窗口与时间采样及连续毛细波假设一致、对界面识别流程进行系统敏感性测试、显式传播副本变异性，并独立验证模型厚度收敛性。作者进一步提出了一种基于共存温度一致性的厚度选择规则，可在控制有限尺寸效应的同时保持带状几何的计算效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭波动谱的表观线性并不能保证得到可靠的刚度或各向异性估计；可靠的CFM分析需要拟合窗口与时间采样及连续毛细波假设一致、对界面识别流程进行系统敏感性测试、显式传播副本变异性，并独立验证模型厚度收敛性。作者进一步提出了一种基于共存温度一致性的厚度选择规则，可在控制有限尺寸效应的同时保持带状几何的计算效率。；创新点：提出了一套诊断驱动（diagnostics-driven）的可重复CFM工作流程，明确了CFM计算中不确定性的主要来源并使其可诊断；提出了基于共存温度一致性的实用厚度选择规则，在控制有限尺寸效应的同时保留带状几何的计算效率，从而提升CFM作为定量工具的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 采用毛细波动方法（capillary fluctuation method, CFM），结合原子尺度模拟，使用带状模型（ribbon models）和厚二维参考体系（thick two-dimensional references），并进行了拟合窗口选择、界面识别敏感性测试、副本变异性传播分析以及模型厚度收敛性验证。

papers.title: A photonic source with half-a-GHz single-photon flux
papers.abstract: Advanced optical quantum technologies demands high quality quantum light generation at very high rates. Here, we report on a deterministic single-photon source that simultaneously combines high excitation rates with high system efficiency to reach over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux. The source delivers optical power of over 100 pW, as is measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter, enabling a simple and direct way of determining the single-photon source fiber efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：report on、deterministic single-photon source、measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter、in-fibre single-photon flux。；研究对象：确定性单光子源（deterministic single-photon source），研究其在高激发速率下的单光子通量及光纤耦合效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该确定性单光子源同时结合了高激发速率与高系统效率，实现了超过 500 MHz 的光纤内单光子通量，输出光功率超过 100 pW（用现成光功率计即可测量），从而提供了一种简单直接测定单光子源光纤效率的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该确定性单光子源同时结合了高激发速率与高系统效率，实现了超过 500 MHz 的光纤内单光子通量，输出光功率超过 100 pW（用现成光功率计即可测量），从而提供了一种简单直接测定单光子源光纤效率的方法。；创新点：同时实现高激发速率与高系统效率，达到超过 500 MHz 的光纤内单光子通量，并可通过普通光功率计直接、简便地确定单光子源的光纤效率。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如具体材料体系、激发方式、光学腔结构等均未提及）；仅提到使用现成的光功率计（off-the-shelf powermeter）测量输出光功率。

papers.title: Infrared Memory and Scrambling in a Dynamically Opened Coupled-SYK Majorana Junction
papers.abstract: We study a dynamically opened Majorana junction formed by two coupled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) systems. A time-dependent bilinear coupling drives the system from a nearly decoupled to a strongly hybridized regime, providing an interacting realization of a Majorana shutter. Using a low-frequency analysis of the large-$N$ Keldysh theory around the conformal $q=4$ SYK saddle, we find that the opening retains a strong infrared memory, with the associated anomalous response becoming increasingly sensitive to the infrared cutoff. Exact finite-dimensional simulations of two $N=8$ SYK clusters show enhanced inter-sector entanglement, parity transfer, and cross-sector operator scrambling after the opening. These results connect the infrared structure of conformal SYK dynamics with finite-size many-body scrambling and show how a dynamically opened interacting Majorana system can retain long-wavelength memory beyond the quadratic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：large-$N$ Keldysh theory、conformal $q=4$ SYK saddle、Exact finite-dimensional simulations，均为理论与数值计算框架，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：由两个耦合的 Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev（SYK）系统构成的、动态打开的 Majorana 结（Majorana junction），即一个相互作用版本的“Majorana 快门（Majorana shutter）”体系，关注其红外响应、纠缠与 scrambling 行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动态打开过程保留了强烈的红外记忆（infrared memory），相关反常响应对红外截断越来越敏感；对两个 $N=8$ SYK 团簇的有限尺寸模拟显示，打开后出现增强的跨扇区纠缠、宇称转移以及跨扇区算符 scrambling。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动态打开过程保留了强烈的红外记忆（infrared memory），相关反常响应对红外截断越来越敏感；对两个 $N=8$ SYK 团簇的有限尺寸模拟显示，打开后出现增强的跨扇区纠缠、宇称转移以及跨扇区算符 scrambling。；创新点：将共形 SYK 动力学的红外结构与有限尺寸多体 scrambling 联系起来，表明一个动态打开的相互作用 Majorana 系统可以在二次型极限之外保留长波记忆。
papers.method_zh: 在共形 $q=4$ SYK 鞍点附近对 large-$N$ Keldysh 理论做低频分析；并对两个 $N=8$ 的 SYK 团簇进行精确有限维数值模拟。

papers.title: Thermoelectric properties of metal-semiconductor percolation composites
papers.abstract: We analyze thermoelectric response of composite materials comprising homogeneous semiconductor hosts with randomly distributed metallic inclusions. We demonstrate that the properties of such materials are strongly affected by the percolation transition (with background conductivity). We show that in vicinity of percolation threshold, the power factor and the thermoelectric figure of merit strongly depend on both the concentration and arrangement of inclusions. Finally, we identify promising regimes for enhancing the power factor in realistic composites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：analyze、demonstrate、identify promising regimes，摘要中未提及具体实验手段或实验数据。；研究对象：由均匀半导体基体与随机分布的金属夹杂物组成的复合热电材料，以及其中的渗流转变（percolation transition）对热电响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在渗流阈值附近，复合材料的功率因子和热电优值强烈依赖于金属夹杂物的浓度和排列方式；论文还指出了在现实复合材料中增强功率因子的有前景的参数区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在渗流阈值附近，复合材料的功率因子和热电优值强烈依赖于金属夹杂物的浓度和排列方式；论文还指出了在现实复合材料中增强功率因子的有前景的参数区间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但核心贡献在于揭示了渗流转变（含背景电导率）对复合热电材料功率因子和热电优值的强烈调控作用，并识别了增强功率因子的有利区间。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的理论框架或计算方法（如有效介质理论、渗流理论、数值模拟等），仅说明是对复合材料热电响应进行分析。

papers.title: What Photocurrent Versus Effective Voltage Tells Us About Charge Generation in Organic Solar Cells
papers.abstract: The photocurrent of an organic solar cell is routinely plotted against an effective voltage and used to extract an exciton dissociation probability, and through it a free-charge generation efficiency. The photocurrent measures neither. Using a drift-diffusion model in which free-charge generation is field independent and losses occur only by bimolecular recombination, we show that the apparent dissociation probability returned by this procedure lies well below unity even for complete dissociation. Across wide variations of carrier mobility and recombination strength it is a single-valued function of the fill factor and coincides with the short-circuit charge collection efficiency, reporting neither the generation yield nor anything about collection beyond what the fill factor already shows. Even for ideal transport the normalised photocurrent saturates below unity at an intensity-independent first-order limit set by recombination of photogenerated carriers with injected equilibrium charge. Applied to four organic solar cells whose generation efficiencies are known independently, the apparent dissociation probabilities track the short-circuit collection efficiency rather than the generation yield. We therefore suggest this construction not be used, particularly in the high-efficiency non-fullerene acceptor systems that are now state of the art.
